text: Albania is generally a **mountainous** country, with a **Mediterranean** climate and vegetation. In between the hills and mountains, you can sometimes find more flat, agricultural valleys. The mountains are usually quite green, sometimes with patches of exposed rock visible.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞通常是個 **多山** 的國家，擁有 **地中海型** 氣候和植被。在丘陵和山脈之間，有時會發現較為平坦的農業谷地。山區通常相當翠綠，有時可見裸露的岩石區塊。

text: Albania has a lot of **exposed red soil** next to roads.
NOTE: This is less common in Montenegro. Greece on the other hand also has a fair amount of similar-looking red soil, especially closer to the Albanian border.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞的路邊有許多 **裸露的紅土**。
注意：這在蒙特內哥羅較不常見。另一方面，希臘也有不少類似的紅土，尤其是在靠近阿爾巴尼亞邊境的地區。

text: Albania is generally a very mountainous country. This map shows the elevation and relief.

- Low-lying areas are mostly concentrated in the west, around Shkodër, Tirana and Vlorë. This part of the country is characterised by agricultural flatlands and low, undulating hills. Note that the highland plateau around Korçë in the southeast is also very flat.
- The highest mountains can be found in the far north and the far south. In places, these mountains can have an almost alpine look.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞通常是個多山的國家。這張地圖顯示了海拔和地形。
- 低窪地區主要集中在西部，斯庫台、地拉那和夫羅勒周圍。該國這部分地區的特點是農業平原和低矮的丘陵。請注意，東南部科爾察周圍的高原也相當平坦。
- 最高的山脈位於最北部和最南部。在某些地方，這些山脈幾乎呈現阿爾卑斯山脈的樣貌。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The road leading into Theth National Park can typically be recognised by the **tall, jagged mountains**, often with bare mountainsides.
text_zh: 通往泰特國家公園的道路通常可以透過 **高聳崎嶇的山脈** 辨識，通常山坡光禿禿的。

text: The road by the eastern part of the Montenegrin border goes in a valley with tall, **fully exposed cliff sides** along the road.
text_zh: 蒙特內哥羅邊境東部附近的道路沿著道路穿過一個山谷，兩旁有高聳、**完全裸露的懸崖峭壁**。

text: Maja e Papingut is a **massive mountain** in the south of Albania, with an almost completely vertical cliffside near the top. It can be seen from several nearby roads.
text_zh: Maja e Papingut 是阿爾巴尼亞南部一座 **巨大的山脈**，頂部附近幾乎是垂直的懸崖峭壁。從附近幾條道路都可以看到它。

text: A wide, almost **dried out river valley** going southeast to northwest, can be seen along the SH71 between Pishaj and Kokel.
text_zh: 在 Pishaj 和 Kokel 之間的 SH71 公路沿線，可以看到一個寬闊、幾乎 **乾涸的河谷**，從東南向西北延伸。

text: The large **Bay of Vlorë** can be seen on many parts of the SH4 between Vlorë and Orikum. It can be recognized by the large Karaburun peninsula jutting out into the ocean from the south, and the small Sazan island just to its north.
text_zh: 在夫羅勒（Vlorë）和奧里庫姆（Orikum）之間的 SH4 道路上，許多路段都能看到廣闊的 **夫羅勒灣**。它的特徵是南邊有巨大的卡拉布倫半島（Karaburun peninsula）伸入海中，而北邊則有小小的薩贊島（Sazan island）。

text: A couple of small roads northwest of Vlorë can be recognised by the very coastal-looking **Aleppo pine forest**.
text_zh: 在夫羅勒（Vlorë）西北方的一些小路上，你可以看到極具海岸風情的 **阿勒坡松林**。

text: Most of the SH4 between Durrës and Fier is divided by a **basic double guardrail**. The road does not go through any mountains.
text_zh: 都拉斯（Durrës）和費爾（Fier）之間的大部分 SH4 道路都以 **基本的雙層護欄** 分隔。這條路沒有穿過任何山區。

text: The E851 is the only divided road with a basic double guardrail that goes directly **through mountains**.

NOTE: A section of the A3 goes through the mountains but is either divided by a double guardrail with a [fence](https://goo.gl/maps/sEhkf36gQT4r56yMA) above, or with [concrete blocks](https://goo.gl/maps/59RXBrWohChLHePS9).
text_zh: E851 是唯一一條設有基本雙層護欄，並直接 **穿過山區** 的分隔式道路。
注意：A3 的某個路段雖然穿過山區，但其分隔方式要不是雙層護欄上方有 [圍籬](https://goo.gl/maps/sEhkf36gQT4r56yMA)，要不就是使用 [水泥塊](https://goo.gl/maps/59RXBrWohChLHePS9)。

text: The city of Lezhë can often be recognised by the **old castle** at the top of a tall hill.
text_zh: 列澤市通常可以透過其位於高山頂部的**古老城堡**來辨識。

text: Gjirokaster is a city situated on the **western hillside** of a wide valley.
text_zh: 吉羅卡斯特是一座位於寬闊山谷**西側山坡**上的城市。

text: Most of Austria is **mountainous** and covered in forests. However, some areas in the east and northeast are much more flat and agricultural.
text_zh: 奧地利大部分地區**多山**且被森林覆蓋。然而，東部和東北部的一些地區則較為平坦且以農業為主。

text: Soil in most of Brazil is distinctly **red**. It can range from a [light pink](https://goo.gl/maps/n8fe3fywheFqKCTPA) around Mato Grosso to a deep maroon near the Paraná river. The soil is usually not red in the North East, or in the majority of Rio Grande do Sul, however.
NOTE: Parts of Paraguay and the nearby Argentine province of Misiones have deep red soil, as well a handful of other regions around the world.
text_zh: 巴西大部分地區的土壤呈明顯的**紅色**。它的範圍可以從馬托格羅索州附近的[淺粉紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/n8fe3fywheFqKCTPA)到巴拉那河附近的深栗紅色。然而，東北部或南里奧格蘭德州的大部分地區土壤通常不是紅色的。
註：巴拉圭的部分地區以及鄰近的阿根廷米遜內斯省也有深紅色的土壤，世界上還有少數其他地區也是如此。

text: Shown here is an **elevation map** of Brazil. It can help to have a rough mental map of where you can find mountains, and which regions are more flat. The highest mountains are generally found near the southeastern coast.
text_zh: 這裡展示的是巴西的**海拔地圖**。在腦海中對哪裡有山脈、哪些地區較平坦有個大概的概念會很有幫助。最高的山脈通常位於東南海岸附近。

text: Northeastern Brazil can be identified by its **dry soil, shrubs and succulents** (the [Caatinga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caatinga) landscape). In rainy season coverage, the shrubs are still recognisable, but can be deceptively green.
text_zh: 巴西東北部的特徵是**乾燥的土壤、灌木和多肉植物**（[卡廷加](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caatinga)地貌）。在雨季的街景中，灌木仍然清晰可辨，但可能會呈現出具有欺騙性的翠綠色。

text: The **Amazon** is a dense rainforest that comprises 40% of Brazil’s total area. Not many roads are within it, but those that are, mostly go through either biodiverse forest or grassy hills with sparse trees.
text_zh: **亞馬遜**是一片茂密的雨林，占巴西總面積的 40%。裡面的道路不多，但有的話，大多穿過生物多樣性豐富的森林，或是樹木稀疏的草丘。

text: Acre has a unique landscape of **small grass hills** and sparsely growing trees. The roads often do not cut around the hills like in most of Brazil, but ride the hills instead. A similar landscape can also be seen near Maraba in the state of Pará.
text_zh: 阿克里州（Acre）擁有獨特的**小草丘**與稀疏樹木景觀。這裡的道路通常不會像巴西大部分地區那樣繞過山丘，而是直接順著山丘起伏。在帕拉州（Pará）的馬拉巴（Maraba）附近也可以看到類似的景觀。

text: Rural locations in Roraima are mostly open **grassy plains with large, distant mountains** in the background. Occasionally, you are on roads within the mountains. Furthermore, the grass in Roraima is distinctly thin, and grows in bunches.
text_zh: 羅賴馬州（Roraima）的鄉村地區大多是開闊的**草坪平原，遠處背景有雄偉山脈**。偶爾你會處於山中的道路上。此外，羅賴馬州的草明顯較細，且成簇生長。

text: The landscape in Rio Grande do Sul can be hilly or flat with lush, green fields. Southern areas can have some resemblance to Uruguay.
text_zh: 南里奧格蘭德州（Rio Grande do Sul）的景觀可以是丘陵或帶有茂盛綠色田野的平地。南部地區與烏拉圭有些相似。

text: Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo often have **rolling grassy hills**.
text_zh: 米納斯吉拉斯州（Minas Gerais）、里約熱內盧州（Rio de Janeiro）和聖埃斯皮里圖州（Espírito Santo）通常擁有**起伏的草丘**。

text: Espírito Santo, and the surrounding areas, often have large mountains with **exposed rock**.
text_zh: 聖埃斯皮里圖州（Espírito Santo）及其周邊地區經常有帶有**裸露岩石**的大山。

text: The landscape near the town of Uiramuta, in northern Roraima, features a very distinct landscape. It is dry, with large mountains containing numerous “folds.”
text_zh: 羅賴馬州北部威拉穆特鎮附近的景觀非常獨特。那裡氣候乾燥，有著許多具有「摺皺」的大山。

text: Coastal regions in Rio Grande do Sul are recognisable due to being a rare **flat wetland**, which is uncommon in Brazil.
text_zh: 南里奧格蘭德州的沿海地區很好辨認，因為它是巴西罕見的**平坦濕地**。

text: The 364 through Acre is very recognisable due to the **rollercoaster-like landscape and road**: the road uniquely rides the hills rather than snaking around them. There is usually no traffic, and is covered mostly by Generation 4 blue car.
text_zh: 穿過阿克里州的 364 號公路非常容易辨認，因為它有**雲霄飛車般的景觀和道路**：這條道路獨特地直接跨越丘陵，而不是繞著丘陵蜿蜒而行。通常沒有車流，且大部分是由 4 代藍車拍攝。

text: The Amazonas 319 has a very lush, bright green and tropical landscape, as it **cuts through the Amazon rainforest**. The road is flat and mostly unpaved, featuring bright orange soil. However, closer to Manaus the road becomes paved. There are wooden or ladder poles alongside the entire stretch. It is covered by the blue Generation 4 car.
text_zh: 亞馬遜州的 319 號公路擁有非常茂密、鮮綠且具熱帶風情的景觀，因為它**穿越亞馬遜雨林**。這條道路平坦且大部分未鋪設柏油，帶有鮮橘色的土壤。不過，靠近瑪瑙斯時道路會變成鋪設好的柏油路。整段路旁邊都有木桿或梯形桿。這條路是由藍色 4 代車拍攝的。

text: The Pará section of the 163 is often **hilly, curvy, dry, and sometimes hazy**. It has a wide range of amazonian vegetation. The road is frequently trafficked, usually by transportation trucks. It is covered by the blue Generation 4 car in the north and the Smallcam car in the south.
text_zh: 163 號公路帕拉州路段通常**多丘陵、多彎道、乾燥且有時霧濛濛**。它有著豐富的亞馬遜植被。這條道路車流量大，通常是運輸卡車。北方由藍色 4 代車覆蓋，南方由 Smallcam 車覆蓋。

text: Western Canada is very **mountainous**. The highest mountains are in British Columbia, western Alberta, and parts of Yukon. Outside these provinces, large mountains are rare to non-existent in Canada.
text_zh: 加拿大西部**地形多山**。最高聳的山脈位於英屬哥倫比亞省、亞伯達省西部以及育空的部分地區。除了這些省份外，加拿大其他地方極少或完全沒有大山。

text: Yukon has a very northern, **boreal landscape** that is mostly **hilly**,** **sometimes** **with [large mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/j7jVz8vNP3EczZRF8)** **in the distance. Coniferous** **trees line the roads and the further north you go, the thinner and shorter** **the trees get. Older [Generation 2 coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/EuhTiy8inFfLy7BF8) is common in this region.
text_zh: 育空擁有非常偏北的**寒帶景觀**，地形多為**丘陵**，** **有時** **遠處會有[高山](https://goo.gl/maps/j7jVz8vNP3EczZRF8)** **。針葉** **樹沿著道路排列，越往北走，樹木就越稀疏矮小** **。較舊的 [Generation 2 街景覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/EuhTiy8inFfLy7BF8) 在這個地區很常見。

text: The landscape in the interior of southern British Columbia, mostly centred around the towns of **Kamloops and Kelowna**, has a distinct look. It is generally hilly and a little more arid than the rest of BC. The vegetation consists of sprawling brown grasslands, and pine tree forests on the hillsides.
text_zh: 英屬哥倫比亞省南部內陸地區（主要以**甘露市與基隆拿**等城鎮為中心）的景觀非常獨特。這裡總體多丘陵，比英屬哥倫比亞省的其他地區稍微乾旱一些。植被由廣袤的褐色草地和山坡上的松樹林組成。

text: The **Great Plains** are mostly flat, with some rolling hills. There is a lot of agriculture, very few trees, and it is very sparsely populated. The landscape gets drier the further south-southwest you go, with the driest parts near the border with the US state of Montana.
text_zh: **大平原**大多地勢平坦，帶有部分起伏的丘陵。當地農業發達，樹木極少，人口非常稀少。越往西南方走景觀越乾燥，最乾燥的區域靠近美國蒙大拿州的邊界。

text: The region around Rouyn-Noranda in northwestern Québec can mainly be characterised by the **north-south grid, **along with the **slightly hilly** landscape featuring many agricultural fields nestled between the forests, which have many shorter trees as well as thin birches.
text_zh: 魁北克省西北部魯安-諾蘭達周邊地區的主要特徵為**南北向的網格狀道路，**以及**微起伏的丘陵**地形，森林之間鑲嵌著許多農田，森林中有許多較矮小的樹木與纖細的樺樹。

text: Southern Saskatchewan has many river valleys, which means that the province can have a barren **hilly landscape**; much more so than the rest of the Canadian Great Plains, which tends to be really flat.
NOTE: Some of this hilliness extends into southern Alberta and Manitoba.
text_zh: 薩斯喀徹溫省南部有許多河谷，這意味著該省擁有較為荒涼的**丘陵地形**；比起加拿大其他非常平坦的大平原區域要起伏得多。
註：部分丘陵地形延伸到了亞伯達省南部與曼尼托巴省。

text: The Canadian Shield extends through the eastern part of Canada. Therefore, you will commonly see **exposed rocks** on street view in the highlighted area.
text_zh: 加拿大地盾貫穿加拿大東部。因此，在標示的區域內，你經常會在街景中看到**裸露的岩石**。

text: The **Québec City-Windsor Corridor** is the most densely populated part of Canada. It is mostly flat and green, with a patchwork of agriculture and occasional forest cover.
NOTE: This area can look similar to the Great Lakes region in the US.
text_zh: **魁北克市-溫莎走廊**是加拿大人口最密集的區域。當地大多平坦且一片綠意，交織著農田與偶爾出現的森林覆蓋。
註：這個區域看起來可能與美國的五大湖地區相似。

text: The Paphos Forest nature reserve consists of windy mountain roads with red soil on the sides, passing through the mostly uninhabited Mediterranean forest. You will not see any bollards in the reserve, with few exceptions.
text_zh: 帕福斯森林（Paphos Forest）自然保護區由多風的山路組成，兩側帶有紅土，穿過幾乎無人居住的地中海森林。在此保護區內除了少數例外，你看不到任何路樁。

text: Cuboid barriers made of** stones** and mortar are commonly found on Corsica. While by no means unique to Corsica, it is good to consider the island when you see them in rounds with a plausible Mediterranean landscape.
NOTE: Stone barriers with a [rounded top](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VJ9vC1KXSVHkmqHbA) are not found on Corsica.
text_zh: 由**石頭**和水泥砂漿製成的長方體路障常見於科西嘉島。雖然這絕非科西嘉島獨有，但當你在看起來像地中海景觀的回合中看到它們時，考慮這個島嶼準沒錯。
注意：帶有[圓頂](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VJ9vC1KXSVHkmqHbA)的石造路障在科西嘉島上是找不到的。

text: This is a topographic map of France. Notably, the tallest mountains are found in the southeast and on the Spanish border. The north and the west coast is generally quite flat or rolling, while the southern half is often hillier.
text_zh: 這是法國的地形圖。值得注意的是，最高山脈位於東南部和西班牙邊境。北部和西海岸通常相當平坦或起伏平緩，而南部地區則往往更多山丘。

text: Wind turbines are considerably more common in the north of the country.
text_zh: 風力發電機在該國北部相當普遍。

text: **Salt farms**, which appear as flooded trenches with grass medians, are found along the Atlantic coast, most notably around Guérande, Noirmoutier, Île de Ré and Île d'Oléron.
text_zh: **鹽田**分佈在大西洋沿岸，外觀為帶有草地分隔帶的淹水溝渠，最著名的地方包括蓋朗德、努瓦穆捷、雷島和奧萊隆島。

text: On the French Riviera (Côte d'Azur in French, literally translated as **Blue Coast**), you can find regular traffic signposts painted azure blue. Uniquely, [Cagnes-sur-mer](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sP2LGFRxb79XRWro6), west of Nice, will feature lighter, powder blue infrastructure.
NOTE: Blue infrastructure can be found to a lesser extent all across France, particularly [Brittany](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6GwpcWAD5gS5LCE7A), so consider the landscape as well.
text_zh: 在法國蔚藍海岸（法文為 Côte d'Azur，字面意思是**藍色海岸**），你可以找到漆成天藍色的常規交通標誌桿。特別的是，尼斯以西的[卡agnes-sur-mer](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sP2LGFRxb79XRWro6)擁有較淺的粉藍色基礎設施。
注意：全法國各地都能在一定程度上找到藍色的基礎設施，特別是在[布列塔尼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6GwpcWAD5gS5LCE7A)，因此也要把周遭景觀納入考量。

text: The Nusas are **drier **than other regions in Indonesia. Vegetation tends to look less tropical, but instead lower and shrubbier.
NOTE: While less common, other regions such as Java can look similarly dry. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 努沙登加拉群島比印尼其他地區**更為乾燥**。植被看起來比較沒有熱帶風情，反而較為矮小且多灌木。
注意：雖然較少見，但像爪哇這樣的其他地區看起來也可能同樣乾燥. 在猜測之前，請務必尋找其他線索。

text: **Very rounded green hills**, typically covered with clusters of palms, sugarcane or corn, are extremely common within the province of Gorontalo.
text_zh: **非常圓潤的綠色山丘**，通常覆蓋著一叢叢的棕櫚、甘蔗或玉米，在哥倫打洛省非常普遍。

text: This **savannah** landscape is occasionally seen on north Sumba.
NOTE: In Generation 3, you will always see a [white car](https://goo.gl/maps/Dz8hDHNHviJTvKiCA).
text_zh: 這種**莽原**景觀偶爾會在松巴島北部看到。
注意：在第三代相機中，你總是會看到一輛[白車](https://goo.gl/maps/Dz8hDHNHviJTvKiCA)。

text: Red soil with a layer of **white soil on top** of it is most commonly found in the Bangka Belitung islands. On these islands, the white soil can often be seen spilling onto the road.
text_zh: 表面覆蓋著一層**白土**的紅土最常見於邦加勿里洞群島。在這些島上，白土經常會漫溢到路上。

text: The region around **Lake Toba**, in North Sumatra, can be recognized by mountains surrounding the lake and Samosir Island in the middle. Overcast coverage is also common for the region.
text_zh: 北蘇門答臘的**多巴湖**周邊地區，可以透過環繞湖泊的山脈以及位於正中央的沙摩西島來辨識。陰天覆蓋在該地區也很常見。

text: Eastern South Kalimantan features these **karst formations**, particularly along the highway into East Kalimantan.
NOTE: Similar karst formations can be found most commonly in South Sulawesi and West Sumatra.
text_zh: 南加里曼丹東部具有這些**喀斯特地形**，特別是沿著通往東加里曼丹的高速公路沿線。
注意：類似的喀斯特地形最常出現在南蘇拉威西和西蘇門答臘。

text: Palu Bay is a unique slightly north-west facing bay just north of Palu city, which features mountains to the **west **of the bay, and a flat, more urbanised landscape to the **east**.
text_zh: 帕盧灣（Palu Bay）是一個獨特且稍微朝西北的海灣，位於帕盧市正北方，海灣**西**側有山脈，**東**側則是較平坦且較為都市化的景觀。

text: Italy has a **Mediterranean landscape** with a lot of agricultural fields on rolling hills, and forested mountain valleys.
text_zh: 義大利擁有**地中海景觀**，起伏的山丘上有許多農田，以及長滿森林的山谷。

text: The Padan Plain (commonly referred to as Po Valley) can typically be recognized by its complete **flatness**. The plain has some of the worst air quality in Europe, which has led to much of the coverage having a noticeable [haze](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.9090493,11.4587497,3a,52.2y,90.92h,87.93t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sZK0fGSH3oe3u7ooE8Yt2KA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DZK0fGSH3oe3u7ooE8Yt2KA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D81.52424%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192).
text_zh: 波河平原（Padan Plain，通常稱為波谷）通常可以藉由其完全的**平坦度**來識別。該平原擁有歐洲最差的空氣品質之一，這導致許多街景覆蓋都有明顯的[霧霾](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.9090493,11.4587497,3a,52.2y,90.92h,87.93t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sZK0fGSH3oe3u7ooE8Yt2KA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DZK0fGSH3oe3u7ooE8Yt2KA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D81.52424%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192)。

text: The landscape on the southeastern peninsula surrounding Bari has many **olive plantations**, which are often seen together with **bright** **rock walls**. The dirt in the region typically has a noticeably red colour.
Beware that a similar landscape can also be found in [southeastern Sicily](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aRgNqNdsccanmo3m8).
text_zh: 巴里周圍東南半島上的景觀有許多**橄欖園**，經常與**明亮的** **石牆**一同出現。該地區的泥土通常具有明顯的紅色。
請注意，在[西西里島東南部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aRgNqNdsccanmo3m8)也能找到類似的景觀。

text: The alpine region in northern Italy has tall, wide **mountain ranges** and deep valleys.
text_zh: 義大利北部的阿爾卑斯地區擁有高大寬廣的**山脈**和深邃的山谷。

text: The Sicilian landscape is characterised by an **arid**, hilly agricultural landscape, often combined with **rocky mountains**.
text_zh: 西西里島景觀的特徵是**乾旱**、丘陵起伏的農業景觀，通常與**岩石山脈**相結合。

text: Grey **rocks** sticking up from the ground are commonly found on Sardinia, particularly in the northeast.

NOTE: A similar phenomenon can be seen on [Sicily](https://www.google.com/maps/@37.4586829,14.0819986,3a,42.3y,232.74h,94.42t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sGGxh3x_wUzS4zIyD0PD2mA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu), however the landscape will typically be much drier than Sardinia.
text_zh: 從地面突出的灰色**岩石**在薩丁尼亞島很常見，特別是在東北部。
注意：在[西西里島](https://www.google.com/maps/@37.4586829,14.0819986,3a,42.3y,232.74h,94.42t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sGGxh3x_wUzS4zIyD0PD2mA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)可以看到類似的現象，然而該景觀通常會比薩丁尼亞島乾燥得多。

text: The Campione d'Italia **exclave** in Switzerland can be recognized by its low camera, having a long antenna and a flag. There is also a body of water to the west.

NOTE: This antenna can also be found in several areas in [Switzerland](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.8917308,9.0384397,3a,38.3y,19.25h,71.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0x8K6Xn3tuFsalTznE_BGw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656).
text_zh: 位於瑞士的坎皮奧內d'義大利（Campione d'Italia）**飛地**可以藉由其低相機、長天線和一面旗幟來識別。西部還有一個水域。
注意：這個天線也可以在[瑞士](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.8917308,9.0384397,3a,38.3y,19.25h,71.73t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0x8K6Xn3tuFsalTznE_BGw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)的幾個地區找到。

text: **Etna**, the tallest volcano in Europe, can be seen rising above the landscape from far away in eastern Sicily.
text_zh: **埃特納火山**（Etna）是歐洲最高火山，從西西里島東部的遠處就可以看到它高聳於景觀之上。

text: The volcano of **Vesuvius** can often be seen to the south or east from the plains around Naples.
text_zh: 從那不勒斯周圍的平原向南或向東，經常可以看到**維蘇威火山**（Vesuvius）。

text: Plana del Fùcino is a **small plain** surrounded by mountains in the middle of Italy with a grid of roads going completely **north-to-south**.
text_zh: 富奇諾平原（Plana del Fùcino）是義大利中部被群山環繞的**小平原**，有一網格完全呈**南北向**的道路。

text: The island of Pantelleria is a volcanic island southwest of Sicily. Dark volcanic rocks can be seen in the many rock walls of the island, as well as on some houses. It is fairly common to see **yellow lichen** covering the rocks. The island also has a very large amount of cacti.
text_zh: 潘泰萊里亞島（Pantelleria）是西西里島西南部的火山島。島上許多石牆以及一些房屋上都可以看到深色的火山岩。看到覆蓋岩石的**黃色地衣**相當常見。該島也有大量的仙人掌。

text: The Aeolian islands are a volcanic archipelago north of Sicily. Here you will find a mix of volcanic soil and rocks with mediterranean vegetation, like stone pines or olive trees. Like in Sicily, cacti are fairly common.

In the mountains of the islands it is very common to see [touristic white villas](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.4821375,14.9501444,3a,33.7y,13.97h,96.75t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shlfKkMyHDc-zTzWKFLh70g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 伊奧利亞群島（Aeolian islands）是西西里島北部的火山群島。在這裡你會發現火山土壤和岩石與地中海植被（如石松或橄欖樹）的混合。就像在西西里島一樣，仙人掌相當常見。
在群島的山區裡，看到[觀光白色別墅](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.4821375,14.9501444,3a,33.7y,13.97h,96.75t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shlfKkMyHDc-zTzWKFLh70g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)非常普遍。

text: Within the Aeolian islands, Salina can easily be distinguished from the **twin volcanoes** forming a valley across the island.
text_zh: 在伊奧利亞群島中，薩利納島（Salina）可以輕易地從橫跨島嶼形成山谷的**雙子火山**中區分出來。

text: Vulcano is perhaps the most easily recognisable of the Aeolian islands, with its volcano having an almost **white stripe of dirt** following the top of the mountainside. It can typically be spotted from [afar](https://goo.gl/maps/THJBuAvQtzUCYWCZ7) on the island.
text_zh: 武爾卡諾島（Vulcano）或許是伊奧利亞群島中最容易辨認的，其火山的山腰頂部有一條幾乎是**白色的泥土帶**。通常可以從島上的[遠處](https://goo.gl/maps/THJBuAvQtzUCYWCZ7)被發現。

text: The island of Favignana has a distinct topography, with mountains running north to south splitting the island in two.
On both sides of the island you will find flat areas, with many rock walls similar to those found in Bari.
Unlike the other islands near Sicily, Favignana is not volcanic.
text_zh: 法維尼亞納島（Favignana）具有獨特的地形，南北走向的山脈將島嶼一分為二。
在島嶼的兩側，你會發現平坦的區域，有許多類似於巴里發現的石牆。
與西西里島附近的其它島嶼不同，法維尼亞納島不是火山島。

text: The area around Kitui is **semi-arid**, usually mountainous, and has light orange, sandy dirt.
text_zh: 基圖伊（Kitui）周邊地區屬於**半乾燥**氣候，通常多山，並帶有淺橘色的沙質土壤。

text: The northwest part of the country has very limited coverage, most of which is on the A1 or in Sibiloi National Park. It has faintly **tan soil **and sparse** low trees**. A lot of the coverage in this area is very flat, but you can also see hills or mountains.
NOTE: Most of this coverage has a [dirty exposed car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AVaanekywEYdiAqm6).
text_zh: 該國西北部的街景覆蓋非常有限，大部份位於 A1 公路或希比洛伊國家公園（Sibiloi National Park）內。這裡有著淡淡的**棕褐色土壤**與稀疏的**低矮樹木**。這區的大部分街景非常平坦，但你也能看到丘陵或山脈。
注意：此覆蓋的大多數街景都有[髒污的外露車身](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AVaanekywEYdiAqm6)。

text: The western part of the C34 is a flat, **east to west** road. There are two long, straight sections with an abundance of **sugar cane**. Furthermore, you will see a large **mountain range** **north** along the entire mentioned stretches of road.
text_zh: C34 的西部是一條平坦、**東西走向**的道路。這裡有兩段長且筆直的路段，並有大量的**甘蔗**。此外，在上述整段路程的**北方**，你會看到一座巨大的**山脈**。

text: The mountains here can be characterised by **steep rocky cliffs** that can have a slight **purple or red** tint to them. Not much vegetation grows on these mountains - only some grass and shrubs. A small river also runs alongside the road. You can also spot these [brown metallic electricity pylons](https://goo.gl/maps/oscB5ajzy2rpkMi26) and [curved concrete guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/4nGewnwYYuPECDwa8) on the sides of this road.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 這裡的山脈特徵是**陡峭的岩壁**，可能帶有微弱的**紫色或紅色**調。這些山上沒有生長太多植被，只有一些草和灌木。一條小河也沿著道路流過。你還可以在這條路的兩側發現這些[棕色金屬電塔](https://goo.gl/maps/oscB5ajzy2rpkMi26)以及[彎曲的混凝土護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/4nGewnwYYuPECDwa8)。
注意：這段路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: Going further west, you will encounter a very **hilly** landscape. The landscape features a lot of **vegetation** - tall grass, trees, bushes. This road uses these [concrete barriers](https://goo.gl/maps/KP2sH81R7BDqb2wx5) as guardrails, notice the cement above the gaps.
The general southeast to northwest driving direction on this road is also worth noting.
text_zh: 再往西走，你會遇到非常**丘陵**起伏的景觀。這裡的景觀有大量的**植被**——高草、樹木、灌木。這條路使用這些[混凝土護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/KP2sH81R7BDqb2wx5)作為護欄，注意看縫隙上方的水泥。
這條路大致由東南向西北的行駛方向也值得注意。

text: Madeira sometimes uses yellow-and black guardrails on its mountain roads.
text_zh: 馬德拉（Madeira）的山路有時會使用黃黑相間的護欄。

text: The road east of the plateau can be recognized by its unique mountain formations and the black-and-yellow guardrail on the side of the road.
text_zh: 高原以東的道路可以透過其獨特的山脈構造以及路邊的黑黃相間護欄來辨識。

text: Montenegro is a small, **mountainous** country. Inland mountains are lush and green, while most coastal mountains have distinct exposed, light coloured rock. Most roads are also only 1 or 2 lanes wide.
text_zh: 蒙特內哥羅是一個**多山**的小國。內陸山脈蒼翠茂盛，而大多數沿海山脈則有明顯裸露的淺色岩石。大多數道路也只有 1 到 2 個車道寬。

text: Green, **agricultural valleys** with deforested hills to make way for farmland are most commonly seen in the north.
text_zh: 綠色、因砍伐森林改作農田而光禿禿的 **農業河谷** 在北部最常見。

text: The Bay of Kotor has a **touristy and populated** feel to it, with many people dressed in swimwear. A distinct [steep, rocky ridge](https://goo.gl/maps/Sj5ENoJMcprLyLzWA) can also be seen.
text_zh: 科托爾灣給人一種 **觀光且人口稠密** 的感覺，許多人穿著泳衣。也能看到明顯的 [陡峭岩石山脊](https://goo.gl/maps/Sj5ENoJMcprLyLzWA)。

text: **Dry mountains** with a lack of trees are seen around Podgorica, and to the south of it. Vineyards are also commonly seen in this region.
text_zh: 波德里查周邊及南部一帶可以看到缺乏樹木的 **乾燥山脈**。這片地區也很常見到葡萄園。

text: **Pine forests** can be found in the north and a small area north of Nikšić, but most commonly in the **east**.
text_zh: **松樹林** 分布在北部、尼克希奇（Nikšić）以北的一小片區域，但最常見於 **東部**。

text: Durmitor National Park can be recognized by a distinct landscape consisting of **grassy, treeless mountains** with a high-altitude feel.

The town of [Žabljak](https://goo.gl/maps/ityFp93bD3WQweCq5) is situated in this national park, and can be recognized by the landscape but also by the [unique](https://goo.gl/maps/1dyUEW1YaCgDS1SU9) [architecture](https://goo.gl/maps/wQFbfwF88LLTbie77).
text_zh: 杜米托爾國家公園的辨識特徵是具有高山風情、由 **長滿草且無樹木的山脈** 組成的獨特地景。
[扎布利亞克](https://goo.gl/maps/ityFp93bD3WQweCq5)鎮就位於這個國家公園內，可以透過地景以及 [獨特](https://goo.gl/maps/1dyUEW1YaCgDS1SU9)的 [建築風格](https://goo.gl/maps/wQFbfwF88LLTbie77)來辨識。

text: Podgorica is the capital and **largest city** in Montenegro, and can be recognized by the modern buildings, wide roads and modern infrastructure.
text_zh: 波德里查是蒙特內哥羅的首都與 **最大城市**，其特徵是現代化建築、寬敞的道路和現代化基礎設施。

text: These distinct **staircase-like** mountainsides can be seen in the Cemi River Valley.
text_zh: 這些獨特的 **階梯狀** 山坡可以在切米河谷（Cemi River Valley）看到。

text: Many small islands can be seen within **Slansko Lake**.
text_zh: 在 **斯拉恩斯科湖**（Slansko Lake）內可以看到許多小島。

text: The Pljevlja Coal Mine can be recognized by the wide, artificial **wall of gravel**. The mine can often be seen from [afar](https://goo.gl/maps/45CwG7nnsD9NjzXE6).
text_zh: 普列夫利亞（Pljevlja）煤礦可以透過寬闊的人造 **碎石牆** 來辨識。從 [遠處](https://goo.gl/maps/45CwG7nnsD9NjzXE6)經常就能看到該礦場。

text: The Skadar Lake Bridge can be recognized by the **railway** and stone bollards next to the road.
text_zh: 斯庫台湖大橋可以透過道路旁的 **鐵路** 和石質路樁來辨識。

text: Nepal typically uses square concrete poles in the flat areas, and thin metallic poles in the mountainous regions. The poletops vary, but it is often some kind of trident.

The concrete pole with a [trident pole top and triangle supports](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZpwKw2HMY3K4QkQy9) is unique to Nepal. Another common pole almost unique to Nepal is a concrete square pole with [2 vertical insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RBVJCNrtq2enZDS47) on the sides with a wide gap between them. Other poles can often appear very similar to poles in India.
text_zh: 尼泊爾在平原地區通常使用方形水泥電線桿，山區則使用細金屬桿。桿頂造型不一，但通常某種程度上類似三叉戟。
帶有[三叉戟桿頂與三角形支撐結構](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZpwKw2HMY3K4QkQy9)的水泥電線桿是尼泊爾特有的。另一種幾乎是尼泊爾獨有的常見電線桿是方形水泥桿，其兩側帶有[兩個垂直絕緣子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RBVJCNrtq2enZDS47)，且中間有很大的間距。其他電線桿看起來常與印度的電線桿非常相似。

text: The general landscape of North Macedonia consists of relatively **dry grasslands**, and small hills and scattered trees.
text_zh: 北馬其頓的整體景觀由相對**乾燥的草原**、小山丘和散落的樹木組成。

text: Skopje is the capital and by far the largest city. If you see any **large apartments **or **buildings**, you are almost guaranteed to be in Skopje.
text_zh: 斯科普里是首都，也是遠為最大的城市。如果你看到任何**大型公寓**或**建築物**，你幾乎可以保證自己身在斯科普里。

text: Ohrid is the only large city located next to a** lake**.
text_zh: 奧赫里德是唯一位於**湖泊**旁的大城市。

text: These two **extremely rocky hills** are visible in some parts of the city of Prilep.
text_zh: 這兩座**極為岩石密布的山丘**在普里萊普市的某些部分清晰可見。

text: Panama is a tropical country with a lot of hills. You will find a lot of palms and other tropical plants along with drier rolling hills and fields.
text_zh: 巴拿馬是一個熱帶國家，有許多丘陵。你會沿路看到許多棕櫚樹和其他熱帶植物，以及較為乾燥的起伏丘陵和田野。

text: Most roads are paralleled by fences that are partly or fully made out of small trees. The rest of the fence posts are also almost always wooden.
text_zh: 大多數道路旁都有部分或全部由小樹組成的圍籬。其餘的圍籬柱也幾乎都是木製的。

text: **Green tropical landscapes** with palm trees and very tall grass** **are common around Colón and Panama City.
text_zh: **綠意盎然的熱帶景觀**，伴隨棕櫚樹與非常高的草，**在科隆和巴拿馬市周邊很常見。**

text: **Volcanic rocks** that are either scattered on the ground, or built into **rock walls**, are common north of David.
text_zh: 散落地上或砌成**石牆**的**火山岩**，在大衛城以北很常見。

text: The area around David is **very flat**, with lots of fairly **open fields**. Usually, [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/MT8CapwfA7XwFeDw9) will be visible to the north and northeast.
text_zh: 大衛城周邊地區**非常平坦**，有許多相當**開闊的田野**。通常往北和東北方可以看到[山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/MT8CapwfA7XwFeDw9)。

text: The region around Aguadulce is relatively **flat **and features a lot of agricultural fields along with very **brown or orange** soil.
text_zh: 阿瓜杜爾塞周邊地區相對**平坦**，有許多農田以及非常**棕色或橘色**的土壤。

text: The main covered road in the Ngäbe-Buglé province is very **high-altitude** and almost above the clouds. The surrounding mountains tend to be quite **dry**, and the altitude makes for many stunning views.
text_zh: 恩戈貝-布格萊省的主要涵蓋道路**海拔很高**，幾乎高出雲端。周圍的山脈往往相當**乾燥**，高海拔造就了許多絕佳的景色。

text: The road going to Changuinola features a lush and **green hilly landscape**. The weather is **cloudy **or overcast** **on the entire road.
text_zh: 前往樟宜諾拉（Changuinola）的道路有著翠綠且起伏的**綠色丘陵地景**。整條路的氣候都是**多雲**或陰天。

text: Highway 9 going from Panama City north to Colón is a **divided concrete highway**. The road is visibly **grainy **and has a lot of **tar lines**. The landscape is lush and hilly.
text_zh: 從巴拿馬市往北到科隆（Colón）的 9 號公路是一條**分隔式混凝土公路**。路面明顯帶有**顆粒感**且有許多**瀝青線**。地景繁茂且多山。

text: Most of Road 407 features a **freshly paved road**, with visibly **orange soil** on the sides of the road. The southern portion is [hilly](https://goo.gl/maps/jAhhHN6t4w56XvCM6), right before the road quality [deteriorates](https://goo.gl/maps/F59mLWj9TrUS9LXM8).
text_zh: 407 號公路的大部分路段都是**剛鋪好的道路**，道路兩側有明顯的**橘色土壤**。南段是[丘陵地形](https://goo.gl/maps/jAhhHN6t4w56XvCM6)，就在道路品質[惡化](https://goo.gl/maps/F59mLWj9TrUS9LXM8)之前。

text: The region around Changuinola is filled with** banana plantations.**
text_zh: 樟宜諾拉周邊地區佈滿了**香蕉園。**

text: **Sunset **coverage can be found in southern Panama on a small road south of Tonosi.
text_zh: 在巴拿馬南部的東諾西（Tonosi）南方的一條小路上，可以找到**日落**街景覆蓋。

text: A mountainous** **landscape with **pine trees**, **volcanic rocks**, **dry grass**, and gravel roads can be found northeast of Volcán.
text_zh: 沃爾坎（Volcán）東北方可以找到多山的**地景**，有**松樹**、**火山岩**、**乾草**和碎石路。

text: The Serra da Estrela natural park can be recognised by the **rocky mountainous highland landscape**, often combined with yellow and black striped snow poles.
text_zh: Serra da Estrela 自然公園可以透過**多岩石的山區高原景觀**來識別，通常伴隨著黃黑相間的雪樁。

text: Spruce trees are an **evergreen tree** that can be identified by their dense and droopy or parallel branches, and generally are darker in color than most trees.
A similar evergreen tree, a [caucasian fir](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1XKsGPrBJaZiuSXn9), exists in the Caucasus Mountains. It has much more well organized and straighter branches.

NOTE: Larches have branches which point up and are less dense. Some [larches](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jmi4vRoWbfEr8TD37) can look very similar, but can be thought of as having much more unruly branches and look less “healthy”. Nonetheless, use with caution, especially on rounds that look eastern.
text_zh: 雲杉是一種**常綠樹**，可以透過其濃密且下垂或平行的樹枝來識別，且通常顏色比大多數樹木更深。
一種相似的常綠樹 [高加索冷杉](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1XKsGPrBJaZiuSXn9)，存在於高加索山脈。它的枝條更有條理且更筆直。
注意：落葉松的枝條朝上且較不濃密。有些 [落葉松](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jmi4vRoWbfEr8TD37) 看起來非常相似，但可以把它們想像成枝條更加凌亂且看起來比較「不健康」。儘管如此，請謹慎使用，特別是在看起來像東部的回合。

text: **Sandy roadsides** are common in Khanty-Mansi and Yamalo-Nenets and adjacent subjects, as well as areas around [Nizhny Novgorod ](https://goo.gl/maps/NSDDrfNaFFCQPF8z5)on the Volga river. Other notable areas are [Karelia](https://goo.gl/maps/qw6yxjAp1TvUTT7S8), [Murmansk](https://goo.gl/maps/t4fzZ21q1MZrQLzG6), and [western Sakha](https://goo.gl/maps/QHWgEJ1kwRXxAEPu7). Beware, however, that sandy roadsides can less commonly be found near rivers in other regions.
text_zh: **沙質路邊**常見於漢特-曼西、亞馬爾-涅涅茨及相鄰主體，以及伏爾加河上的[下諾夫哥羅德](https://goo.gl/maps/NSDDrfNaFFCQPF8z5)周邊地區。其他值得注意的地區有[卡累利阿](https://goo.gl/maps/qw6yxjAp1TvUTT7S8)、[莫曼斯克](https://goo.gl/maps/t4fzZ21q1MZrQLzG6)和[薩哈西部](https://goo.gl/maps/QHWgEJ1kwRXxAEPu7)。不過請注意，其他地區的河川附近也較少見地能找到沙質路邊。

text: **Red soil** is common in the highlighted areas, notably around Izhevsk and Perm, much of Arkhangelsk Oblast, Leningrad Oblast, and Pskov Oblast, and near Volgograd and Astrakhan. Note that this map is by no means exhaustive; red soil can be found almost anywhere in the country near water or iron mines.
text_zh: **紅土**常見於反白標示的地區，特別是在伊熱夫斯克和彼爾姆周邊、阿爾漢格爾斯克州的大部分地區、列寧格勒州和普斯科夫州，以及伏爾加格勒和阿斯特拉罕附近。請注意，這張地圖絕非詳盡無遺；在全國各地靠近水源或鐵礦的地方幾乎都能找到紅土。

text: The Kamchatka peninsula has unique **grey gravelly soil**, as well as the largest number of **volcanoes** of any region in Russia. They are frequently seen across the peninsula, and in some places can appear quite close such as in [Klyuchi](https://goo.gl/maps/2JTY8XjBELQ2Q2tT8).
text_zh: 堪察加半島擁有獨特的**灰色碎石土壤**，也是俄羅斯所有地區中擁有最多**火山**的地區。它們經常出現在整個半島上，在某些地方看起來相當近，例如在[克柳奇](https://goo.gl/maps/2JTY8XjBELQ2Q2tT8)。

text: Extremely gravelly and sometimes [dark](https://goo.gl/maps/DqAozgnTPiGBAj7g8) soil appears as you approach the mountains east of Yakutsk, starting around Keskil.
text_zh: 當你接近雅庫茨克以東的山脈時（從凱斯基爾一帶開始），會出現極度多礫石且有時呈[深色](https://goo.gl/maps/DqAozgnTPiGBAj7g8)的土壤。

text: **Lush** and diverse forests in a **hilly** landscape characterises the noticeably warmer region around Vladivostok. Most of the coverage is overcast and has a white car with a long antenna. Further south, near the tri-border, you will find a more open [rolling hill landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/ErMpfen9KCE4HGHE7).
text_zh: **蒼翠**且多樣的森林搭配**丘陵**景觀，是海參崴周邊明顯較溫暖地區的特徵。大多數街景覆蓋都是陰天，並有一輛帶有長天線的白車。再往南走，靠近三國交界處附近，你會發現更開闊的[起伏丘陵景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/ErMpfen9KCE4HGHE7)。

text: The eastern half of the Kolyma Highway going to Magadan features a lot of tall **hills** and **mountains**, usually shrouded in a **haze**. Most of the roads are unpaved and feature **dark gravelly soil**. The haze is not present in the western half.
text_zh: 科雷馬公路通往馬加丹的東半段有許多高大的**山丘**和**山脈**，通常籠罩在**薄霧**中。大部分道路都未鋪路，且具有**深色碎石土壤**。西半段則沒有薄霧。

text: A presence of Siberian larches and large mountains on a mostly paved, but sometimes [wide-gravel road](https://goo.gl/maps/ztavuzTw3BXAyNMv6) indicates the main road south of Yakutsk, with [Generation 4 white car](https://goo.gl/maps/4VP2UsVh2FrsQjBg8) appearing north of Berkakit.
text_zh: 西伯利亞落葉松的存在以及大山，搭配一條大多有鋪面但有時為[寬廣碎石路](https://goo.gl/maps/ztavuzTw3BXAyNMv6)的道路，指向雅庫茨克以南的主幹道，而[第四代白車](https://goo.gl/maps/4VP2UsVh2FrsQjBg8)則出現在別爾卡基特以北。

text: The landscape in Buryatia is very unique, containing open grassy landscape with shrubs and mountains. It is lusher near Baikal, but the mountains persist.
text_zh: 布里雅特（Buryatia）的地景非常獨特，包含了帶有灌木與山脈的開闊草地景觀。貝加爾湖（Baikal）附近較為蒼翠，但山脈依然存在。

text: This **forest fire haze** is found near Lake Gusinoye, southwest of Ulan-Ude in Buryatia. While similar to the haze found near [Mirny](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kZY7oWKZW3bHoFp5A), the Buryatia haze coverage can typically be recognised by the **open rolling landscape**, which is not found near Mirny.
text_zh: 這種**森林大火煙霧**（forest fire haze）可以在布里雅特烏蘭烏德（Ulan-Ude）西南方的古西諾耶湖（Lake Gusinoye）附近找到。雖然它類似於[米爾內](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kZY7oWKZW3bHoFp5A)附近的霧氣，但布里雅特的霧霾街景通常可以透過**開闊的起伏地景**來辨認，這是米爾內附近所沒有的。

text: The main road of Altai Republic has a black car long antenna driving north **through the Altai Mountains**, often with **foggy or rainy** coverage.
text_zh: 阿爾泰共和國（Altai Republic）的主幹道有一輛長天線黑車，正**穿過阿爾泰山脈**向北行駛，通常伴隨著**起霧或下雨**的街景覆蓋。

text: **Dry steppe mountains** with a long antenna will usually indicate the Tuva Republic. The south part of the main road in the [Altai Republic](https://goo.gl/maps/C7aWe5KJWyT8Sa3W6) and Tuva can appear similarly dry, so things such as driving direction and cloudiness can be used to distinguish them.
text_zh: **乾草原山脈**配上長天線通常代表圖瓦共和國。[阿爾泰共和國](https://goo.gl/maps/C7aWe5KJWyT8Sa3W6)主幹道的南部和圖瓦看起來可能同樣乾燥，因此可以利用行車方向和多雲程度來區分它們。

text: The landscape in the far north can be recognised by the relatively **flat** landscape, with **very low vegetation**.
text_zh: 極北地區的景觀可以透過相對**平坦**的地形以及**極矮的植被**來辨識。

text: The coverage in Omsk Oblast is some of the most recognizable in Russia. It is typically summer Generation 4 and has a distinct landscape consisting of green agricultural fields, which are interrupted by isolated patches of (primarily) birch forest.
Note that in Generation 3, this landscape can be seen in a much larger area of Russia.
NOTE: This combination of coverage and landscape spills over slightly into the neighbouring Tyumen and Novosibirsk Oblasts (in the south, and near Tatarsk, respectively).
text_zh: 鄂木斯克州（Omsk Oblast）的街景覆蓋是俄羅斯辨識度最高的地方之一。通常是夏季的 Generation 4，並擁有獨特的景觀，包含綠色的農田，其中穿插著（主要為）樺樹林的孤立塊狀林地。
請注意，在 Generation 3 中，這種景觀可以在俄羅斯大得多的區域看到。
注意：這樣的街景覆蓋與景觀組合會稍微延伸到鄰近的秋明州與新西伯利亞州（分別位於南部，以及塔塔尔斯克附近）。

text: The area west of the Caspian Sea can often be recognised by its extremely **dry and flat landscape**, especially in Kalmykia, Astrakhan Oblast, and Dagestan.
text_zh: 裏海以西的地區通常可以透過其極度**乾燥且平坦的景觀**來辨識，特別是在卡爾梅克共和國、阿斯特拉罕州與達吉斯坦共和國。

text: **Grassy fields**, with **bushy vegetation**, in early spring Generation 4 coverage is typical for Dagestan. The landscape can either be completely [flat](https://goo.gl/maps/aagmDRf8TAcokMkn9) or [mountainous](https://goo.gl/maps/ZbWrv4FiuSGLBzHq9). [These flowers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P26tJd6Lf73upk4G8) are also quite common in the Generation 4 Dagestan coverage.
text_zh: 在早春的 Generation 4 街景覆蓋中，帶有**叢生植被的草地**是達吉斯坦的典型特徵。景觀可能是完全[平坦](https://goo.gl/maps/aagmDRf8TAcokMkn9)或是[多山的](https://goo.gl/maps/ZbWrv4FiuSGLBzHq9)。[這些花朵](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P26tJd6Lf73upk4G8)在達吉斯坦的 Generation 4 街景中也相當常見。

text: The **Caucasus mountain range** is one of the largest mountain ranges in Russia. The tallest mountain in Russia, [Mount Elbrus](https://goo.gl/maps/v1yAcshzeyBme85y8), can be found on the border of the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic and Karachay-Cherkessia.
text_zh: **高加索山脈**是俄羅斯最大的山脈之一。俄羅斯最高峰[厄爾布魯士山](https://goo.gl/maps/v1yAcshzeyBme85y8)位於卡巴爾達-巴爾卡爾共和國和卡拉恰伊-切尔克斯共和國的邊界上。

text: **Rocks** along the road are extremely common throughout most of Karelia and Murmansk Oblast. They can also be found in Perm Krai and Buryatia but are less common and smaller in size.
text_zh: 道路旁的**岩石**在卡累利阿和莫曼斯克州的大部分地區極為常見。它們也可能出現在彼爾姆邊疆區和布里雅特共和國，但較不常見且尺寸較小。

text: An open, hilly landscape with low shrubbery and [fireweed](https://goo.gl/maps/jQxpJeqbas286g7i7) usually indicates Murmansk. The lower the shrubbery, the more north it generally is.
text_zh: 開闊的丘陵景觀、低矮的灌木叢以及[柳葉菜](https://goo.gl/maps/jQxpJeqbas286g7i7)通常指向莫曼斯克。灌木叢越低，通常代表位置越偏北。

text: **Generation 4** coverage is quite extensive and is found in most federal subjects in the country. Notably, areas like the Altai mountains and most of the Far East lack Generation 4 completely. Knowing where Generation 4 can be found isn’t the most helpful at the beginner level; other clues like season and car are more important. The dark red signifies areas where all of the coverage is Generation 4.
text_zh: **相機世代 4** 街景相當廣泛，國內大多數聯邦主體都能找到。值得注意的是，阿爾泰山脈和大部分遠東地區完全沒有相機世代 4。對新手來說，知道哪裡有相機世代 4 並不是最有幫助的技巧；季節和車輛等其他線索更為重要。深紅色代表所有街景均為相機世代 4 的區域。

text: [Spring Generation 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mxR9jx12qcpoqiX47) is common in several distinct places, such as around [Kemerovo](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AYpeDSAXjY4DTcfHA) and [Krasnoyarsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6XmSQBo12yhE4peS7), [Orenburg](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gGk8Qr7GFamJkEUj9) and [Kamyshin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Xzo5rBpi1mDngfmw7), around [Lipetsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5rDYMi3imMh6wZ9S6), and in [Moscow city](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CzcoMF9KbXZqerCWA). Differentiating these places typically comes down to landscape, as they tend to be fairly distinct.
text_zh: [春季相機世代 4](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mxR9jx12qcpoqiX47)常見於幾個不同的地方，例如[克麥羅沃](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AYpeDSAXjY4DTcfHA)和[克拉斯諾亞爾斯克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6XmSQBo12yhE4peS7)周邊、[奧倫堡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gGk8Qr7GFamJkEUj9)與[卡梅申](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Xzo5rBpi1mDngfmw7)、[利佩茨克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5rDYMi3imMh6wZ9S6)周邊，以及[莫斯科市內](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CzcoMF9KbXZqerCWA)。區分這些地方通常取決於地貌，因為它們往往具有相當鮮明的特色。

text: Rwanda is generally quite **hilly**, but not very mountainous.
text_zh: 盧安達整體相當**丘陵起伏**，但不太算高山。

text: Most of the soil in Rwanda has a noticeable red tint to it.
text_zh: 盧安達的大多數土壤都有明顯的紅色調。

text: Northeastern Rwanda has less extreme elevation compared to the rest of Rwanda. It more so consists of rolling hills and open agricultural land or undeveloped grassland.
text_zh: 盧安達東北部的海拔起伏比起盧安達其他地區沒那麼極端。它主要由綿延起伏的丘陵、開闊的農田或未開發的草原組成。

text: **Volcanoes **and **volcanic rocks **can be seen in northwestern Rwanda.
text_zh: 在盧安達西北部可以看到**火山**與**火山岩**。

text: The Akagera national park features a very **vegetated **yet **dry **landscape with wide unpaved roads that are reddish-brown in colour.

You can also find these rectangular [waystones](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.9022489,30.722706,2a,20y,181.31h,78.8t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fw%3D900%26h%3D600%26panoid%3DB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.share%26yaw%3D182.35496720275722%26pitch%3D10.959278061715409%26thumbfov%3D18!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu) at intersections.
This coverage was taken with the **brown **Google car.

NOTE: There is some coverage on the [paved section](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.8994956,30.6816537,2a,75y,17.57h,83.7t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D25.209553%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu) south of the national park.
text_zh: 阿卡蓋拉國家公園（Akagera National Park）的地貌非常**植被茂密**卻又**乾燥**，並有著紅褐色的寬闊未鋪裝道路。

你也可以在交叉路口找到這些長方形的[里程碑](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.9022489,30.722706,2a,20y,181.31h,78.8t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fw%3D900%26h%3D600%26panoid%3DB9e29rgnkACmiNgJg_aagQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.share%26yaw%3D182.35496720275722%26pitch%3D10.959278061715409%26thumbfov%3D18!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu)。
此街景覆蓋是用**棕色** Google 車拍攝的。

注意：國家公園南方的一段[鋪裝路段](https://www.google.com/maps/@-1.8994956,30.6816537,2a,75y,17.57h,83.7t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DTssJn2-WhW4H8e6A7POLGQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D25.209553%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu)也有覆蓋。

text: The Nyungwe Forest National Park goes through a **lush** and **hilly **landscape, which has 2 distinct covered roads; The yellow NR10 is paved, with roadlines. **French style bollards** and** green lamp posts** can be seen on the sides of the road. The[ white NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) going south is mostly paved, except for the [southernmost section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6). No roadlines are present.
This coverage was taken with the **brown **Google car.
text_zh: 紐恩威森林國家公園（Nyungwe Forest National Park）穿過一片**蒼翠**且**丘陵起伏**的地貌，這裡有 2 條不同的覆蓋道路：黃色的 NR10 是柏油路，有道路標線。道路兩側可以看到**法式路樁**與**綠色路燈**。往南的[白色 NR26](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DgoieDsNnmxKfitRA) 大部分是柏油路，除了[最南端路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xRs6onjfXYSi7hZS6)外。沒有道路標線。
此街景覆蓋是用**棕色** Google 車拍攝的。

text: A wide river can be seen along the northeastern border of Kigali City.
text_zh: 在基加利市的東北部邊界沿線可以看到一條寬闊的河流。

text: In the north of Serbia in the Vojvodina region, from the Hungarian border to Belgrade, the landscape is **extremely flat**, with no hills whatsoever. A slight ridge however can be seen at Fruška Gora National Park.

A more hilly landscape can be seen in the central-southern region. The most mountainous regions of Serbia are found in the southwest and southeast, where the Dinaric Alps, Carpathian and Balkan mountains run through Serbia.
text_zh: 在塞爾維亞北部的伏伊伏丁那地區，從匈牙利邊境到貝爾格勒一帶，地勢**極其平坦**，完全沒有任何丘陵。不過，在弗魯什卡戈拉國家公園（Fruška Gora National Park）可以看到微小的山脊。
在中南部地區可以看到較為丘陵起伏的地景。塞爾維亞最山多的一帶位於西南部和東南部，狄納爾阿爾卑斯山脈、喀爾巴阡山脈和巴爾幹山脈貫穿其中。

text: Vojvodina, the northern region between the Hungarian border and Belgrade, can be recognized by the **flat**, **agricultural landscape**. The landscape will be completely flat with **no hills whatsoever**.
text_zh: 伏伊伏丁那（位於匈牙利邊境和貝爾格勒之間的北部地區）可以透過**平坦的農業地景**來辨識。地景將會完全平坦，**完全沒有任何丘陵**。

text: This slight **ridge** in an otherwise flat landscape can be seen in Fruška Gora National Park, southwest of Novi Sad.
text_zh: 諾維薩德（Novi Sad）西南方的弗魯什卡戈拉國家公園中，可以看到這種在平坦地景中突兀出現的微小**山脊**。

text: Central-northern Serbia can be recognized by the **slight rolling hills**.
text_zh: 中北部塞爾維亞可以透過**微微起伏的丘陵**來辨識。

text: A similarly rolling landscape can be seen in the southern Morava River basin, however **larger hills and mountains** can be seen.
text_zh: 在南摩拉瓦河（Morava River）流域也可以看到類似的起伏地景，不過能見到**較大的丘陵和山脈**。

text: A **lush**, **green**, **mountainous** landscape can be seen in the south and southeast, along the Bulgarian and Kosovo border.
text_zh: 在南部和東南部沿著保加利亞和科索沃邊境一帶，可以看到一片**蒼翠、綠意盎然的山區**地景。

text: Generation 3 **Fall coverage** can be seen in this region south of Čačak, and a small area around Valjevo.
text_zh: 在恰查克（Čačak）南方這個區域以及瓦列沃（Valjevo）周邊的小區域，可以看到第 3 代的**秋季街景覆蓋**。

text: The distinct **Vršac Mountains** can be seen east of Vršac near the Romanian border. The mountains protrude out from a flat landscape and [vineyards](https://goo.gl/maps/e2hLdz6HJw4kWN778) can commonly be seen to the south of the mountains. The [Vršac Castle](https://goo.gl/maps/WzaCRBL14QdDEdre7) can also be seen atop the mountain.
text_zh: 在弗沙茨（Vršac）東側鄰近羅馬尼亞邊境處，可以看到獨特的**弗沙茨山脈（Vršac Mountains）**。這些山脈從平坦的地景中拔地而起，在山脈的南方常見到[葡萄園](https://goo.gl/maps/e2hLdz6HJw4kWN778)。山頂上也能看到[弗沙茨城堡（Vršac Castle）](https://goo.gl/maps/WzaCRBL14QdDEdre7)。

text: If you are in a mountainous area with orange snow poles that have **two wide reflectors close together**, you are very likely to be near the Norwegian border on, or close to road E12.
text_zh: 如果你身處山區，且橙色雪樁上有**兩個靠得很近的寬反光片**，你非常有可能靠近挪威邊境，或位於 E10 道路附近。

text: If you see a **mixture** of orange and yellow snow poles in a mountainous area, you should be on road E10 close to the Norwegian border.
text_zh: 如果你在山區看到橙色和黃色雪樁的**混合**，你應該是在靠近挪威邊境的 E10 公路上。

text: The Provincial Highway 20, specifically the part that runs through **Yushan National Park**, features tall mountains covered with coniferous trees. The road also utilises these tube-like double guardrails.
NOTE: This road is only covered in Generation 2 and 4. The Generation 4 coverage is very overexposed and features sunny weather.
text_zh: 台 20 線（南橫公路）行經**玉山國家公園**的路段，兩側是覆滿針葉樹的高山，並採用這種管狀雙層護欄。
註：這條路只有第二代與第四代街景覆蓋。第四代的畫面曝光過度，且是晴天拍攝。

text: Shown here is a **topographic map** of the US.

Most significant elevation is in the west: here you will find large mountain ranges, but also more flat, high plateaus. Some parts have lower elevation: good examples are the [Central Valley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Valley_(California)) and [Imperial Valley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_Valley,_California) in California.

Elevation in the east is generally much lower. The most significant amount of elevation is found in the [Appalachians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appalachian_Mountains), low mountain ranges running through the eastern and northeastern US. Good examples of hills in otherwise fairly flat regions are the [Driftless Area](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Driftless_Area) in the Midwest, and [The Ozarks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ozarks) in Missouri and Arkansas.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這裡顯示的是美國的**地形圖**。
最顯著的高海拔地區在西部：在這裡你會找到巨大的山脈，還有較平坦的高原。有些地區海拔較低：很好的例子是加利福尼亞州的[中央谷地](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Valley_(California))和[帝王谷](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_Valley,_California)。

東部的海拔通常低得多。最顯著的高海拔地形位於[阿巴拉契亞山脈](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appalachian_Mountains)，這是一條貫穿美國東部和東北部的低矮山脈。在其他方面相當平坦的地區中，丘陵的好例子包括中西部的[無冰磧區](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Driftless_Area)，以及密蘇里州和阿肯色州的[歐扎克山脈](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ozarks)。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: This is a **forest density map** of the contiguous United States. Eastern and Northern regions of the country typically have much denser tree cover than Western and Southwestern regions.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這是美國本土的**森林密度圖**。該國的東部和北部地區通常比西部和西南部地區擁有密得多得多的樹木覆蓋。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The Great Plains are in the middle of the United States and stretch from the Canadian border in the North, to central Texas in the South. This area is primarily **flat with few trees**. Some areas feature agriculture fields, while others feature dry and barren grassy fields.
text_zh: 大平原（Great Plains）位於美國中部，北起加拿大邊境，南至德州中部。這個地區主要為**地勢平坦且樹木稀少**。有些區域以農田為主，有些則是乾燥荒涼的草地。

text: The Appalachian mountain range is a low mountain range that runs through the eastern states. The general landscape consists of **low, forested mountains**, with beech and oak trees being a common sight.

NOTE: Houses in the south generally have [less storeys](https://goo.gl/maps/7MwjHjPstb8UBtvk8). [New England architecture](https://goo.gl/maps/rZWceRbXuLC9BBo76), commonly consisting of wood panelling, high roofs and a porch, is also more common toward the north, especially in New England.
text_zh: 阿帕拉契山脈（Appalachian mountain range）是一條貫穿東部各州的低矮山脈。整體景觀為**低矮且林木茂密的山區**，常見山毛櫸和橡樹。
注意：南方的房屋通常[樓層較少](https://goo.gl/maps/7MwjHjPstb8UBtvk8)。[新英格蘭建築](https://goo.gl/maps/rZWceRbXuLC9BBo76)通常具有木製外牆、高屋頂和門廊，這在北方也較為常見，特別是在新英格蘭地區。

text: The area stretching from the Canadian border to Northern New Mexico is home to the Rocky Mountains. These jagged, rocky formations often feature many **pine trees** and **visible snow** all year round at the highest peaks. Some areas of the Rocky Mountain Range are noticeably [dry](https://goo.gl/maps/cKv83UNDc6w9dqgK8), with few trees.
text_zh: 從加拿大邊境延伸至新墨西哥州北部的區域是洛磯山脈（Rocky Mountains）的所在地。這些鋸齒狀的岩石地形在最高峰通常有許多**松樹**，且全年都有**清晰可見的積雪**。洛磯山脈的某些地區明顯[乾燥](https://goo.gl/maps/cKv83UNDc6w9dqgK8)，且樹木稀少。

text: The Great Basin, centred around Nevada, can be recognized by the tall, sometimes [snow-capped](https://goo.gl/maps/NXgQnbWsKqmY3ybZ7) mountains in the background. There are dry, but grassy, and slightly **shrubby plains** leading up to the mountains.

The tallest mountains are in Nevada, Utah and California. More [gradual, rocky hills](https://goo.gl/maps/c9o9o95e3rQdr5k57) can be seen in Oregon, and [greener mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/s3pg7tQgwLH5oLg18) can be seen in Idaho and central Utah.
Keep in mind that there are exceptions, so make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 以內華達州為中心的大盆地，其特徵是背景中高聳且有時[覆雪](https://goo.gl/maps/NXgQnbWsKqmY3ybZ7)的山脈。通往山脈的平原乾燥但長滿青草，且略帶**灌木叢生**。
最高聳的山脈位於內華達州、猶他州和加州。在奧勒岡州可以看到較為[平緩的岩石山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/c9o9o95e3rQdr5k57)，而在愛達荷州和猶他州中部則可以看到[較為翠綠的山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/s3pg7tQgwLH5oLg18)。
請記住凡事都有例外，因此在猜測之前務必留意其他線索。

text: Many parts of the Deep South, stretching from Oklahoma to South Carolina, have **reddish soil**. The exact tint of the soil can range from yellow to deep red.
text_zh: 從奧克拉荷馬州延伸到南卡羅來納州的深南部（Deep South）許多地區都有**帶紅色的土壤**。土壤的確切色調可以從黃色到深紅色不等。

text: The area spanning from the Montana Border with Saskatchewan to the Western Great Lakes features many ‘prairie potholes.’ These are areas of low-lying wetlands that feature **marshy grasses** and **small, shallow ponds**.
text_zh: 從蒙大拿州與薩斯喀徹溫省的邊境延伸至西部五大湖的地區，有許多「草原載波穴（prairie potholes）」。這些是低窪的濕地地區，帶有**沼澤草**和**小型淺水池**。

text: The **Nebraska Sandhills** are a recognizable region of rolling hills covered with prairie grass in the central-north part of the state.
text_zh: **內布拉斯加沙丘（Nebraska Sandhills）**是該州中北部一個辨識度很高、覆蓋著草原草的綿延沙丘地區。

text: In the Appalachian area stretching from southern New York to southern Virginia, there are a lot of forest-covered rolling hills, with **flat valleys** dividing them. A majority of the ridges are oriented Southwest to Northeast.
text_zh: 在從紐約州南部延伸至維吉尼亞州南部的阿帕拉契地區，有許多森林覆蓋的起伏山丘，並由**平坦的山谷**分隔開來。多數的山脊走向為西南至東北。

text: The Lower Mississippi River Valley is a **very flat** and open landscape with **red soil** in areas of Tennessee, Arkansas, Mississippi, and Northeast Louisiana. Corn and other crops are common in this area.
text_zh: 下密西西比河谷（Lower Mississippi River Valley）是一個**非常平坦**且開闊的景觀，在田納西州、阿肯色州、密西西比州和路易斯安那州東北部的部分地區帶有**紅土**。玉米和其他農作物在該地區很常見。

text: **The** **Ouachita Mountains** stretch from Eastern Oklahoma into West-Central Arkansas. Unlike the nearby Ozark Mountains, these mountains are typically more steep in nature and easier to see from a distance.
text_zh: **瓦奇塔山脈（Ouachita Mountains）**從奧克拉荷馬州東部延伸至阿肯色州中西部。與鄰近的歐札克山脈（Ozark Mountains）不同，這些山脈通常本質上更為陡峭，從遠處也更容易看見。

text: The Southwest, centred around the Four Corners region of Utah, Arizona, New Mexico, and Colorado, features many **mesas** and **tablelands**. Often, these rock formations will be **red** in colour. Additionally, red soil is common in these areas.
text_zh: 以猶他州、亞利桑那州、新墨西哥州和科羅拉多州四角地區為中心的西南部，有許多**平頂山（mesas）**和**高原（tablelands）**。通常這些岩石地形會呈**紅色**。此外，紅土在這些地區也很常見。

text: Temperate rainforests are found in coastal areas of Washington, Oregon, and Northern California. These rainforests feature many **broadleaf trees, large conifers, and ferns.**
NOTE: These rainforests stretch north into coastal British Columbia and Southeast Alaska as well.
text_zh: 溫帶雨林分佈在華盛頓州、奧勒岡州和加州北部的沿海地區。這些雨林有許多**闊葉樹、大型針葉樹和蕨類植物。**
注意：這些雨林也向北延伸至英屬哥倫比亞省沿海和阿拉斯加東南部。

text: Central Valley, California can be recognized by its **Mediterranean climate**. This is reflected in its agriculture, seen in the vineyards and olive trees that can commonly be found here.
In addition, [rolling hills](https://goo.gl/maps/RU5Wcy6ubkyWLn5U6) can be seen toward the edges of the valley.
text_zh: 加州的中央谷地（Central Valley）可以透過其**地中海型氣候**來識別。這反映在其農業上，在這裡常見到葡萄園和橄欖樹。
此外，在谷地邊緣可以看到[起伏的山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/RU5Wcy6ubkyWLn5U6)。

text: Just west of the metropolitan areas of Austin and San Antonio Texas lies a large area of dry, rocky hills featuring many **yucca** and **prickly pear** plants. [Texas Live Oak](https://goo.gl/maps/w98CVBghQFtndu9C6) trees are the predominant tree type in this area.
text_zh: 就在德州奧斯汀和聖安東尼奧都會區的正西方，坐落著一大片乾燥的岩石丘陵地帶，長有許多**絲蘭**和**刺梨**植物。[德州櫟樹（Texas Live Oak）](https://goo.gl/maps/w98CVBghQFtndu9C6)是該地區主要的樹種。

text: The Rio Grande Valley in South Texas is **extremely flat** and features **shrubby trees** and agricultural fields. This area borders the Mexican state of Tamaulipas.
text_zh: 德州南部的格蘭德河谷（Rio Grande Valley）**極為平坦**，且有**灌木狀的樹木**和農田。這個地區與墨西哥的塔毛利帕斯州接壤。

text: Deep South Florida, between the metropolitan areas of Ft. Myers and Miami, features **dense, jungle-like forests** that have few inhabitants. Roads through these areas are commonly very straight and long.
text_zh: 南佛羅里達深處，在麥爾茲堡（Ft. Myers）和邁阿密等大都會區之間，有著**人煙稀少的茂密叢林般森林**。穿過這些地區的道路通常非常筆直且漫長。

text: The Florida Keys are an archipelago of tropical islands west of Miami. The highway connecting the islands can be recognized by green, tropical vegetation on the sides of the usually single lane road. The soil is also **sandy white**.
Urban locations are also similar, but with many more planted palm trees and mowed grass being a common sight.
text_zh: 佛羅里達礁島群是邁阿密以西的一群熱帶島嶼。連接這些島嶼的公路可以透過通常為單線道道路兩側的綠色熱帶植被來辨識。土壤也是**沙白色**。
城鎮地點也很相似，但有更多種植的棕櫚樹，修剪整齊的草皮也很常見。

text: The area between the cities of Orlando and Lakeland in Florida sometimes feature **low**, **rolling hills.** Lakes and agricultural fields are also common in this area. This is the only main hilly area in central or southern Florida.
text_zh: 佛羅里達州奧蘭多和萊克蘭市之間的地區有時會出現**低矮**、**起伏的丘陵。**湖泊和農田在該地區也很常見。這是佛羅里達州中部或南部唯一的 主要丘陵區。

text: Southwestern Oklahoma features a small area of **rocky, shrubby peaks**. Some of the mountains are also covered in trees, and the rocks can have a pinkish red tint to them.
text_zh: 奧克拉荷馬州西南部有一小片**岩石林立、灌木叢生的山峰**。有些山脈也覆蓋著樹木，岩石可能帶有粉紅色調。

text: Central Colorado is home to a large **North-to-South oriented mountain ridge**. This divides the Rocky Mountains to the west and the Great Plains to the east.These mountains are adjacent to the major metropolitan areas of Boulder, Denver, and Colorado Springs.
text_zh: 科羅拉多州中部是大型**南北走向山脊**的所在地。這將西部的洛磯山脈和大平原分隔開來。這些山脈與波德、丹佛和科羅拉多泉等主要大都會區相鄰。

text: Along the New Mexico and or Texas border there is a ridge of **tall, dry peaks** known as the Guadalupe Mountains. In adjacent areas of both states, [smaller foothills](https://goo.gl/maps/7ugHko97ZYSDBNDG9) of these mountains can be seen with relatively flat tops and shrubby foliage.
text_zh: 在新墨西哥州及／或德州的邊界沿線，有一道被稱為瓜達盧佩山脈（Guadalupe Mountains）的**高大乾旱山脊**。在兩州相鄰的地區，可以看到這些山脈[較小的山前丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/7ugHko97ZYSDBNDG9)，山頂相對平坦，並覆蓋著灌木植被。

text: The Black Hills, located in far Western South Dakota and far Eastern Wyoming, are a series of moderately tall mountains with large amounts of **conifer trees** and **rocky outcroppings**. The surrounding areas are typically much flatter with lesser tree cover.
NOTE: This area has a similar appearance to many areas within the Rocky Mountains, which lie further to the West.
text_zh: 黑山（The Black Hills）位於南達科他州最西部和懷俄明州最東部，是一系列中等高度的山脈，擁有大量的**針葉樹**和**岩石露頭**。周圍地區通常平坦得多，樹木覆蓋率較低。
注意：這個地區的外觀與進一步向西延伸的洛磯山脈中的許多地區相似。

text: Thin **bamboo poles** can be found in rural areas of the northwestern mountains.
text_zh: 細長的**竹竿**可以在西北山區的鄉村地區找到。

text: On a lot of the Alaskan coverage you will be able to see tall, **snow covered mountains**.
text_zh: 在許多阿拉斯加的街景覆蓋中，你會看到高聳的**白雪覆蓋山脈**。

text: The Alaskan towns in the Alexander Archipelago, on the British Columbia border have a unique look. Tall mountains with **lush green forests** can be seen in the background, with the majority of buildings made of wood. In addition, [Generation 2](https://goo.gl/maps/YU3fykwkkhwSeihP8) coverage is often overcast and misty.
NOTE: Coastal areas of [Oregon](https://goo.gl/maps/JUuhjUojP42eQrsF7) and [Washington](https://goo.gl/maps/LikUSJBshaMjidcK6) can have a similar appearance in terms of landscape and foliage.
text_zh: 位於與英屬哥倫比亞省接壤處的亞歷山大群島阿拉斯加城鎮，外觀獨特。背景可見高聳且**綠意盎然的森林**山脈，大部分建築物為木造。此外，[第二代相機](https://goo.gl/maps/YU3fykwkkhwSeihP8)的街景覆蓋通常陰天且多霧。
注意：[奧勒岡州](https://goo.gl/maps/JUuhjUojP42eQrsF7)和[華盛頓州](https://goo.gl/maps/LikUSJBshaMjidcK6)的沿海地區在景觀和植被方面可能外觀相似。

text: Most of the **suburban areas** in Alaska are in and around Anchorage.These areas feature wide roads, commercial districts, and sometimes heavy traffic. Mountains can commonly be seen in the distance.
NOTE: Fairbanks has some [similar areas](https://maps.app.goo.gl/y5zA5uE8KjngyPVV8), but mountains are less prevalent.
text_zh: 阿拉斯加大部分的**郊區**位於安克拉治市區及周邊。這些地區的特色是道路寬敞、商業區林立，有時交通繁忙。遠處通常可見山脈。
注意：費爾班克斯也有一些[類似的區域](https://maps.app.goo.gl/y5zA5uE8KjngyPVV8)，但山脈較不常見。

text: **Juneau**, Alaska’s Capital city, is the largest settlement in the Alaskan panhandle. Therefore, it is much more ‘built up’ than other towns in this area. The city is surrounded by heavily forested mountains and hills.
text_zh: **朱諾**是阿拉斯加州的首府，也是阿拉斯加狹長地帶最大的聚落。因此，相較於該地區其他城鎮，朱諾的「建設」更為完善。這座城市被森林密布的山脈和丘陵環繞。

text: The North end of the Dalton Highway features a **flat** and **snowy landscape** and an overcast sky. A [small ridge](https://goo.gl/maps/fNWJxvvpz1Jzwjs89) of hills can be seen to the west of the highway in certain spots.
text_zh: 道爾頓公路的北端特徵是**平坦**的**雪景**和陰沉的天空。在某些地點，可以在公路西側看到[一條小山脊](https://goo.gl/maps/fNWJxvvpz1Jzwjs89)。

text: The Denali highway, stretching from Cantwell to Paxson in central Alaska, is a mostly **gravel highway** in the ‘Alaska’ mountain range. This road runs generally east to west, is covered in the generation 2 camera, and was taken in late summer, so wildflowers and green shrubby plants are common.
text_zh: 迪納利公路從阿拉斯加中部的坎特威爾延伸到帕克斯頓，是「阿拉斯加」山脈中一條大多為**碎石公路**。這條道路大致呈東西走向，由第二代相機拍攝，且是在夏末拍攝的，因此野花和綠色灌木植物很常見。

text: The Steese Highway is another gravel highway that goes from Fairbanks to the town of ‘Central.’ Similar to the Denali highway, this road runs generally east to west and is covered in generation 2. The difference, however, is that the **mountains** along this road are noticeably **lower** than the ones adjacent to the Denali Highway.
text_zh: 史蒂斯公路是另一條碎石公路，從費爾班克斯通往「中央」鎮。與迪納利公路類似，這條道路大致呈東西走向，並由第二代相機拍攝。然而，不同之處在於，沿著這條路的**山脈**明顯**較低**，比迪納利公路旁邊的山脈矮。

text: Prudhoe Bay, the northernmost town in America covered by street view, can be recognized by **cold, dead** landscape, overcast clouds and lack of tall buildings. A second Google car can sometimes be seen.
text_zh: 普魯德霍灣 (Prudhoe Bay) 是美國最北端有街景覆蓋的城鎮，可以透過其**寒冷、荒蕪**的景觀、陰沉的天空以及缺乏高樓大廈來辨識。有時可以看到第二輛 Google 車。

text: The general landscape consists of **green, tropical** mountains with many palm trees. Small roads are often made of [concrete](https://goo.gl/maps/GENv4jmjUzvkSbp38). Most houses are one storey, and have a simple box design. Plain **metal sheet** roofs are also very common.
text_zh: 整體地貌由**綠意盎然的熱帶**山脈和許多棕櫚樹組成。小路通常由[混凝土](https://goo.gl/maps/GENv4jmjUzvkSbp38)製成。大多數房屋為一層樓，採用簡單的箱型設計。樸素的**金屬板**屋頂也十分常見。

text: **Andorra la Vella** is a capital city surrounded by high mountains, making it recognisable.
NOTE: It is the highest European capital with an altitude of 1023 metres.
text_zh: **安道爾城**是一座四周環繞著高山的首都，因此易於辨識。
注意：它是歐洲海拔最高的首都，海拔 1023 公尺。

text: **Pas de la Casa**, a touristy city in eastern Andorra, can be easily recognized by the plethora of shops and hotels. As it is located at an altitude of 2080 metres, there are no trees visible on the mountains surrounding it.
text_zh: **帕斯德拉卡薩**是安道爾東部的一個觀光城市，很容易透過大量的商店和飯店來辨識。由於它位於海拔 2080 公尺處，周圍的山上看不到任何樹木。

text: Cuverville Island can be recognised by the overcast weather combined with the coastline to the **northwest**. You’ll also see a decent number of penguins, particularly [toward the east](https://goo.gl/maps/EVEBMqPQCrBaeptV6).
text_zh: 庫佛維爾島的特徵是陰沉的天氣，加上**西北方**的海岸線。你也會看到相當數量的企鵝，尤其是在[東邊](https://goo.gl/maps/EVEBMqPQCrBaeptV6)。

text: The trekker can be seen walking through a fantastical landscape consisting of many **desolate valleys** on mainland Antarctica, west of Ross Island.
text_zh: 在羅斯島以西的南極大陸上，可以看到徒步拍攝者穿梭於由許多 **荒涼山谷** 組成的奇幻景觀中。

text: A **vast, snowy landscape **with spread out hills can be seen south of McMurdo station.
text_zh: 在麥克默多站的南方，可以看到一片 **廣闊的雪景**，其中散佈著零星的山丘。

text: While Argentina features a plethora of different landscapes, most of the country is relatively flat, mostly treeless, and sparsely populated. In the absence of better clues, you should consider Argentina when you see landscapes like this with a very “wide open”, desolate feel.
text_zh: 儘管阿根廷擁有豐富多樣的景觀，但該國大部分地區相對平坦、樹木稀少且人口稀疏。在沒有更好線索的情況下，當你看到這種帶有非常「開闊」、荒涼感覺的景觀時，應考慮阿根廷。

text: Far western Argentina typically features a **mountainous** landscape.
NOTE: It is rare to find mountains in eastern Argentina.
text_zh: 阿根廷極西部通常會有**多山**的景觀。
注意：阿根廷東部很少能看到山脈。

text: **Flat** and **barren** landscapes like this are typically found in central southern Argentina.
text_zh: 像這樣**平坦**而**貧瘠**的景觀通常會出現在阿根廷中南部。

text: [Trithrinax Campestris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trithrinax_campestris), or the caranday palm, not to be confused with the Caranday Wax Palm, is a rustic palm native to the Sierras de Córdoba with a broader distribution in San Luis and northern mountainous Argentina. It can be identified by its compact fan-like leaves** **with a trunk hidden by a **coat of dead-leaves.**
text_zh: [田野三稜棕](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trithrinax_campestris)（即卡蘭代棕，切勿與卡蘭代蠟棕混淆）是一種源自科爾多瓦山脈的粗生棕櫚，在聖路易省及阿根廷北部山區分佈較廣。其特徵為**緊密的扇形葉片**，且樹幹被一層**枯葉外殼**所覆蓋。

text: [Trichocereus atacamensis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leucostele_atacamensis), or the **cardón**, is a cactus native to the high elevation mountain ranges of Catamarca, Tucumán, Salta and Jujuy. It can be identified by its candelabra-like appearance and fuzzy golden brown spines.
text_zh: [Trichocereus atacamensis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leucostele_atacamensis)（又稱 **cardón**）是一種原產於卡塔馬卡省、圖庫曼省、薩爾塔省和胡胡伊省高海拔山區的仙人掌。其外觀酷似燭臺，並長有毛茸茸的金棕色刺。

text: These **red mountains** are unique to the RN68 valley in southern Salta.
text_zh: 這些**紅色山脈**是薩爾塔省南部RN68公路山谷所獨有的。

text: The western part of the RN65 in western Tucumán can easily be recognized by this **bendy unpaved road up in the mountains** with its western part [up in the clouds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dq1L8WT13w2QBXpu5).
text_zh: 圖庫曼省西部RN65公路的西部路段，很容易透過這條**蜿蜒崎嶇的山區未鋪設道路**來辨識，其西部路段[雲霧繚繞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dq1L8WT13w2QBXpu5)。

text: Red soil** **with a barren landscape and mountain ranges, can often be seen on the RN76 in **Parque Nacional Talampaya** in western La Rioja.
text_zh: 紅土** **與貧瘠的景觀和山脈，經常可見於拉里奧哈省西部**塔拉姆佩雅國家公園**內的RN76公路。

text: These mountains are typically found west of Córdoba.
NOTE: They are not as high as the mountains in the west.
text_zh: 這些山脈通常位於哥多華省西部。
注意：它們不像西部的山脈那麼高。

text: If you see** vineyards **with mountains in the west and flatness in the east, you are most likely in the outskirts of Mendoza.
NOTE: There are multiple wine regions in Argentina, but the Mendoza wine region is the most recognisable one of them all.
text_zh: 如果你看到**葡萄園**，西邊有山脈而東邊是平坦地形，你很可能位於門多薩省郊區。
注意：阿根廷有多個葡萄酒產區，但門多薩葡萄酒產區是其中最容易辨識的。

text: These snowy mountains to the north can only be found in **Ushuaia**.
NOTE: Ushuaia is the southernmost city of Argentina and the province capital of Tierra del Fuego.
text_zh: 北方的這些雪山只出現在**烏斯懷亞**。
備註：烏斯懷亞是阿根廷最南端的城市，也是火地島省的省會。

text: The area around Warramboo in SA to Madura in WA has a unique landscape. Vegetation is quite **dry **and is made up of shrubs and **wide crowned eucalyptus**. In addition, the soil is sandy with a slight orange tint.
The dry area east of Adelaide and into northwestern Victoria has a similar landscape, with the same vegetation but usually with [**whiter soil**](https://goo.gl/maps/rFiSFVLVUJcF4kGt5).
NOTE: The soil gets more red in the WA side. Redder soil can also be seen more inland on the Victorian side around Mildura. In addition, the Nullarbor Highway has a distinct landscape.
text_zh: 從南澳（SA）的 Warramboo 到西澳（WA）的 Madura 一帶有獨特的景觀。植被相當**乾燥**，由灌木叢和**寬冠桉樹**組成。此外，土壤是沙質的，帶有淡淡的橘色。
阿得雷德以東和維多利亞西北部的乾燥地區有相似的景觀，植被相同，但土壤通常[**更白**](https://goo.gl/maps/rFiSFVLVUJcF4kGt5)。
注意：在西澳（WA）一側，土壤會更紅。在維多利亞（Victorian）一側，米爾杜拉（Mildura）周圍的內陸地區也能看到更紅的土壤。此外，納拉伯公路（Nullarbor Highway）有獨特的景觀。

text: **Lush green or golden **fields can be found in this band from the south of the Yorke Peninsula to Echuca. In the SA side, the landscape should be drier than the Victorian side and more wide crowned eucalyptus can be seen. On the Victorian side, the trees generally have more leaves and are taller.
NOTE: The area near Mount Gambier has a distinct landscape. For more information, see below.
text_zh: 從約克半島（Yorke Peninsula）南部到埃丘卡（Echuca）的這條地帶，可以發現**鬱鬱蔥蔥的綠色或金黃色**田野。在南澳（SA）一側，景觀應該比維多利亞（Victorian）一側更乾燥，可以看到更多寬冠桉樹。在維多利亞（Victorian）一側，樹木通常葉子更多且更高。
注意：甘比爾山（Mount Gambier）附近的地區有獨特的景觀。欲了解更多資訊，請參閱下方。

text: The landscape in inland NSW is mostly flat, and the soil gets **redder **the more inland you go. Vegetation consists of mostly dry **pale-green shrubs**. Further east and on the Queensland and Victorian borders, the climate gets more temperate but is still quite dry and more eucalyptus trees can be seen, with the soil transitioning into a more sandy colour as well as more hills being [visible](https://goo.gl/maps/GhZAimbF6eymrGVE9).
text_zh: 新南威爾斯（NSW）內陸地區的景觀大多平坦，越往內陸，土壤就越**紅**。植被主要由乾燥的**淺綠色灌木叢**組成。再往東，在昆士蘭（Queensland）和維多利亞（Victorian）邊界，氣候變得更溫和，但仍然相當乾燥，可以看到更多的桉樹，土壤也過渡到更沙質的顏色，並且可以看到更多的[山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/GhZAimbF6eymrGVE9)。

text: Tasmania has a **cool temperate** climate which is uncommon in the rest of Australia and is comparable to central-southern Chile or New Zealand. Typical landscape consists of green rolling hills that can look dry in winter coverage. Eucalyptus trees can be seen on the side of roads and on hills in the distance. Rural Tasmania is also quite hilly with dense eucalyptus forests making up the [landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/zcCanmsdVyGkoXY49).
NOTE: Certain areas of Victoria can look similar so make sure to look for other clues.
text_zh: 塔斯馬尼亞擁有澳洲其他地區少見的**涼爽溫帶**氣候，與智利中南部或紐西蘭相當。典型的景觀包含綠色起伏的丘陵，在冬季街景覆蓋中看起來可能較為乾燥。路邊和遠處的山丘上可以看到桉樹。塔斯馬尼亞的鄉村地區丘陵起伏，濃密的桉樹林構成了這裡的[景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/zcCanmsdVyGkoXY49)。
備註：維多利亞州的部分地區看起來可能很相似，因此務必尋找其他線索。

text: The northern QLD city of Cairns is distinct due to its **tropical **vegetation and big green mountains around the city.

NOTE: To differentiate Cairns from other northern Queensland towns, Cairns has many high rise buildings and should feel quite urban. [Divided roads](https://goo.gl/maps/3HjnCsgmbsdWAFMA9) are also common in downtown Cairns, and only commonly seen in Mackay further south, where it is less tropical and more flat.
text_zh: 昆士蘭北部的城市凱恩斯以其**熱帶 **植被和城市周圍綠意盎然的大山為特色。
註：若要將凱恩斯與昆士蘭北部的其他城鎮區分開來，凱恩斯有許多高樓大廈，都市感相當強。凱恩斯市中心也很常見[分隔道路](https://goo.gl/maps/3HjnCsgmbsdWAFMA9)，而這種道路只在更南邊的麥凱（Mackay）較為常見，但麥凱的熱帶感較少且地形更為平坦。

text: The **Grampians** are isolated hills that are viewable from afar within the otherwise flat western Victorian agricultural landscape.
text_zh: **格蘭坪**是一片獨立的山丘，在維多利亞州西部平坦的農業景觀中可以從遠處望見。

text: The **Stirling Ranges** are a small mountain range in Western Australia that tower over a largely flat plain, such that they can be viewed from a distance.
text_zh: **斯特靈山脈**是西澳的一座小山脈，聳立在大片平坦的平原上，因此可以從遠處看見。

text: Dorat Road (23) in the Northern Territory can be easily recognized thanks to its distinct Darwin area landscape and **lack** of road lines.
text_zh: 北領地的 Dorat Road (23) 很容易辨認，這要歸功於其獨特的達爾文地區景觀以及**缺乏**道路標線。

text: All-**yellow **road lines can be seen on roads around Mount Kosciuszko.
In addition, a unique white truck with a **snorkel**, and cab guard can be found.
NOTE: All yellow road lines can also be found in other alpine areas in Victoria and New South Wales, so make sure to look at the landscape and other clues.
text_zh: 科斯丘斯科山周圍的道路上可以看到全**黃色 **道路標線。
此外，還能看到一輛帶有**涉水管**和駕駛室防護欄的獨特白色卡車。
註：全黃色道路標線也可以在維多利亞州和新南威爾斯州的其他高山地區看到，因此請務必觀察景觀和其他線索。

text: **Elevation** is very important when region-guessing Austria based on landscape alone.

The central and western parts of Austria are the most mountainous. The flatter areas are found in the east, mostly near the borders. Note that “flat” is a relative concept in Austria: even in the flat areas, rolling hills are still common.
text_zh: 當單憑景觀在奧地利進行區域猜測時，**海拔高度**非常重要。
奧地利的中部和西部多山。較平坦的區域位於東部，大多靠近邊境。請注意，在奧地利「平坦」是個相對概念：即使在平坦區域，起伏的丘陵依然相當常見。

text: The **highest parts of the Alps** are found in the west and central parts of the country.

The tallest mountains are found in the panhandle of Austria, on the Italian border. These mountains can be recognized by their generally sharper peak and [grander appearance](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1389055,10.2855153,3a,75y,66.33h,92.53t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTDJ_tFCAlBIH4nUIgmkiMw!2e0!5s20200901T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: **阿爾卑斯山最高的部分**部位於該國的西部和中部。

最高聳的山脈位於奧地利的狹長地帶、與義大利交界處。這些山峰的特徵通常是山頂更為尖銳且[氣勢更為雄偉](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1389055,10.2855153,3a,75y,66.33h,92.53t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTDJ_tFCAlBIH4nUIgmkiMw!2e0!5s20200901T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)。

text: **Lake Constance** (known in German as the Bodensee) is a large lake on the western border of Austria. It can be recognized by its vastness, which is not seen in other lakes within the mountainous part of the country.
text_zh: **波登湖**（德語稱為 Bodensee）是位於奧地利西部邊境的大型湖泊。它的辨識特徵在於其廣闊的湖面，這是該國山區其他湖泊所沒有的。

text: Most of the Azores visible on Street View consists of open agricultural fields in a rolling landscape, often with taller round hills in the background.
NOTE: Madeira has a very mountainous landscape, and very rarely has open agricultural fields.
text_zh: 在街景上看到的亞速群島大部分是起伏地形中的開放農田，背景往往有較高的圓形丘陵。
註：馬德拉的地形非常多山，極少有開放農田。

text: The Ardennes, located in the southeast part of Belgium, have a very distinct landscape. You can see a lot of **steep hills**, dense **forests, **and **valleys**.
NOTE: The Ardennes extend partially into France, Luxembourg, and Germany.
text_zh: 阿登地區位於比利時東南部，擁有非常獨特的地貌。你可以看到許多**陡峭的山丘**、密集的**森林**與**山谷**。
注意：阿登地區延伸至法國、盧森堡和德國的部分區域。

text: The coastal plain is extremely flat and consists of so-called **polders**, which are man-made fields at or below sea level, surrounded by many waterways. This landscape is situated near the North Sea coast, as well as near the western part of the border with the Netherlands, particularly around Antwerp.
NOTE: This part of Belgium is especially often confused with the Netherlands. Carefully look around for clues to distinguish the two countries if you find yourself in this landscape.
text_zh: 海岸平原極為平坦，由所謂的**圩田**（polders）組成，這是位於海平面或海平面以下、四周圍繞著眾多水道的人工田地。這種地貌位於北海海岸附近，以及與荷蘭接壤的西部邊境附近，特別是在安特衛普周邊。
注意：比利時的這個部分特別容易與荷蘭混淆。如果你發現自己處於這種地貌中，請仔細觀察四周的線索來區分這兩個國家。

text: Many parts of the Belgian **North Sea coast** are lined by apartment blocks, in a manner that is often derisively referred to as a “wall” of buildings by locals.
Near the coast, you will also sometimes be able to spot a [dune landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/oM2uuPVVeUfEZt839), with low bushes, long grass and sandy soil.
text_zh: 比利時**北海海岸**的許多地方都排滿了公寓大樓，當地人常嘲諷地稱之為建築「牆」。
在海岸附近，你時不時也能發現[沙丘景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/oM2uuPVVeUfEZt839)，帶有矮灌木、長草和沙質土壤。

text: The most typical look of Bermuda is somewhat dense vegetation, consisting of fairly small trees and a lot of bushes, combined with single family houses strewn across the landscape.
text_zh: 百慕達最典型的景色是稍微密集的植被，由相當矮小的樹木和大量灌木組成，並散落著獨棟住宅。

text: Bhutan is a **mountainous** country and most of the coverage is located on its main mountain roads.
NOTE: In the south are flat areas where you cannot see any mountains.
text_zh: 不丹是一個**多山**的國家，大部分的街景覆蓋都位於其主要山路上。
注意：南部是有平坦區域，在那裡你看不到任何山脈。

text: Flat landscapes like this in Bhutan can only be found in the **south**.
NOTE: The coverage in the south is **limited** to the four regions shown on the map.
text_zh: 不丹像這樣平坦的景觀只會在**南部**看到。
注意：南部的街景覆蓋**僅限於**地圖上顯示的四個區域。

text: The **Altiplano** (“high plain”) is an immense highland plateau that dominates most of western Bolivia. It is covered in grasslands that range from green to arid. Some parts are suitable for [agriculture](https://goo.gl/maps/KmBznqSbPKfSGGBF6), whereas other parts are [extremely dry](https://goo.gl/maps/cr2y2FLrMe2nne7R6). Grass growing in [tufts](https://goo.gl/maps/j7Tb5hpmkUkxZ8Bt6) is common (sometimes referred to as “Bolivian hedgehogs” in the community).
NOTE: While it is generally fairly flat, you will often see [hills and mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/NYUhe5JZvzW1EZTF6) around you. However, as a general rule, the road itself will be mostly flat.
text_zh: **阿爾蒂普拉諾高原**（Altiplano，意為「高平原」）是一座廣袤的高山高原，占據了玻利維亞西部的大部分地區。這裡覆蓋著從綠色到乾旱不等的草原。有些部分適合[農業](https://goo.gl/maps/KmBznqSbPKfSGGBF6)，而其他部分則[極度乾燥](https://goo.gl/maps/cr2y2FLrMe2nne7R6)。成[叢](https://goo.gl/maps/j7Tb5hpmkUkxZ8Bt6)生長的草很常見（社群有時稱之為「玻利維亞刺蝟」）。
註：雖然這裡整體來說相當平坦，但你經常會在四周看到[丘陵與山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/NYUhe5JZvzW1EZTF6)。不過原則上，道路本身大多是平坦的。

text: **Lake Titicaca**, on the border with Peru, is the most significant body of water in Bolivia. It is located entirely within the Altiplano. It can be seen from two roads:
- The section of Ruta 1 between Desaguadero and Guaqui. Here, the lake will always be to your north.
- The section of Ruta 2 between San Pablo de Tiquina and Batallas. Here, the lake will mostly be to your south or west.
The landscape around Titicaca is very green, compared to most of the western half of Bolivia.
text_zh: **的的喀喀湖**（Lake Titicaca）部位於與秘魯交界之處，是玻利維亞最重要的水體。它完全位於阿爾蒂普拉諾高原內。從兩條道路上可以看到它：
- Ruta 1 位於 Desaguadero 和 Guaqui 之間的路段。在這裡，湖泊永遠位於你的北方。
- Ruta 2 位於 San Pablo de Tiquina 和 Batallas 之間的路段。在這裡，湖泊大多位於你的南方或西方。
與玻利維亞西部的大部分地區相比，的的喀喀湖周圍的景觀非常翠綠。

text: If you are surrounded by tall mountains, you are likely in the Andes, which goes roughly northwest to southeast in between the Altiplano and the Amazon rainforest.
NOTE: The Altiplano has several [smaller](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xg1B6p6zANJpMNSF9) and [solitary](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pi1ydWitmQto2HLa6) mountains.
text_zh: 如果你被高山環繞，你很可能身處安地斯山脈中，它大致呈西北至東南走向，夾在阿爾蒂普拉諾高原和亞馬遜雨林之間。
註：阿爾蒂普拉諾高原上有一些[較小](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xg1B6p6zANJpMNSF9)且[孤立](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pi1ydWitmQto2HLa6)的山峰。

text: Cochabamba is situated in a large flat valley, where you will almost always see an imposing wall of** mountains to your north**. This is the single most useful and consistent way of distinguishing this city from other places in Bolivia.
text_zh: 科查班巴位於一個廣闊平坦的山谷中，你幾乎總能看到北方有一座令人印象深刻的** 牆狀山脈**。這是將這座城市與玻利維亞其他地方區分開來最實用且一致的方法。

text: Of all the major cities in Bolivia, Oruro is situated in by far the most **dry landscape**.
In Oruro, you will also usually be able to see a large **dry hill to your west**, in an otherwise mostly flat and very arid landscape.
NOTE: Potosí is also located in an arid landscape. However, it is considerably hillier.
text_zh: 在玻利維亞的所有主要城市中，奧魯羅所處的景觀是迄今最為**乾旱的**。
在奧魯羅，在大部分平坦且極度乾旱的景觀中，你通常還能在**西方看到一座乾旱的大丘陵**。
註：波托西（Potosí）也部位於乾旱的景觀中。不過，它的地形要多丘陵得多。

text: Sucre is situated in a very hilly landscape, and as a result you can see many elevation changes in its streets. Uniquely, you can see these **round, tree-covered hills **in many parts of the city.
text_zh: 蘇克雷部位於多丘陵的地形中，因此可以在其街道上看到許多地勢起伏。獨特的是，你在城市的多個區域都能看到這些**被樹木覆蓋的圓形丘陵 **。

text: Potosí is also situated in a very **hilly** landscape, like Sucre. However, its landscape is much more **arid**, with little to no trees atop the hills.
text_zh: 波托西也像蘇克雷一樣部位於非常**多丘陵**的地形中。然而，它的景觀要**乾旱**得多，山頂上幾乎沒有樹木。

text: In many parts of Potosí, you can see this colossal pyramid-shaped mountain called **Cerro Rico**. It is famous for having massive quantities of silver ore, and as a result its surface is stripped bare by extensive mining – which is distinctly visible in the street view coverage.
text_zh: 在波托西的許多地方，你可以看到這座被稱為**富裕之山**（Cerro Rico）的巨大金字塔形山峰。它以擁有大量銀礦而聞名，因此其表面因大規模採礦而被剝光——這在街景覆蓋中清晰可見。

text: Santa Cruz is the only large Bolivian city located in a **tropical** (and flat) landscape.
Note that there are several smaller towns around Santa Cruz that look essentially identical. Some of these have extensive side-road coverage too.
text_zh: 聖克魯斯是玻利維亞唯一部位於**熱帶**（且平坦）景觀中的大城市。
注意，聖克魯斯周圍有幾個小鎮看起來基本上完全相同。其中一些小鎮也有大量的旁道街景覆蓋。

text: The section of Ruta 3 around Pongo, northeast of La Paz, can easily be recognised by the breathtaking views of **enormous mountains**, which are often surrounded by low-hanging clouds. The mountains are also recognizable by their [dark grey rocks](https://goo.gl/maps/vr7NDxSPDkjH5tbKA) lightly covered in greenish grass.
text_zh: 拉巴斯東北方 Pongo 周圍的 Ruta 3 路段很容易透過**巨大山脈**的壯麗景色來辨識，這些山脈往往被低垂的雲霧包圍。這些山脈也可藉由微覆綠草的[深灰色岩石](https://goo.gl/maps/vr7NDxSPDkjH5tbKA)來識別。

text: The N Yungas Road (also popularly known as **Death Road**), is a bendy, small and unpaved road, high up in the mountains east of La Paz. The vegetation is very tropical. The coverage in the southern part of the road is very foggy. True to its unofficial name, this road looks like a very dangerous drive. You can sometimes see some [daring cyclists](https://goo.gl/maps/paLV6Q6yFCrpgxHn7).

NOTE: The northern half of this road looks [less foggy and dangerous](https://goo.gl/maps/qrdtAg2G1jLGSWGP7). However, it should still be recognizable, as it is the only dirt road meandering through jungle hills in Bolivia.
text_zh: 北雲加斯路（N Yungas Road，俗稱**死亡之路**）是一條蜿蜒、狹窄且未鋪設路面的道路，位於拉巴斯以東的高山深處。植被非常具有熱帶特色。該路段南部的街景覆蓋大霧瀰漫。名副其實，這條路看起來開起來非常危險。你時常可以看到一些[大膽的自行車騎士](https://goo.gl/maps/paLV6Q6yFCrpgxHn7)。
