註：這條路的北半段看起來[霧氣較少，也沒那麼危險](https://goo.gl/maps/qrdtAg2G1jLGSWGP7)。不過，它仍然應該很容易辨認，因為這是玻利維亞唯一蜿蜒穿過叢林丘陵的泥土路。

text: Ruta 1 and 4 between La Paz and Oruro is a large **divided highway** that runs through the Altiplano landscape of western Bolivia.

It is the only large, divided highway in the entire country. There are smaller, divided roads in and near some urban areas, but those should be easily distinguishable based on landscape and road size.
text_zh: 拉巴斯和奧魯羅之間的 Ruta 1 與 4 是一條大型**分隔公路**，穿過玻利維亞西部的阿爾蒂普拉諾高原景觀。
這是全國唯一的大型分隔公路。在一些城鎮區域內或附近有較小的分隔道路，但根據景觀和道路大小應該很容易區分。

text: Around Morochata, northwest of Cochabamba on Ruta 25, there is a small isolated piece of coverage that looks **extremely similar to Peru**. It is a dirt road that meanders through a mountainous landscape. Knowing this road can be extremely helpful for country streak purposes.
The western part of this road is located in a [green mountain landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/XYS5bkYquerLYR4C8), with fields on the mountain slopes and lots of eucalyptus trees around.
Towards the east, it transitions into a more [arid high altitude landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/HSCxmB1jeaQpXrfP6) that still looks very similar to Peru.
text_zh: 在科查班巴西北方 Ruta 25 的 Morochata 周圍，有一小段孤立的街景覆蓋，看起來**極度類似秘魯**。這是一條蜿蜒穿過山區景觀的泥土路。了解這條路對於連勝國家模式非常有幫助。
這條道路的西段位於[綠色山脈景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/XYS5bkYquerLYR4C8)中，山坡上有農田，周圍有許多尤加利樹。
向東延伸，它轉變為更加[乾旱的高海拔景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/HSCxmB1jeaQpXrfP6)，看起來仍然非常像秘魯。

text: Ruta 1 between Machacamarca and Guindal runs through an arid landscape where you will often see patches of **snow on the hilltops**, and sometimes even [next to the road](https://goo.gl/maps/G87Gugfru1v6zi1D8). Weather conditions range from **cloudy to fully overcast**, lending this coverage a gloomy look.
The aforementioned road can be regionguessed even more precisely. See the next two tips.
text_zh: Machacamarca 和 Guindal 之間的 Ruta 1 穿過乾旱的景觀，你經常會看到**山頂上有積雪**，有時甚至會出現[在路邊](https://goo.gl/maps/G87Gugfru1v6zi1D8)。天氣狀況介於**多雲到陰天**之間，賦予這段街景覆蓋一種陰沉的外觀。
上述道路可以進行更精確的區域猜測。請參閱接下來的兩個提示。

text: The section north of Challapata runs in a general **NNW direction**, with straight roads in flat terrain, with hills on one or both sides. Weather conditions are a little bit better, with some of the sky visible, especially when [looking south](https://goo.gl/maps/oftxnXzA4Dfp4QACA).
text_zh: Challapata 以北的路段大致呈**北北西走向**，平坦地形上有筆直的道路，單側或雙側有丘陵。天氣狀況稍微好一點，可以看到部分天空，尤其是[向南看](https://goo.gl/maps/oftxnXzA4Dfp4QACA)的時候。

text: The roads around the town of Mataral have recognizable coverage: a **very green, hilly** landscape, and **sunny weather** with only a couple of clouds. While the hills are very green, the vegetation is not very dense, and quite low.

This coverage is limited to Ruta 7 from Comarapa to Mairana, and Ruta 22 to Vallegrande. Other roads in Bolivia with similar vegetation tend to either have different weather (overcast) or terrain (more flat).
text_zh: Mataral 鎮周圍的道路擁有可辨識的街景覆蓋：**非常翠綠、多丘陵的**景觀，以及只有幾朵雲的**晴朗天氣**。雖然丘陵非常翠綠，但植被並不茂密，而且相當矮小。
這段街景覆蓋僅限於從 Comarapa 到 Mairana 的 Ruta 7，以及前往 Vallegrande 的 Ruta 22。玻利維亞其他具有類似植被的道路，要麼天氣不同（陰天），要麼地形不同（更平坦）。

text: The **eastern section of Ruta 4**, east of Santa Cruz, runs in a general east-west direction, through a mostly flat, green landscape. In some places, you can see some low hills. This road has both asphalt and concrete pad sections.
text_zh: 聖克魯斯以東的 **Ruta 4 東段**大致呈東西走向，穿過大部分平坦、翠綠的景觀。在某些地方可以看到一些低矮的丘陵。這條道路同時擁有柏油路段和混凝土板路段。

text: The section of Ruta 4, southwest of Patacamaya, runs through a semi-arid grassland landscape. Many parts of that road between Patacamaya and Callapa have **worn-down grainy asphalt**.
text_zh: Patacamaya 西南方的 Ruta 4 路段穿過半乾旱的草原景觀。Patacamaya 和 Callapa 之間該道路的多個路段擁有**磨損的顆粒狀柏油路面**。

text: On the southwesternmost section of Ruta 4, you can usually see the **Nevado Sajama**, an isolated snow-capped volcano that is very distinct and unlike any other mountain in Bolivia.
When you see Sajama, you will always be south of Callapa and the Desaguadero River. However, you will not always be able to see it on this section of the road, as it is often hidden by hills.
NOTE: The only other place where you can see Nevado Sajama is coverage in the National Park, which is recognizable by its unique Google car.
text_zh: 在 Ruta 4 最西南端的路段上，你通常可以看到**薩哈馬火山**（Nevado Sajama），這是一座孤立的雪山火山，非常獨特且與玻利維亞的任何其他山脈都不同。
當你看見薩哈馬火山時，你一定位於 Callapa 和德薩瓜德羅河以南。然而，你在這段道路上並不總能看到它，因為它經常被丘陵遮擋。
註：唯一能看到薩哈馬火山的其他地方是國家公園內的街景覆蓋，該處可透過其獨特的 Google 車來辨識。

text: Between the villages of Villa Vitalina and Coipasa, there is an isolated stretch of coverage where the Google car drove through **extremely arid** desert terrain. This small road is located close to the southwestern end of Ruta 12, near the Chilean border. It can be hard to spot on the map, because it blends in with the salt flat.

Closer to Villa Vitalina, the car drove over the [salt flat](https://goo.gl/maps/8e9bmY6Fiih6gB5e9). Closer to Coipasa, the car drove on an unpaved dirt road, where you can see [cone-shaped volcanic hills](https://goo.gl/maps/vGForqRVdK6vjo9V7). In both parts, there is virtually no vegetation.
text_zh: 在 Villa Vitalina 和 Coipasa 村莊之間，有一段孤立的街景覆蓋，Google 車駛過了**極度乾旱的**沙漠地形。這條小路位於 Ruta 12 的西南端附近，靠近智利邊境。在地圖上可能很難注意到，因為它與鹽沼融為一體。
靠近 Villa Vitalina 時，車輛駛過了[鹽沼](https://goo.gl/maps/8e9bmY6Fiih6gB5e9)。靠近 Coipasa 時，車輛行駛在未鋪設路面的泥土路上，在那裡你可以看到[錐形的火山丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/vGForqRVdK6vjo9V7)。這兩個部分幾乎都沒有植被。

text: The typical Botswana landscape is **dry and mostly flat**, though a limited amount of elevation can be found in certain regions. Common vegetation includes shrubs, small trees, and occasionally dry, golden grasslands. The soil is arid, sandy and ranges in colour from white to red.
NOTE: The border region of South Africa can have a similar landscape.
text_zh: 典型的波札那景觀為**乾燥且大多平坦**，不過在特定區域仍可看到少許地勢起伏。常見的植被包括灌木、矮樹以及偶爾出現的乾枯金色草原。土壤乾旱呈沙質，顏色從白色到紅色不等。
註：南非的邊境地區可能會有類似的景觀。

text: Botswana has many unique and distinct regions throughout the country. This image breaks down the main factors that differentiate each distinctive landscape by soil, vegetation and other clues.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._

RESOURCE: This image was made possible by the invaluable research done by Jasper Woodard. You can check out his [Botswana videos](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-FLhEAs1GfI) on his [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@jasperwoodard8134).
text_zh: 波札那全國各地有許多獨特且截然不同的區域。這張圖片透過土壤、植被和其他線索，拆解出區分每個獨特景觀的主要因素。
_點擊圖片可放大。_
資源：這張圖片歸功於 Jasper Woodard 所做的寶貴研究。你可以在他的 [YouTube 頻道](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-FLhEAs1GfI) 上查看他的 [波札那影片](https://www.youtube.com/@jasperwoodard8134)。

text: The landscape in the eastern pocket north of Francistown is characterised by **red soil **and a somewhat arid look. The soil in these two areas often looks firm and rocky, rather than sandy or dusty. Trees and bushes with yellowed leaves and other “**autumn**” colours are common. Many trees are bare and withered. You might see fallen leaves on the ground here and there.
text_zh: 法蘭西斯敦以北的東部區域景觀特徵為**紅土**和些許乾旱的外貌。這兩個區域的土壤通常看起來堅硬且多石，而非沙質或多塵。帶有黃葉和其他「**秋天**」色彩的樹木和灌木非常常見。許多樹木皆已枯禿凋零。你可能偶爾會看到地面上的落葉。

text: The A33 is characterised by a landscape that is more **lush** than usual. Trees have lots of green leaves and the grass is very tall. The more north you go, the more lush the vegetation becomes.
text_zh: A33 的特徵是比平常更為**茂密**的景觀。樹木長滿綠葉，草非常高。越往北走，植被就越茂密。

text: The road that runs along Botswana’s southern border, through the town of Middlepits, has asphalt with a distinct **red tint**. The landscape is arid. In some sections, slight hills can be seen.
NOTE: Near the town of Middlepits itself, the soil is very red and dotted with small white pebbles.
text_zh: 沿著波札那南部邊境穿過米德爾皮茨（Middlepits）鎮的道路，其柏油路面帶有明顯的**紅調**。景觀乾燥。在某些路段可以看到起伏的小丘陵。
註：在米德爾皮茨鎮本身附近，土壤非常紅，並點綴著白色的小卵石。

text: The A20 has mostly **clean, recent asphalt**. Some sections of the road are much **thinner** than usual. The landscape is characterised by red soil, dry grey-coloured trees, and very little grass.
text_zh: A20 大部分鋪有**乾淨且較新的柏油**。該道路的某些路段比平常要**窄**得多。景觀特徵為紅土、乾枯的灰色樹木以及極少的草。

text: The beautiful National Park of Northeast Maranhão, known for its **sand dunes** with pools of water, has [walking trekker](https://goo.gl/maps/Pftf1x4EiqezRmw38) and [vehicle coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/atT5yDswGMP8jaWs9). The truck is white with a black bed. The landscape can vary from beach to sandy wetland.
text_zh: 馬拉尼昂州東北部美麗的國家公園以帶有水池的**沙丘**聞名，那裡有[徒步拍攝](https://goo.gl/maps/Pftf1x4EiqezRmw38)和[車輛拍攝覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/atT5yDswGMP8jaWs9)。貨車是白色的，帶有黑色車斗。景觀可以從海灘變化到沙質濕地。

text: The Balkan mountains cut across Bulgaria and divide the country in two distinct halves. North of them, you will find a mostly flat area that goes all the way to the border with Romania.
The Rhodope Mountains start close to Sofia and run South-East into Greece. In them you will find the highest peaks of Bulgaria.
Between both mountain ranges you will find the second biggest flat area of Bulgaria.
The westernmost part of the country usually features many small valleys surrounded by hills and small mountains.
text_zh: 巴爾幹山脈橫貫保加利亞，將該國分為截然不同的兩半。山脈以北是一片大部分平坦的區域，一直延伸到與羅馬尼亞的邊境。
羅多彼山脈始於索菲亞附近，向東南延伸至希臘。保加利亞的最高峰就位於其中。
在這兩座山脈之間，你會找到保加利亞第二大的平坦區域。
該國最西部的地區通常以許多被丘陵和小山環繞的小谷地為特色。

text: The towering mountains of Pirin and Rila National Parks can be recognised by the tall pyramid-shaped peaks, and can be seen from a few different vantage points in Blagoevgrad, Kyustendil and Sofia Provinces.
text_zh: 皮林國家公園和里拉國家公園聳立的山脈可以透過高大的金字塔形山峰來辨認，並且可以從布拉格耶夫格勒省、居斯滕迪爾省和索菲亞省的幾個不同角度看到。

text: The mountains overlooking Vratsa from the southwest have a very distinct “bumpy” shape, and can be seen from afar in the province.
text_zh: 從西南方俯瞰弗拉察的山脈有著非常獨特的「崎嶇」形狀，在該省遠處就能看到。

text: The **low-lying central plain** is home to most agricultural land. The landscape is flat, cultivated, and dotted with villages and farms.
text_zh: **低窪的中部平原**是大部分農地的所在地。地勢平坦，已被開墾，點綴著村莊和農場。

text: **The southwest** is the area with the most elevation in Cambodia. This region is characterized by hills and low mountains. Some inland roads feature dense forest cover, but the coastal areas in particular are fairly densely populated.
text_zh: **西南部**是柬埔寨地勢最高的區域。該地區的特徵是丘陵和低山。部分內陸道路有密集的森林覆蓋，但特別是沿海地區人口相當密集。

text: Near the northern border with Thailand, you can often see a **mountainous ridgeline to your north**. The soil in this region tends to be red, ranging from a slight reddish tinge to deep dark red.

The ridgeline closely corresponds with the border with Thailand. The drop-off to the Cambodian lowland to its south is abrupt. This means that the roads you are on are themselves located in a very flat landscape (see inset map).
text_zh: 在靠近北方與泰國交界的邊境附近，你經常可以在**北方看到山脈脊線**。該地區的土壤往往偏紅，從微紅到深暗紅色不等。
這條脊線與泰國邊界高度吻合。其南側向柬埔寨平原落差陡峭。這意味著你所處的道路本身位於非常平坦的地形中（參見插圖地圖）。

text: Several **unpaved jungle offroads** in the southwest of the country, northeast of Road 48, have a distinct look: red soil, dense jungle, and generally hilly terrain.
NOTE: Some rural jungle roads in the east of the country can look similar. Here, however, the soil tends to be more brownish or orange rather than red.
text_zh: 該國西南部、48 號道路東北方的幾條**未鋪設叢林小路**具有獨特的外貌：紅土、密林以及大致為丘陵的地形。
注意：該國東部的一些鄉村叢林道路看起來也很像。不過這裡的土壤通常偏棕色或橙色，而不是紅色。

text: The coverage close to **Phnum Samkos** has a distinct look: overcast weather, and large, prominent mountains that are visible in the distance. The roads are unpaved and consist of brown soil. Wild, very green vegetation can be seen all around you.
text_zh: **菩薩山**附近的街景有著獨特的外觀：陰天，遠處可見巨大而顯著的山脈。道路是未鋪柏裝的泥土路，呈棕色。四周可以看到野生且非常翠綠的植被。

text: **Preah Monivong National Park** in the south of the country has a unique and recognizable landscape. It is situated on a highland plateau. The soil is white and very rocky. The vegetation consists of stunted, windswept bushes and low trees. The foliage has a distinct dark green tint that contrasts with the white rocks. Some parts of the park are [more forested](https://goo.gl/maps/o8jNzth6g1aK3woh7) but will still have the same rocky soil.
text_zh: 該國南部的**波哥國家公園（Preah Monivong National Park）**擁有獨特且易於辨認的景觀。它位於高地高原上。土壤呈白色且多石。植被由矮小且受風吹侵蝕的灌木與矮樹組成。樹葉帶有獨特的深綠色調，與白石形成鮮明對比。國家公園的某些部分[森林較茂密](https://goo.gl/maps/o8jNzth6g1aK3woh7)，但依然擁有相同的多石土壤。

text: **Road 41**, southwest of Phnom Penh, has a recognizable look and road angle:
- It is a wide road, with a grey and very gravelly road surface
- It runs in a general NNE direction
- The landscape close to the road is flat and agricultural. However, you can often see hills in the distance.
NOTE: There are other roads that can look similar. Therefore, the road angle is very important to identify this road.
text_zh: 金邊西南方的 **41 號道路**具有易於辨認的外觀與道路走向：
- 這是一條寬闊的道路，路面呈灰色且多碎石
- 它大致朝北北東方向延伸
- 道路附近的景觀平坦且為農業區。不過你經常可以看到遠處有丘陵。
注意：還有其他道路看起來很像。因此，道路走向對於辨識這條道路非常重要。

text: The **southern section of Road 76**, south of Krong Saen Monourom, has recognizable coverage: overcast weather, dark asphalt, the presence of outer road lines, and relatively crisp lines for Cambodian standards. Furthermore, a large part of the eastern half of this road runs through hilly terrain with dense jungle.
text_zh: Krong Saen Monourom 以南的 **76 號道路南段**具有易辨認的街景覆蓋：陰天、深色柏油、有外側道路標線，且以柬埔寨標準來說標線相當清晰。此外，這條道路東半部的大部分路段穿過帶有密林的丘陵地形。

text: The **Dempster Highway** (road numbers 5 and 8) connects the Klondike Highway (road number 2) in Yukon with the remote town of Inuvik in the Northwest Territories.

It is very recognizable: it is an unpaved road with Generation 2 coverage, **dark brown** soil, and a tundra landscape with **short trees**. It is mostly hilly and mountainous, but the section between Fort McPherson and Inuvik is flat. Closer to Inuvik, the weather gets cloudy.
text_zh: **鄧普斯特公路**（5 號與 8 號公路）連接育空的克朗代克公路（2 號公路）與西北地區偏遠的因奴維克鎮。
它非常容易辨認：是一條未鋪設泥土路，具有 Generation 2 街景覆蓋、**深褐色**土壤，以及帶有**矮樹**的苔原景觀。地形大多為丘陵與山地，但麥克弗森堡與因奴維克之間的路段平坦。越靠近因奴維克，天氣就越陰沉。

text: The **Top of the World Highway** west of Dawson City in Yukon has overcast Generation 2 coverage and is located mostly high up in the mountains, making it recognizable.
text_zh: 位於育空道森市以西的**世界之頂公路**擁有陰天的 Generation 2 街景覆蓋，且大部分位於高山之上，這使其非常容易辨認。

text: The AB-93 highway through Banff and Jasper National Park features distinct, gradual, and steep mountains with a **sharp **peak on either side of the road. Tall, somewhat thin trees can also be seen.
text_zh: 穿過班夫與賈斯珀國家公園的 AB-93 公路特色是道路兩側都有陡峭、山勢漸升且具有**尖銳**山峰的山脈。也可以看到高大但稍微纖細的樹木。

text: The area near Drumheller, Alberta has distinct canyon-like **treeless **rock formations that comprise the landscape.
text_zh: 亞伯達省德拉姆黑勒附近的區域具有獨特的峽谷狀**無樹**岩石地貌構成景觀。

text: The inland roads of the **Gaspé Peninsula** feature densely forested mountainous terrain. It is particularly common to encounter **overcast **coverage in this region.
text_zh: **加斯佩半島**的內陸道路以森林密佈的山地地形為特色。在這個區域特別容易遇到**陰天**的街景覆蓋。

text: **Route 430 **on Newfoundland runs in a roughly south-southwest to north-northeast direction, with the road lines slightly washed out. It is located in a remote and sparsely populated part of the island. On many sections of the road, the coast is visible to your west. To your east, you will usually see low **balsam fir** forests, and occasionally an imposing [wall of mountains](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.81276,-57.8695694,3a,90y,101.84h,97.1t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sR6Wwvxu7AYQ_tISVDbXjzg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) in the far distance.
text_zh: 紐芬蘭島上的**430號公路**（Route 430）大致呈南南西至北北東走向，道路標線稍微有些褪色。它位於該島偏遠且人口稀疏的地區。在這條路的許多路段，往西可以看見海岸。往東通常會看到低矮的**膠冷杉**（balsam fir）森林，遠處偶爾還能看到壯觀的[山牆](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.81276,-57.8695694,3a,90y,101.84h,97.1t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sR6Wwvxu7AYQ_tISVDbXjzg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)。

text: Grise Fiord is the northernmost covered town in Canada. It can easily be recognized by these **unique mountains** and the ice floes on the coast.
text_zh: 葛里斯菲奧德是加拿大最北端有街景覆蓋的城鎮。透過這些**獨特的山脈**和海岸上的浮冰就能輕鬆認出它。

text: The northern town of Resolute can be recognized by the **barren **landscape with visible **patches of snow**.
text_zh: 北方城鎮雷索盧特可以透過**荒涼的**景觀與隨處可見的**殘雪**來辨識。

text: The town of Qikiqtarjuaq features distinct **mountains**, and **red tinted soil**.
text_zh: 奇奇克塔盧阿克鎮的特徵是顯眼的**山脈**與**偏紅的土壤**。

text: The **northernmost Google Street View coverage in the world** is a trekker on Ellesmere Island in northern Nunavut. It shows a glacier in a rocky, desolate landscape that is devoid of any vegetation.

NOTE: This coverage is sometimes used in maps to improve and standardise the scoring range. As a result, you might encounter this trekker in competitive maps like ACW, despite it not being pinpointable.
text_zh: **全世界最北的 Google 街景覆蓋**是位於努納福特北部埃爾斯米爾島（Ellesmere Island）上的徒步拍攝街景。它展示了荒涼岩石景觀中的冰川，該處完全沒有任何植被。
注意：這種街景有時會被地圖拿來改善並標準化評分範圍。因此，儘管它無法精確定位，你還是可能會在 ACW 等競技地圖中遇到這個徒步拍攝街景。

text: The region of Arica y Parinacota can be recognized by the **smooth, sandy** mountains that may look **slightly eroded**, or have [bulbous formations](https://goo.gl/maps/SRJ52GEYhEnuRU9G6). Valleys are also common, which are rarely seen in other parts of Chile.
text_zh: 阿里卡和帕里納科塔大區可以透過**平坦、沙質**的山脈來辨認，這些山脈看起來可能**有些侵蝕**，或有 [球狀地形](https://goo.gl/maps/SRJ52GEYhEnuRU9G6)。山谷也很常見，這在智利其他地區很少見。

text: These **rocky, uneven** mountains are most commonly seen in Atacama and northern Coquimbo.
text_zh: 這些**岩石質、不平坦**的山脈最常在阿塔卡馬和科金博北部看到。

text: A **rolling, agricultural** landscape, comparable to New Zealand, can be seen on Isla Grande de Chiloé.
NOTE: Similar looking landscapes exist in some other parts of the country, but usually more level.
text_zh: 具有**起伏、農業**風貌、可媲美紐西蘭的景觀，可以在奇洛埃大島上看到。
注意：該國其他一些地區也存在類似外觀的景觀，但通常更平坦。

text: **Lush green valleys**, with rocky mountains and often overcast coverage, can be seen in southern Los Lagos and northern Aysén.
text_zh: **蔥鬱的綠色山谷**，伴隨岩石山脈以及經常陰天的街景覆蓋，可以在洛斯拉戈斯南部和艾森北部看到。

text: Ruta 1 is a coastal road that is easily recognized by the **wall of mountains** to the east, and the **Pacific Ocean** to the west. This image shows the various weather conditions faced on the road to help you make closer guesses.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 1 號公路（Ruta 1）是一條沿海公路，其東側的**山壁**以及西側的**太平洋**使其非常容易辨認。這張圖片展示了該道路上遇到的各種天氣狀況，幫助你做出更精確的猜測。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Part of Ruta 41 is located in a valley, with **snowy** mountains seen in the distance. Many trees and vineyards can commonly be seen toward the west. Triple yellow lines can also be seen from [this point](https://goo.gl/maps/C4gxEFDpZX1Uz6er5).
text_zh: 41 號公路（Ruta 41）的一部分位於山谷中，遠處可以看到**積雪的**山脈。向西常可見到許多樹木和葡萄園。從 [這個點](https://goo.gl/maps/C4gxEFDpZX1Uz6er5) 還可以看到三黃線。

text: **All yellow lines** on a **concrete road** are a good indicator that you are on a paved road in the Magallanes region, in the very south of Chile. The landscape tends to be barren, grassy, and treeless.
NOTE: Ruta 9 only appears in Generation 3, whereas the other roads only appear in Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: **全黃線**加上**水泥路**是你在智利最南端的麥哲倫地區行駛於鋪裝道路上的好指標。景觀往往是貧瘠、長滿草且無樹木的。
注意：9 號公路（Ruta 9）只出現在第 3 代相機中，而其他道路只出現在第 4 代街景覆蓋中。

text: A distinct landscape consisting of a line of snow-capped mountains with two other isolated, symmetrical **snow-capped volcanoes** are seen in Lauca National Park. Most of the roads are newly paved and have a smooth, dark look.
text_zh: 勞卡國家公園（Lauca National Park）中可以看到一條獨特的景觀，由一排覆雪的山脈以及另外兩座孤立、對稱的**覆雪火山**組成。大部分道路都是新鋪設的，具有平坦、深色的外觀。

text: Alto Loa National Reserve can be recognized by the vast, open landscape, followed by **salt pans** leading up to snow-capped **volcanoes**. The road running through the reserve is paved.
text_zh: 阿爾托洛阿國家保護區（Alto Loa National Reserve）可以透過廣闊開闊的景觀來辨認，接著是通往**火山**的**鹽灘**。貫穿保護區的道路是鋪裝道路。

text: **Smooth** mountains with a **reddish** tint are seen in Los Flamencos National Reserve. Salt pans are also a common sight. The reserve uses triple yellow lines, with [short dashes](https://goo.gl/maps/Z18RdxWXXB2c1FAr7) in the west.
text_zh: 洛斯弗拉門戈斯國家保護區（Los Flamencos National Reserve）內可以看到帶有**微紅**色調的**平坦**山脈。鹽灘也是常見的景象。該保護區使用三黃線，西部則有 [短短的虛線](https://goo.gl/maps/Z18RdxWXXB2c1FAr7)。

text: In the west, Nevado Tres Cruces National Park can be recognized by the vast, open landscape, followed by **salt pans** leading up to a line of mountains. The sand has a **reddish **tint.
In the east, the Google Car drives up a mountain pass with views of lightly snow-capped volcanoes and **snow **on the side of the road. The roads in the National Park are paved.
text_zh: 在西部，內瓦多特雷斯克魯塞斯國家公園（Nevado Tres Cruces National Park）可以透過廣闊開闊的景觀來辨認，接著是通往一排山脈的**鹽灘**。沙子帶有**紅色**調。
在東部，Google 車行駛在一個山隘上，可以看到微帶積雪的火山以及路邊的**雪**。國家公園內的道路都是鋪裝道路。

text: Llanos de Challe National Park can be recognized by the **brown** coloured dirt on the roadside, patches of light sand, **juniper** plants, and dark coloured mountains. The sky is overcast in most of the coverage.
NOTE: [Pan de Azúcar National Park](https://goo.gl/maps/QyUDrkEedZ29m21G8) looks similar, however has less vegetation.
text_zh: 亞諾斯德查爾雷國家公園（Llanos de Challe National Park）可以透過路邊**褐色**的泥土、零星的淺色沙地、**杜松**植物以及深色的山脈來辨認。大部分街景覆蓋的天空都是陰天。
注意：[潘德阿蘇卡國家公園](https://goo.gl/maps/QyUDrkEedZ29m21G8) 看起來類似，但植被較少。

text: A **vast**, mostly treeless landscape combined with triple yellow lines are seen in Alto Bio Bio National Reserve. While the reserve may look dry, there is a distinct cold and **high altitude** feel. [Monkey puzzles](https://goo.gl/maps/j5q5VVZamhkFDLSQ6) are also seen toward the east.
NOTE: Ruta 181 leading up to the reserve also has triple yellow lines, however, is less vast with more vegetation.
text_zh: 阿爾托比奧比奧國家保護區（Alto Bio Bio National Reserve）中可以看到**廣闊**、幾乎沒有樹木的景觀結合三黃線。雖然保護區看起來可能很乾燥，但有一種明顯寒冷和**高海拔**的感覺。向東也可以看到 [智利南洋杉](https://goo.gl/maps/j5q5VVZamhkFDLSQ6)。
注意：通往該保護區的 181 號公路（Ruta 181）也有三黃線，然而範圍較不廣闊且植被較多。

text: Villa O’Higgins can be recognized by the large **mountains** located immediately to the east. To the west, [snow-capped mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QGUzYaHWvb8PphP99) are seen in the distance. Street signs, fences and many other structures throughout the village are made of orange-stained wood.
text_zh: 維拉奧伊金斯（Villa O’Higgins）可以透過位於正東方的大型**山脈**來辨認。向西望去，遠處可以看到 [覆雪山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QGUzYaHWvb8PphP99)。村莊各處的街道標誌、柵欄和許多其他結構都是由染成橘色的木頭製成的。

text: The Torres del Paine area can be recognized by the **sharp peaked** mountains, and the trekker walking on a **glacier** along with other people in orange helmets.
text_zh: 百內國家公園地區可以透過**尖峭峰頂**的山脈，以及在**冰川**上行走、身穿橘色頭盔的其他人來識別。

text: There is a **boat trekker** near the north coast of the island. Some of the boat’s white-coloured deck pokes through the blur. Much of the trekker closely hugs the coast; here you can see the steep, rocky coastline of Christmas Island.
text_zh: 島嶼北海岸附近有一個**船隻徒步拍攝**。該艘船白色的甲板有部分從模糊中穿透出來。該徒步拍攝大多緊貼著海岸；在這裡你可以看到聖誕島陡峭、岩石密布的海岸線。

text: The general landscape consists of **bright white sand**, **many palms** and mowed grass. Cocos Islands is significantly less forested or hilly compared to Christmas Island.
text_zh: 整體景觀由**明亮的白沙**、**許多棕櫚樹**與修剪過的草皮組成。與聖誕島相比，科科斯群島的森林或丘陵少得多。

text: The Northern part of the country is characterised by **white, sandy soil** and an arid landscape.
text_zh: 該國北部地區的特徵是**白色沙質土壤**與乾旱景觀。

text: This landscape is typical of the far Northern province of La Guajira: **extreme dryness**, low vegetation and occasional cacti.
In addition, you can often recognise the Uribia-Puerto Bolivar road because of this landscape, the straightness and the train track always present to the East.
text_zh: 這種地貌是極北省份拉瓜希拉省的典型特徵：**極度乾旱**、植被稀疏且偶有仙人掌。
此外，你經常可以透過這種地景、筆直的道路，以及東側始終陪伴的鐵軌，來認出烏里比亞－波利瓦爾港（Uribia-Puerto Bolivar）公路。

text: You can recognise the narrow Ruta 90 landbridge between Barranquilla and Cienaga thanks to the dashed yellow lines and **shallow bodies of water** next to the road. [Open ocean](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xp7rvZ2T77oh1Cbu7) can often be seen to the north.
NOTE: In the older Generation 3 coverage, you will also see tall mountains in the distance.
text_zh: 你可以透過巴蘭幾亞（Barranquilla）和謝納加（Cienaga）之間狹窄的 90 號公路陸橋、虛線黃線，以及路旁**淺水水體**來認出這裡。北方經常可以看到[外海](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xp7rvZ2T77oh1Cbu7)。
注意：在較舊的第 3 代街景覆蓋中，你還會看到遠方的高山。

text: North of the mountains lie the largely flat Caribbean **Lowlands**, characterised by extensive agriculture, grey dirt and a good number of straight roads. Although overcast coverage is common in this area, some locations can be rather [sunny](https://maps.app.goo.gl/N4eAcvDuwTzWmg4n7).
text_zh: 山脈以北是大致平坦的加勒比海**低地**，其特徵是廣泛的農業、灰色泥土和相當多的筆直道路。雖然陰天街景在這個地區很常見，但有些地方可能會相當[晴朗](https://maps.app.goo.gl/N4eAcvDuwTzWmg4n7)。

text: **Sugarcane **plantations can be found in multiple areas across the country, but the major areas are usually distinguishable based on landscape. In the southern area around San Isidro de El General and Buenos Aires you can find sugarcane plantations in [bloom](https://maps.app.goo.gl/j6rWvHbxbdmVnqwRA) with silvery tufts of strands at the top of the plants.
text_zh: **甘蔗**種植園可以在全國多個地區找到，但主要區域通常可以根據地景來區分。在聖伊斯德羅-德爾赫內拉爾（San Isidro de El General）和布宜諾斯艾利斯周圍的南部地區，你可以找到正值[開花期](https://maps.app.goo.gl/j6rWvHbxbdmVnqwRA)、植物頂部帶有銀色穗狀流蘇的甘蔗種植園。

text: **San José** is the capital and by far the largest urban area in Costa Rica. Situated in a valley between multiple mountains, the roads have a noticeable incline. You will see many suburban neighbourhoods and [taller buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cJGHc42e3oXrugMK8) than anywhere else in the country.
text_zh: **聖荷西**是哥斯大黎加的首都，也是遠為最大的都會區。坐落於多座山脈之間的山谷中，道路有著明顯的坡度。你會看到許多郊區鄰里以及全國其他任何地方都沒有的[更高建築物](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cJGHc42e3oXrugMK8)。

text: Costa Rica Institute of Technology can usually be recognised by the **mountain range** which can be seen to the south and east.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加科技學院通常可以透過向南和向東可以看到的**山脈**來辨識。

text: By the entrance of Jardín Botanico Lankester, located southeast of Cartago, you can find a poorly maintained dirt road, surrounded by mountains in the distance, as well as a [sign](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ieKVnVBKyytKZxRw5#extra%5Btags%5D=aigen&extra%5Btags%5D=jardin&extra%5Btags%5D=pinpointable&extra%5Btags%5D=urban&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) with the name of the garden.
Within the garden itself you will find a plethora of different plants, with the [walkways](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZeyMUPjpFPoufVLk9) having many soft curves, and almost never being straight.
text_zh: 在位於卡塔戈東南方的蘭克斯特植物園（Jardin Botanico Lankester）入口處，你可以找到一條維護不良的泥土路，遠處環繞著群山，還有一塊寫著植物園名稱的[標示牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ieKVnVBKyytKZxRw5#extra%5Btags%5D=aigen&extra%5Btags%5D=jardin&extra%5Btags%5D=pinpointable&extra%5Btags%5D=urban&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)。
在花園內部，你會發現大量不同的植物，其[步道](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZeyMUPjpFPoufVLk9)有許多平緩的彎道，幾乎從不筆直。

text: The north-eastern region of Croatia is mostly **flat **and features a lot of agriculture. It is similar in terms of landscape to Hungary and north-western Serbia.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞東北部地區大多是**平原**且有許多農業活動。其景觀與匈牙利及塞爾維亞西北部相似。

text: The Adriatic coast features **rocky **mountains similar to those seen in Montenegro or Albania. Shrubs are more common instead of trees along the coast, especially in the south. This coastal region has a lot of islands and peninsulas.
text_zh: 亞得里亞海沿岸有著類似蒙特內哥羅或阿爾巴尼亞的**岩石**山脈。沿海地區的樹木較少、灌木叢較普遍，尤其是南部。這個沿海地區有許多島嶼和半島。

text: The region northeast of Zadar is recognizable as it is flat with a **mountain **ridge visible in the distance north.
text_zh: 札達爾東北部的地區很好認，因為它是平坦的，且北方遠處可以看到**山**脈稜線。

text: There are a lot of vineyards around the town of **Ilok**, near the Serbian **border**,** **west of Novi Sad. You can find vineyards in other parts of Croatia as well, but they are most common in this area. If you see lots of vineyards in a northeastern Croatian landscape, you are more often than not near Ilok.
text_zh: 位於塞爾維亞**邊境**附近、諾威薩西側的 **伊洛克** 城鎮周邊有許多葡萄園。你也可以在克羅埃西亞的其他地方找到葡萄園，但它們在這個地區最常見。如果你在克羅埃西亞東北部的地貌中看到大量葡萄園，十之八九你都在伊洛克附近。

text: The western half of Curaçao is characterised by a semi-arid **rural** **landscape** with green, but dry hills. Houses are spread apart, with the roads in the west quite narrow in width.
text_zh: 古拉索的西半部以半乾旱的**鄉村** **地貌**為特徵，帶有綠色但乾燥的山丘。房屋分佈散落，西部的道路寬度相當窄。

text: The island has a Mediterranean landscape, with bright exposed rock, olive trees, palm trees, cypress trees, and green coastal farmland. The interior consists of pine forests in the mountains.
text_zh: 這座島嶼擁有地中海景觀，有明亮的裸露岩石、橄欖樹、棕櫚樹、柏樹以及翠綠的沿海農田。內陸山區則是由松樹林組成。

text: Being a small island, the terrain will be the easiest way to narrow down your location. Most of the country is hilly to mountainous, with the centre having the highest elevation, that you can use to orient yourself.
text_zh: 作為一個小島，地形會是縮小地區範圍最簡單的方法。全國大部分地區從丘陵到山脈都有，中央地帶海拔最高，你可以利用這一點來辨別方向。

text: In the northeast of Cyprus, you will often be able to see the** Kyrenia Mountain ridge** to the **north**, overlooking the otherwise flat farmland.
text_zh: 在賽普勒斯東北部，你通常可以看到**吉里山脈（Kyrenia Mountain ridge）**位於**北方**，俯瞰著其他方面較為平坦的農田。

text: Famagusta can easily be recognised by the mostly flat landscape, with lots of red fields. Maybe more importantly though, all of the coverage is **shitcam**.
NOTE: Shitcam is quite rare in the rest of Cyprus.
text_zh: 法馬古斯塔可以透過大致平坦的地貌以及大量紅色田地輕易辨認。不過可能更重要的是，所有的街景覆蓋都是**爛畫質相機**。
注意：Shitcam 在賽普勒斯其他地區相當罕見。

text: The Czech landscape is fairly rolling, with a lot of hills and altitude changes, but not a lot of tall mountains. Generally speaking, Slovakia has more mountains, but also more completely flat areas.
text_zh: 捷克的風景相當起伏，有許多丘陵和海拔變化，但沒有太多高山。一般來說，斯洛伐克有更多山脈，但也有更多完全平坦的地區。

text: Much of the northern Bohemian landscape can be characterised by a rolling landscape combined with **steep solitary hills**.

NOTE: The hills can sometimes have [castles](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.4371068,14.0015438,3a,43.8y,108.34h,98.72t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sf48uOBx0xRr90Q7aC9y1Ow!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3Df48uOBx0xRr90Q7aC9y1Ow%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D62.330986%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4) on the top, which look absolutely awesome.
text_zh: 波希米亞北部的大多數景觀特徵是起伏的丘陵地形，並伴隨著**陡峭的孤立山丘**。

注意：這些山丘頂部有時會有[城堡](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.4371068,14.0015438,3a,43.8y,108.34h,98.72t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sf48uOBx0xRr90Q7aC9y1Ow!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3Df48uOBx0xRr90Q7aC9y1Ow%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D62.330986%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4)，看起來非常壯觀。

text: This unique car was used for all street view coverage in the Dominican Republic. It can be recognized by the two metal bars, the **thick black stripes** on them, as well as the white hood visible at the front.
NOTE: These stripes can also be found on one of the Mongolian cars, but the landscape should allow you to tell them apart.
Within the Americas, you will also see metal bars in Guatemala and Curaçao. However, they will not have thick black stripes.
text_zh: 這種獨特的車輛被用於多明尼加共和國的所有街景覆蓋。它的特徵是兩根金屬桿、桿上的**粗黑條紋**，以及前方可見的白色引擎蓋。
注意：這些條紋也可以在其中一輛蒙古車上找到，但地景應該能讓你區分它們。
在美洲內部，你也會在瓜地馬拉和古拉索看到金屬桿。然而，它們不會有粗黑條紋。

text: If you have **mountains to the North**, you will always be in Santiago de los Caballeros.
NOTE: Although some parts of Santo Domingo are hilly, you will never see proper mountains like this one.
text_zh: 如果你有**北方的山脈**，你一定身處聖地牙哥。
注意：雖然聖多明哥的一些地區是丘陵地形，但你絕對看不到像這樣真正的山脈。

text: This type of landscape is found on the outskirts of Santo Domingo. It is characterised by narrow dirt tracks, whitish dirt, **dried green shrubbery** and debris next to the road.
text_zh: 這種地景見於聖多明哥的郊區。其特徵是狹窄的土路、白色的泥土、路旁的**枯綠灌木叢**和雜物。

text: This is an **elevation map** of Ecuador. The imposing Andes mountains run through the middle of the country. The east and west of the country are more flat.
text_zh: 這是一張厄瓜多的**海拔地圖**。雄偉的安地斯山脈貫穿該國中部。該國的東西部則較為平坦。

text: This extremely **dry landscape** is only found in the coastal region between Guayaquil and Manta.
text_zh: 這種極度**乾燥的地景**僅見於瓜亞基爾和曼塔之間的沿海地區。

text: The southern regions have many winding **mountain roads** and exposed brownish **red dirt**.
The central provinces can have similar roads, but the exposed dirt will usually not be found in these areas.
text_zh: 南部地區有許多蜿蜒的**山路**以及裸露的 brownish **紅土**。
中部省份可能有類似的道路，但在這些區域通常找不到裸露的土壤。

text: [The Galapagos Islands](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Gal%C3%A1pagos+Islands/@-0.383106,-90.4233344,8z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x9021d9b43bec07cd:0xfb3e68fef05dae23!8m2!3d-0.383106!4d-90.4233344!16zL20vMDE2empq?entry=ttu) are an archipelago located west of mainland Ecuador. There are only **trekkers** and **boat coverage** on and around the islands. There is a wide variety of landscapes, including volcanic soil, low shrubbery, and craters (with Galapagos turtles onlooking).
text_zh: [加拉巴哥群島](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Gal%C3%A1pagos+Islands/@-0.383106,-90.4233344,8z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x9021d9b43bec07cd:0xfb3e68fef05dae23!8m2!3d-0.383106!4d-90.4233344!16zL20vMDE2empq?entry=ttu)是位於厄瓜多本土西側的群島。島上及周邊只有**徒步拍攝**與**船隻街景覆蓋**。這裡有各種不同的地貌，包括火山土壤、低矮灌木叢以及火山口（有加拉巴哥象龜在旁觀看）。

text: Eswatini’s landscape is known for its **green, wooded hills** and **tall golden grass**.
NOTE: In contrast, Lesotho’s mountains are typically barren, and long grass is not a common sight there.
text_zh: 史瓦帝尼的地景以**綠色林木山丘**和**高聳的金色長草**聞名。
注意：相比之下，賴索托的山脈通常光禿禿的，且長草在那裡並不常見。

text: Montane grasslands with **long golden grass** and a mountainous landscape are typical of Western Eswatini.
NOTE: Long grass can be found in almost all areas of Eswatini. This clue refers specifically to the pristine golden colour most commonly seen in the Western highlands.
text_zh: 具有**金色長草**的山地草原與山地景觀是西史瓦帝尼的典型特徵。
注意：長草幾乎可以在史瓦帝尼的所有地區找到。這個線索特別指的是西部高地最常見的原始金色。

text: This distinct region in the central South of the country, mostly along the MR9, can be recognized by the dark, overwhelming **greenness** and **tall wooded mountains**.
NOTE: If you are struggling to see why this is unique, try comparing this to other areas of the country, which are more “golden” and light-coloured.
text_zh: 這個位於該國中南部、主要沿著 MR9 的獨特區域，可以透過深色、壓倒性的**綠意**和**高大的林木山脈**來辨認。
注意：如果你看不出這裡有何獨特之處，試著將其與該國其他較為「金色」且顏色較淺的地區進行比較。

text: You can recognise this region in the east of the country thanks to the **unusual flatness** and the mountains often visible in the distance.
text_zh: 你可以透過**異常平坦**的的地形以及遠處經常可見的山脈，來認出位於該國東部的這個地區。

text: You can recognise the **Mlawula Nature Reserve** thanks to the narrow dirt tracks, tall grass and overall savannah landscape.
text_zh: 你可以透過狹窄的泥土小徑、高高的草叢和整體的疏林草原景觀，來認出**姆拉武拉自然保護區（Mlawula Nature Reserve）**。

text: The landscape of the Faroe islands is characterised by long, wide fjords with jagged **green mountains** that rise straight out of the water, with rocky ridge lines along the mountainsides. The mountains generally look more imposing and greener than coastal mountains in Iceland, which can often be used to tell them apart.
text_zh: 法羅群島的地景特徵是長而寬的峽灣，伴隨著鋸齒狀的**綠色山脈**從水中拔地而起，山腰沿線有著岩石山脊線。這些山脈通常看起來比冰島的海岸山脈更為雄偉且更綠，這點通常可以用來區分它們。

text: All Generation 3 car coverage on the Faroe Islands has a black Street View car with a **plain grey roof rack**.
NOTE: No other country with a similar landscape has a car similar to this.
text_zh: 法羅群島所有第三代相機車的街景覆蓋，都配有一輛車頂架為**素灰色**的黑色 Google 車。
註記：沒有其他擁有類似地景的國家有類似的車輛。

text: Torshavn is by far the **biggest town** on the islands, and the only place where you will find buildings taller than three floors. The landscape is somewhat open relative to the rest of the country, particularly to the east.
text_zh: 托爾斯港（Torshavn）是群島中**最大的城鎮**，也是唯一能找到超過三層樓建築的地方。相較於該國其他地區，這裡的地景稍微開闊，特別是東部地區。

text: There are two distinct **pyramid-shaped mountains** to the south of the trekker on Klakkur, with a very thin layer of snow on top.
text_zh: 克拉克（Klakkur）徒步拍攝的南側有兩座形狀明顯的**金字塔形山脈**，山頂覆蓋著薄薄的雪。

text: The trekker by Gjógv features a view of the **village to the south** with snow covered mountains in the background.
text_zh: 焦格夫（Gjógv）旁的徒步拍攝可以看到**南側村莊**的景色，背景則是覆雪的山脈。

text: Due to its proximity to the Scandinavian Mountains, the area near Kilpisjärvi features a unique **hilly **landscape, with** low vegetation**.
NOTE: [The Generation 2 coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/32NoQ1mRjDmu5CsUA) on this road was taken during Spring, so the vegetation looks dead.
text_zh: 由於鄰近斯堪地那維亞山脈，基爾皮斯耶爾維附近的地區擁有獨特的**丘陵**地貌，並伴隨**低矮植被**。
注意：這條道路上的[第二代相機覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/32NoQ1mRjDmu5CsUA)是在春天拍攝的，因此植被看起來像是枯萎的。

text: Germany also has a wide variety of sign backs. Notably, you can commonly find **black** or **dark grey** sign backs, which are rather rare in Europe. Most signs will also feature this sticker, with an upside-down red triangle on a black rectangle.
NOTE: Italy, Romania and Albania also have black sign backs, however landscape should be sufficient to tell them apart.
text_zh: 德國也有各式各樣的標誌背面。值得注意的是，你經常可以找到**黑色**或**深灰色**的標誌背面，這在歐洲相當罕見。大多數標誌也都會貼上這個貼紙，上面是一個黑色長方形，裡面有倒置的紅色三角形。
註記：義大利、羅馬尼亞與阿爾巴尼亞也有黑色的標誌背面，但周遭景色通常就足以辨別它們。

text: Using the surrounding elevation can be crucial for getting good guesses in Germany. Here are some general rules:
- The north and especially northwest is very flat.
- Central Germany is hilly.
- Very southern Germany has big mountains.
Also note that despite having a higher elevation, many parts of southern Germany can still be flat.
text_zh: 利用周遭的海拔高度對於在德國進行精準的猜測至關重要。以下是一些一般規則：
- 北部尤其是西北部非常平坦。
- 中德地區多山丘。
- 極南部的德國有大山。
同時也要注意，儘管海拔較高，德國南部的許多地區仍然可能是平坦的。

text: The German Alps is the most mountainous region in Germany, it is mostly concentrated on the Austrian Border.
text_zh: 德國阿爾卑斯山是德國最多山的地區，主要集中在奧地利邊境。

text: Ghana is mostly flat with **red soil**, however hills and mountains can be seen in some regions. **Tropical **vegetation is very common, and palms are common especially toward the south.
text_zh: 迦納的地形大多平坦且有著**紅色土壤**，但在某些地區可以看到丘陵和山脈。**熱帶**植被非常普遍，棕櫚樹也很常見，特別是在南部地區。

text: Northern Ghana features a **savannah** landscape, which can be identified by its dry soil and less dense vegetation.
text_zh: 迦納北部具有**熱帶草原**景觀，其特徵是乾燥的土壤和較稀疏的植被。

text: **Tall mountain ranges **in Ghana are typically seen near Lake Volta in the highlighted area.
NOTE: Mountain ranges to the east are more common in the area near Togo.
text_zh: 迦納的**高山山脈**通常出現在沃爾特湖（Lake Volta）附近的突顯區域。
註：東部的山脈在靠近多哥（Togo）的地區更常見。

text: Most **unpaved roads** in a **dry savannah** landscape are found north of Wa, as well as near the town itself.
NOTE: The other unpaved roads in northern Ghana are the Yendi-Nkwanta road in the east, and part of the Salaga-Tamale road, which has very distinct soil. See the tips below.
text_zh: **乾燥熱帶草原**景觀中的大多數**未鋪面道路**都位於瓦鎮（Wa）以北，以及該城鎮本身附近。
註：迦納北部的其他未鋪面道路包括東部的延迪-恩寬塔（Yendi-Nkwanta）公路，以及薩拉加-塔馬利（Salaga-Tamale）公路的一部分，該路段具有非常獨特的土壤。請參閱下方的提示。

text: The road connecting the town of Sawla with the N10 has very crisp,** new road lines**. Most of the road runs in a general east-west direction, through a lush savannah landscape. The middle line can be solid or dashed.
NOTE: There are a couple of other roads with crisp road lines like these, however these tend to have a different road angle or landscape.
text_zh: 連接索瓦鎮（Sawla）和 N10 公路的道路有非常清晰的**新道路標線**。這條路大致呈東西走向，穿過鬱鬱蔥蔥的熱帶草原景觀。中間的標線可以是實線或虛線。
註：還有其他幾條道路也有像這樣清晰的道路標線，但這些道路通常有不同的道路角度或景觀。

text: The Salaga-Tamale road up to Kpalbusi is a dirt road with very moody **overcast **coverage. The soil tends to be **very dark**, with a purple or brown** **tinge to it. The road also has a unique tropical savannah feel. The soil is most dark near the town of Salaga.
NOTE: Unpaved roads with overcast coverage and a savannah landscape can be found in other places. The unique aspect of this road is the dark purplish brown soil and the especially dark cloud cover.
text_zh: 通往克帕爾布西（Kpalbusi）的薩拉加-塔馬利公路是一條泥土路，有著非常陰暗的**陰天**街景覆蓋。土壤往往**非常黑暗**，帶有紫色或棕色的**色調**。這條路也帶有獨特的熱帶草原風情。土壤在薩拉加鎮附近最黑。
註：帶有陰天街景覆蓋和熱帶草原景觀的未鋪面道路在其他地方也能找到。這條路的獨特之處在於其帶有紫褐色的土壤以及特別陰暗的雲層覆蓋。

text: The road between Nkwanta and Domanko is **unpaved**, with a **powerline** close to the road to your east or northeast. The road itself runs in a general SE-NW direction, through a lush savannah landscape that is typical of central Ghana.

NOTE: In urban areas, there can be a powerline on both sides of the road. In addition, a section of the Salaga-Tamale road has a powerline to the east as well, but the darker soil and moody cloud cover makes it distinguishable.
text_zh: 恩寬塔（Nkwanta）和多曼科（Domanko）之間的道路是**未鋪面道路**，道路東側或東北側緊鄰著**高壓電線**。道路本身大致呈東南-西北走向，穿過迦納中部典型的鬱鬱蔥蔥的熱帶草原景觀。
註：在市區，道路兩側都可能設有高壓電線。此外，薩拉加-塔馬利公路的一段路東側也有高壓電線，但較暗的土壤和陰沉的雲層覆蓋使其得以區分。

text: The coastal area just **east of Accra**, especially on the N1, has a distinct landscape: it is very flat and wide open, with significantly less vegetation than the rest of southern Ghana. Some parts can look somewhat dry.
text_zh: **阿克拉以東**的沿海地區，特別是在 N1 公路上，有著獨特的景觀：地勢非常平坦且開闊，植被比迦納南部其他地區明顯少得多。有些部分看起來可能有點乾燥。

text: The territory’s most recognizable feature is the Rock of Gibraltar, a massive limestone mountain that dominates every part of the territory. It can be recognized by its exposed **white limestone rocks** and distinct shape.
text_zh: 該領土最具辨識度的特徵是直布羅陀巨岩（Rock of Gibraltar），這是一座巨大的石灰岩山，主導了該領土的每一個角落。它以其外露的**白色石灰岩**和獨特的形狀而聞名。

text: The main language used in Gibraltar is **English**. This can be especially helpful if you see English on official signs in a Mediterranean setting.
NOTE: Note that English is also one of the main languages of Malta, which also has a Mediterranean landscape and vibe.
text_zh: 直布羅陀使用的主要語言是**英語**。如果你在地中海風情的環境中看到英文，這會特別有幫助。
註：請注意，英語也是馬爾他（Malta）的主要語言之一，馬爾他同樣擁有地中海景觀和氛圍。

text: Greece is a very mountainous country, with a large portion of the coverage being taken on **winding mountain roads**.
text_zh: 希臘是個多山國家，很大一部分的街景覆蓋都是在**蜿蜒的山路**上拍攝的。

text: The largest **flat agricultural valleys** in Greece are found close to Thessaloniki and Larissa, but smaller flat valleys, where the mountains generally appear closer, can be found in several other areas in the north and centre of the country.
text_zh: 希臘最大的**平坦農業谷地**位於特薩洛尼基和拉里薩附近，但在該國北部和中部的其他幾個地區，也能找到較小的平坦谷地，這些地方的山脈通常看起來更近。

text: The **tallest** Greek mountains are found in the western half of the country, and contain most of the country’s high-altitude mountain roads with coverage.
text_zh: 希臘**最高**的山脈位於該國的西部半有覆蓋的地區，並包含該國大部分的高海拔山區道路街景。

text: On many of the central islands you can find a very **barren landscape**, with small bushes and no trees in sight. This tends to be more common on the smaller islands with coverage.
text_zh: 在許多中部島嶼上，你可以看到非常**貧瘠的景觀**，只有小灌木叢，看不到任何樹木。這在有街景覆蓋的小島上通常更常見。

text: Mount Pangaion can be recognised from its shape, being more of a **solitary mountain** rather than a wide mountain range, combined with the fact that it is located to the **south** of a flat agricultural valley.
text_zh: 潘蓋翁山可以從它的形狀辨認出來，它比較偏向**孤立的山峰**而不是廣闊的山脈，再加上它位於平坦農業谷地的**南方**。

text: These extraordinary **monolithic mountains** are called Meteora, and can be found north of Trikala.
text_zh: 這些非凡的**巨石山**稱為梅特歐拉，位於特里卡拉北方。

text: The coverage in Greenland is divided into well over fifty small disjoint parts, with different weather conditions, seasons, landmarks and so on. Although the largest concentration is found on the southern half of the **west coast**, coverage can be found scattered along a lot of the coast. Since differentiating between some of them requires a lot of technical information, such as the position of the sun or clouds, this guide will only cover the parts with clear distinctive features, such as a unique Street View vehicle or an easily recognizable mountain.

Because of the limited coverage, this guide will be structured differently than most other guides. It will be divided into two main sections: one for **land coverage** and one for **boat coverage**. These two sections will each be divided into step 2, for larger towns and boats found in multiple locations, and step 3, for smaller settlements and boats found only in one place.
text_zh: 格陵蘭的街景覆蓋劃分為五十多個互不相連的小區域，各自擁有不同的天候狀況、季節、地標等。雖然最大宗的覆蓋集中在**西海岸**的南半部，但沿著許多海岸線也能找到零星的覆蓋。由於區分其中某些區域需要大量技術資訊，例如太陽位置或雲層，本指南將僅涵蓋具備明顯獨特特徵的地區，例如獨特的街景拍攝工具或容易辨識的山脈。
由於覆蓋範圍有限，本指南的結構將與大多數其他指南不同。它將分為兩個主要部分：一個是**陸地覆蓋**，另一個是**船隻覆蓋**。這兩個部分將各自細分為步驟 2（針對較大城鎮和出現在多個地點的船隻）以及步驟 3（針對較小聚落和僅出現在一個地點的船隻）。

text: The Greenlandic landscape is very barren, with **no trees or taller vegetation **and often featuring snow. Mountains and hills are common, with very limited flat areas. On top of that, almost all coverage was taken in coastal areas, so fjords and visible coastlines are very common.
text_zh: 格陵蘭的景觀非常荒涼，**沒有樹木或高大植被**，且經常有雪。山脈和小山很常見，平坦地區非常有限。除此之外，幾乎所有的街景覆蓋都是在沿海地區拍攝的，因此峽灣和清晰可見的海岸線非常普遍。

text: Most coverage in Ilulissat can be recognized by the green ATV with black bars and the driver wearing a **beige hat. **Note however that there are some [small sections](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=MHgi-HGuMNFzyxbnwbMG9g&viewpoint=69.216044%2C-51.120939&heading=309.0825089308934&pitch=-31.444946001086684&fov=133.16482449375943#extra%5Btags%5D=mountains%3A+low&extra%5Btags%5D=car%3A+green%2C+no+%22m%C3%B6ssa%22&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) where the driver does not wear it. The coverage is fairly sunny and bright.
text_zh: 伊盧利薩特的絕大多數街景可以透過裝有黑色桿子且駕駛戴著**米色帽子**的綠色 ATV 來辨識。不過請注意，有些[小路段](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=MHgi-HGuMNFzyxbnwbMG9g&viewpoint=69.216044%2C-51.120939&heading=309.0825089308934&pitch=-31.444946001086684&fov=133.16482449375943#extra%5Btags%5D=mountains%3A+low&extra%5Btags%5D=car%3A+green%2C+no+%22m%C3%B6ssa%22&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)中的駕駛沒有戴帽子。此處的街景相當晴朗明亮。

text: Uummannaq has two distinctive features: a **sharp mountain** to the north and a green snowmobile with **large** **black side mirrors**. Neither of the two can be seen on all coverage but at least one can be seen on most.
text_zh: Uummannaq 有兩個獨特的特徵：北邊有一座**尖山**，以及一台裝有**大型** **黑色側邊後視鏡**的綠色雪上摩托車。這兩個特徵不一定會出現在所有街景覆蓋中，但通常至少能看到其中一個。

text: The coverage in and around Igaliku is most easily recognized by the wide, **snow-covered mountain range** to the northeast which looks very bright due to the setting sun. The green ATV, while not entirely unique on its own, can also be a useful hint.
text_zh: Igaliku 及其周邊的街景覆蓋最容易透過東北方寬闊、**覆雪的山脈**來辨識，在落日餘暉下顯得非常明亮。綠色的 ATV 雖然本身並非完全獨一無二，但也是一個很有用的線索。

text: To the north of Saattut you can see a wide mountain range **shrouded in clouds**, on the other side of a fjord. The paths covered are mostly dark, muddy dirt roads, and the foliage is mainly yellow grass tufts.
text_zh: 在 Saattut 的北方，隔著峽灣可以看到一片**籠罩在雲霧中**的寬闊山脈。涵蓋的路徑大多是黑暗、泥濘的土路，植被則主要是黃色草叢。

text: The coverage on Kulusuk island has a **round, red ATV**, with a pyramid shaped mountain often seen to the northeast. The footage was taken right after sunset on a clear day, making it fairly dark.
text_zh: Kulusuk 島的街景覆蓋有一台**圓形紅色 ATV**，東北方經常可以看到一座金字塔形的山。畫面是在晴天的日落後不久拍攝的，光線相當昏暗。

text: Ikerasak is most easily recognized by the large **monolithic mountain** to the west.
text_zh: Ikerasak 最容易透過西方巨大的**巨石山**來辨識。

text: Ukkusissat is located below a **tall cliffside** to the east with mountains towering above it.
text_zh: Ukkusissat 位於東側**高大懸崖**下方，上方有群山聳立。

text: Kuummiit can be recognized by **two distinct mountains**, a sharp one to the east and a rounder one to the north. The coverage is slightly dark due to clouds and the sun setting.
text_zh: Kuummiit 可以透過**兩座特徵鮮明的山**來辨識，東側是一座尖山，北側是一座較圓的山。由於雲層和日落，街景覆蓋稍微偏暗。

text: Siorapaluk can be recognized by the **sandy, pyramid-shaped mountains** to the north, combined with the wide **sand beach** below the village.
NOTE: Look for the store named “Pilersuisoq” to locate the village, as you have to zoom in very far on Google Maps to see the label of the village.
text_zh: Siorapaluk 可以透過北方的**沙質金字塔形山脈**，結合村莊下方寬闊的**沙灘**來辨識。
注意：尋找名為「Pilersuisoq」的商店來定位村莊，因為你必須在 Google 地圖上放大非常多才能看到村莊的標籤。

text: To the southwest of Qaanaaq, you can see icebergs in a large body of water, and a wide mountain range on the other side, where the snow is **bright white** as it reflects the sunlight through the thick clouds.
text_zh: 在 Qaanaaq 的西南方，你可以看到大片水域中的冰山，以及對岸寬闊的山脈，由於陽光透過厚雲反射，那裡的雪呈現**亮白色**。

text: A **red and black ATV **can be found in and around the village of Kapisillit, northeast of Nuuk. Many mountains in the distance are covered in a layer of snow.
text_zh: 在努克東北方的 Kapisillit 村莊內及周邊可以找到一台**紅黑相間的 ATV**。遠處許多山峰都覆蓋著一層雪。

text: Kangerluk can be recognized by the evenly tall mountains with a **particular shape** on the other side of the fjord.
text_zh: Kangerluk 可以透過峽灣對岸高度一致且具有**特定形狀**的山脈來辨識。

text: On a small bit of coverage east of Nuuk you can see a large number of sharp mountains, **powdered in snow**. The coverage is somewhat dark due to the thick clouds and the sun being hidden behind the mountains.
text_zh: 在努克東側的一小段街景覆蓋中，你可以看到大量覆蓋著**薄雪**的尖峭山峰。由於厚雲以及太陽被群山遮蔽，街景覆蓋顯得有些昏暗。

text: This is a topographic map of Guatemala. Generally speaking, the middle of the country is mountainous, while the south and north are fairly flat.
text_zh: 這是瓜地馬拉的地形圖。一般來說，國防中部是山區，而南部和北部相當平坦。

text: The central regions of Guatemala are generally **mountainous**.
text_zh: 瓜地馬拉的中部地區通常是**多山**的。

text: The northern regions of Guatemala are typically **fairly flat**. You will however usually see some hills or a slightly [rolling landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/gn49EV7aAQv94cq6A), rather than the complete flatness of the south.
text_zh: 瓜地馬拉的北部地區通常**相當平坦**。不過，你通常會看到一些丘陵或稍微[起伏的景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/gn49EV7aAQv94cq6A)，而不是南部的完全平坦。

text: **Oil palm plantations** are primarily found in two general areas: in the southwest and just north of the central mountain range.
text_zh: **油棕園**主要分布在兩個大致區域：西南部以及中部山脈的正北方。

text: Lago de Atitlán is by far the **largest lake** in the mountainous regions of Guatemala. It is surrounded by mountains, and some volcanoes.
text_zh: 阿提特蘭湖是瓜地馬拉山區中迄今為止**最大的湖泊**。它被群山環繞，並伴隨著幾座火山。

text: The PET-11, south of Las Pozas can be recognised by the slightly rolling landscape combined with its completely **north-to-south road angle**.
text_zh: 位於拉斯波薩斯南部的 PET-11 公路，可以透過微幅起伏的地形以及完全呈**南北走向的道路角度**來辨識。

text: Hawaii is known for its **lush** and **tropical** vegetation, with a variety of plants and trees. However, being a volcanic island chain, Hawaii has a wide range of landscapes, and as such vegetation as well.
You will often see plenty of [ferns](https://goo.gl/maps/Ki93sohMTCDs1MZM8), [tall grass](https://goo.gl/maps/vfprezHVC8j4r6wY9), or other flowers on the sides of the roads.
text_zh: 夏威夷以其**蒼翠**且**熱帶**的植被而聞名，擁有各種植物和樹木。然而，作為一個火山島鏈，夏威夷擁有廣泛的地貌，因此植被也很多樣。
你經常會在路邊看到大量的[蕨類植物](https://goo.gl/maps/Ki93sohMTCDs1MZM8)、[高草](https://goo.gl/maps/vfprezHVC8j4r6wY9)或其他花卉。

text: The Island of Maui sits southeast of Molokaʻi. In the centre of the island, you will find dry and somewhat flat grasslands with one or **both** of the **mountain ranges** on the island visible.
text_zh: 茂宜島位於摩洛凱島的東南方。在島嶼中心，你會發現乾燥且有些平坦的草原，島上的一座或**兩座**山脈清晰可見。

text: Coastal areas of Maui are noticeably more** lush and green**. Banana plants, palm trees, and [views of the mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dm1N9dDprdoeUqWP7) are all common.
text_zh: 茂宜島的沿海地區明顯**更加蒼翠茂盛**。香蕉樹、棕櫚樹以及[山景](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dm1N9dDprdoeUqWP7)都很常見。

text: **Rural roads** going through forests within a flat landscape are commonly found south of the city of Hilo, on the island of Hawaiʻi.
NOTE: Mountainous forests are dotted around Hawaii, but if you are in one, and you see red soil with Generation 3, consider guessing in Kauaʻi, the westernmost covered island.
text_zh: 夏威夷島（Hawaiʻi）希洛（Hilo）市南方常見穿越平坦地景森林的**鄉間道路**。
注意：夏威夷各地散布著山地森林，但如果你身處其中，且看到搭配第三代相機的紅土，可以考慮猜在最西邊有街景涵蓋的考艾島（Kauaʻi）。

text: The **Red Hill** can easily be recognised by this unique barren, red rocky landscape. Due to the high altitude, clouds are usually visible below you.
text_zh: **紅山（Red Hill）**可以透過這種獨特荒涼、紅色岩石林立的地景輕鬆辨認。由於海拔較高，通常可以看到雲層在你的下方。

text: On the eastern side of the island of Molokaʻi lies the [Kamakou volcano](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamakou), leading to a significantly hillier and slightly more vegetated landscape than the western parts of the island.
text_zh: 摩洛凱島的東側坐落著[卡馬庫火山](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamakou)，這使得當地的地形比該島西部明顯更加多山，植被也稍微多一些。

text: There is also a plethora of rural locations that are harder to identify.

Outside the urban areas, Hong Kong is generally quite **mountainous**, with green, subtropical vegetation. There is extensive coverage in rural areas outside the city, with many roads going through the mountains. You might see low-rise rural buildings, however usually you will not need to travel far to see tall apartment blocks.
NOTE: Singapore, on the other hand, is very flat.
text_zh: 這裡也有大量較難辨識的鄉村地點。
在市區之外，香港通常相當**多山**，且擁有綠色的亞熱帶植被。市郊的鄉村地區有廣泛的街景涵蓋，許多道路穿梭於群山之間。你可能會看到低矮的鄉村建築，但通常不需要走太遠就能看到高聳的公寓大廈。
注意：相對地，新加坡非常平坦。

text: Distinct weathered rock walls can be seen on the side of mountains. Some of them have nets, to prevent rockslides. In addition, **green or blue plaques** are a common sight.
text_zh: 山壁旁可以看到明顯風化的岩石牆。其中一些設有防落石網。此外，**綠色或藍色牌匾**也是常見的景象。

text: Fan Kam Road runs in a general north-east direction, and can be recognized by the dense **tropical vegetation** surrounding the road, and sometimes mountains in the background. The road is also quite narrow and does not have any outer lines. Many [small villages](https://goo.gl/maps/9LA3nzaHZdsVzMvm6) branch off of the road, south and north of the country park.
text_zh: 粉錦公路大致朝東北方向延伸，其特徵為道路周圍茂密的**熱帶植被**，有時背景還能看到山脈。該道路也相當狹窄，且沒有任何外側標線。郊野公園的南北兩側有許多[小村莊](https://goo.gl/maps/9LA3nzaHZdsVzMvm6)自該道路分岔出去。

text: While the southeastern parts of Hungary are extremely flat, with almost no noticeable hills, the northern and western parts mainly consist of **forested hills and mountains**. The tallest mountains are found in the north, while the southwestern mountains are generally slightly lower.
text_zh: 雖然匈牙利的東南部地區極其平坦、幾乎沒有明顯的山丘，但北部和西部地區主要由**多樹的山丘和山脈**組成。最高山脈位於北部，而西南部山脈通常稍低。

text: Iceland often looks **barren and treeless**. Most regions have a dark grey soil consisting mostly of volcanic rocks.
NOTE: Due to the lack of trees, the landscape in Iceland does not look like anywhere else in Northern Europe.
text_zh: 冰島的景色通常**荒涼且無樹木**。大多數地區的土壤呈深灰色，主要由火山岩組成。
注意：由於缺乏樹木，冰島的地景看起來與北歐其他任何地方都不一樣。

text: Iceland is a very **geologically active** country, where plate tectonics and volcanic processes have shaped the landscape. As a result, many regions are rugged, mountainous and a sight to behold. In addition, strange and bewildering landscapes can be found all over, such as geothermal lakes, lava fields, rift valleys, and towering rock formations.
text_zh: 冰島是一個**地質活動**非常頻繁的國家，板塊運動和火山作用形塑了這裡的地貌。因此，許多地區崎嶇多山且景色壯麗。此外，各地還能看到奇特迷人的地景，例如地熱湖、熔岩原、裂谷以及高聳的岩層。

text: The Westfjords region features numerous narrow fjords, surrounded by moderately tall, and mostly **flat-topped** mountains.
text_zh: 西峽灣地區有許多狹窄的峽灣，周圍環繞著高度適中且大多為**平頂**的山脈。

text: The far east of the country is also home to several fjords. What distinguishes them from the Westfjords are the generally larger and more **jagged mountains**.
text_zh: 冰島的最東部也有幾個峽灣。它們與西峽灣的區別在於山脈通常更大且更**崎嶇**。

text: The mountains west of Akureyri contain many valleys, sandwiched between tall, often slightly snowcapped peaks. Most of these valleys generally face north to northeast.
text_zh: 阿克雷里以西的山脈包含許多山谷，夾在高聳且通常帶有一點雪冠的山峰之間。這些山谷大多朝向北方到東北方。

text: Barren landscapes consisting mostly of** dark volcanic gravel**, with little to no vegetation or signs of life, are typical of the inland regions of Iceland. Most such covered roads are located in the east.
text_zh: 主要由**深色火山礫石**組成的荒涼地景，幾乎沒有植被或生命跡象，是冰島內陸地區的典型特徵。大多數此類有覆蓋的道路都位於東部。

text: The Southwest agricultural area in Iceland can be identified by its relatively flat **farmland landscape** scattered with numerous [farmsteads](https://goo.gl/maps/a8wo7RuEwy7EX5vZ6), fields, meadows and grasslands.
NOTE: Although there are other smaller agricultural areas in Iceland, mountains in this area tend to be quite distant, making it unique.
text_zh: 冰島的西南農業區可以透過其相對平坦的[農莊](https://goo.gl/maps/a8wo7RuEwy7EX5vZ6)、田野、草地和草原錯落的**農田地景**來辨識。
NOTE: 雖然冰島還有其他較小的農業區，但該地區的山脈通常相當遙遠，這使其顯得獨特。

text: The valley around Hallormsstaður has a distinct northeast/southwest angle with **low-lying mountains** on either side, a **wide river** flowing through it, and an **unusual amount of trees** for Iceland. Some of the sideroads are [in the forests](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HrmHr9Y8mPom7qBk6).
text_zh: 霍爾姆斯豪茲尤爾周圍的山谷具有明顯的東北/西南走向，兩側有**低矮的山脈**，一條**寬闊的河流**流過其中，並且以冰島來說擁有**異常多的樹木**。有些小路[位於森林中](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HrmHr9Y8mPom7qBk6)。

text: You can recognise the area near the town of Selfoss from its distinct** flat-ridge mountain**. Due to the otherwise flat landscape, this mountain can be seen from a wide area.
text_zh: 你可以從其特有的**平脊山**認出塞爾福斯鎮附近的區域。由於周遭地景平坦，這座山從很廣的範圍都能看見。

text: Reykjavík is the capital and by far the **largest city** in Iceland. The city is mostly flat with slight hills, and is located on the south side of a bay. It is most recognizable as it is significantly larger than other Icelandic cities, with a large urban area and “bigger city” feel.
NOTE: The city of Akureyri can feel urban in some places. You can distinguish it from Reykjavik as it has mountains to the east and west.
text_zh: 雷克雅維克是冰島的首都，也是冰島**最大的城市**。該城市大多平坦並有輕微起伏的丘陵，位於海灣的南側。它最容易辨識，因為它比其他冰島城市大得多，具有廣大的市區和「大城市」的感覺。
注意：阿克雷里市在某些地方也會給人城市感。你可以透過它東側和西側都有山脈來將它與雷克雅維克區分開來。

text: Akureyri is the second-biggest city in Iceland and is located in a **North-South oriented valley**, along the western edge of the bay. The city features mountains ranges to the [east](https://goo.gl/maps/eMBDTPVRuWi2EmU2A) and [west](https://goo.gl/maps/FyqhMTP1bcbLEqsG9), making it recognisable.
text_zh: 阿克雷里是冰島第二大城市，位於海灣西緣的**南北向山谷**中。該城市的[東側](https://goo.gl/maps/eMBDTPVRuWi2EmU2A)和[西側](https://goo.gl/maps/FyqhMTP1bcbLEqsG9)都有山脈連綿，使其極具辨識度。

text: The by far **tallest mountains** in India are found in the Himalayas.
text_zh: 印度境內**最高山脈**毫無疑問位於喜馬拉雅山脈。

text: In Ladakh and northern Himachal Pradesh you can find an **extremely dry landscape** with little to no vegetation within the Himalayan mountains.
text_zh: 在拉達克和喜馬拉雅山脈內喜馬拉雅普德什省北部，你可以找到幾乎沒有植被的**極度乾燥景觀**。

text: The western parts of Rajasthan can commonly be recognised by the **dry landscape** with **sandy soil**.
text_zh: 拉賈斯坦省的西部地區通常可以透過帶有**沙質土壤**的**乾燥景觀**來識別。

text: The Western Ghats Mountains in the western part of Maharashtra can be recognised by their **distinct ridgelines**, often having plateaus rather than peaks. The northern part is drier while the southern part has more vegetation.

NOTE: During the [rainy season](https://www.google.com/maps/@19.5669899,73.7237394,3a,42y,336.38h,97.72t,359.97r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfFjQwbXx-Aro9gPWDaPH5Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) the mountains will turn green and appear quite different.
text_zh: 位於馬哈拉施特拉省西部的西高止山脈可以透過其**清晰的山脊線**來識別，這些山脈通常是高原而非尖峰。北部地區較為乾燥，而南部地區則有較多植被。
注意：在[雨季](https://www.google.com/maps/@19.5669899,73.7237394,3a,42y,336.38h,97.72t,359.97r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfFjQwbXx-Aro9gPWDaPH5Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)期間，群山會變成綠色，外觀會截然不同。

text: The landscape in Mizoram mainly consists of lush, green valleys with fairly low vegetation with eroded hillsides having many small peaks scattered around.

NOTE: A somewhat similar landscape can be found in [Meghalaya](https://www.google.com/maps/@25.3870998,91.7617742,3a,40.2y,128.95h,86.43t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9EK2RjZ-ChZWuNyxjcwwvA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu), however rather than distinct peaks, the hillsides will have a mostly smooth and flat top.
text_zh: 米索蘭省的景觀主要由茂盛的綠色山谷組成，植被相當矮小，侵蝕的山坡周圍散落著許多小山峰。

注意：在[梅ઘ拉亞省](https://www.google.com/maps/@25.3870998,91.7617742,3a,40.2y,128.95h,86.43t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9EK2RjZ-ChZWuNyxjcwwvA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)可以找到某種程度上類似的景觀，然而山坡不會有明顯的尖峰，而是多半呈現平滑且平坦的頂部。

text: The Mechuka valley is the only place in Northeast India where snowy mountains are visible. The valley contains brownish grass and a plethora of Bhutan white pine. [North of Mechuka](https://www.google.com/maps/@28.6320523,94.0662987,3a,49y,194.26h,92.18t,359.98r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smCvraPHUR1hld15MPCcP1Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) the coverage gradually becomes overcast and somewhat dark.
text_zh: 梅楚卡山谷是印度東北部唯一能看到雪山的地方。山谷裡有褐色的草和大量的不丹白松。[梅楚卡以北](https://www.google.com/maps/@28.6320523,94.0662987,3a,49y,194.26h,92.18t,359.98r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smCvraPHUR1hld15MPCcP1Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的街景覆蓋逐漸變得陰暗且有些昏暗。

text: [Chaukhamba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaukhamba), located near the town of Ukhimath, is a mountain massif covered in snow which can be recognised by its **three distinct peaks**, with the centre peak being the tallest.
text_zh: 位於烏基馬特鎮附近的[喬卡姆巴峰](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaukhamba)是一座覆蓋著積雪的山峰群，其特徵是擁有**三個明顯的峰頂**，其中中央峰最高。

text: The landscape south of Shillong in Meghalaya, is characterised by V-shaped, green eroded valleys with somewhat flat and smooth ridgetops.
NOTE: Mizoram hills are less smooth with more rises and falls instead of long smooth ridges.
text_zh: 梅ઘ拉亞省西隆以南的景觀特徵是 V 形綠色侵蝕山谷，山脊頂部較為平坦和光滑。
注意：米索蘭省的山丘較不平滑，有較多的起伏而非長而平滑的山脊。

text: Near the southern tip of Tamil Nadu, you can find these large **monolithic mountains**, with huge exposed rocks. Several of these mountains can be seen from afar, especially the [Magenthiragiri hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qfZtnxhcLqxAxbzq9).
text_zh: 在泰米爾納德省南端附近，你可以找到這些巨大的**單體山脈**，有著巨大的裸露岩石。從遠處可以看到其中幾座山，特別是[馬根蒂拉吉里山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qfZtnxhcLqxAxbzq9)。

text: A flat, bushy landscape with **very red soil** can be found in southern Tamil Nadu.
text_zh: 泰米爾納德省南部可以找到一片平坦、多灌木且帶有**非常紅的土壤**的景觀。

text: Ireland and the UK **drive on the left side** of the road.
NOTE: The only other European countries to drive on the left are Malta and Cyprus, but landscape should be sufficient to tell them apart.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭和英國都是**靠左側駕駛**。
注意：歐洲其他靠左側駕駛的國家只有馬爾他和賽普勒斯，但景觀應該足以將它們區分開來。

text: Most of Ireland is dominated by a very green, agricultural landscape, with lots of **hedgerows** next to the roads and dividing the fields.
This type of landscape is also common in many parts of the UK, and can be virtually indistinguishable from Ireland.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭大部分地區都是翠綠的農業景觀，道路旁和農田之間有許多**樹籬**。
這種景觀在英國許多地區也很常見，幾乎無法與愛爾蘭區分。

text: In and around urban areas, you will sometimes encounter **double yellow road lines** on the sides of marked roads. These indicate a no parking zone, and are also very common in the UK. They are not really found anywhere else in Europe apart from Malta, but landscape should be sufficient to tell it apart.
text_zh: 在市區及周邊地區，你有時會在標線道路的側邊遇到**雙黃道路標線**。這些標線代表禁止停車區，在英國也非常常見。除了馬爾他之外，它們在歐洲其他地方幾乎找不到，但景觀應該足以將其區分開來。

text: Ireland’s west coast is defined by a **rugged, hilly landscape**. Steep hills and low mountains dominate. The neat fields of the east make way for wild grass- and moorlands. The grass often has more brownish and yellow tones to it. Sometimes you will be able to see exposed rocks.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的西海岸有著**崎嶇且多山的地景**。陡峭的山丘與低矮的山脈佔據了大片地區。東部的平坦農田在這裡轉變為野草叢生的大片草地與荒原。草地通常帶有更多褐色與黃色的色調。有時你能看見裸露的岩石。

text: If a very small rural road has **Generation 4** coverage and is located in an unusually **hilly** landscape, you are likely to be in Donegal.

Note that this meta only applies to the smallest roads: thin, without road lines, and sometimes with grass in the middle. This type of coverage is also not exclusive to Donegal, it is just likely to be there.
text_zh: 如果一條非常小的鄉間小路有**第四代**相機的街景覆蓋，且位於異常**多山**的地景中，你很可能就在多尼戈爾（Donegal）。
請注意，這個特徵線索僅適用於最小的道路：狹窄、沒有道路標線，有時中間還長著草。這種拍攝畫質也不是多尼戈爾所獨有的，只是很有可能會在那裡遇到。

text: One noteworthy area in the east is the **Wicklow Mountains**, just south of Dublin. They can look deceptively similar to the western coastal mountains. It can be very hard, if not downright impossible to distinguish these two areas.
Two things to look out for:
- You will never see the coast from the Wicklow mountains.
- Like Donegal, its small roads are mostly covered with Generation 4 instead of the Generation 2 that is more typically associated with small roads in the west.
text_zh: 東部一個值得注意的區域是位於都柏林正南方的**威克洛山脈**（Wicklow Mountains）。它們看起來可能跟西海岸的山脈極為相似。要區分這兩個地區非常困難，甚至可以說是不可能的任務。
有兩件事需要注意：
- 你絕不可能從威克洛山脈（Wicklow mountains）看到海岸線。
- 就像多尼戈爾一樣，其小路大多採用 Generation 4 拍攝畫質，而不是西部小路通常搭配的 Generation 2。

text: In the north of counties Sligo and Leitrim you can find distinctive **tabletop mountains**.
Note that the mountains in the image are just an example, many of the mountains in this area have the same sort of shape.
text_zh: 在斯利、戈縣（Sligo）與利特里姆郡（Leitrim）的北部，你可以找到外形獨特的**桌山**。
請注意，圖片中的山脈只是一個例子，該地區的許多山脈都有著類似的形狀。

text: The area in and around Burren National Park is characterised by a unique [karst landscape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karst) consisting of **exposed grey limestone rocks**.
text_zh: 巴倫國家公園（Burren National Park）內部及周邊地區的特徵是獨特的[喀斯特地形](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karst)，由**裸露的灰色石灰岩**組成。

text: The general landscape on the Isle of Man consists of **hilly farmland**, and narrow roads passing through them.
text_zh: 曼島的一般地景由**多山農田**以及穿梭其中的狹窄道路組成。

text: Northern Isle of Man is **very flat** in comparison to the rest of the island. Usually, there are mountains visible to the south.
text_zh: 與島上其他地區相比，曼島北部**非常平坦**。通常往南方可以看到山脈。

text: The landscape ranges from a greener Mediterranean landscape in the north, to a very arid landscape in the south.
text_zh: 地形從北部的較綠的地中海景觀，到南部的極度乾旱景觀不等。

text: Northern Israel is usually far more **mountainous** and **green** than the rest of Israel. Throughout the region you will almost always see forested hills and mountains.
text_zh: 以色列北部通常比以色列其他地區更加**多山**且**翠綠**。放眼整個地區，你幾乎總是能看到長滿森林的山丘和山脈。

text: The area west of Jerusalem can often look deceptively similar to northern Israel, with green forested hills and some agriculture sprinkled across the landscape.

Two things can occasionally be used to tell the two apart. Firstly, in northern Israel you may occasionally see wide, [flat valleys](https://goo.gl/maps/6TvF6u9qvM7ZGx2k8), while the Jerusalem area is always going to be hilly. Secondly, if you see houses made of [Jerusalem stone](https://goo.gl/maps/8QyM47Z1iwZCsiR9A), you are likely to be near Jerusalem.
text_zh: 耶路撒冷以西的地區看起來通常會與以色列北部有著欺騙性的相似，那裡有綠色的森林山丘，景觀中點綴著一些農業。
偶爾可以用兩件事來區分這兩者。首先，在以色列北部，你可能會偶爾看到寬闊的[平坦山谷](https://goo.gl/maps/6TvF6u9qvM7ZGx2k8)，而耶路撒冷地區則總是丘陵起伏。其次，如果你看到由[耶路撒冷石](https://goo.gl/maps/8QyM47Z1iwZCsiR9A)建造的房屋，你很可能就在耶路撒冷附近。

text: Most of the West Bank has a **semi-arid** Mediterranean landscape. It is generally greener than southern Israel, drier than northern Israel and west of Jerusalem, and hillier and less agricultural than central Israel.
text_zh: 約旦河西岸的大部分地區擁有**半乾旱**的地中海地景。它通常比以色列南部綠色，比以色列北部和耶路撒冷以西乾燥，且比以色列中部多山、農業活動較少。

text: Mount Carmel is a **long mountain ridge**, going northwest to southeast, near the city of Haifa. From the northeast, it can easily be recognised by its direction and size.
There is also a lot of coverage [on top](https://goo.gl/maps/A4p7Eveq31t2uCDB9) of the mountain range, which is generally fairly green and looks noticeably high altitude.
text_zh: 卡梅爾山（Mount Carmel）是位於海法市附近、呈西北至東南走向的**狹長山脈**。從東北方向看，它的方向和規模讓它極易被辨識。
山脈[頂部](https://goo.gl/maps/A4p7Eveq31t2uCDB9)也有許多拍攝畫質，這裡通常相當綠意盎然，並且海拔看起來明顯很高。

text: Mount Gilboa is a very **dry looking mountain**, which can be seen from far away and from many angles.
There is [some coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/YJhYwAjXK71YwQtj9) on top of the mountain, which is very green and often with a very good view over the surrounding valleys.
text_zh: 吉利波阿山（Mount Gilboa）是一座外觀非常**乾燥的山脈**，從遠處和多個角度都能看到。
山頂上有[一些街景覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/YJhYwAjXK71YwQtj9)，那裡非常綠意盎然，並且經常能將周圍的山谷景色盡收眼底。

text: The southern stretch of road 90 will have a **dry mountain range** to the east. It is also common to see palm trees.
text_zh: 90號公路的南部路段東側會有一座**乾燥的山脈**。看到棕櫚樹也很常見。

text: Road 2 can usually be recognised by the Mediterranean sea being visible on the west side of the road.

NOTE: If you see [mountains to the east](https://www.google.com/maps/@32.7489022,34.9519266,3a,75y,93.89h,86.25t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sJSwoI-La_6_N63MjNVZ4Dg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu), you will be somewhere between Haifa and Zikhron Yaakov.
text_zh: 2 號公路通常可以透過道路西側看得見地中海來識別。
NOTE: 如果你看到[東側有山脈](https://www.google.com/maps/@32.7489022,34.9519266,3a,75y,93.89h,86.25t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sJSwoI-La_6_N63MjNVZ4Dg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)，你就會身處海法和濟克龍雅科夫（Zikhron Yaakov）之間。

text: Timna National park can be recognised by the complete dryness combined with the mountain ridges in **all directions**.
text_zh: 蒂姆納國家公園（Timna National park）可以透過極度的乾燥以及**四面八方**的山脊來辨識。

text: These **tall, rocky mountains** can be found east of Eilat, making the city very easy to recognize.
text_zh: 這些**高聳的岩山**可以在埃ilat（埃拉特）以東找到，這使得該城市非常容易辨識。

text: This mountain range, in the far north of Israel, can be recognised by its shape, somewhat resembling a **camel's back**.
As a bonus, if you are in a city and see these mountains to the west, you will be in Kiryat Shmona.
text_zh: 位於以色列極北處的這個山脈，其外形有點像**駱駝的背**，可以透過這個特徵來辨識。
作為額外加分，如果你身處某個城市且向西看到這些山脈，你就會在基爾夏特什莫納（Kiryat Shmona）。

text: The Israel National Trail goes through the entire country and has one of the **longest trekkers** in the world. The trail goes through more or less every landscape present in the country, from the [rocky desert](https://goo.gl/maps/N9yF7LjTjYj2jXo89) in the south to [lush forests](https://goo.gl/maps/iKEmza2XMqA6DuP6A) in the north. Along the trail you may find [these markings](https://www.google.com/maps/@29.7794747,34.9703316,2a,15y,278.69h,83.71t,2.5r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sCNnIN-Yjz8voGkn46w7zjw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu), which will typically be orange, blue and white, but can also feature [other colour schemes](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.8947414,34.9497539,2a,15y,70.95h,72.04t,2.13r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sEjA0G5uGy2rDeCJn5cFLSA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 以色列國家步道貫穿整個國家，擁有世界上**最長的徒步拍攝**之一。該步道或多或少會穿過國內現存的所有景觀，從南部的[岩石沙漠](https://goo.gl/maps/N9yF7LjTjYj2jXo89)到北部的[鬱鬱蔥蔥的森林](https://goo.gl/maps/iKEmza2XMqA6DuP6A)。沿著步道你可能會找到[這些標記](https://www.google.com/maps/@29.7794747,34.9703316,2a,15y,278.69h,83.71t,2.5r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sCNnIN-Yjz8voGkn46w7zjw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)，它們通常是橘色、藍色和白色，但也可能採用[其他配色方案](https://www.google.com/maps/@30.8947414,34.9497539,2a,15y,70.95h,72.04t,2.13r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sEjA0G5uGy2rDeCJn5cFLSA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: Kerosine tanks, otherwise known as “Claymores”, can be found more commonly the further **north** you go. They are abundant in Hokkaido, but can be found in prefectures south of it, or in high elevation mountainous areas.
text_zh: 煤油桶（社群俗稱「Claymore」）越往**北**越常見。北海道到處都是，南邊的縣或高海拔山區也找得到。

text: Hot water, gas and propane tanks can be found more frequently in **northern** prefectures or high elevation mountainous areas. Here are a few common variations you can find:
- The standard [hot water tank](https://goo.gl/maps/WPocxwCcZguGUn9z7).
- [Covered](https://goo.gl/maps/JDeGep9WhjT672Gb6) propane tanks.
- [Exposed](https://goo.gl/maps/ZinuXP8pGdw2bmi89) propane tanks.
- These [cylindrical](https://goo.gl/maps/kGsvLXq7p4ekVuw39) tanks.
- And finally, these [circular](https://goo.gl/maps/8esQoGWDtj3uAwvi8) tripod tanks.
Moreover, these are even more common in rural towns or villages, where major water or gas lines are unavailable.
text_zh: 熱水桶、瓦斯桶與丙烷桶在**北部**各縣或高海拔山區較常出現。常見的幾種樣式：
- 標準的[熱水桶](https://goo.gl/maps/WPocxwCcZguGUn9z7)。
- [有外罩的](https://goo.gl/maps/JDeGep9WhjT672Gb6)丙烷桶。
- [裸露的](https://goo.gl/maps/ZinuXP8pGdw2bmi89)丙烷桶。
- 這種[圓柱形](https://goo.gl/maps/kGsvLXq7p4ekVuw39)桶槽。
- 以及這種[圓形](https://goo.gl/maps/8esQoGWDtj3uAwvi8)三腳架桶槽。
此外，在沒有自來水或瓦斯管線的鄉鎮村落，這些設備更為普遍。

text: The further you are **north**, roofs generally transition from tiled to level or flat sloped in order to compensate for heavy snowfall. Northern houses often have **ladders** attached to the side, giving roof access to clear snow.
NOTE: In addition to north to south, high-elevation mountainous regions or high snowfall areas often use such roofs, even in more central or southern prefectures.
text_zh: 越往**北**，屋頂會從瓦片逐漸轉為平緩或平坦的形式，以因應大雪。北部住宅側面常裝有**梯子**，方便上屋頂剷雪。
註：除了南北差異之外，高海拔山區或多雪地帶也常用這種屋頂，即使位在中部或南部各縣。

text: Japan is notably a very mountainous country. However, there are some regions that are quite **flat**, being the Nobi and Kanto **plains**. While at times they can look very similar, determining that it is one or the other can be very helpful.
NOTE: While there are, of course, other flat areas in Japan, these two are the most recognizable.
text_zh: 日本是出了名的多山國家，但有幾處相當**平坦**的地帶，也就是濃尾**平原**與關東平原。兩者有時看起來很像，但能確定是其中之一就很有幫助。
註：日本當然還有其他平坦地區，但這兩處最容易辨認。

text: **Mount Fuji** is the tallest mountain in Japan, with a gradual incline and often snowy summit.
Depending on the elevation, it can be seen from far away. This can create some excellent region guesses, especially if you account for direction and distance.
text_zh: **富士山**是日本最高峰，山勢坡度平緩，山頂經常積雪。
由於海拔夠高，遠距離也看得到。若能一併判斷方位與距離，往往可以推出相當精準的位置。

text: **Cornish palms** (Cordyline australis) can be identified by their distinctive thin trunks and arching leaves. They are commonly used as decorative plants on Jersey.
NOTE: These palms can also be found on some stretches of the British mainland’s coastline.
text_zh: **康沃爾棕櫚**（Cordyline australis）以其特有的細樹幹和拱形葉子為特徵。它們在澤西島上常用作裝飾植物。
註：這些棕櫚樹也可以在英國本土的一些海岸線沿線找到。

text: Imagery containing a greenish-purple **discolouration **can be found in the southwest of the island.

NOTE: This glitch typically makes parts of the screen appear darker than they actually are. In addition, it blends into the landscape more seamlessly than [other glitches](https://goo.gl/maps/4B8quhU7FXLricWn7).
Moreover, this glitch is not unique to Jersey. It can be found in other countries as well.
text_zh: 島嶼西南部可以找到帶有綠紫色**變色**的影像。
註：這種瑕疵通常會使螢幕的一部分看起來比實際更暗。此外，它比[其他瑕疵](https://goo.gl/maps/4B8quhU7FXLricWn7)更能無縫地融入風景中。
而且，這種瑕疵並非澤西島獨有。它也可以在其他國家找到。

text: Jordan is a **very arid** country, with limited vegetation and a lot of almost completely lifeless desert. The lushest parts will still only have the look of an [arid Mediterranean landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zvmGEnAftHUVwb6N9).
text_zh: 約旦是一個**非常乾旱**的國家，植被有限，且有許多幾乎毫無生氣的沙漠。最茂盛的部分也只會呈現[乾旱地中海景觀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zvmGEnAftHUVwb6N9)的外觀。

text: **Highway 15** is the longest **divided highway** with coverage in Jordan. Most of the road is surrounded by desert landscape. It is also surrounded by rocky hills in the south closer to Aqaba.

NOTE: Highway 35 north of Madaba and highway 40 west of Amman are also divided but do not feature a desert landscape, while the divided highway 80 in the south runs mainly from east to west, making it distinguishable.
text_zh: **15號公路**是約旦覆蓋範圍內最長的**分隔雙向公路**。公路大部分被沙漠景觀環繞。在南部靠近亞喀巴的地方，周圍則是岩石山丘。
注意：馬達巴以北的35號公路和安曼以西的40號公路也是分隔道路，但沒有沙漠景觀，而南部的80號分隔公路主要呈東西走向，這點讓它很容易辨認。

text: **Highway 35** connecting Amman and Jerash is a divided road surrounded by hills speckled with green vegetation.
NOTE: Highway 40 west of Amman is also divided and features a similar landscape. However, the **T-shaped** lamppost shown in the image is only found on highway 35 which helps distinguish the two.
text_zh: 連接安曼和傑拉什的**35號公路**是一條周圍點綴著綠色植被山丘的分隔道路。
注意：安曼以西的40號公路也是分隔道路，且具有類似的景觀。不過，圖片中顯示的**T字形**路燈僅見於35號公路，這有助於區分這兩條路。

text: **Highway 40** is a recognisable divided** **road surrounded by low, green shrubbery that makes its way west of Amman through the hilly terrain into the sandy area close to the Dead Sea.
NOTE: **Y-shaped **lamp posts as shown in the image can be found along the length of highway 40, making it distinguishable from highway 35 north of Amman.
text_zh: **40號公路**是一條好認的分隔**道路**，周圍環繞著低矮的綠色灌木叢，從安曼以西穿過丘陵地形，一直延伸到死海附近的沙地區域。
注意：如圖片所示，沿著40號公路全長可以找到**Y字形**路燈，這使其有別於安曼以北的35號公路。

text: For a large majority of Highway 80 and its turns, this **divided valley road** is surrounded by **large, rigid mountains.** When turning onto the stretch of road leading to Aqaba, the mountains level off.
NOTE: The road direction of Highway 80 is east to west, as opposed to Highway 15, which runs north to south.
text_zh: 80號公路的大多數路段和轉彎處，這條**分隔山谷道路**都被**巨大而僵硬的山脈**所環繞。當轉入通往亞喀巴的路段時，山勢就會變得平緩。
注意：80號公路的道路方向是東西走向，而南北走向的則是15號公路。

text: This long stretch of **jagged mountains** can be found on the eastern to southern side of Aqaba.
text_zh: 這段長長的**崎嶇山脈**可以在亞喀巴的東側至南側找到。

text: In some parts of the town of **Wadi Musa**, unique mountains with distinctive, bulbous rock formations can be seen in the background.
text_zh: 在**瓦迪穆薩**（Wadi Musa）城鎮的部分地區，背景中可以看到具有獨特球狀岩石地貌的奇特山脈。

text: Kazakhstan is a big and diverse country, which features a plethora of distinct landscapes like [deserts](https://goo.gl/maps/DWJvw2JjfZTTF2ER9), [grassy steppes](https://goo.gl/maps/FtuwHnxx1cACr5HU9), [mountain passes](https://goo.gl/maps/dnJR7qdEBDQLUkUC9), and [birch forests](https://goo.gl/maps/NTfW9tkDsF2mVbqT8).
Most strikingly, most of the rural coverage in Kazakhstan is in a very empty, open and mostly flat landscape.
text_zh: 哈薩克是一個廣闊且地形多樣的國家，擁有大量不同的景觀，例如[沙漠](https://goo.gl/maps/DWJvw2JjfZTTF2ER9)、[草地草原](https://goo.gl/maps/FtuwHnxx1cACr5HU9)、[山隘](https://goo.gl/maps/dnJR7qdEBDQLUkUC9)以及[樺樹林](https://goo.gl/maps/NTfW9tkDsF2mVbqT8)。
最顯著的是，哈薩克的鄉村街景大多位於非常空曠、開闊且大多平坦的景觀中。

text: Kazakhstan is a generally flat country, so getting locations that are hilly or mountainous are useful for narrowing the options.
For example, the region around Karaganda is often either [quite hilly](https://goo.gl/maps/FjDGLgLundGni8JW9), or you can see [hills in the distance](https://goo.gl/maps/SCZGbpzayibTNtp18).
Another [notable set of hills](https://goo.gl/maps/8c3KnWMUZDxPyRv69) would be the ones around Aktobe.
And of course getting bigger mountains will mean you are in the [south](https://goo.gl/maps/5NMT4EMQVSw7s1g27), or [east](https://goo.gl/maps/BdLnnfBacQn6G2XA8).
text_zh: 哈薩克大致上是個平坦的國家，因此若遇到有丘陵或山脈的地點，對於縮小選項很有幫助。
例如，卡拉aganda（Karaganda）周邊地區通常[相當多丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/FjDGLgLundGni8JW9)，或者你可以看到[遠處的丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/SCZGbpzayibTNtp18)。
另一處[顯著的丘陵群](https://goo.gl/maps/8c3KnWMUZDxPyRv69)是阿克托貝（Aktobe）周邊的丘陵。
當然，如果看到較大的山脈，則意味著你在[南部](https://goo.gl/maps/5NMT4EMQVSw7s1g27)或[東部](https://goo.gl/maps/BdLnnfBacQn6G2XA8)。

text: These **lush birch forests** next to green fields are common in northern Kazakhstan.
NOTE: This landscape often appears very similar to that found in and around [Omsk Oblast](https://goo.gl/maps/GSSXj16AyYgmrd2L8) in Russia.
text_zh: 這些位於綠色田野旁的**茂密樺樹林**在哈薩克北部很常見。
注意：這種地貌看起來通常與俄羅斯[鄂木斯克州](https://goo.gl/maps/GSSXj16AyYgmrd2L8)及周邊地區非常相似。

text: **Sandy **and shrubby **desert-like** landscapes are common in southwestern Kazakhstan.
text_zh: 哈薩克西南部常見**沙質**且帶有灌木的**沙漠般**地貌。

text: **Tall mountains**, which are often **snow-capped**, can be seen in southeastern Kazakhstan.
text_zh: 哈薩克東南部可以看到**高山**，且通常**山頂覆雪**。

text: The East Kazakhstan Region is **hilly **and **forested**. It was covered in october, so you will see **fall colours** on the vegetation. The town of [Ridder](https://goo.gl/maps/i5kesJk8N1Nm9tJK9) itself is flat, but surrounded by hazy mountains.
text_zh: 東哈薩克州**多山丘**且**多森林**。它是十月份拍攝的，因此你會看到植被呈現**秋季色彩**。[里德](https://goo.gl/maps/i5kesJk8N1Nm9tJK9)城鎮本身是平坦的，但被朦朧的山脈環繞。

text: The landscape in southern Kazakhstan near Uzbekistan is hilly and quite **dry and shrubby**, with a lot of [orange looking grass](https://goo.gl/maps/NMh2NNtw2fLihzkD6). The landscape consists of [dry but grassy rolling hills](https://goo.gl/maps/HVEEsWWCgeKeFyMv7) or [dead flat agricultural land](https://goo.gl/maps/rYuF4Q74ka7y5KXz5) near Zhetisay.
NOTE: These [red and white KM markers](https://goo.gl/maps/55J3nhF75bSt4K7G6) that look like Kyrgyz ones, are only found near Zhetisay.
text_zh: 哈薩克南部鄰近烏茲別克邊境的景觀多丘陵且相當**乾燥多灌木**，有許多[看起來呈橘色的草](https://goo.gl/maps/NMh2NNtw2fLihzkD6)。景觀包含[乾燥但長滿草的起伏丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/HVEEsWWCgeKeFyMv7)，或是傑特賽（Zhetisay）附近[死平的農田](https://goo.gl/maps/rYuF4Q74ka7y5KXz5)。
注意：這些看起來像吉爾吉斯風格的[紅白相間公里碑](https://goo.gl/maps/55J3nhF75bSt4K7G6)，只在傑特賽附近找得到。

text: The divided section of the **E38** goes **southeast to northwest** from Shymkent to Kyzylorda. The road is made of **asphalt**, and it has **all white road lines**. The landscape varies quite a lot; in the south, it is very [green](https://goo.gl/maps/71g8LgQkJqC4mYJF6) and in the north, it gets [dry, sandy, and shrubby](https://goo.gl/maps/StZ6q6CejmVpK7yg8).
Driving direction: Both ways
text_zh: **E38** 的雙向分隔車道從奇姆肯特到克孜勒奧爾達**由東南向西北**延伸。這條路是**柏油**路面，並有**全白色道路標線**。地景變化相當大；南部非常[綠意盎然](https://goo.gl/maps/71g8LgQkJqC4mYJF6)，北部則變得[乾燥、多沙且有灌木](https://goo.gl/maps/StZ6q6CejmVpK7yg8)。
行車方向：雙向
