text: The section of the **M36 **going from Karaganda to Almaty can often be recognised by the road being under construction, with a second lane being built. Yellow lines are common. As for the landscape, it’s a wintery dry [steppe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steppe), which looks noticeably [orange-brown](https://goo.gl/maps/7KVHpuL59rVgZVNt9).
Driving direction: **South **from Karaganda.
text_zh: 從卡拉干達通往阿拉木圖的 **M36 **路段通常可以透過正在施工、正在興建第二車道的路況來辨識。黃色線條很常見。至於地景，則是帶有冬日感的乾燥[草原](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steppe)，看起來明顯呈現[橘褐色](https://goo.gl/maps/7KVHpuL59rVgZVNt9)。
行車方向：自卡拉干達**向南**。

text: Between Karaganda and Astana, the **M36 **is now a divided highway, with **yellow outer lines**. The landscape consists of a grassy, sometimes hilly, steppe with an occasional row of trees along the road. Note that the general **southeast to northwest** road angle is important.
Driving direction: Both ways
text_zh: 在卡拉干達和阿斯塔納之間，**M36 **現在是一條中央分隔的高速公路，帶有**黃色外側線**。地景由草地、有時起伏的草原組成，路旁偶有成排的樹木。請注意，大體的**由東南向西北**道路角度很重要。
行車方向：雙向

text: The** P4/A17** from Astana to Pavlodar is a divided road, generally going **east to west**, through a **hilly steppe landscape** similar to the M36, but is generally less vegetated**. **Most of the road has **outer yellow lines**.
Driving direction: Both ways
text_zh: 從阿斯塔納到巴甫洛達爾的 **P4/A17** 是一條分隔道路，大致呈**東西走向**，穿過類似 M36 但植被通常較少的**起伏草原地景**。**大部分道路都有**黃色外側線**。
行車方向：雙向

text: The roads from Kyzylagash to Druzhba feature a unique hilly landscape, which looks **hazy** and [dead](https://goo.gl/maps/n1VjdBCmbX9VsuD7A). On most sections, you will see small mountains either [south](https://goo.gl/maps/71N7jRTVjSDqnhyf8) or [east](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FqttjKAp8RPKJzJ69) of the road.
Driving direction: **East **from Kyzylagash.
text_zh: 從克孜勒阿加什到德鲁日巴的道路具有獨特的起伏地景，看起來**霧茫茫**且[死氣沉沉](https://goo.gl/maps/n1VjdBCmbX9VsuD7A)。在多數路段上，你會看到道路[南方](https://goo.gl/maps/71N7jRTVjSDqnhyf8)或[東方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/FqttjKAp8RPKJzJ69)有小山。
行車方向：自克孜勒阿加什**向東**。

text: The **A26 **goes from Kandyagash to the intersection of M32/E38.

It has very **bad road quality** throughout, ranging from [poor grainy pavement](https://goo.gl/maps/SutyRPAen8GPgGXP7), to [completely unpaved](https://goo.gl/maps/vAPBAKKBSqP1cY4y5). Apart from the northernmost section, the weather is either cloudy or overcast.
The landscape consists mostly of flat, semi-arid grassy plains.
Driving direction: **North **towards Kandyagash. (Mostly)
text_zh: **A26 **從坎德阿加什延伸至 M32/E38 的交叉口。
它全線的**道路品質非常差**，從[粗糙的顆粒狀鋪面](https://goo.gl/maps/SutyRPAen8GPgGXP7)到[完全未鋪柏油](https://goo.gl/maps/vAPBAKKBSqP1cY4y5)都有。除了最北端路段外，天氣不是多雲就是陰天。
地景主要由平坦、半乾旱的草地平原組成。
行車方向：**向北**朝坎德阿加什。（大部分）

text: The section of the **A1 **going from Astana to Shchuchinsk is a **6-lane divided highway**. The landscape around is generally **quite green**, with trees and grassy plains or hills.
Driving direction: Both ways
text_zh: **A1 **從阿斯塔納到休欽斯克的路段是一條 **6 車道的分隔高速公路**。周圍的地景通常**相當翠綠**，有樹木以及草地平原或山丘。
行車方向：雙向

text: The **A17 **going to Ulytau Region can be recognised by the **bad pavement quality**, where the edges of the road are almost crumbling away, along with the **single white middle road line**, which can be dashed or solid. The landscape itself is a grassy steppe, with some fall coloured trees occasionally lining the roads.
[West of Atasu](https://goo.gl/maps/TdENdhe3WB985Lhi8), the sun is distinctly low on the horizon.
NOTE: A small section east of Atasu has [pristine new pavement](https://goo.gl/maps/XeJe82NWDfF4gH1K9), which has a slight red tint to it.
Driving direction: **Towards **[**Atasu**](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.6874387,71.6576538,13.19z?entry=ttu) from both directions
text_zh: 通往兀魯套州的 **A17 **可以透過**糟糕的鋪面品質**來辨識，道路邊緣幾乎在崩塌，並伴隨著**單一白色中央道路標線**（可能是虛線或實線）。地景本身是草地草原，路旁偶爾點綴著帶有秋色的樹木。
[阿塔苏西方](https://goo.gl/maps/TdENdhe3WB985Lhi8)，太陽明顯在地平線低處。
注意：阿塔苏東方的一小段路擁有[嶄新的 pristine 鋪面](https://goo.gl/maps/XeJe82NWDfF4gH1K9)，帶有一點微紅的色調。
行車方向：從雙向**朝向**[**阿塔苏**](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.6874387,71.6576538,13.19z?entry=ttu)

text: The road north of Zhezqazghan has no road lines. The landscape is **very dry, desolate**, with very limited vegetation** **and slightly hilly. The soil can look very red or orange at times.
The weather is sunny, with a lot of [cumulus clouds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumulus_cloud).
Driving directions: **North **from Nikolskiy
text_zh: 傑茲卡茲甘北方的道路沒有道路標線。地景**非常乾燥、荒涼**，植被非常有限** **且略帶起伏。土壤有時看起來非常紅或橘。
天氣晴朗，有許多[積雲](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cumulus_cloud)。
行車方向：自尼科利斯克**向北**

text: The **R260 **road is mostly paved, but not in the best condition; many cracks can be seen, and it** **mostly lacks road lines. The weather is **overcast** and the landscape is a **slightly hilly steppe**, consisting of somewhat yellow grass and reddish soil, which is very evident when the road is [unpaved](https://goo.gl/maps/TdSkNVCsQwfzuWvQ7).

The **R217 **is very similar, but the road is in [better condition](https://goo.gl/maps/gkFt8pTBsvfWYnuq5) and mostly has very [faded dashed white middle road lines](https://goo.gl/maps/sYN29uJEyzQKdJjt7), which are often quite difficult to see. The further east you go, the more [sparse](https://goo.gl/maps/J4zjwGopGaSfr1N3A) the cloud cover gets.
Driving directions: **South **from Atbasar
text_zh: **R260 **道路大體上有鋪面，但狀況不是最好；可以看到許多裂縫，且它** **大部分缺乏道路標線。天氣**陰天**，地景是**略帶起伏的草原**，由微黃的草和帶紅的土壤組成，當道路[未鋪柏油](https://goo.gl/maps/TdSkNVCsQwfzuWvQ7)時這點非常明顯。
**R217 **非常相似，但道路[狀況較好](https://goo.gl/maps/gkFt8pTBsvfWYnuq5)，且大多帶有非常[褪色的白色虛線中央道路標線](https://goo.gl/maps/sYN29uJEyzQKdJjt7)，通常相當難以看清。你越往東走，雲層覆蓋就會越[稀疏](https://goo.gl/maps/J4zjwGopGaSfr1N3A)。
行車方向：自阿特巴薩爾**向南**

text: In southern Almaty City, there is **snow** coverage **in the mountains**.
text_zh: 在阿爾馬提市南部，**山區**有**雪**景覆蓋。

text: The Altyn Emel National Park is a barren grassland with snowy mountains in all directions. Some parts are [very snowy](https://goo.gl/maps/7K5s7XqLSKzpMLvEA). And in the eastern section, there is a small [curvy mountain pass](https://goo.gl/maps/8rJPLHV5Zs7DxQC87).
text_zh: 阿爾廷埃梅爾國家公園是一片貧瘠的草原，四周環繞著雪山。某些部分[非常雪白](https://goo.gl/maps/7K5s7XqLSKzpMLvEA)。而在東部路段，有一個小型[蜿蜒山隘](https://goo.gl/maps/8rJPLHV5Zs7DxQC87)。

text: The only **May coverage** in Kazakhstan is found in the Almaty exclave of Alataou, which is east of Almaty proper. All of the coverage is sunny and the mountains are visible to the south.
text_zh: 哈薩克唯一有**五月街景覆蓋**的地方位於阿爾馬提飛地阿拉套（Alataou），也就是阿爾馬提本市以東。所有覆蓋都是晴天，且往南方可以看到群山。

text: Near the Turkmenistan border in southwest Kazakhstan, you will find this **unpaved sandy desert road. **The landscape is almost blindingly bright from the sand.
text_zh: 在哈薩克西南方的土庫曼邊境附近，你會找到這條**未鋪裝的沙質沙漠道路。**風景被沙子映得幾乎刺眼。

text: Kenya has many **unique **Google cars in and around its National Parks and Reserves. These are still identifiable by the snorkel which is present in almost all of them.
Many of the National Park and Reserve cars must be used in conjunction with landscape, as they can be found in multiple areas.
_You can learn more about these National Parks and Reserves in the spotlight section._
text_zh: 肯亞的國家公園及保護區內外有許多**獨特的** Google 車。這些車輛依然可以透過幾乎每輛車上都有的進氣 snorkel 來辨識。
許多國家公園和保護區的車輛必須結合地景來判斷，因為它們可能出現在多個地區。
_你可以在特輯單元中了解更多關於這些國家公園與保護區的資訊。_

text: The B9 in the Northeast is entirely unpaved and has bright **reddish orange dirt **with many trees surrounding the road. Most of it is very flat, but the coverage at the western end of the road can have hills and mountains. The soil also transitions into a more sandy colour.
text_zh: 東北部的 B9 公路完全未鋪柏油，擁有明亮的**紅橘色泥土**，道路周圍有許多樹木。大部分路段非常平坦，但道路西端的街景可能會出現丘陵和山脈。土壤也會轉變成更偏向沙子的顏色。

text: The A2 between Isiolo and Marsabit has many plants alongside the road and you will often see **large mountains **in the distance. The stretch going through Namunyak Wildlife Conservation Trust will have a very large mountain range to the west.
text_zh: 伊西奧洛（Isiolo）和馬斯比特（Marsabit）之間的 A2 公路沿線有許多植物，你經常會在遠處看到**大山**。穿過納穆尼亞克野生動物保護信託（Namunyak Wildlife Conservation Trust）的路段，西側會有一座非常巨大的山脈。

text: North of Marsabit will be **much flatter**, with some mountains in the distance. The stretch just north or Marsabit will have mountains visible to the south, while further north, a different range can be seen. It will also have much less vegetation.
text_zh: 馬斯比特以北的地區會**平坦許多**，遠處有一些山脈。馬斯比特正北方的路段往南可以看見山脈，而再往北方則能看見不同的山脈。該處的植被也會少得多。

text: In a lot of the coverage north of **Mt Kilimanjaro**, the mountain is visible to the south, usually obscured by clouds. In the city of [Oloitoktok](https://goo.gl/maps/aRSZy6jApL8BNXkm7), the mountain will often be visible directly to the south.
NOTE: The map shows the location of Mt Kilimanjaro, but it can be seen from very far away.
text_zh: 在**吉力馬札羅山**以北的許多街景覆蓋中，往南方可以看到這座山，通常會被雲層遮蔽。在 [奧洛伊托托克](https://goo.gl/maps/aRSZy6jApL8BNXkm7) 市區，經常可以直接往南看到這座山。
注意：地圖顯示的是吉力馬札羅山的位子，但從非常遠的地方就能看見它。

text: Mara Triangle has no considerable mountains and most of it is either **flat or hilly**. It has a white car that can be found in other Kenyan National Parks. [Generation 4 coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/bKJA3RRXboNWPdgD8) exists there as well.
text_zh: 馬拉三角洲沒有顯著的山脈，大部分地區不是**平原就是丘陵**。這裡有一輛白色的車，可以在其他肯亞國家公園找到。那裡也存在 [第 4 代相機世代街景覆蓋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/bKJA3RRXboNWPdgD8)。

text: Between Kitale and Mt Elgon, you can find the Aberdare car as well, but it will always have **rubber bands**, unlike in Aberdare where it will only have them on the main roads through the park. It can be differentiated from Aberdare by its redder dirt, and **greener **landscape.
text_zh: 在基塔萊和埃爾贡山之間，你也可以找到亞伯德爾的車，但它一定會有**橡皮筋**，不像在亞伯德爾那樣只有在穿過公園的主幹道上才有。它可以透過更紅的泥土和**更綠的**景觀與亞伯德爾區分開來。

text: The area surrounding and between Kerio and Lodwar uses the same car as the Aberdare National Park, but with a vastly different landscape. It is very **sandy, dry**, and has little vegetation.
You may also find yourself in [Generation 3 coverage without car meta](https://goo.gl/maps/SVmfuG3XAkPt2ipv7).
text_zh: 克里奧和洛德瓦爾周圍及之間的地區使用的是與亞伯德爾國家公園相同的車，但景觀截然不同。這裡非常**沙質、乾燥**且植被稀少。
你可能也會發現自己身處[沒有 Google 車特徵的第三代街景覆蓋範圍](https://goo.gl/maps/SVmfuG3XAkPt2ipv7)。

text: Kyrgyzstan can be recognised from the **silver car** and **four bars** that are visible. All coverage is Generation 3.
NOTE: No other country with a similar landscape has a similar Street View car.
text_zh: 可以透過清晰可見的**銀色車**與**四條天線**來辨識吉爾吉斯。所有街景覆蓋均為第三代相機（Generation 3）。
注意：沒有其他擁有類似景觀的國家有相同的 Google 車。

text: All of Kyrgyzstan was covered during the **winter months**, so many of the trees will lack leaves, the landscape will be quite drab, and you can see snow in many parts of Kyrgyzstan.
text_zh: 整個吉爾吉斯斯坦的街景都是在**冬季**拍攝的，所以許多樹木沒有葉子、景觀相當枯黃，且在吉爾吉斯斯坦的許多地方都可以看到雪。

text: Lake Issyk Kul is the **biggest body of water** in Kyrgyzstan. You will often be able to spot it on the roads north and south of the lake. Sometimes it will be obscured by buildings or trees, but the lack of any mountains in the direction of the lake will be a good clue.

NOTE: There are two other significant bodies of water that can be seen from the road: the [Toktogul Reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/ay9ZJWwV3ZNPLviu6) and [Lake Song-Kul](https://goo.gl/maps/zgw4obnegxGGkWSPA). With a bit of practice, you can reliably distinguish these from Issyk Kul however.
text_zh: 伊塞克湖是吉爾吉斯 **最大的水體**。你經常可以在湖泊的南北兩側道路上看到它。有時它會被建築物或樹木遮擋，但朝著湖泊的方向沒有任何山脈會是一個很好的線索。
注意：從路上還可以看見另外兩個重要水體：[托克托古爾水庫](https://goo.gl/maps/ay9ZJWwV3ZNPLviu6)與[松湖](https://goo.gl/maps/zgw4obnegxGGkWSPA)。不過只要稍加練習，你就能穩妥地將它們與伊塞克湖區分開來。

text: As the capital city of Kyrgyzstan, Bishkek is by far the most developed city, featuring many taller **multi-story** buildings you would not see elsewhere. And on the outskirts, you can see [fancier buildings ](https://goo.gl/maps/xd7MyxMkqN71PgQs8)as well. There are also [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/tJvLR8okRKxPUMvx6) south of Bishkek, but these can be hard to see at times.
text_zh: 作為吉爾吉斯的首都，比許凱克是遠比其他地方都還要開發的城市，擁有許多你在其他地方看不到的較高**多層**建築。而在市郊，你也可以看到[更高級的建築](https://goo.gl/maps/xd7MyxMkqN71PgQs8)。比許凱克南方也有[山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/tJvLR8okRKxPUMvx6)，但有時很難看清楚。

text: The coverage south of Bishkek is generally a bit hilly, and you will see the **snowy Tian Shan mountains** to the south. And as Bishkek has the most polluted air of any city, there will usually be visible **smog** to the north.
text_zh: 比許凱克南方的街景通常有點丘陵起伏，你往南會看到**多雪的天山山脈**。由於比許凱克是空氣汙染最嚴重的城市，北方通常會看到明顯的**霧霾**。

text: In the centre of Osh, you can see these **unique mountains** with radio masts on top of them.
text_zh: 在奧什的市中心，你可以看到這些山頂上有無線電鐵塔的**獨特山峰**。

text: Arslanbob is a **snowy** town north of Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad), with hills and mountains all around. As the town is located in the mountains, you can see a lot of **elevation change** inside the town.
NOTE: The town also features the southern mirror.
text_zh: 阿爾斯朗博布（Arslanbob）是馬納斯（舊稱賈拉拉巴德）以北的一個**多雪**城鎮，四周環繞著山丘與山脈。由於該城鎮位於山區，你可以在鎮內看到許多**高低起伏**。
注意：該城鎮同樣具有南部鏡像。

text: Karakol is a city located between snow capped mountains to the north and south. The coverage in the city is **sunny**, and you can see **melting snow** on the ground.
text_zh: 卡拉科爾（Karakol）是一座位於南北白雪皚皚山脈之間的城市。市區的街景是**晴天**，你可以在地面上看到**融雪**。

text: Naryn features a steep **orange ridge** to the north, and big snow capped mountains to the south.
text_zh: 納倫（Naryn）的特徵是北側有一道陡峭的**橘色山脊**，南側則是巨大的雪山。

text: Here, you will see the Tian Shan **mountain range** to the south. The landscape is otherwise **flat**. The further away from the mountains you are, the [foggier](https://goo.gl/maps/8kUk6rSVFqKD7CoEA) they seem.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 在這裡，你會看到南邊的天山**山脈**。除此之外，地貌十分**平坦**。距離山脈越遠，它們看起來就[越霧茫茫](https://goo.gl/maps/8kUk6rSVFqKD7CoEA)。
注意：這段路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: On this long stretch of road, you will see plenty of **snow** all around you, except on the road. The Landscape is generally hilly, except the northeastern and southwestern parts, which are in the mountains.
NOTE: Most of this section features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 在這段漫長的道路上，除了路面之外，你會看到周圍全是**雪**。地貌大體上是丘陵起伏，除了位於山區的東北部和西南部。
注意：這段路的大部分路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: This section of road goes through mountains that have **rocky cliffs**. These mountains are a habitat for lots of [spruce trees](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6) that grow on the cliff sides. A more diverse selection of trees grows next to the river that follows the road. You can see that [some mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A) still have snow on the peaks. Most [signposts](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6) along the road are coloured blue.
NOTE: The southern section of the road features more rocky cliffs that cannot sustain any trees.
text_zh: 這段路穿過擁有**岩石懸崖**的山區。這些山脈是許多生長在懸崖邊的[雲杉樹](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6)的棲息地。順著道路流淌的河流旁生長著更多樣化的樹木。你可以看到[有些山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A)頂端仍有積雪。沿路的 plupart [路標](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6)都是藍色的。
注意：該道路的南部路段有更多無法支撐任何樹木生長的陡峭岩壁。

text: You can see the mostly **dried up** part of the Toktogul Reservoir either to the south or north of the road. There are taller mountains quite close on every side. The northern half is more desolate, while the south features more vegetation and buildings as well.
text_zh: 你可以在道路的南側或北側看到托克托古爾水庫（Toktogul Reservoir）大體上**乾涸**的部分。四面八方都有相當靠近的較高山脈。北半部更為荒涼，而南半部則有更多植被和建築物。

text: You will usually see the Toktogul Reservoir north of the road in this section. It now resembles an actual **lake**. The landscape is generally **hilly**, especially to the south.
NOTE: The road is in better condition than the one south of Issyk Kul.
text_zh: 在這段路上，你通常會看到托克托古爾水庫位於道路北側。它現在看起來就像一個真正的**湖泊**。地貌普遍呈現**丘陵**狀，特別是往南看。
注意：這條路的狀況比伊塞克湖（Issyk Kul）南側的路要好。

text: The road then runs through a **river gorge**, with large, rocky mountains on both sides. It features overcast coverage. A sizable river (the [Naryn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naryn_(river))) is usually visible to the north, next to the road.
text_zh: 接著道路穿過一個**河谷**，兩側都是巨大且岩石密布的山脈。這裡的街景為陰天。一條規模不小的河流（[納倫河](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naryn_(river)))通常位於道路北側，清晰可見。

text: The road then becomes undivided. This section south of Balykchy is **extremely dry**, with the landscape mostly consisting of **small shrubs**, unless you are next to the [Chu river](https://goo.gl/maps/ywDaNU4WiGsZyf6y8). To the north, you can spot [these mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/LP3YHHgYadZiUXew7) that have clouds hovering above them. Otherwise, there are no clouds in this region.
text_zh: 接著道路變回未分隔的雙向道。巴雷克奇（Balykchy）以南的這段路**極為乾燥**，除非你靠近[楚河](https://goo.gl/maps/ywDaNU4WiGsZyf6y8)，否則地貌主要由**小型灌木**組成。往北看，你可以發現[這些山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/LP3YHHgYadZiUXew7)上方懸掛著雲朵。除此之外，這個地區沒有雲。

text: Further up the road, you enter a **dry valley** with mountains flanking both sides. There is barely any vegetation - just some shrubs close to the ground. The river next to the road brings some more [greenery](https://goo.gl/maps/QHRbRNePyag8rCWZ7) to the area. In the southern half of this section, you can see this [slightly snowy ridge](https://goo.gl/maps/EXF4khfG7pRPC3hY6) to the north.
text_zh: 順著路往前，你進入了一個兩側環繞著山脈的**乾燥山谷**。這裡幾乎沒有植被——只有一些靠近地面的灌木。道路旁的小河為該地區帶來了更多[綠意](https://goo.gl/maps/QHRbRNePyag8rCWZ7)。在這段路的南半部，你可以看到北側有這個[微雪的山脊](https://goo.gl/maps/EXF4khfG7pRPC3hY6)。

text: Going further south, you will reach this next valley, which seems equally dry, but the mountains are more rocky and have **trees** growing on them. The road now has very **bad pavement**, and as such you can see dust clouds.
text_zh: 繼續向南，你將抵達下一個山谷，它看起來同樣乾燥，但山脈更為崎嶇且長有**樹木**。現在道路的**路面狀況很差**，因此你可以看到塵土飛揚。

text: Once you get out of the valley, you will notice this area is **more vegetated**, has **more buildings**, and more animals on the now grassy fields. The landscape is still hilly, with bigger mountains to the north, south, and west. The southern mountains are especially distinct, with them being covered in snow. The hills immediately north of Naryn can get very dry, but look out for [snow](https://goo.gl/maps/E8fD9vJwmhoBrUfNA) that you can see in the shade.
text_zh: 一旦你走出了山谷，你會注意到這裡**植被更多**、**建築物更多**，且在現在長滿青草的原野上有更多動物。地貌依舊是丘陵起伏，北側、南側和西側都有更大的山脈。南側的山脈特別顯眼，上面覆蓋著白雪。納倫正北方的山丘會非常乾燥，但請留意你在陰影處可以看到的[雪](https://goo.gl/maps/E8fD9vJwmhoBrUfNA)。

text: The mountains and hills south of Naryn have a unique combination of **snow** and **red soil** that make them very distinct.
text_zh: 納倫以南的山脈和山丘擁有**雪**與**紅土**的獨特組合，使其非常顯眼。

text: The At-Bashi Valley has a [very distinct mountain range](https://goo.gl/maps/DNxLPk2rgUd5Babu9), which you will see to your south from any section on this road. To the north, you can see [scattered mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/GAaBPtEVnyF3xJAa8) that do not form a uniform ridge. There is also a big set of [hills](https://goo.gl/maps/CHXuEYCMG96zSkoY9) to the west.
text_zh: 阿特巴什山谷（At-Bashi Valley）有一個[非常獨特的山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/DNxLPk2rgUd5Babu9)，從這條路的任何路段往南看都能見到。向北看，你可以看到[零星的山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/GAaBPtEVnyF3xJAa8)，它們沒有形成統一的山脊。西側也有一大群[山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/CHXuEYCMG96zSkoY9)。

text: The section from Balykchy to Cholpon Ata is **sunny**, with mountains to the north, and a lake to the south.
text_zh: 從巴雷克奇到喬爾蓬阿塔（Cholpon Ata）的路段是**晴天**，北側有山脈，南側有湖泊。

text: The section east of Cholpon Ata appears **overcast**, with mountains to the north, and a lake to the south. Tall** tree rows** on either side of the road is a common sight.
text_zh: 喬爾蓬阿塔以東的路段呈現**陰天**，北側有山脈，南側有湖泊。道路兩旁高大的**樹排**是常見的景象。

text: The vertical stretch of road north of Karakol is mostly flanked by tall **tree rows** on either side. There are also tall **snowy mountains** to the north and south.
NOTE: The weather changes [here](https://goo.gl/maps/KRut2ZyU5NqN4kSh9), around the midpoint of the road.
text_zh: 卡拉科爾以北的垂直路段兩旁大多有高大的**樹排**夾道。北部和南部也有高大的**雪山**。
注意：天氣在道路中點附近的[這裡](https://goo.gl/maps/KRut2ZyU5NqN4kSh9)發生了變化。

text: On the road west of Karakol, you will see a lot of vegetation on the sides of the roads, and long expanses of green and yellow fields beyond them. You will usually be able to see the [Tian Shan Mountain Range](https://goo.gl/maps/eas6MS21Stbsv2xSA) in the distance to the north. There are [big mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/CADnPrwmSH4cDRNz5) to the south as well, with smaller hills before them.
NOTE: The weather is completely clear east of [this intersection](https://goo.gl/maps/pWreLeU7anq1h2kZ7).
text_zh: 在卡拉科爾以西的路上，你會看到道路兩旁有許多植被，遠處則是綿延不斷的綠黃相間田野。你通常能夠在遠處的北側看到[天山山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/eas6MS21Stbsv2xSA)。南側也有[大山](https://goo.gl/maps/CADnPrwmSH4cDRNz5)，前方則有較小的山丘。
注意：[這個交叉口](https://goo.gl/maps/pWreLeU7anq1h2kZ7)以東的天氣完全晴朗。

text: You will almost always see the **Issyk Kul lake**, and the [Tian Shan mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/xN3btAAdfLjmejwv8) on this section. The soil here is **sandy and rocky**.
text_zh: 在這段路上，你幾乎總是能看到**伊塞克湖**以及[天山山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/xN3btAAdfLjmejwv8)。這裡的土壤**沙多且多石**。

text: You will see a lot of mountains and hills to the south here, but only some hills to the north, with seemingly nothing behind them. You might even see Issyk Kul behind them. There is still a lot of **sand** on the sides of the roads.
text_zh: 在這裡你會看到南側有許多山脈和山丘，但北側只有一些山丘，其後方似乎空無一物。你甚至可能會看到山丘後方的伊塞克湖。道路兩旁仍然有很多**沙子**。

text: The landscape around the western end of Issyk Kul is **drier** than the east. The lake itself and the southern hills are **further away** from the road as well.
text_zh: 伊塞克湖西端周圍的地貌比東部**更乾燥**。湖泊本身以及南側的山丘距離道路也**更遠**。

text: This section of EM-17 is **very snowy**. The hills and mountains around the road are almost fully covered in snow. Unlike the other snowy roads, this road is often covered in **uncleared slush** or melted snow.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: EM-17 的這段路**非常多雪**。道路周圍的山丘和山脈幾乎完全被雪覆蓋。與其他多雪的道路不同，這條路經常覆蓋著**未清除的半融雪**或融雪。
注意：這段路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: Going further west, only the hills to the **south** will have **snow** on them. The landscape is generally dry, with hills to the north and south of the road.
Most of this section features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 繼續向西走，只有**南側**的山丘上會有**雪**。地貌大致乾燥，道路南北兩側都有山丘。
這段路的大部分路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: The road going east of Kazarman is an **unpaved gravel road**, between two **hilly ridges** on either side. The ridge to the north is further away, and has a bigger set of mountains visible behind it. The mountain ridge has a [unique mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/4ho1Xxywx3kqwBb67) that towers above the rest.
text_zh: 卡扎爾曼（Kazarman）以東的道路是一條**未鋪 asfalt 的碎石路**，介於兩側的兩道**丘陵山脊**之間。北側的山脊距離較遠，其後方可見一組更大的山脈。山脊上有一座高出其他山峰的[獨特山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/4ho1Xxywx3kqwBb67)。

text: The eastern side of EM-13 closely resembles the road going west of Naryn. (See tip below) This road, however, is an unpaved gravel road in the middle of the Naryn valley, so the hills to the north are now closer. The Landscape is filled with bushes, shrubs, and grass.

NOTE: The one [town](https://goo.gl/maps/1thfQDp4CWjf8LFd6) in the region can be recognized by these [white-and-red fences](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4501666,74.8385784,3a,19y,34.51h,67.32t,0.03r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suyOimMFlXHwwDfOq3fpKRQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) with a white diamond pattern in the middle.
text_zh: EM-13 的東側非常類似納倫以西的道路。（見下方提示）然而，這條路是納倫河谷中央的一條未鋪面碎石路，因此北側的山丘現在更靠近了。地貌充滿了灌木、矮樹叢和青草。

注意：該地區的唯一[城鎮](https://goo.gl/maps/1thfQDp4CWjf8LFd6)可以透過中間帶有白色菱形圖案的[紅白相間圍欄](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4501666,74.8385784,3a,19y,34.51h,67.32t,0.03r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suyOimMFlXHwwDfOq3fpKRQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)來辨識。

text: This road going west of Naryn is situated south in the **dry** Naryn valley. You will typically see hills **close** to the road on the southern side. There are also bigger mountains not too far behind. While to the north, there is a wide plain, with hills and mountains in the distance. Many parts of the road also have a pavement with a [salt and pepper-like quality](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4307504,75.7604242,3a,19.2y,69.61h,72.46t,0.49r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfkTujXcKAOpKC3EtfhN0tg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 這條納倫以西的道路位於**乾燥**納倫河谷的南部。你通常會看到南側有**緊鄰**道路的山丘。不太遠的後方也有更大的山脈。而北側則是一個開闊的平原，遠處有山丘和山脈。道路的許多部分還擁有具有[胡椒鹽般特質](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4307504,75.7604242,3a,19.2y,69.61h,72.46t,0.49r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfkTujXcKAOpKC3EtfhN0tg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的路面。

text: The M-082 is a unique road, with only a small section being covered, from the shore of Song-Kul to the mountains right south of it.
Includes **2** tips.
text_zh: M-082 是一條獨特的道路，只有一小段有街景覆蓋，從宋湖（Song-Kul）的湖岸一直延伸到正南方的山脈。
包含 **2** 個小技巧。

text: The road in the mountains south of Song-Kul is the only unpaved road this **high up** in the mountains. You can see the clouds below you, down in the valleys below. The mountains have rugged peaks, and snowy cliff sides. Many of the mountains also have **spruce trees** growing on them.
text_zh: 宋湖以南山區的道路是山區中海拔**這麼高**的唯一未鋪面道路。你可以看到下方的雲朵在下方的山谷中。山脈擁有崎嶇的山峰和覆蓋著雪的懸崖邊。許多山脈上還生長著**雲杉樹**。

text: On this road, you should be able to see the **Kara Darya river** to the east in the valley below the road. The region is generally hilly and green. To the north, you can see some [low-lying mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/fYZUkPu26QE6tfCQ9) in the distance, they have some snow on them. The hills east of the river have snow on the top as well.
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Dirty Mirror.
text_zh: 在這條路上，你應該能夠看到道路下方山谷中東側的**卡拉達里亞河（Kara Darya river）**。該地區普遍多山且綠意盎然。向北看，你可以在遠處看到一些[低矮山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/fYZUkPu26QE6tfCQ9)，上面有一些雪。河流東側的山丘頂部也有雪。
注意：這段路段具有南部髒鏡像。

text: There will generally be some **snow** on the ground on this road. You will see more snow depending on how north you are. You will often see the massive [Gora Babash-Ata mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/kGtjN6oAmAbvkUze9) to the north.
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Dirty Mirror.
text_zh: 這條路上的地面通常會有一些**雪**。你會根據自己有多靠北而看到更多雪。你經常會看到北側巨大的[巴巴什阿塔山（Gora Babash-Ata）](https://goo.gl/maps/kGtjN6oAmAbvkUze9)。
注意：這段路段具有南部髒鏡像。

text: This section of M-107 is **dry and rocky**. There are a lot of mountains around, but [this one ridge](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4371677,72.2096491,3a,21.4y,37.6h,94.9t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s_g43tNH_JZ14j9fSIrncTg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) specifically can be seen from most of this section.

NOTE: This is what [the ridge](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.6308683,72.0703855,3a,15y,123.88h,92.76t,0.97r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sRRet5QctN8yaoLRahjoS3w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=tts&shorturl=1) looks like from further away.
text_zh: M-107 的這段路**乾燥且多石**。周圍有很多山脈，但特別是[這道山脊](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4371677,72.2096491,3a,21.4y,37.6h,94.9t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s_g43tNH_JZ14j9fSIrncTg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)可以在這段路的絕大部分地方看到。
註記：[這座山脊](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.6308683,72.0703855,3a,15y,123.88h,92.76t,0.97r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sRRet5QctN8yaoLRahjoS3w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=tts&shorturl=1)從遠處看是長這樣的。

text: This section near Arkit has a lot of **snow** everywhere and **low broad leafed trees** all around. This already unique landscape paired with the south to north driving direction makes it very easy to recognise.
text_zh: 阿爾基特附近的這段路到處都是**雪**，周圍環繞著**低矮的闊葉樹**。這種本就獨特的景觀搭配由南向北的行駛方向，使得這裡非常容易辨認。

text: This section of the M-010 is surrounded by beautiful **spruce covered snowy mountains**. Some snow has also gathered on the sides of the road.
text_zh: M-010的這段路被美麗的**雲杉覆蓋的雪山**環繞。路邊也積了一些雪。

text: There is another road with coverage to the east of the Chunkurchak road: it goes through a very **rocky valley**, with a variety of plants growing on the mountainsides, of which only some have small amounts of snow. You can also see some snow in the valley, and more so towards the south.
text_zh: 在春丘克道路的東側還有另一條有街景覆蓋的路：它穿過一個非常**岩石密布的山谷**，山坡上生長著各種植物，其中只有少數有少量的雪。你也可以在山谷中看到一些雪，越往南越多。

text: You can easily recognise this side road, labelled as A367 on the map, from the snow covered mountain ranges in **every** direction. The sun to the south is almost blinding.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 你可以從**四面八方**被覆雪山脈環繞的特徵，輕鬆認出這條在地圖上標示為A367的小路。南邊的太陽幾乎令人目眩。
注意：這段路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: The road south of Jeti Oguz goes through a valley. The general landscape in this valley is **very green** by Kyrgyzstan standards, there are plenty of trees and bushes growing in the valley and on the hills. You can see small patches of snow still on the ground. From most of the valley, you can still see the [Tian Shan mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/n5nMitgC1Zx3N7H69) to the north, and other snowy mountains to the south. The valley also contains these [unique orange rock formations](https://goo.gl/maps/b1a7ct7RJ3iedLDPA).
text_zh: 傑提奧古茲（Jeti Oguz）南側的道路穿過一個山谷。以吉爾吉斯標準來看，這個山谷中的整體景觀**非常翠綠**，山谷中和山丘上生長著大量的樹木和灌木。你還可以看到地面上有一小塊一小塊的殘雪。從山谷的大部分地方，你仍然可以看到北邊的[天山山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/n5nMitgC1Zx3N7H69)，以及南邊的其他雪山。山谷中也包含這些[獨特的橙色岩石地形](https://goo.gl/maps/b1a7ct7RJ3iedLDPA)。

text: The road north of Grigorievka goes through a stunning river valley. This is one of the most unique roads in Kyrgyzstan. You can easily recognise it from the **spruce covered mountains** in this rocky valley. The lack of snow is also notable.

The [northern half](https://www.google.com/maps/@42.8331837,77.4143633,2a,90y,134.55h,91.08t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D36.16604%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) of this road is on an open rolling field with pine forests scattered around.
text_zh: 格里戈里耶夫卡（Grigorievka）北側的道路穿過一個令人驚嘆的河谷。這是吉爾吉斯最獨特的道路之一。你可以從這個岩石山谷中**雲杉覆蓋的山脈**輕易將其認出。沒有雪也是一個顯著特點。

這條路的[北半部](https://www.google.com/maps/@42.8331837,77.4143633,2a,90y,134.55h,91.08t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D36.16604%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)位於開闊的起伏原野上，周圍散落著松林。

text: There is a side road north of the Orto Tokoy Reservoir that has very broken coverage. This road is **well maintained**, and it passes through **dry mountains**. The only vegetation around is grass and shrubs. To the west, you can see this [mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/EYX6oJnUFHhxN89P8) which has little snow left. To the north, the [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/NP7X99RuTAnMVSNu5) are dark, similar to silhouettes, and on the southern portion of the road, you will see the [reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/tqBo8qMqdCXkZhjT9).
text_zh: 奧爾托托科伊水庫（Orto Tokoy Reservoir）北側有一條支路，其街景覆蓋非常破碎。這條路**維護良好**，它穿過**乾旱的山脈**。周圍唯一的植被是草和灌木。向西望去，你可以看到這座[山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/EYX6oJnUFHhxN89P8)，上面幾乎沒有殘雪。向北望去，[山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/NP7X99RuTAnMVSNu5)呈深色，類似剪影，而在道路的南部，你會看到[水庫](https://goo.gl/maps/tqBo8qMqdCXkZhjT9)。

text: This remote gravel road southwest of Naryn passes through a **dry and desolate valley**. Despite the river, there is nothing but some shrubs on the ground. Many of the mountains in the valley have steep, rocky cliff sides. You will also find snow here, but more so in the south.
text_zh: 納倫（Naryn）西南方這條偏遠的碎石路穿過一個**乾旱荒涼的山谷**。儘管有河流，但地面上除了幾叢灌木外什麼也沒有。山谷中的許多山脈都有陡峭的岩石懸崖面。你在這裡也會發現雪，但越往南越多。

text: Street View coverage in Laos is very **limited**. Only five cities are covered: Vientiane, Vang Vieng, Luang Prabang, Savannakhet, and Pakse.
In addition, all coverage in Laos was taken by a Generation 3 camera.

All five cities have a distinct look and with some practise they are easily distinguishable from each other. The differences are discussed in more detail in the region-guessing section, but the summarized version is as follows:
- **Luang Prabang**: historical architecture, hills, palms
- **Vang Vieng**: distinct mountains
- **Vientiane**: no roof rack, large city
- **Savannakhet**: very flat
- **Pakse**: red soil, arid, hills
text_zh: 寮國的街景覆蓋非常**有限**。只有五個城市有覆蓋：永珍（Vientiane）、旺陽（Vang Vieng）、龍坡邦（Luang Prabang）、沙灣拿吉（Savannakhet）和巴色（Pakse）。
此外，寮國的所有覆蓋都是由第 3 相機世代拍攝的。
這五個城市都有獨特的外觀，經過一些練習後，它們很容易彼此區分。這些差異將在區域猜題部分進行更詳細的討論，但總結版本如下：
- **龍坡邦**：歷史建築、山丘、棕櫚樹
- **旺陽**：特異的山峰
- **永珍**：沒有車頂架、大城市
- **沙灣拿吉**：非常平坦
- **巴色**：紅土、乾旱、山丘

text: Luang Prabang is located on the [Mekong River](https://goo.gl/maps/kdK5uhvp6kE4E3zc6) and surrounded by low **mountains** and hills (not always visible).
text_zh: 龍坡邦位於[湄公河](https://goo.gl/maps/kdK5uhvp6kE4E3zc6)畔，周圍環繞著低矮的**山脈**和丘陵（並不總是看得見）。

text: This **rugged mountain range** can be seen from almost any point in Vang Vieng, and is the most reliable way of recognizing it.
NOTE: Vang Vieng has [very limited coverage](/images/laos/laos_vangviengcoverage.png); by far the least out of all 5 Lao cities. The actual coverage is also south of the Vang Vieng label on the map.
text_zh: 從旺陽的幾乎任何地方都可以看到這座**崎嶇的山脈**，這是識別它最可靠的方法。
註記：旺陽的[街景覆蓋非常有限](/images/laos/laos_vangviengcoverage.png)；是所有 5 個寮國城市中最少的。實際覆蓋範圍也在地圖上旺陽標籤的南方。

text: Vang Vieng is also very **touristic**: you will see a lot of signs for hotels, guesthouses, and other tourism-related enterprises. In the (very few) rounds that the distinct mountains are blocked by buildings, this is a good way to recognize the town.
text_zh: 旺陽也非常**觀光化**：你會看到大量關於飯店、民宿和其他旅遊相關企業的招牌。在特異山脈被建築物擋住的（極少數）回合中，這是識別該城鎮的好方法。

text: The road that goes through the conservation area features uniquely **hilly **terrain for Laos. Landscape around the road is also very **dry**, and mostly **forested**. Additionally, the road is in good condition with coloured curbs and dashed outer lines.
NOTE: It is the only single lane road that has black and white or yellow and white curbs.
text_zh: 穿過保育區的道路具有寮國少見的**丘陵**地形。道路周圍的景觀也非常**乾旱**，且大多為**森林**。此外，道路狀況良好，配有彩色緣石和虛線外側標線。
註記：這是唯一一條擁有黑白或黃白緣石的單車道道路。

text: Savannakhet is very **flat**: the only mountains that are visible are on the other side of the Mekong river, in Thailand.
It is also recognizable as its soil has a **slight red** tinge, however not as red as Pakse.
NOTE: On Google Maps, the label for Savannakhet is hidden under the label of the Thai province of Mukdahan until you zoom in relatively close. You can find Savannakhet by going west of Xeno.
text_zh: 沙灣拿吉非常**平坦**：唯一能見到的山脈在湄公河對岸的泰國境內。
它也可以透過其土壤帶有**微紅**色調來辨識，不過沒有巴色那麼紅。
註記：在 Google 地圖上，沙灣拿吉的標籤藏在泰國莫拉限府（Mukdahan）的標籤下方，直到你放大到相對接近的程度。你可以透過向西前往瑟農（Xeno）來找到沙灣拿吉。

text: The area south of Jelgava is characterised by a **wide open landscape** with considerably less forest and more fields than most of the rest of Latvia.
text_zh: 葉爾加瓦以南地區的特徵是**開闊廣大的景觀**，與拉脫維亞其他大部分地區相比，森林明顯較少而田野更多。

text: Lebanon has a **Mediterranean landscape**, with a lot of hills and rocky cliffs.
text_zh: 黎巴嫩擁有**地中海景觀**，有許多丘陵和岩石峭壁。

text: The region around Zahle has flat agricultural fields, with mountains visible to the northwest.
text_zh: 扎勒萊周邊地區有平坦的農田，西北方可以看見山脈。

text: Coverage where **snow **is visible on mountain tops, or on the ground, is found in the northeastern mountains, east of Tripoli.
text_zh: 山頂或地面上看得見**雪**的街景覆蓋，位於黎波里以東的東北部山脈。

text: Northern Lebanon is **very flat** and **agricultural**. You might see the mountains to the southeast.
text_zh: 黎巴嫩北部**非常平坦**且**充滿農業活動**。你可能會看到東南方的山脈。

text: One of the best ways to identify the country are the characteristic ‘**Lesotho mountains**’. They are bare and treeless, often have tabletop-like shapes, and recognizable horizontal rocky ridgelines.

Depending on where you are in the country, the mountains can vary a bit in appearance. Especially inland areas towards the southeast, where they appear more like [rolling green hills](https://goo.gl/maps/uRYrjkWN2cmHuVEx6) rather than isolated tabletop mountains. However, you will still often be able to see the [horizontal rocky ridges](https://goo.gl/maps/MVrsuyyabZ25F6YH7).
text_zh: 辨識這個國家最好的方法之一是具有代表性的「**賴索托山脈**」。它們光禿禿且沒有樹木，通常呈桌山般的形狀，並具有可辨識的水平岩石山脊線。
根據你身處國家的哪個位置，山脈的外觀可能會有些許差異。特別是往東南方的內陸地區，那裡的群山看起來更像是[起伏的綠色丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/uRYrjkWN2cmHuVEx6)，而不是孤立的桌山。不過，你通常還是能看到[水平的岩石山脊](https://goo.gl/maps/MVrsuyyabZ25F6YH7)。

text: Lesotho can be roughly divided into two regions, based on landscape: flat and mountainous.

In the **flat region**, the road itself runs through a mostly flat or hilly landscape. “Flat” is a bit of a misnomer, as you will usually still see tabletop-like mountains around you. However they will usually be significantly further away from the road, giving you a more clear line of sight. This “flat” part is the region with the most coverage, settlements and agriculture.
text_zh: 根據景觀，賴索托大致可分為兩個區域：平坦區和山區。
在**平坦區**，道路本身穿過一個大致平坦或丘陵起伏的景觀。「平坦」有點名實不符，因為你通常周圍還是會看到桌山般的山脈。不過它們通常距離道路明顯更遠，能提供更清晰的視線。這個「平坦」的部分是街景覆蓋、聚落和農業最多的區域。

text: Conversely, in the **mountainous part**, the road will usually be directly on the side of the mountain, instead of slightly away from it. The mountains are often large, closer to the road, and covered in green grass.

Coverage in the mountainous part of Lesotho is very sparse: there are only 6 main roads (and a couple of very small off-roads) with coverage, meaning that you can learn each road by heart if you feel so inclined.
text_zh: 相反地，在**山區**，道路通常直接位於山腰上，而不是稍微遠離山脈。山脈通常很大，離道路更近，且長滿了綠草。
賴索托山區的街景覆蓋非常稀疏：只有 6 條主要道路（以及幾條非常小的越野道路）有街景覆蓋，這意味著如果你有這個興致，可以將每一條路都背得滾瓜爛熟。

text: There are two large man-made water reservoirs in the mountainous part of Lesotho, which can be seen from several road sections.
The larger Katse reservoir is visible from parts of the A25. The smaller Mohale reservoir is visible from an off-road of the A3.
NOTE: Do not confuse these with the [small industrial lake](https://goo.gl/maps/E2pkBCdJhdXoezCD9) found near the Letseng diamond mine.
text_zh: 賴索托山區有兩個大型的人工蓄水庫，從幾個道路路段都可以看到。
較大的卡茨水庫（Katse reservoir）從 A25 的部分路段可見。較小的莫哈萊水庫（Mohale reservoir）從 A3 的一條越野道路可見。
注意：不要把這些與雷特森（Letseng）鑽石礦場附近找到的[小型工業湖](https://goo.gl/maps/E2pkBCdJhdXoezCD9)搞混了。

text: The road going from Ramatsediso to **Sehlabathebe NP**, in the southeast on the border with South Africa, is very recognizable. Consider guessing there if the following three things are all true for your location:
- Unpaved road with light brown soil.
- Good weather with little fluffy clouds.
- Grassy landscape high in the mountains.
You will also often be able to see exposed, light-coloured rocks next to the road.
text_zh: 從拉馬特西索（Ramatsediso）通往東南部與南非交界處的**塞拉巴泰貝國家公園（Sehlabathebe NP）**的道路非常容易辨識。如果你的位置符合以下三種情況，請考慮猜測在那裡：
- 土路且帶有淺棕色土壤。
- 天氣晴朗且有少許蓬鬆的雲朵。
- 高山上的草原景觀。
你通常也還能看到路旁裸露、顏色較淺的岩石。

text: Qacha's Nek is a very recognizable town that is located far away from most other towns, on the southeastern border with South Africa.
It is situated right in the middle of **green mountains**, and it had noticeably **bad weather** when the Google car drove there.
text_zh: 卡查斯內克（Qacha's Nek）是一個非常容易辨識的城鎮，位於距離大多數其他城鎮很遠的東南部與南非邊境上。
它坐落於**綠色山脈**的正中間，當 Google car 開過去時，那裡的**天氣明顯很糟**。

text: Most coverage in Liechtenstein is situated in a somewhat flat river valley, but with tall mountains in almost every direction. In particular, within this valley, you will almost always be able to see the nearby mountains towering above you to the east. Most of the mountainous coverage is just on the slopes of the mountains, with only a small amount properly in the mountains.
As a result of the flat Rhine River Valley, Liechtenstein has a lot of pastures and other agricultural land.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登的大部分街景覆蓋都位於相對平坦的河谷中，但幾乎每個方向都有高山。特別是，在這個河谷內，你幾乎總是能看到東側附近的高山高聳在你上方。大部分山區的街景覆蓋都只在山坡上，只有一小部分真正位於山區內。
由於平坦的萊茵河谷，列支敦斯登有許多牧場和其他農田。

text: Triesenberg and its surroundings are a fairly densely populated area on the slope of the mountains just east of the Rhine River Valley, which can often be seen below to the west.
text_zh: 特里森貝格及其周邊地區是萊茵河谷正東方山坡上人口相當稠密的地區，經常可以在下方西方看到。

text: Mountains can be seen all around in the coverage east of the mountain ridge that cuts through Liechtenstein.
text_zh: 在穿過列支敦斯登的山脊以東的街景覆蓋中，四周都可以看到群山。

text: Around Ruggell, there is a small, forested ridgeline to the south. This is a big contrast to the towering mountains seen elsewhere.
text_zh: 在魯格爾周圍，南方有一個帶森林的小型山脊線。這與其他地方看到的巍峨群山形成了巨大對比。

text: Around Mauren, you can see the aforementioned ridge to the north, but this side of the hills is much more developed and urban. And to the south and southeast, you will see the much bigger mountains usually seen to the east.
text_zh: 在毛倫周圍，你可以看到前面提到的北方山脊，但山丘的這一側開發程度更高、更都市化。而在南方和東南方，你會看到平時在東方看到的巨大得多的山脈。

text: There is a set of **rolling hills** that run from Bendern, northeast, to the Austrian border. The rest of Liechtenstein is either very flat or in the mountains.
text_zh: 有一組**起伏的丘陵**從本登（Bendern）向東北延伸至奧地利邊境。列支敦斯登的其餘地區要麼非常平坦，要麼位於山區。

text: The only lakes in Liechtenstein are located just south of Steg, near the middle of the mountains.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登僅有的湖泊位於斯泰格正南方、群山中央附近。

text: Lithuania has **less forest cover** than the other two Baltic countries. As a result, the landscape appears more open and agricultural. Your mileage may vary depending on the round however, so use this meta with some caution.
text_zh: 立陶宛的**森林覆蓋率較低**，不如另外兩個波羅的海國家。因此，風景看起來更為開闊且充滿農田。不過實際情況可能因回合而異，因此在使用這項線索特徵時請保持謹慎。

text: The Curonian Spit is a long thin sand-dune [spit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spit_(landform)) south of Klaipeda, that separates the Curonian Lagoon from the Baltic Sea. The main road on this spit, **road 167**, has a recognizable combination of landscape and road direction:
- The road runs in an approximate north-south direction and has Generation 4 coverage.

The road is surrounded on all sides by forest with many [Baltic pines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_sylvestris). In many places, you will see slightly windswept trees (visible in the example image).
text_zh: 庫爾斯沙嘴（Curonian Spit）是位於克萊佩達（Klaipeda）南方的一條長形細沙[沙嘴](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spit_(landform))，它將庫爾斯潟湖與波羅的海隔開。這條沙嘴上的主要道路——**167號公路**，具有可辨識的地景與道路方向組合：
- 這條路大致呈南北走向，且擁有 Generation 4 街景覆蓋。
道路四周都被森林環繞，並有許多[歐洲赤松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_sylvestris)。在許多地方，你可以看到稍微被風吹歪的樹木（如範例圖片所示）。

text: Chevrons are **black with yellow** arrows. You may also rarely come across [blue and yellow](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.6287886,6.1349694,3a,15y,1.97h,71.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s64mNrisMtRf0qKgQ49PAaw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) chevrons.
NOTE: None of Luxembourg’s neighbours use these chevrons.
The only other European countries with this colour scheme tend to have wildly different landscapes: Iceland, Norway, Finland, Ireland, and Portugal.
text_zh: 轉彎標誌為**黑底黃箭頭**。你也很少會碰到[藍黃相間](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.6287886,6.1349694,3a,15y,1.97h,71.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s64mNrisMtRf0qKgQ49PAaw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)的轉彎標誌。
注意：盧森堡的所有鄰國都沒有使用這種轉彎標誌。
其他採用這種配色方案的歐洲國家，其景觀往往截然不同：冰島、挪威、芬蘭、愛爾蘭和葡萄牙。

text: Some signposts have this bulky, round reflector with **blue and white** markings.
NOTE: Similar markings are found in Sweden and Finland. Landscape should be sufficient to tell these apart from Luxembourg, however.
text_zh: 有些標誌柱有這種笨重的圓形反光器，帶有**藍白相間**的標記。
注意：瑞典和芬蘭也能找到類似的標記。不過，風景應該足以將這些與盧森堡區分開來。

text: Almost all of Luxembourg’s landscape consists of green **rolling hills**, with a patchwork of agriculture and forests.
NOTE: If you see a yellow licence plate, and you are not sure what country it belongs to, landscape is often a good clue: almost all of the Netherlands is completely flat.
text_zh: 盧森堡的景觀幾乎全由綠色**起伏丘陵**組成，夾雜著農田和森林。
NOTE: 如果你看到黃色車牌，且不確定它屬於哪個國家，風景通常是一個很好的線索：荷蘭幾乎完全是平地。

text: A beach west of Ambiky can be recognized by the **low trees** combined with low mountains to the northwest.
text_zh: 安比基以西的海灘可以透過**矮樹**結合西北方的低矮山脈來辨識。

text: The Tsaranoro Massif is a large [**monolithic mountain**](https://goo.gl/maps/coxbSnD6beVYspY19) with trekker coverage. The steep mountainsides, combined with the mountainous area surrounding the coverage makes it very recognizable. The [four people](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.0973126,46.7594034,2a,90y,182.36h,90.99t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0NR1H26JY_5a9JRRVRluDw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) following the trekker can also occasionally be a useful clue.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅山塊（Tsaranoro Massif）是一座大型[**巨石山**](https://goo.gl/maps/coxbSnD6beVYspY19)，具備徒步拍攝街景覆蓋。陡峭的山壁，加上環繞街景覆蓋的山區使其非常好認。跟著徒步拍攝的[四個人](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.0973126,46.7594034,2a,90y,182.36h,90.99t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0NR1H26JY_5a9JRRVRluDw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)有時也是一個有用的線索。

text: A small part of the coverage in Tsaranoro was taken inside a forest, which occasionally hides the surrounding mountains. The best way to recognize this area is the relatively **dark coverage**, combined with the four people following the trekker.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅的一小部分街景覆蓋是在森林內部拍攝的，這偶爾會遮蔽周圍的山脈。辨識這個區域的最佳方式是相對**昏暗的街景覆蓋**，結合跟著徒步拍攝的四個人。

text: A **small settlement** is found in the northeastern end of Tsaranoro. The mountains can typically be seen in the background.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅東北端有一個**小型聚落**。背景通常可以看到群山。

text: The second part with the same two people is found to the east of St Augustin, going through a **hilly landscape** with a lot of shrubs.
text_zh: 第二段有著同樣兩個人，位在 St Augustin 東側，會穿過一片有許多灌木的**起伏山丘景觀**。

text: Madeira is a very mountainous and semi-tropical island.
NOTE: The Azores are less mountainous and more temperate.
text_zh: 馬德拉是一個非常多山且半熱帶的島嶼。
注意：亞克索群島（Azores）山脈較少且氣候更溫和。

text: Due to the lack of flat terrain, **terrace farming** is extensively practised on the island. Stone walls are used to separate the individual plateaus.
text_zh: 由於缺乏平坦地形，島上廣泛使用**梯田農業**。石牆被用來分隔各個臺地。

text: As a result of the island’s mountainous terrain, **tunnels** are very common.
text_zh: 由於島嶼多山的地形，**隧道**非常普遍。

text: **Pico Areeiro** is the second highest mountain on the island, and the highest with coverage. It can be recognized by its view over most of the island, and the white radar station at the top.
text_zh: **皮庫艾里魯峰**是島上第二高峰，也是有街景覆蓋的最高峰。它可以透過俯瞰島上大部分地區的視野以及山頂白色的雷達站來辨識。

text: Trash bins with this logo featuring a **sunny landscape**, saying **‘Alam Flora’** are found in Pahang, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya. The logo will occasionally be absent, and it will just say ‘Alam Flora’.
text_zh: 印有**陽光風景**圖案並寫著**「Alam Flora」**字樣的垃圾桶可以在彭亨、吉隆坡和布城找到。這個標誌有時會省略，只寫「Alam Flora」。

text: Assuming you are on Borneo: the state of Sabah is **very mountainous**, and much of the coverage is on mountain roads like this one.
NOTE: Sarawak generally has flatter roads. Even if you see mountains, they will usually be at a [distance](https://goo.gl/maps/5VrnWWJCBfNgREaP7).
text_zh: 假設你在婆羅洲：沙巴州**非常多山**，且大部分的街景都在像這樣的山路上。
注意：砂勞越的道路通常較平坦。就算你看到山，通常也都在[遠處](https://goo.gl/maps/5VrnWWJCBfNgREaP7)。

text: These **isolated rock formations**, rising abruptly from an otherwise flat landscape, can be found near the Thai border in Perlis state.
text_zh: 這些**孤立的岩層**從平坦的地景中拔地而起，可以在玻璃市州的泰國邊境附近找到。

text: Mali is generally an **arid** country. Seeing a sandy, dry landscape can help with immediately distinguishing the Mali tripods from most tripods in other countries.
text_zh: 馬利大致上是一個**乾旱**的國家。看到沙質、乾燥的地景有助於立即將馬利的三腳架與其他多數國家的三腳架區分開來。

text: The general landscape of Malta consists of slightly hilly **dry agricultural fields**. Many roads are also only 1 or 2 lanes wide, due to the island’s size. Having a mediterranean climate, [cacti](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kh2pMFPUTQhivKT76#extra%5Btags%5D=yes) and various [dry shrubs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BqgdrBxdG2UFft3z7#extra%5Btags%5D=yes) can be seen.
text_zh: 馬爾他的整體地景由微坡的**乾燥農田**組成。由於島嶼的面積，許多道路也只有 1 或 2 個車道寬。由於擁有地中海氣候，可以看到[仙人掌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Kh2pMFPUTQhivKT76#extra%5Btags%5D=yes)和各種[乾燥灌木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BqgdrBxdG2UFft3z7#extra%5Btags%5D=yes)。

text: Habitation Clément is a **rum distillery** covered by a trekker. Due to it being pinpointable, some locations are on maps such as [ACW](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/62a44b22040f04bd36e8a914). There are several landscapes in and around the distillery, including:
- A [warehouse](https://goo.gl/maps/zSrUUsk3JPYyyP8YA) with a truck and a forklift.
- A [view of the outside](https://goo.gl/maps/FW2mfgwes23dj1yd6) with hills in the background and machinery on display.
- A [rural dirt track](https://goo.gl/maps/3Wx7QjXUcCUVRuRU9) outside with red soil and palm trees.
- The [inside of the distillery](https://goo.gl/maps/mnoysxVXLY5VZBpN7) with the structure made of H-beam steel.
text_zh: 克萊芒莊園（Habitation Clément）是一個有徒步拍攝覆蓋的**蘭姆酒蒸餾廠**。由於它是可精準定位的，因此有些位置會出現在諸如 [ACW](https://www.geoguessr.com/maps/62a44b22040f04bd36e8a914) 等地圖上。蒸餾廠內外有幾種景觀，包括：
- 一個有卡車和堆高機的[倉庫](https://goo.gl/maps/zSrUUsk3JPYyyP8YA)。
- 一個[戶外景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/FW2mfgwes23dj1yd6)，背景有山丘並展示著機械。
- 外部的[農村泥土小徑](https://goo.gl/maps/3Wx7QjXUcCUVRuRU9)，有著紅土和棕櫚樹。
- 蒸餾廠[內部](https://goo.gl/maps/mnoysxVXLY5VZBpN7)，其結構由 H 型鋼梁製成。

text: The Monterrey metropolitan area features tall stunning **mountain ranges** that surround the city.
text_zh: 蒙特雷都會區擁有環繞城市的壯麗高大**山脈**。

text: The western parts of Chihuahua and Durango can feature a rocky mountainous landscape covered with **pine forests**. In general, these pines are shorter and more **stunted **in appearance than pine forests of the central or south.
text_zh: 奇ihuahua州和杜蘭戈州的西部地區可能具有覆蓋著**松林**的岩石山地景觀。一般來說，與中部或南部的松林相比，這些松樹外觀更矮、更**發育不良**。

text: This tall, flat ridge, with very **prominent ridgelines**, belongs to the Maderas del Carmen Biosphere Reserve in Northern Coahuila near the US border.
NOTE: The only road the mountain range can be observed from is the Federal Highway 53 that leads to Boquillas del Carmen.
text_zh: 這座高而平坦的山脊擁有非常 **顯眼的山脊線**，屬於位於美國邊境附近科阿韋拉州北部的馬德拉斯德爾卡門生物圈保護區。
注意：唯一能觀賞到這個山脈的道路是通往博基拉斯德爾卡門的 53 號聯邦公路。

text: The town of Guaymas has a lot of **jagged **cliffs and mountains that make the area very distinct. The soil is also distinctly pinkish and organ-pipe cacti can be seen scattered on the hills and next to the road.
text_zh: 瓜伊馬斯鎮有許多 **陡峭的** 懸崖和山脈，使該地區非常獨特。土壤也明顯呈粉紅色，仙人柱散布在山丘上和道路旁。

text: The 40D that crosses the Sinaloa-Durango state line is recognizable by the stunning lush **cliffs **and mountains along the road. The highway commonly passes through tunnels and the road itself features **double yellow** middle roadlines.
text_zh: 穿越錫那羅亞州與杜蘭戈州省界的 40D 公路，可以透過沿途令人驚嘆的茂密 **懸崖** 和山脈來辨識。這條公路經常穿過隧道，路面本身則有 **雙黃線** 的中央道路標線。

text: Mongolia has a very flat landscape in the [east](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.73666,115.619004,3a,133.2y,131.8h,89.73t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPMeGOJzhTczd2N48yJO0SA!2e0) and in the [south](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.625866,110.189335,3a,133.2y,106.3h,88.33t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1suf4vmx84-FxMBRMs_8-nXw!2e0), with rolling hills in the [north](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.670421,107.38073,3a,133.2y,14.0h,90.81t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sJUXSwULUB8Oyo71A1jzpjw!2e0), and large mountains and rocky hills being common in the [west](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.3651208,91.9735923,2a,90y,233.82h,91.68t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1saI5LPmTsTzRoYr99i_qoHg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
text_zh: 蒙古的[東部](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.73666,115.619004,3a,133.2y,131.8h,89.73t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPMeGOJzhTczd2N48yJO0SA!2e0)和[南部](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.625866,110.189335,3a,133.2y,106.3h,88.33t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1suf4vmx84-FxMBRMs_8-nXw!2e0)地勢非常平坦，[北部](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.670421,107.38073,3a,133.2y,14.0h,90.81t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sJUXSwULUB8Oyo71A1jzpjw!2e0)有起伏的山丘，而[西部](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.3651208,91.9735923,2a,90y,233.82h,91.68t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1saI5LPmTsTzRoYr99i_qoHg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)則常見大山和岩石山丘。
_你可以點擊地圖來放大它。_

text: These **dry**, **rugged hills and mountains** are common to see in far western Mongolia.
text_zh: 這些**乾燥**、**崎嶇的山丘和山脈**在蒙古最西部很常見。

text: Due to Mongolia’s harsh climate and terrain, **crop fields** are rare, but they do occasionally appear in the subdivisions of Selenge and Töv,** **near Ulaanbaatar.
text_zh: 由於蒙古嚴酷的氣候和地形，**農田**非常罕見，但它們偶爾會出現在烏蘭巴托附近的色楞格省和中央省行政區。

text: The Mandalgovi Highway runs south of the capital and was covered during a blizzard, making it **extremely snowy and foggy.** It also has a deep blue tent, which is found along this entire road, and a flat landscape which can differentiate it from other snowy roads.
text_zh: 曼達勒戈壁公路（Mandalgovi Highway）位於首都南方，拍攝時正逢暴風雪，因此**極度雪霧迷漫**。這條路的沿線全段都有深藍色的帳篷，且地勢平坦，這點能與其他下雪的道路區分開來。

text: The highway connecting the towns of Chinggis and Baruun-Urt stands out as one of the only **paved highways in the east**. It is considerably cloudy and the road seems freshly paved, making it a **very dark road**, combined with a mostly flat landscape.
text_zh: 連接成吉思市（Chinggis）與巴倫烏爾特（Baruun-Urt）的公路是**東部少數有鋪面的公路**之一，因而格外顯眼。當地雲層偏多，道路看起來像是剛鋪好，呈現**非常深色的路面**，並結合了大多平坦的地形。

text: Baruun-Urt can be identified by the** towering building under construction** in the centre of town (on the map its POI is called “Smile”) combined with the dry landscape.
NOTE: Similar buildings under construction can be found in other towns such as Chinggis but they are not as large and do not feature an** **orange tower crane like the Smile building.
text_zh: 巴倫烏爾特可以透過鎮中心**正在興建的高樓**（在地圖上的地標稱為「Smile」）結合乾燥的地形來辨識。
注意：在其他城鎮（如成吉思市）也能找到類似的在建大樓，但它們沒那麼大，也沒有像 Smile 大樓那樣的**橘色塔式起重機**。

text: The town of Khalkhgol in far east Mongolia can be recognized by its flat, green landscape with low rolling hills and a **giant sword statue** visible in the distance.
text_zh: 位於蒙古極東地區的哈勒赫河鎮（Khalkhgol）可以透過其平坦、綠意盎然且帶有低矮起伏丘陵的地形，以及遠處清晰可見的**巨劍雕像**來辨識。

text: The town of Dariganga can be recognized by the **distinctive hill** present to the northwest of the town in an otherwise flat landscape.
text_zh: 達里甘加鎮（Dariganga）可以透過在平坦地景中、位於城鎮西北方的**獨特山丘**來辨識。

text: Arvaikheer is a large central town recognizable by the **warm, green, and grassy landscape **in gen 4, with low rolling hills in every direction. Often you can see the town’s [ferris wheel](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RzBqinKz157B8kS19) in a park in the centre of town.

NOTE: In older coverage, a distinct [camera smudge](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.2622102,102.7889926,2a,63.4y,51.57h,74.46t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1szEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fcb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile%26w%3D900%26h%3D600%26pitch%3D15.543539424258526%26panoid%3DzEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ%26yaw%3D51.569379852417136!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205410&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MDkwNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) can be seen on the right side of the camera.
text_zh: 科布多爾（Arvaikheer）是個大型的中部城鎮，在第四代相機中以**溫暖、綠意盎然且長滿草的景觀**為特色，四周環繞著低矮的起伏山丘。通常你可以看到城鎮中心公園裡的[摩天輪](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RzBqinKz157B8kS19)。

注意：在較舊的街景覆蓋中，相機右側可以看到明顯的[相機汙漬](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.2622102,102.7889926,2a,63.4y,51.57h,74.46t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1szEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fcb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile%26w%3D900%26h%3D600%26pitch%3D15.543539424258526%26panoid%3DzEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ%26yaw%3D51.569379852417136!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205410&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MDkwNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)。

text: The town of Bayankhongor, in central Mongolia, has an overall dry landscape and can be recognized from the nearby **large dry hill to the east,** with the Soyombo symbol inscribed onto it.

NOTE: In older coverage, a distinct [camera smudge](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.2622102,102.7889926,2a,63.4y,51.57h,74.46t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1szEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fcb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile%26w%3D900%26h%3D600%26pitch%3D15.543539424258526%26panoid%3DzEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ%26yaw%3D51.569379852417136!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205410&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MDkwNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) can be seen on the right side of the camera.
text_zh: 巴彦洪戈尔（Bayankhongor）位於蒙古中部，整體景觀乾燥，可以從東側附近的**大型乾涸山丘**辨識出來，上面刻有索永博（Soyombo）符號。

注意：在較舊的街景覆蓋中，相機右側可以看到明顯的[相機汙漬](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.2622102,102.7889926,2a,63.4y,51.57h,74.46t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1szEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fcb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile%26w%3D900%26h%3D600%26pitch%3D15.543539424258526%26panoid%3DzEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ%26yaw%3D51.569379852417136!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205410&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MDkwNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)。

text: Khovd is a large, dry and shrubby town, in western Mongolia, that can be identified by the very distinct **rocky, red-tinted hills,** present to the** **north of town.

NOTE: The nearby [Khar-Us](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AM8e1gaheeFvUP5X9), [Tugrug](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NipvfyEBDZw75eLNA), and the samely named [Khovd](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Gg2oVW2ZVEnLyzZ17) have similar landscapes but are much smaller towns.
text_zh: 科布多（Khovd）是蒙古西部一個大型、乾燥且灌木叢生的城鎮，可以透過城鎮**北方**非常明顯的**岩石質、帶紅色的山丘**來識別。
注意：附近的[哈爾烏斯湖](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AM8e1gaheeFvUP5X9)、[圖格里克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NipvfyEBDZw75eLNA)以及同名的[科布多](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Gg2oVW2ZVEnLyzZ17)景觀相似，但城鎮規模小得多。

text: Ölgii is a large town in the west, that is **surrounded by close, dry rocky mountains**. Towards the south end of town, there is a tall **red & white radio tower,** that can be seen from all across town and is quite distinct to Ölgii.
text_zh: 烏列蓋（Ölgii）是西部的大型城鎮，**四周環繞著鄰近且乾燥的岩石山脈**。在城鎮的南端有一座高聳的**紅白相間無線電塔**，從城鎮各處都能看見，對烏列蓋來說非常具有辨識度。

text: Ulaangom is a northwestern town with **large, distant, dark mountains** to the southwest. Additionally, these distinct **double lamp posts **with a blue or green painted base can frequently be seen in Ulaangom.

NOTE: Rarely, double lamp posts can be found in other cities such as [Baruun-Urt](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.6824863,113.27728,2a,45.8y,266.42h,95.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8wyWiMi85Yc9lq0p5Fc6MQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [Chinggis](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.3156,110.657067,3a,79.3y,6.0h,89.88t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s37JBTksYabYNoiTdGCsv-Q!2e0), but these towns have flat landscapes.
text_zh: 烏蘭固木（Ulaangom）是西北部的城鎮，西南方有**大型、遙遠且黑暗的山脈**。此外，在烏蘭固木經常可以看到這些帶有藍色或綠色塗漆底座的獨特**雙燈柱**。

注意：極少數情況下，雙燈柱也可能在其他城市找到，例如[巴倫烏爾特](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.6824863,113.27728,2a,45.8y,266.42h,95.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8wyWiMi85Yc9lq0p5Fc6MQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)和[喬巴山](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.3156,110.657067,3a,79.3y,6.0h,89.88t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s37JBTksYabYNoiTdGCsv-Q!2e0)，但這些城鎮的地形較為平坦。

text: In the westmost part of Mongolia, there is some very remote coverage showcasing the tallest mountains in Mongolia where you can see glaciers and **snow-capped peaks**. This area also has a unique Street View car with a green or black bag above the right side roof racks.
text_zh: 在蒙古的最西部，有一些非常偏遠的街景覆蓋，展示了蒙古最高的山峰，你可以看到冰川和**雪山山頂**。這個地區還有一輛獨特的 Google 車，右側車頂行李架上方有一個綠色或黑色的袋子。

text: East of Uvs lake, you can find a lot of these **small shrubs** and patchy grass in a somewhat flat landscape.

NOTE: Similar shrubs can be found around [Shaazgai Lake](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.234698,91.23369,3a,133.2y,93.5h,88.52t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sp0fw9T6Pm6c030-i807Nmw!2e0), but that area is considerably more hilly.
text_zh: 在烏布蘇湖以東，你可以在相對平坦的景觀中找到許多這些**小灌木**和斑駁的草地。
注意：類似的灌木可以在[沙斯蓋湖](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.234698,91.23369,3a,133.2y,93.5h,88.52t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sp0fw9T6Pm6c030-i807Nmw!2e0)周邊找到，但該地區的山丘要多得多。

text: The Gobi Gurvan Saikhan National Park, in the far south of Mongolia, features **bright orange sand** and **sand dunes**. There are two separate spots covered in the park: one in the middle just north of Sevrei, which has [distant southern mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jjXtYWfWCBWUuSgs9), and the other in the far southwest corner of the park, which has a [Jeep follow car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cHgJsPAW8xUFrK8s9).
text_zh: 戈壁古爾賽汗國家公園位於蒙古極南部，擁有**明亮的橘色沙子**和**沙丘**。公園內有兩個獨立的街景覆蓋點：一個在色夫雷（Sevrei）正北方的中間地帶，擁有[遙遠的南方山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jjXtYWfWCBWUuSgs9)；另一個在公園的最西南角，配備了[吉普跟拍車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cHgJsPAW8xUFrK8s9)。

text: This beautiful river valley, just west of Lake Hatgal in the Khoridol Saridag mountains, is very recognizable from the surrounding rocky cliffs and forests, and the ground that is completely **covered in pebbles**.
text_zh: 這個美麗的河谷位於哈特嘎湖以西的科里多爾薩里達格（Khoridol Saridag）山脈中，周圍環繞著岩石峭壁與森林，且地面完全**覆蓋著卵石**，極易辨認。

text: The landscape east of Windhoek closely resembles that of Botswana, with a generally **flat and dry** landscape, featuring** **slightly reddish soil, short **golden grass** and shrubbery, as well as acacia trees.
text_zh: 溫荷克以東的地景與波札那（Botswana）非常相似，大致為**平坦且乾燥**的地景，帶有微紅的土壤、矮小的**金色草叢**與灌木叢，以及金合歡樹。

text: Dry mountains and hills dominate much of the western and southern parts of the country.
text_zh: 乾燥的山脈和小山丘主導了該國西部和南部的絕大部分地區。

text: Further northwest, you’ll find a somewhat greener region, where the mountains and hills will be covered in shrubbery and trees.
text_zh: 再往西北方，你會發現一個稍微綠意盎然的區域，那裡的群山與小山丘會覆蓋著灌木叢和樹木。

text: This pocket south of Tsumeb features the most lush coverage in Namibia, with the grass and mountains being completely green in colour.
text_zh: 楚梅布（Tsumeb）以南的這個區域擁有納米比亞最綠意盎然的街景覆蓋，草地和群山呈現完全的綠色。

text: Around Windhoek, you’ll find a small region with a somewhat **dry rolling hills landscape**, with hills that are covered in dry yellow grass and dead-looking bushes and small trees.
text_zh: 在溫荷克周邊，你會發現一個小區域，有著稍微**乾燥的起伏丘陵地景**，山丘覆蓋著乾黃的草、看起來枯死的灌木和小樹。

text: A coastal sandy landscape with the occasional sand dunes can be found around and north of Swakopmund, as well as two small pockets around Luderitz and Oranjemund further south.
text_zh: 斯瓦科普穆德（Swakopmund）周邊及北側可以找到沿海的沙地景觀與零星的沙丘，南部呂德里茨（Luderitz）和奧蘭治蒙德（Oranjemund）周邊也有兩小塊這樣的區域。

text: Road A1 between Windhoek and Okahandja, featuring a savannah-like landscape, is just one of two major roads that are **divided** in Namibia. The [other one](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VVjMKLWS9dDQ2qLb8) can be found just southeast of Swakopmund, and features a dry coastal landscape, with light sandy soil and sand dunes.
text_zh: 位於溫荷克和奧卡漢賈（Okahandja）之間的 A1 公路具有疏林草原般的景觀，是納米比亞僅有的兩條主要**分隔**道路之一。[`另一條`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VVjMKLWS9dDQ2qLb8)可以在斯瓦科普穆德東南側找到，具有乾燥的海岸地景，帶有輕薄的沙土與沙丘。

text: Road B1 south of Grunau is a desolate paved road going generally N-NE through a desert landscape with only very low and dry vegetation.
text_zh: 格魯瑙（Grunau）南側的 B1 公路是一條荒涼的鋪裝道路，大致朝北北東方向穿過沙漠地景，只有非常矮小且乾燥的植被。

text: Outer yellow road lines are missing on the following sections of the B1:
- Between Grunau and Keetmanshoop, the landscape becomes hillier, and the road quality deteriorates in general.
- This [small section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/enThcbiWS4e37Xx19) north of Keetmanshoop is cloudy.
- The [third section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YS14ugmHJm9DeBqx5) is between Gibeon and Mariental, which is flat, and goes in a N-NE direction.
text_zh: B1 的以下路段缺少外側黃色道路標線：
- 在格魯瑙和凱特曼斯胡普（Keetmanshoop）之間，地景變得更多山，道路品質整體而言也在惡化。
- 凱特曼斯胡普北側的這個[小路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/enThcbiWS4e37Xx19)有多雲的天氣。
- [第三個路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YS14ugmHJm9DeBqx5)位於吉本（Gibeon）和馬林達爾之間，地勢平坦，大致呈北北東走向。

text: The section of road B1 between Mariental and Rehoboth can be recognised by a combination of the generic **arid steppe landscape**, the **paved road**, and mainly the distinct** NW bound road angle**. It can also help to know that the sun is in the SE for this section.
text_zh: 馬林達爾與雷霍博特（Rehoboth）之間的 B1 路段可以透過以下特徵來辨識：通用的**乾旱草原地景**、**鋪裝道路**，以及最主要的**獨特西北走向道路角度**。知道這段路的太陽在東南方也有所幫助。

text: Around Rehoboth the landscape gradually becomes more vegetated, and as you get closer to Windhoek, the hills become more prominent, with a lot of somewhat pointed lonestanding hills, as well as ridges being visible. The weather is fairly clear with small clouds across the sky.
text_zh: 在雷霍博特周邊，地景逐漸變得較有植被，隨著你越接近溫荷克，山丘變得更為顯著，可以看到許多稍微尖銳的獨立小山以及山脊。天氣相當晴朗，天空中有些許小雲。

text: North of Okahandja, the B1 follows a general northbound direction, with the sun shining brightly to the N-NW. The sky is otherwise clear of clouds. As for the landscape, it’s flatter than around Windhoek, with only the occasional hill or mountain, otherwise the short golden grass, somewhat green acacia trees and shrubbery further away from the road is typical for middle to north Namibia.
South of Sukses, you’ll see these two pointy [mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDSJUQXQbwBwL9CNA), one of which has a sharper peak than the other, to the west of the road.
text_zh: 奧卡漢賈以北，B1 大致呈向北走向，太陽在 N-NW 方向燦爛地照耀著。除此之外天空晴朗無雲。至於地景部分，它比溫荷克周邊還要平坦，只有零星的小山或山脈，除此之外，短小的金色草叢、離路面較遠且帶點綠意的金合歡樹與灌木叢，是納米比亞中北部典型的景象。
蘇克斯（Sukses）以南，你會在道路西方看到這兩座尖尖的[`山`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDSJUQXQbwBwL9CNA)，其中一座的山峰比另一座更尖銳。

text: You can recognise the B2 NE of Swakopmund by the sandy soil, and the mountain ridge visible to the east. A few [lone mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/msmSb43uQCuq9SC17) or hills can be seen to the NW as well. Beware that close to Swakopmund the sky is [hazy](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HojVjgFmZKtjad7JA), and you’ll not see the ridge. On this stretch, the coastal looking sandy soil and the NE bound road angle is still generally sufficient to confirm the road.
text_zh: 你可以透過沙質土壤以及東側可見的山脊來辨識斯瓦科普穆德東北方的 B2。西北方也可以看到幾座[`獨立的山`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/msmSb43uQCuq9SC17)或山丘。請注意，靠近斯瓦科普穆德時天空[`霧茫茫的`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HojVjgFmZKtjad7JA)，你看不到山脊。在這段路上，具海岸風情的沙質土壤以及東北走向的道路角度通常就足以確認這條路。

text: A bit further east, between Karibib and Usakos, you’ll find sunrise coverage combined with a sky covered in fairly thin clouds. There are mountains to the north, as well as smaller hills just south of the road, while it's mostly flat to the E-NE.
text_zh: 再往東一點，在卡里比布（Karibib）和烏薩科斯（Usakos）之間，你會遇到日出街景覆蓋，搭配覆蓋著相當薄雲的天空。北方有山脈，道路正南方有較小的小山丘，而東東北方向則大多平坦。

text: East of Karibib, the weather becomes completely clear, and the mountains are only visible further in the distance. The wide shoulder lines combined with the E-NE road angle makes this section distinct.
text_zh: 卡里比布以東，天氣變得完全晴朗，山脈只能在更遠處看見。寬闊的路肩標線結合東東北的道路角度讓這個路段顯得獨特。

text: This desolate paved road goes in a general E-SE direction through a fairly flat and dry landscape. Small clouds dot the sky. The shrubbery is quite green for the most part, especially in the [east](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J4HCC4RMMBLLk4659), which is also very hilly.
NOTE: The easiest way to tell it apart from parts of the B4 is the eastwards driving direction on this road, as opposed to westwards on the B4.
text_zh: 這條荒涼的鋪裝道路大致朝東東南方向穿過相當平坦且乾燥的地景。天空中點綴著小雲。灌木叢大體上相當翠綠，特別是在[東部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J4HCC4RMMBLLk4659)，那裡也非常多山丘。
注意：要將它與 B4 的部分路段區分開來，最簡單的方法是這條路的行駛方向是向東，而 B4 則是向西。

text: The B4 east of Luderitz has almost blindingly **bright sandy soil**. The landscape close to the road is generally flat, with hills and mountains in the distance. Close to Luderitz the landscape becomes [much hillier](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UACZ8efgUyMThsrF9). A railway follows the road closely on the south side for most of this section.
text_zh: 呂德里茨以東的 B4 擁有幾乎會讓人眩目的**明亮沙質土壤**。靠近道路的地景大致平坦，遠處則有丘陵和山脈。接近呂德里茨時，地景變得[`非常多山`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UACZ8efgUyMThsrF9)。在這段路的絕大部分路段中，鐵路都在南側緊鄰著道路。

text: East of Aus, the road winds through some table-topped mountains, with the railway still just to the south. A [similar landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TLHJpZNGFNWbJBDB7) can briefly be found further east on the road, just east of the intersection with the D432, however the mountains are bigger, closer to the road and redder in colour.
text_zh: 奧斯（Aus）以東，道路蜿蜒穿過幾座平頂山，鐵路依然在正南方。稍早在更東邊、也就是與 D432 交會處正東方的道路上，也能短暫找到[`類似的地景`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TLHJpZNGFNWbJBDB7)，不過那裡的群山更大、距離道路更近且顏色更紅。

text: After the road climbs onto the plateau east of Kuibis, the landscape will seem mostly flat until you reach the [intersection with the D432](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LnyJcQw9FVFwQbiRA), but you can notice the road having a [gradual incline](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uKxxvnhYT7HLAqBk7) for long stretches. The soil around is very red in colour, with limited shrubbery or signs of life. The weather is clear, with some clouds far in the distance.
text_zh: 在道路爬升至庫伊比斯（Kuibis）以東的高原後，直到你抵達[`與 D432 的交會處`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LnyJcQw9FVFwQbiRA)之前，地景看起來大致平坦，但你可以注意到道路有[`長距離的漸進式爬坡`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uKxxvnhYT7HLAqBk7)。周邊的土壤顏色非常紅，幾乎沒有灌木叢或生命跡象。天氣晴朗，遠處有些許雲朵。

text: Between Seeheim and Keetmanshoop, the landscape close to the road is flat, with mountains always close by. Just east of Seeheim, you’ll see a [short ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gzgznEv2KFa2Gsr29) to the NE, with a lone mountain just west of it, as well as a [long ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Vy4TJZ6S5giURVcYA) far away to the west. A bit east, on the NE-bound stretch, mountains are in all directions, but you’ll see a [long uneven tabletop ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4rz1mXGEGvJXA45k8) to the west. A railroad can also be seen to the south on this stretch.
text_zh: 澤海姆（Seeheim）和凱特曼斯胡普之間，靠近道路的地景平坦，且隨時有山脈相伴。在澤海姆正東方，你會看到東北方有一座[`短山脊`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gzgznEv2KFa2Gsr29)，其正西方有一座獨立山，遠處西方則有一座[`長山脊`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Vy4TJZ6S5giURVcYA)。再往東一點、在朝東北的路段上，四面八方都是山脈，但你會在西方看到[`長條且不平坦的平頂山脊`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4rz1mXGEGvJXA45k8)。這段路的南側也可以看到鐵路。

text: Road B6 goes in a general eastwards direction from Windhoek, with the landscape ranging from [hilly](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HKH2ANTv77TFfAKp8) close to Windhoek, to [mostly flat](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LPHBgkFuNUibVNjm8) closer to Gobabis. The soil is somewhat orange in colour, with short green grass and otherwise green vegetation growing from it. The cloud cover also varies, but no part of this road has a clear sky.
NOTE: The only other similar paved road, road [C39](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gtHvwZTt24sAB3wa8), has brighter soil.
text_zh: B6 公路從溫荷克大致向東延伸，地景從溫荷克附近的[`多山`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HKH2ANTv77TFfAKp8)轉為接近戈巴比斯時的[`大多平坦`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LPHBgkFuNUibVNjm8)。土壤顏色帶點橘色，上面生長著短小的綠草以及其他綠色植被。雲量也有所不同，但這條路的任何路段都沒有萬里無雲的天空。
注意：唯一另一條類似的鋪面道路，即[C39](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gtHvwZTt24sAB3wa8)公路，其土壤顏色較明亮。

text: You can recognise this long stretch of B8 by the **light coloured grainy pavement** as well as the general E-NE angle and vegetated northern landscape.
text_zh: 你可以透過**淺色帶顆粒的鋪面**以及大致朝東北的走向與有植被的北部地景，來認出這段長長的 B8 路段。

text: Bright soil, clear skies with cloud cover to the east over a tabletop mountain ridge makes this paved N-NW bound road distinct.
text_zh: 明亮的土壤、晴朗的天空，加上東側平頂山脊上方覆蓋著雲層，讓這條朝北北西北的鋪裝道路顯得獨特。

text: A large rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from the paved C13. Other smaller hills and mountains can be seen in other directions. Light coloured soil hugs the road, while more orange coloured soil can be seen further from the road, with light green vegetation and shrubbery acting as a contrast.
Another easy way to get the road is to look for the [wispy clouds trying to hide the sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PrvocmJ5bXzvv823A) in the east.
text_zh: 從鋪裝的 C13 往西方望去，可以看到大型的峻峭山脈地形。其他方向則可見其他較小的小山丘和山脈。淺色土壤緊貼著道路，而距離道路較遠處則可見更偏橘色的土壤，並以淺綠色的植被和灌木叢作為對比。
取得這條路的另一種簡單方法是尋找東方[`試圖遮蔽太陽的輕薄捲雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PrvocmJ5bXzvv823A)。

text: Red tinted and slightly grainy pavement along with the green savannah-like grassy landscape crowned with [low-lying cumulus clouds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sThNdCyePnA6XouS9) can be used to recognise the northern section of road C35.
text_zh: 帶有紅色調且微帶顆粒的鋪面，搭配點綴著[`低矮積雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sThNdCyePnA6XouS9)的綠色疏林草原般草地景觀，可用來辨識 C35 公路的北部路段。

text: South of the C41 intersection, the road loses its red pavement, and the quality worsens. The landscape is less grassy, and more sandy, with [hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HByXtaekqiaUQGk77) to the west, though often hidden behind the vegetation. The road generally goes in a S-SE direction. Further south, it gets hillier, and parts will have a more SE bound angle. The sky is consistently covered by scattered [cirrostratus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6hbEGCHVQJKwN58A) and [cumulus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d26SpmrumkcZVnv36) clouds.
text_zh: 在 C41 交會處以南，道路失去了紅色鋪面，品質也隨之惡化。地景上的草變少、沙變多，西方有[`山丘`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HByXtaekqiaUQGk77)，雖然經常被植被遮擋。道路大致呈南南東走向。再往南走，地勢變得更多山，部分路段的走向會更偏東南。天空一直被散布的[`卷層雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6hbEGCHVQJKwN58A)和[`積雲`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d26SpmrumkcZVnv36)所覆蓋。

text: A short section NW of Kamanjab along with the same somewhat green and hilly landscape, features an impressive array of clouds in the sky, with the sun attempting to peek out from the west. [Hues of orange](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u7ykwqpSUqGCP8up6) can be seen on the horizon.
text_zh: 卡曼賈布（Kamanjab）西北側的一小段路除了有同樣微綠且多山的景觀外，天空中還展現了令人印象深刻的雲層陣列，太陽試圖從西方探出頭來。地平線上可以看到[`橘色色調`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u7ykwqpSUqGCP8up6)。

text: A very rugged mountain formation can be seen to the west from a few sections of the C35 and its sideroads.
text_zh: 從 C35 及其支路的幾個路段向西望去，可以看到非常峻峭的山脈地形。

text: The C40 has a general NW angle going through flat terrain with the usual northern landscape of short grass next to the road, trees further away and some hills further in the distance. Similar to the C39, a lot of cumulus clouds dot the sky, and the closer to Kamanjab you get, the lower the [sun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3hJec6yLcs49L6SA) sets to the west.
text_zh: C40 具有大致西北走向，穿過平坦地形，沿路有著北部常見的短草地景、較遠處的樹木以及更遠處的一些山丘。與 C39 類似，天空中點綴著許多積雲，而且你離卡曼賈布越近，[`太陽`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/P3hJec6yLcs49L6SA)在西方落得越低。

text: East of the intersection with the C35, the road has a constant SW to NW angle, and grainy pavement. The grass looks soft to the touch, and the somewhat sandy soil is typical of this region. Cumulus clouds dot the sky.
[West of the C35 intersection](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9jXSgyXW1W6ZBLUL7), the same grainy pavement and clouds remain, but the landscape is much hillier, and the road angle changes.
text_zh: 在 C35 交會處以東，道路有著持續的西南至西北走向以及帶顆粒的鋪面。草摸起來似乎很柔軟，帶點沙質的土壤是這個區域的典型特徵。天空中點綴著積雲。
[`在 C35 交會處以西`](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9jXSgyXW1W6ZBLUL7)，相同的帶顆粒鋪面和雲層依舊存在，但地景變得多山許多，道路角度也隨之改變。

text: Along the C43 you can find some of the most impressive [red-coloured tabletop mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/q2ML2FED7ajJFLbb7). The road is wide and unpaved with light coloured gravel contrasting the otherwise red landscape.
text_zh: 沿著 C43 可以找到一些最令人印象深刻的 [紅色平頂山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/q2ML2FED7ajJFLbb7)。這條路寬闊且為未鋪裝道路，淺色碎石與周遭的紅色地景形成強烈對比。

text: The D3600 and the [unlabelled road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RTqENPBLvJo7fsBd6) going NE to Mpungu, have a very light coloured, sometimes grainy pavement, with at times [very faded yellow lines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/X3ZNNmiVtCtcwsiC9), which are hard to even see. Combined with the either exactly N to S or NE angle, as well as the northern landscape, make this road very distinct.
text_zh: D3600 以及通往姆普古 (Mpungu) 的[未命名道路](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RTqENPBLvJo7fsBd6)（東北走向），有著非常淺色、有時帶有顆粒感的路面，並伴隨著有時[非常褪色的黃色標線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/X3ZNNmiVtCtcwsiC9)，甚至很難看清楚。結合剛好是正南北或東北的角度，以及北方的地景，使得這條路非常獨特。

text: Gobabis is a big** north-south gridded** city in the desert, with** red soil** permeating the landscape and roads, which are very often unpaved. A faint green ridge is sometimes visible to the north to northwest. The [street signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yc9JLDVMMF9166Go7), while rare, are also green, with silver framing on the top and bottom. [Blue bins](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nEKjHa3Md6L2VEtr8) are also a good clue for Gobabis.
text_zh: 戈巴比斯 (Gobabis) 是沙漠中一個很大的**南北向網格狀**城市，景觀與道路中充斥著**紅土**，且大多是未鋪裝的泥土路。北方到西北方偶爾可見一道淡淡的綠色山脊。[路標](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yc9JLDVMMF9166Go7)雖然罕見，但也是綠色的，上下有銀色邊框。[藍色垃圾桶](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nEKjHa3Md6L2VEtr8)也是判斷戈巴比斯的好線索。

text: While not as common, the same thatched architecture is present in Noordoewer, and unlike Aussenkehr, the town was built on flat land, with an [imposing cliffside](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JqoV8nVjpTkh3oq89) visible to the southwest, across the border in South Africa. Similar mountains can be seen to the north as well.
text_zh: 雖然沒那麼常見，但諾爾杜弗（Noordoewer）也有相同的茅草建築，與奧森凱爾不同的是，該城鎮建在平地上，向西南方望去across the border可見[雄偉的懸崖邊緣](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JqoV8nVjpTkh3oq89)，位於南非境內。向北也能看到類似的山脈。

text: Rosh Pinah can easily be recognised by the dry mountains just northeast of the city, as well as slightly further away to the [southwest](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3LbfPf8DFpVwr35d8).
text_zh: 羅什皮納（Rosh Pinah）可以透過城市東北方的乾旱山脈，以及稍遠處的[西南方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3LbfPf8DFpVwr35d8)輕易辨認。

text: The landscape of Aus is very rocky, with dry hills devoid of vegetation all around. The hills to the north have a fairly [smooth sloped shape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikY4ReviAoc2v2iB9), while the peaks to the south are [more rugged](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vd5ixxRnz7hyxA6q9).
text_zh: 奧斯（Aus）的景觀非常岩石化，周圍都是缺乏植被的乾旱山丘。北部的山丘具有相當[平緩的斜坡形狀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikY4ReviAoc2v2iB9)，而南部的山峰則[更加崎嶇](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vd5ixxRnz7hyxA6q9)。

text: **Orange coloured mountains**, which are covered in** green vegetation** surround the partly hilly town of Opuwo, from where you have a [great vantage point](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WwNYhsFjQYfs1DZm9) of the mountains.
text_zh: **橘色的山脈**覆蓋著**綠色植被**，環繞著部分多山的城鎮奧普沃（Opuwo），從那裡您可以擁有[絕佳的視角](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WwNYhsFjQYfs1DZm9)欣賞群山。

text: Otavi sits in between many sets of mountains, all of which are quite far away, but can be seen from the city. Being a northern town, Otavi is quite green, with slightly reddish sandy soil, which is common for the more northern cities. The entire town is on a northeast to southwest grid, which can rule out similar looking cities like [Grootfontein](https://maps.app.goo.gl/voT4iBmdxMiajBws8) and [Tsumeb](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7M38actJN9NSjZuz8).
text_zh: 奧塔維（Otavi）坐落在許多山脈之間，這些山脈雖然都相當遙遠，但從市區仍可見。作為一個北方城鎮，奧塔維非常綠意盎然，帶有微紅色的沙質土壤，這在較北方的城市很常見。整個城鎮位於東北至西南的網格上，這可以排除像是[格魯特方丹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/voT4iBmdxMiajBws8)和[楚姆韋布](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7M38actJN9NSjZuz8)等外觀相似的城市。

text: From almost anywhere in Karibib the dark silhouette of [Erongo Mountain](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VZT5WhPkZaDvGadR9) can be seen to the north. Dry [hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ix95xqTwU1d6oC1g7) covered in shrubbery flank the town to the south.
text_zh: 從卡里比卜（Karibib）的幾乎任何地方，都可以看到[埃龍戈山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VZT5WhPkZaDvGadR9)黑暗的剪影位於北方。覆蓋著灌木叢的乾旱[山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ix95xqTwU1d6oC1g7)在南方夾擊著城鎮。

text: A lone** tall ridge** with a **rugged, striated texture** lies to the SSE of Usakos. Another smaller plain textured mountain, which has a red tint to it, is just to the east, or northeast, depending on part of town. From the northern part of town, the cliffy edges of [Erongo Mountain](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DSp83gUhu7qPXGCF7) are visible to the north.
text_zh: 烏薩科斯（Usakos）的 SSE（南南東）方向有一座孤立的**高山脊**，具有**粗糙且帶有條紋的質地**。鎮上的東側或東北側（取決於你在城裡的哪個區域）則有另一座質地較平緩、帶有紅色調的小山。從城鎮北部往北看，可以看見[龍戈山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DSp83gUhu7qPXGCF7)懸崖峭壁般的邊緣。

text: You will see **flat agricultural areas** in the south as well as high altitude **mountain roads** in the northern half of Nepal.
text_zh: 你會在尼泊爾南部看到**平坦的農業區**，以及北部地區的高海拔**山路**。

text: The area in the far south close to the Indian border is almost completely flat, while the central and northern parts are very high altitude and very mountainous.
text_zh: 極南端靠近印度邊境的地區幾乎完全平坦，而中部和北部地區則是海拔極高且多山。

text: The western hills can be recognised by the **dry landscape**, with a lot of exposed hillsides lacking vegetation.
text_zh: 西部山丘的特徵是**乾燥的景觀**，許多裸露的山坡缺乏植被。

text: **Chir Pines**, which can be identified from their generally smooth-looking conical or spherical crowns with very long needles, are found everywhere in the mountains, but are much more common in the west, and near Kathmandu.
NOTE: The eastern region is generally greener than the west.
text_zh: **西藏松**（Chir Pines）可從其外觀普遍光滑、呈圓錐形或球形且帶有非常長針葉的樹冠辨識出來，牠們在山區隨處可見，但在西部和加德滿都附近更為常見。
注意：東部地區通常比西部地區更綠。

text: Tea Plantations are also only found in far eastern Nepal. Both in the mountains, and in the flat region.
text_zh: 茶園也僅見於尼泊爾極東部，無論是在山區還是在平原地區都有。

text: Rectangular tiles that are** less organised** in shape and placement are common in western mountain towns, but can also be found towards the center of the country.
text_zh: 形狀與鋪設**較不規整**的長方形石磚常見於西部山區城鎮，但在該國中部也能找到。

text: This sketchy yellow/orange dirt road can be recognised from the high elevation landscape with the high elevation oaks. It can be found northeast of Phungling in far northeastern Nepal.
text_zh: 這條路況不佳的黃色/橘色泥土路可以從高海拔景觀以及高海拔橡樹來辨識。它位於尼泊爾極東北邊普芬林（Phungling）的東北方。

text: This dirt track in a northwestbound valley can be recognised by the **snowcapped mountains** to the northwest. You can find it north of the Khaptad national park in western Nepal.
text_zh: 這條位於西北走向山谷中的泥土小徑可以透過西北方的**雪山**來辨識。你可以 於尼泊爾西部的卡普塔德國家公園（Khaptad national park）北方找到它。

text: **Barren mountain trails** are found in the northern parts of the coverage.
text_zh: **荒涼的山徑**出現在拍攝範圍的北部。
