text: A lot of the coverage in the vicinity of Namche Bazar can be summarised as being sunny, with the trails going **close to the treeline**, meaning you will be either near the top of or just above a forest for most of this coverage. You will generally see barren or snowy mountains in some direction.
text_zh: 南崎巴扎（Namche Bazar）附近的許多街景可以總結為天氣晴朗，小徑**接近林木線**，這意味著在大部分的拍攝範圍中，你不是在森林邊緣就是剛好在森林上方。你通常會在某些方向看到荒涼的山脈或雪山。

text: Khumjung village, situated just north of Namche Bazar, can be recognised by the **jagged mountain** towering above the village. Almost every house in the village has a **green roof**.
Beware that there is a label for Khumjung further north, which is not close to the village.
text_zh: 坤珍村（Khumjung village）位於南崎巴扎的正北方，可以透過高聳於村莊上方的高聳**鋸齒狀山峰**來辨識。村裡幾乎每棟房子都有**綠色屋頂**。
請注意，更北邊有一個坤珍的地標，但它並不在村莊附近。

text: Pangboche is a fairly large settlement with fairly bright coverage. The surrounding landscape mainly consists of **forested mountains** nearby and some taller mountains in the distance.
text_zh: 龐波契（Pangboche）是一個相當大的聚落，街景相當明亮。周遭景觀主要由附近的**森林山脈**和遠處的一些更高山峰組成。

text: Phorste is a fairly scarcely built settlement with a massive **recognizable mountain** close by. There are a lot of dead-looking trees surrounding the village.
text_zh: 弗斯特（Phorste）是一個建築相當稀疏的聚落，附近有一座巨大的**可辨識山峰**。村莊周圍有許多看起來枯死的樹木。

text: The valley by Thamu can be recognised by the generally forested mountainsides, combined with the **angle of the valley**, going northwest to southeast.
text_zh: 塔姆（Thamu）旁的山谷可以透過大體上長滿森林的山坡，結合**山谷的角度**（由西北向東南走向）來辨識。

text: Next to the village of Thame you can see this snowy, and **shining bright** mountain range.
text_zh: 在塔美村（Thame）旁，你可以看到這座積雪且**閃耀著明亮光芒**的山脈。

text: Northeast of Namche Bazar, you can find this **semi-green river valley** with clouds covering all mountains surrounding it.
text_zh: 在南崎巴扎的東北方，你可以找到這個**半綠色的河谷**，周圍所有山脈都被雲霧籠罩。

text: On a section north of Phorste, you get a view of the mountain Tobuche, covered in a **blanket of clouds**.
text_zh: 在弗斯特北方的路段，你可以看到被**厚重雲層**覆蓋的托布切峰（Tobuche）。

text: Leaving Tobuche behind, you will find this small, **ice-covered lake**, right by Gokyo, with jagged mountains as a backdrop.
text_zh: 把托布切峰拋在身後，你會在戈基約（Gokyo）旁發現這個被**冰覆蓋的小湖**，背景是鋸齒狀的山脈。

text: North of the icy lake, you reach a barren landscape, with a trail going to the **north-north-west**.
text_zh: 在冰湖以北，你會抵達一片荒涼的景觀，有一條通往**西北偏北**的小徑。

text: East of the glacial valley, you get to a somewhat **red-coloured**, rugged mountainside **right next to the trail**.
text_zh: 離開冰河谷地東側，你會來到一處**帶有紅色**、地形崎嶇的山腰，**就在步道旁邊**。

text: Leaving the red mountainside behind, you enter a somewhat **U-shaped valley**, going firmly upwards.
text_zh: 把紅色山腰拋在身後，你會進入一個**U型谷**，一路穩步向上。

text: Above the U-shaped valley, you get a view of this **spiky mountain range**. While there are some clouds around the peaks, they are mostly clearly visible.
text_zh: 在U型谷上方，你可以看見這片**尖峭的山脈**。雖然山峰周圍有些雲霧，但大多能清楚看見。

text: As you lose sight of the spiky mountains, you cross over a **glacier**, which is the largest patch of snow covered ground with coverage in the country.
text_zh: 當你看不見尖峭山脈時，你會跨越一座**冰河**，這是該國有街景覆蓋範圍中面積最大的覆雪地面。

text: The area east of the glacier can be recognised by the many **irregular clouds** spread across the sky and covering various mountain peaks.
text_zh: 冰河東側的區域可以透過天空中散布的許多**不規則雲朵**來辨識，這些雲朵覆蓋了多座山峰。

text: Further along the trail, you get this stunning **view over Tobuche** from the eastern side. The mountains get increasingly covered in clouds to the west.
text_zh: 沿著步道再往前走，你會從東側看到這處令人驚嘆的**都木切峰（Tobuche）景色**。往西望去，山脈被雲層覆蓋的範圍越來越大。

text: Slightly east of Namche Bazar, you can find this very overcast trail following the mountainside. There are still some trees around, and the trail is noticeably **higher** above the valley than other overcast sections with trees.
text_zh: 在南崎巴札（Namche Bazar）稍東的位置，你可以找到這條沿著山腰、天氣非常陰暗的小徑。周圍仍有一些樹木，而且與其他有樹木的陰暗路段相比，這條小徑明顯**高於**河谷。

text: You can recognise the trail between Pangboche and Dingboche by the massive mountains, combined with the sun looking somewhat **hazy**.
text_zh: 你可以透過巨大的山脈，加上看起來有些**朦朧**的太陽，來辨認 Pangboche 和 Dingboche 之間的小徑。

text: North of Dingboche, you reach a high-altitude valley with very **low clouds** covering the sky and most of the surrounding mountains.
text_zh: 在丁波切（Dingboche）以北，你會來到一個高海拔河谷，天空和大多數周圍山脈都被**低矮的雲層**覆蓋。

text: Closing in on Everest, you get this completely barren landscape, with the trail going to the **north-north-east**.
text_zh: 接近聖母峰時，你會看到這片完全荒蕪的景觀，小徑朝著**北北東北**方向延伸。

text: Reaching the endpoint of the coverage, you finally get a stunning view of the world's tallest mountain, **Mount Everest**.
text_zh: 走到街景覆蓋的盡頭，你終於能一睹世界最高山峰**聖母峰**（Mount Everest）的壯麗景色。

text: Most of the **west and north** is at or below sea-level. As a result, most of this region’s countryside has a distinct [“**polder**” landscape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polder): the landscape is marshy, often with a large amount of small waterways.
text_zh: 大部分的 **西部和北部** 地勢位於海平面或以下。因此，該地區的大多數鄉村都有明顯的 [「**圩田**」景觀](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polder)：地勢呈沼澤狀，通常有大量的小型水道。

text: Conversely, the **south and the east** tends to have a more typical flat European farmland look. Waterways are still common, but the landscape can look less marshy.
text_zh: 相對地，**南部和東部** 往往具有較典型的平坦歐洲農田外觀。水道仍然很常見，但景觀看起來沒那麼像沼澤。

text: Almost all of the land belonging to the province of Flevoland was reclaimed from the sea in the mid-20th century. As a result, the province has a distinct, **man-made** look: extremely straight roads and large crop fields dominate the landscape. Wind turbines are common. In urban areas, there are no historical buildings.

NOTE: The only exception to this description is the town of Urk, which is situated on a former island now surrounded by the rest of the province’s man-made [polder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polder) landscape.
text_zh: 弗萊福蘭省幾乎所有的土地都是在 20 世紀中葉從海中填海造陸而來的。因此，該省具有鮮明的人為建造外觀：極其筆直的道路和巨大的農田主導了地景。風力發電機很常見。在市區中，沒有歷史建築。
注意：這項描述唯一的例外是烏克鎮，它坐落在一座前島嶼上，現在被該省其餘的人為 [圩田](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polder) 景觀所環繞。

text: The islands in the northwest are called the **Wadden Islands**. They are very popular local tourism destinations, which is sometimes evident in the street view coverage. Their northwestern coastlines feature a lot of sand dunes.
text_zh: 西北部的島嶼被稱為**瓦登群島**。它們是非常熱門的當地旅遊目的地，這點有時會在街景覆蓋中顯現出來。它們的西北海岸線有許多沙丘。

text: The Waikato and Northland regions are characterised by their **drier climate** and **rolling hills**. In particular, the Northland region is quite [hilly](https://goo.gl/maps/hpVzi3Ur8nvJuUv69).
NOTE: This type of landscape can be found in other parts of the North Island, but is more common in the mentioned regions.
text_zh: 懷卡托和紐西蘭北島北部地區的特徵是**氣候較乾燥**以及**起伏的丘陵**。特別是紐西蘭北島北部地區，地形相當[多山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/hpVzi3Ur8nvJuUv69)。
注意：這種景觀也可以在北島的其他地方找到，但在上述地區更為常見。

text: The West Coast and part of the Tasman region on the South Island can be recognized by its **temperate rainforests** and **rugged landscape**. This can be seen through the hundreds of tall hills and mountains, as well as the dark, compact greenery which is due to the area’s high level of rainfall.
text_zh: 南島的西岸和部分塔斯曼地區可以透過**溫帶雨林**和**崎嶇的地形**來識別。這可以從數百座高山、群山，以及該地區高降雨量所形成的深色、緊密綠植中看出來。

text: The Southern Alps, a **large, snowy mountain range,** stretches throughout the majority of the South Island. Vegetation on the mountains becomes rarer the further south it is.
text_zh: 南冰川山脈是一個**巨大且積雪的山脈，**貫穿了南島的大部分地區。越往南走，山上的植被就越稀疏。

text: **Tall hedge and tree rows** are particularly common in the Canterbury region. They are mostly found in the Canterbury plains, which comprises very flat, large fields.
Due to Canterbury’s flat landscape, mountains can often be seen in the distance to the west.
NOTE: Hedges that are even taller are common near [Tauranga](https://goo.gl/maps/dddpunZazZYpVCqd8).
text_zh: **高大的樹籬和樹排**在坎特伯雷地區特別常見。它們主要分佈在坎特伯雷平原，該平原由非常平坦的大片田野組成。
由於坎特伯雷平原坦蕩，往西往往可以在遠處看到群山。
注意：更高大的樹籬在[陶朗加](https://goo.gl/maps/dddpunZazZYpVCqd8)附近很常見。

text: Coverage on Mount Ruapehu is easily identifiable due to the **dark volcanic landscape **and distinct lack of vegetation.
NOTE: This type of coverage is limited to the roads around the Whakapapa Ski Village.
text_zh: 魯阿佩胡山上的街景覆蓋很容易識別，因為那裏有**黑暗的火山地貌**以及明顯缺乏植被。
注意：這種街景覆蓋僅限於華卡帕帕滑雪村周圍的道路。

text: The region of northern Marlborough, known as [Marlborough Sounds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marlborough_Sounds), has **densely forested mountains protruding from water**.
NOTE: Northern Marlborough is almost exclusively in Generation 4.
text_zh: 馬爾堡北部地區，被稱為[馬爾堡峽灣](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marlborough_Sounds)，擁有**從水中突出的茂密森林山脈**。
注意：馬爾堡北部幾乎完全是第 4 代相機。

text: State Highway 94 is characterised by its dense** **[**red beech**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nothofagus_fusca)** forest **surrounded by **snow-capped mountains**.
text_zh: 94 號省道（State Highway 94）的特徵是周圍環繞著被**雪山**包圍的茂密[**紅山毛櫸**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nothofagus_fusca)**森林**。

text: State Highway 80 in the Southern Alps is recognizable by its north-south orientation up a **glacial valley**. The west side of the road is lined with snow-capped mountains, while the east side of the road runs alongside the Tasman River and Lake Pukaki.
text_zh: 南阿爾卑斯山的80號省道（State Highway 80）具有南北走向的**冰川谷**地形，因而容易辨識。道路西側綿延著覆蓋積雪的山脈，東側則與塔斯曼河（Tasman River）和普卡基湖（Lake Pukaki）並行。

text: The mountains of Pirongia and Kakepuku are often seen together in an otherwise mostly flat landscape. To the west, we have Mount Pirongia which is a long mountain range, with **2 distinct small bumps**. Meanwhile Mount Kakepuku is to the south and has a **volcanic cone shape**.
text_zh: 皮龍吉亞山（Mount Pirongia）與卡凱普庫山（Mount Kakepuku）在其他大多平坦的景觀中經常一同出現。西方是皮龍吉亞山，為一座長型山脈，帶有**2個明顯的小圓峰**。同時，卡凱普庫山位於南方，呈**火山錐形**。

text: Nigeria is generally a **fairly flat **country with subtle elevation changes throughout. The south is relatively flat apart from some noticeable hills in the southeast, in Enugu state and in the southwest, between Ife and Lokoja. In the north, more prominent hills and mountains are found from Abuja and Jimeta. The largest mountains are found in the east, making up the Mandara mountain range and the Nigeria-Cameroon border. However, due to little coverage, the mountains are rarely visible.
text_zh: 奈及利亞大致是一個**相當平坦**的國家，各地有著微小的海拔變化。除了東南部（埃努古州）和西南部（伊費與洛科賈之間）有一些明顯的山丘外，南部相對平坦。在北部，從阿布賈和吉梅塔開始可以見到更顯眼的山丘與山脈。最大的山脈位於東部，構成曼達拉山脈（Mandara mountain range）以及奈及利亞與喀麥隆的邊界。然而，由於街景覆蓋稀少，這些山脈很少被看見。

text: Shown is a **Köppen climate map** of Nigeria. The climate ranges from tropical rainforest in the [far south](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvLGJLnQZK4qnzn99), where you can find an abundance of palms with lush, green vegetation, to a more arid, [savannah landscape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SZQcHSZAonH1A9RD6) in the centre, with more scattered trees. In the far north, it transitions to an [arid steppe](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeiAA6fxzbj3gae47) where the vegetation becomes even more sparse.
NOTE: Due to dry/wet seasons, the coverage may look drastically greener/drier than expected for certain latitudes.
text_zh: 圖中顯示的是奈及利亞的**柯本氣候分區圖**。氣候從[極南方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvLGJLnQZK4qnzn99)的熱帶雨林（那裡有豐富的棕櫚樹與蔥鬱的綠色植被）過渡到中央較為乾旱的[疏林草原景觀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SZQcHSZAonH1A9RD6)（伴隨較為散落的樹木）。在極北方，則轉變為[乾旱草原](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeiAA6fxzbj3gae47)，植被變得更加稀疏。
備註：由於乾季與雨季的緣故，某些緯度的街景覆蓋看起來可能會比預期的還要綠得多或乾得多。

text: If you find yourself in an **arid**, but green, agricultural landscape with an abundance of **corn **around, you are likely to be in Kano state. It is only covered by shitcam, without any Generation 3 or 4.
text_zh: 如果你發現自己身處一個**乾旱**但翠綠的農業景觀中，周圍有大量的**玉米**，你很可能是在卡諾州（Kano state）。這裡僅有 shitcam 覆蓋，沒有任何相機世代 3 或 4。

text: The highways that run through the northwestern states of Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina can be recognized by an even more **open** and **arid** landscape compared to Niger state. The tree coverage becomes even more sparse, or there may [not be trees at all](https://goo.gl/maps/ProC7u4RUH2HVCz8A). These states are entirely covered by shitcam.
text_zh: 貫穿西北部凱比州（Kebbi）、索科托州（Sokoto）、扎姆法拉州（Zamfara）和卡齊納州（Katsina）的高速公路，其景觀與尼日州相比更加**開闊**與**乾旱**，因而可以辨識出來。樹木覆蓋變得更加稀疏，或者可能[完全沒有樹木](https://goo.gl/maps/ProC7u4RUH2HVCz8A)。這些州完全被 shitcam 覆蓋。

text: A **savannah **landscape combined with **rocky hills** can most commonly be seen in the northeast in the states of Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe, Adamawa, and the north of Taraba. The hills in the **far east and west **of this region are typically [greener](https://goo.gl/maps/Hmbqtpv3fxcGRKuLA)** **and covered in more vegetation compared to the hills toward the middle of the range.
NOTE: Around the city of Gombe, hills composed of softer, [clay-like soil](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icUUBKmdGQFN75eP9) can be seen instead.
text_zh: **疏林草原**景觀結合**岩石山丘**最常出現在東北部的高原州（Plateau）、包奇州（Bauchi）、貢貝州（Gombe）、阿達馬瓦州（Adamawa）以及塔拉巴州（Taraba）北部。與山脈中段的山丘相比，該地區**極東與極西**的山丘通常較為[翠綠](https://goo.gl/maps/Hmbqtpv3fxcGRKuLA)**且覆蓋著更多植被**。
備註：在貢貝市周圍，反而可以看到由較軟的[黏土狀土壤](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icUUBKmdGQFN75eP9)組成的山丘。

text: These monolithic mountains with **exposed, weathered rock **are common in and around Abuja.
text_zh: 這些具有**裸露且風化岩石**的獨立大山在阿布賈及周圍地區很常見。

text: A flat landscape with coastal vegetation and **many palms** can be seen east of Lekki. The ground is very **sandy**. Almost all of the coverage is old Generation 3, with a [silver follow car](https://www.google.com/maps/@6.4185992,4.079123,3a,15y,284.01h,83.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sTrh0nQY2S9hrUGN-v1ejng!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 雷基（Lekki）以東可以看到帶有海岸植被與**許多棕櫚樹**的平坦景觀。地面非常**沙質**。幾乎所有的覆蓋都是舊的相機世代 3，並配有一台[銀色跟拍車](https://www.google.com/maps/@6.4185992,4.079123,3a,15y,284.01h,83.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sTrh0nQY2S9hrUGN-v1ejng!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: The A3 going east of Potiskum to the Borno State border can be recognized by the Generation 4 coverage, mostly **open arid landscape**, and the highway being **divided**.
text_zh: 波蒂斯庫姆（Potiskum）向東通往博爾諾州（Borno State）邊界的 A3 公路，可以透過相機世代 4 的覆蓋、大多**開闊的乾旱景觀**以及**雙向分隔**的高速公路來辨識。

text: The Obudu Plateau road can be recognized by having the **tallest mountains **in Nigeria with street view coverage. The road winds up **lush, green** mountains and the coverage is slightly foggy and wet.
text_zh: 奧布杜高原（Obudu Plateau）道路可以透過擁有奈及利亞具有街景覆蓋的**最高山脈**來辨識。道路蜿蜒而上**蔥鬱翠綠**的山脈，且街景覆蓋帶有微微的霧氣與潮濕感。

text: Norway is a very mountainous country, with many fjords along most of the coast.
NOTE: Finland and Denmark are both mostly flat, while Sweden has a mixture of flat, hilly and mountainous areas.
text_zh: 挪威是一個多山的國家，海岸線大部分都有許多峽灣。
注意：芬蘭和丹麥大多為平地，而瑞典則同時有平地、丘陵和山區。

text: The largest concentration of farmland is found in the southeast, in the general vicinity of Oslo. The area is **much flatter** than most of the country, and it is common to get a rolling landscape with smooth, round forested hills in the distance. The area southeast of Oslo is particularly flat.
text_zh: 最大面積的農田集中在東南部，大致位於奧斯陸附近。該地區比該國大部分地區**平坦得多**，且常有起伏的地形，遠處可見平緩、圓潤且長滿樹木的山丘。奧斯陸東南部的地區尤其平坦。

text: While fjords can be found along most of the Norwegian coast, **deep fjords** surrounded by **tall mountains** are most common between Bergen and Trondheim.
text_zh: 雖然峽灣可見於挪威的大部分海岸線，但四周環繞著**高山**的**深峽灣**最常出現在卑爾根和特隆赫姆之間。

text: Distinct, **sharp, rocky** mountains with few trees can be seen on the Lofoten Archipelago.
text_zh: 在羅浮敦群島上可以看到奇特、**尖銳且多岩石**且樹木稀少的高山。

text: The northeast of Norway can typically be recognized by a somewhat **rolling landscape**, rather than tall mountains, and vegetation mainly consisting of very **small birches** combined with patched grass.
text_zh: 挪威東北部通常可以透過略帶**起伏的地形**來辨認，而不是高山，其植被主要由**小型樺樹**結合散落的草地組成。

text: Barren highlands, with **no trees or bushes**, and often with rocky mountains along the road, are mostly found in the southwest.
text_zh: 貧瘠的高原，**沒有樹木或灌木**，且道路旁常有岩山，主要出現在西南部。

text: **Coastal grasslands** with little to no other vegetation and only somewhat low, distant mountains can be found by coastal roads in the far north.
text_zh: **海岸草原**，幾乎沒有其他植被，只有稍低且遙遠的山脈，可以在極北地區的沿海道路上找到。

text: Most of Oman features a **desert landscape** with little vegetation. While the middle and southern half is mostly flat, the north coast features dry mountains similar to those found in the UAE. The southern coast also has mountains, though less dry.
text_zh: 阿曼大部分地區呈現植被稀少的**沙漠景觀**。雖然中部和南部半部大多平坦，但北海岸有著類似阿拉伯聯合大公國的乾燥山脈。南海岸也有山脈，但較不乾燥。

text: Northern Oman features a **dry mountainous landscape** similar to eastern UAE. The south coast of Oman also rarely features some similar mountains.
text_zh: 阿曼北部具有**乾燥的山地景觀**，類似阿拉伯聯合大公國東部。阿曼南部的海岸也偶爾會出現類似的山脈。

text: Close to the southern coast, especially around Salalah, you will find a **rolling hills landscape**. The area commonly features [rocky ground](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jScfBdQjFMYqeLA78), [bushes and small trees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dHACRg4JwejDadmeA) as well as some fairly [green valleys](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tPNC9mp6zLwKW4d1A).
text_zh: 靠近南部海岸的地方，特別是在薩拉alah（Salalah）周邊，你會看到**起伏的丘陵景觀**。該地區常見[岩石地面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jScfBdQjFMYqeLA78)、[灌木和小樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dHACRg4JwejDadmeA)，以及一些相當[翠綠的山谷](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tPNC9mp6zLwKW4d1A)。

text: The mountains north of Nizwa have an amount of **green bushes** that are unusually large for the north. The mountains are very rocky and jagged, which differentiates them from the more [rolling mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NpBXUgtm7496CeuE6) in the south.
text_zh: 尼茲瓦（Nizwa）以北的山脈擁有以北部標準來看數量異常多的**綠色灌木**。這些山脈非常多岩石且崎嶇，這點與南部較為[起伏的山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NpBXUgtm7496CeuE6)有所區別。

text: South of Bidiyah you can find a couple of dirt roads going through a slightly rolling landscape consisting of orange-pink sand and small yellow-ish shrubs. The roads mainly go between long and low sand dunes with a general south-south-west direction.
text_zh: 在比迪亞以南，你可以找到幾條泥土路穿過微幅起伏的景觀，由橘粉色的沙子和黃色小灌木組成。這些道路主要穿梭於長而低矮的沙丘之間，大致呈南南西走向。

text: Salalah is located on a flat coastal plain with rolling mountains surrounding it to the north.
text_zh: 薩拉拉位於平坦的海岸平原上，其北部環繞著起伏的山脈。

text: Masirah Island features a dry and slightly hilly landscape, typically with somewhat grey soil and with [brown shrubs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aKFc2E3KJdkTpbxm9) visible. Road 51, which circulates the island, usually only has a white centre road line, which can help in recognising it. The front camera on the island is [slightly smudged](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ANPz9Zyhb9M2dsdx7).
text_zh: 馬西拉島的特色是乾燥且有些起伏的地形，土壤通常呈灰灰色，並可見[棕色灌木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aKFc2E3KJdkTpbxm9)。環島的 51 號公路通常只有白色中央道路標線，這有助於辨識。島上的前鏡頭[有點模糊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ANPz9Zyhb9M2dsdx7)。

text: The ridge east of Mirbat is similar to the Salalah ridge, but more **pronounced**, and the terrain just south of it is more** rugged and hilly**.
text_zh: 米爾巴特（Mirbat）東側的山脊與薩拉拉山脊相似，但更加**明顯**，且其正南方的地形更加**崎嶇多山**。

text: A prominent** lone-standing mountain** can be seen from afar just southeast of Nizwa. It is more wide than it is tall, and has a **crown-like shape**.
text_zh: 從奈茲瓦（Nizwa）東南方遠處可以看到一座顯眼的**獨立孤山**。它寬度大於高度，且具有**皇冠般的形狀**。

text: Just north of Adam, you’ll find a flat desert landscape with greyish soil and mountains in the distance, notably [one long ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AFDyzLikH9mg41S79) to the south followed by [two smaller and rounder hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7DcxmRPv7QrxDJo96) to the east and southeast. Other mountains are also visible to the north and west.
text_zh: 就在亞當北方，你會發現平坦的沙漠景觀，土壤呈灰灰色，遠處有山脈，特別是南方有[一道長山脊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AFDyzLikH9mg41S79)，東方和東南方隨後有[兩座較小且較圓的山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7DcxmRPv7QrxDJo96)。北方和西方也能看到其他山脈。

text: In and close to Adam, the coverage is usually quite hazy, and the ridge and hills from the previous tip can be seen to the north. Though sometimes, only [one](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JF2kVdCibsQo72N27) or [two](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BFpSfW4WPP9ws7sK8) are visible. Unlike north of Adam, you won’t see mountains in any other direction.
text_zh: 在亞當及鄰近地區，街景通常相當朦朧，從前一個提示中提到的山脊和山丘可以在北方看到。不過有時候，只看得到[一個](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JF2kVdCibsQo72N27)或[兩個](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BFpSfW4WPP9ws7sK8)。與亞當以北不同，你在其他任何方向都看不到山脈。

text: If you are surrounded by mountains on all sides, and you are in a somewhat urban area, you are likely just southeast of Muscat, in Al Amarat.
text_zh: 如果你的四面八方都被群山環繞，且你身處有點都會感的區域，你很可能就在馬斯開特的東南方，即阿姆拉特。

text: Musandam governorate has more in common with the UAE than most of Oman, due to the even** drier mountainous landscape**, and it often has an orange tone. [Dipping beds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WSXnawCd6epZWmCy7), or mountains with diagonal layers, are common too.
NOTE: Most of mainland Oman is dry but still has [somewhat shrubby mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PDSq6znEJaiB52uy6).
text_zh: 穆桑代姆省（Musandam governorate）比多數阿曼地區與阿拉伯聯合大公國有更多相似之處，因為這裡有更**乾燥的山區景觀**，且通常帶有橘色調。[傾斜岩層](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WSXnawCd6epZWmCy7)，也就是具有對角線層理的山脈，在這裡也很常見。
注意：阿曼本土大部分地區是乾燥的，但仍有[些許灌木叢生的山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PDSq6znEJaiB52uy6)。

text: The road going to Saudi Arabia from Ibri can be recognised by the completely flat desert landscape with bright pink-greyish soil along with the road having** very wide shoulders** and the overall great road condition. The southern portion goes in a straight northeast direction, and the [northern section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DayXLmNREwVVVZpc7) curves more and can have more shrubs.
text_zh: 從伊布里（Ibri）通往沙烏地阿拉伯的道路可以透過完全平坦的沙漠景觀來識別，這裡有明亮的粉灰色土壤，且道路擁有**非常寬的路肩**以及整體極佳的道路狀況。南部路段大致朝東北方向筆直延伸，而[北部路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DayXLmNREwVVVZpc7)彎道較多，可能會有更多灌木。

text: Road 29 south of Ibri features a fairly shrubby landscape, with low and jagged mountains on the eastern side of the road. The** low-lying sun** to the northwest is particularly distinct.
text_zh: 伊布里南側的 29 號公路具有相當多灌木的景觀，道路東側有低矮且鋸齒狀的山脈。西北方**低垂的太陽**特別明顯。

text: The southern section of Road 29 only has a **middle white line**, which along with the greyish and sandy desert landscape makes this road unique.
text_zh: 29 號公路的南部路段只有一條**中間白線**，這點加上灰白色且沙質的沙漠景觀，使得這條道路非常獨特。

text: This long stretch of Road 31 can be recognised by the light-coloured flat desert landscape along with the **wide shoulders** and the often faded road lines. The weather is usually somewhat cloudy.
text_zh: 這段長距離的 31 號公路可以透過淺色的平坦沙漠景觀以及**寬路肩**和經常褪色的道路標線來識別。天氣通常有點多雲。

text: The divided section of Road 31 is the only divided road going through a flat desert landscape.
text_zh: 31 號公路的分隔車道段是穿過平坦沙漠景觀中唯一的雙向分隔道路。

text: Road 32 north of Duqm travels through a **hilly **desert landscape, in a general northern direction.
text_zh: 杜庫姆（Duqm）北側的 32 號公路穿過**丘陵**沙漠景觀，大致朝北方行進。

text: Crossing into the Ash Sharqiyah North Governorate, the shoulders become **wide**, like those on Road 31. However, unlike Road 31, the desert here is darker and has more shrubs and greenery. A long portion of the road also has overcast coverage. The lighter red section is no longer road 32 but still features the wide shoulders. The landscape further north also gets [hillier](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4La4moT9kWDS1Xbq6) and more vegetated.
text_zh: 進入沙奇亞北省（Ash Sharqiyah North Governorate），路肩變得跟 31 號公路一樣**寬**。然而，與 31 號公路不同的是，這裡的沙漠顏色更深，且有更多灌木和綠色植物。道路很長的一部分也有陰天覆蓋。較淺的紅色路段已不再是 32 號公路，但仍保有寬路肩。更北方的景觀也變得更[多山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4La4moT9kWDS1Xbq6)且植被更豐富。

text: Road 35 is surrounded by hills and mountains, and the ground is mostly **covered in green shrubs. **Curved lamp posts are posted at regular intervals on the northeastern side of the road.
text_zh: 35 號公路周圍環繞著丘陵和山脈，地面大多**覆蓋著綠色灌木。**道路東北側固定間距設有彎曲的路燈桿。

text: Road 37 travels in a generally northwest direction through a very generic, flat desert landscape. The angle is one of the best clues for this road. On the southern half, a [big power line](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UwJ6ZDLboH1MJNpf8) is visible to the northeast, while on the northern half, you can find distinct [sunset coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Y2gJq7uQW76wV25A).
text_zh: 37 號公路大致呈西北走向，穿過非常平淡、平坦的沙漠景觀。角度是這條道路最好的線索之一。在南半部，東北方可見[大型輸電線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UwJ6ZDLboH1MJNpf8)；而在北半部，則可以找到明顯的[日落街景](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Y2gJq7uQW76wV25A)。

text: Road 39 is also one of the more generic roads. Probably the best way to recognise it are the **narrow**, or even **non-existent shoulders**. The western parts can get quite [hilly](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dgwhWhWKFo1RSK316), but overall, the desert landscape is flat.
text_zh: 39 號公路也是比較大眾化的道路之一。辨識它最好的方法可能就是**狹窄**、甚至**幾乎沒有路肩**。西半部可能會變得蠻[多山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dgwhWhWKFo1RSK316)的，但整體而言，沙漠景觀是平坦的。

text: Coastal Road 41 features one of the sandiest landscapes in Oman, with very light sand all around. [The coast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RcScJcKptXEZAhNL7) is sometimes visible in the distance. On the north-to-south stretch, you can see a [distant ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icj21WV3ryenZhYY6) to the west.
text_zh: 沿海的 41 號公路擁有阿曼最沙質的景觀之一，周圍都是非常淺色的沙子。遠處有時可以看到[海岸](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RcScJcKptXEZAhNL7)。在由北向南的延伸路段，你可以看到西方有一道[遠處的山脊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icj21WV3ryenZhYY6)。

text: Roads 45 and the western stretch of 39 both feature a similar slightly hilly desert landscape, sunny weather, and a general east-to-west direction. What makes them unique is the** **[**light-coloured shoulders**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/81QXr1cqJT9yxvG17)** **the roads share, though it is most pronounced on Road 45. The roads also mostly have a [faded white middle line](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EiBMQQ3bh6DXt6HF8). To tell the 45 and western 39 apart, look at the sun, which is [overhead](https://maps.app.goo.gl/U4JtWs2nAKVCEvs7A) on the 39, but [to the west](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MGzB83ntBRbf7KCG8) on 45. The section north of Mudayy is also the 45, but unlabelled on Google Maps.
text_zh: 45 號公路與 39 公路的西部路段都具有類似的微丘陵沙漠景觀、晴朗的天氣，且大致呈東西走向。它們的獨特之處在於兩條路都有**[淺色路肩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/81QXr1cqJT9yxvG17)**，不過在 45 號公路上最為明顯。這些道路也大多有[褪色的白色中線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EiBMQQ3bh6DXt6HF8)。要分辨 45 號和西部 39 號公路，可以看太陽的位置：在 39 號公路上太陽在[正上方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/U4JtWs2nAKVCEvs7A)，但在 45 號公路上則在[西方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MGzB83ntBRbf7KCG8)。穆代伊（Mudayy）以北的路段也是 45 號公路，但在 Google 地圖上未標示名稱。

text: Peruvian roads always have white outer lines. On highways, you will find either **single yellow dashed** or **double yellow** middle lines. On rural mountain roads, you will most likely see white outer lines without any centre line. On divided highways, the road lines may be [completely white](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VLUf8irrxCGb1hTi8) in colour.
NOTE: In the continent of South America, rural mountain roads, with the features mentioned above, are predominantly found in Peru.
text_zh: 祕魯的道路永遠都有白色外側線。在公路上，你會找到**單黃虛線**或**雙黃**中線。在鄉村山路上，你最常看到的會是沒有任何中心線的白色外側線。在分隔式公路上，道路標線顏色可能是[完全白色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VLUf8irrxCGb1hTi8)的。
注意：在南美洲大陸上，具備上述特徵的鄉村山路主要見於祕魯。

text: Peru largely consists of semi-arid mountain ranges and valleys.
text_zh: 祕魯主要由半乾旱的山脈和山谷組成。

text: The country is generally flat in the east and mountainous in the west. However, an exception is the often flat desert near Piura in the northwest.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 該國東部通常平坦，西部多山。然而，西北部皮烏拉附近常見的平坦沙漠則是個例外。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: These three landscapes are typically found along offroads in Tumbes. You will always see sandy soil with either **green or withered bushes**.
NOTE: In addition, Tumbes does not have black cars on off roads. Make sure to consider it whenever you see such landscapes with a white Street View car.
text_zh: 這三種地景通常會在通往通貝斯（Tumbes）非鋪裝道路沿線找到。你總是會看到沙質土壤配上**綠色或枯萎的灌木**。
注意：此外，通貝斯在非鋪裝道路上沒有黑車。每當你看到搭配白色街景車的此類地景時，務必將此納入考量。

text: The southwestern landscape of Piura is generally dry, featuring a **low amount of vegetation** with a few shrubs and bushes. The landscape is mostly flat, but you will sometimes see rolling hills.
text_zh: 皮烏拉的西南部地景通常很乾燥，具有**少量的植被**以及一些灌木叢。地景大多平坦，但有時你會看到起伏的山丘。

text: A** flat landscape** in the mountains of Peru is usually seen in central Puno and around Lake Chinchaycocha.
NOTE: This landscape might look similar to Bolivia. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 祕魯山區的**平坦地景**通常見於普諾（Puno）中部和欽查科恰湖（Lake Chinchaycocha）周圍。
注意：這個地景看起來可能與玻利維亞相似。在進行猜測之前，務必尋找其他線索。

text: Far north Peru features mountains that are often covered in **shrubby trees and bushes**. Closer to the coast and the Ecuador border, these mountains are often [quite dry](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2sAyUVLu4AdVCyuc7#extra%5Btags%5D=Sandy+Orange&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) in appearance.
text_zh: 祕魯極北部有著經常覆蓋著**灌木狀樹木和灌木**的山脈。靠近海岸和厄瓜多邊界處，這些山脈的外觀通常[相當乾燥](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2sAyUVLu4AdVCyuc7#extra%5Btags%5D=Sandy+Orange&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)。

text: The areas adjacent to the northern Amazonian city of Tarapoto feature **moderately tall foliage-covered mountains** and can bear a similar resemblance to the hilly areas of [Colombia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9CLDvLq2CxSaRJqE8) or [Brazil](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wcxWAuqehRqPfCm96).
text_zh: 靠近北部亞馬遜城市塔拉波托（Tarapoto）的地區有著**中等高度、被樹木覆蓋的山脈**，並且可能與[哥倫比亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9CLDvLq2CxSaRJqE8)或[巴西](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wcxWAuqehRqPfCm96)的丘陵地區有幾分類似。

text: In higher elevation areas near the centre of the country, **exposed rocky outcroppings** are commonly seen in the sides of hills and mountains. Some areas with the highest concentrations are near Lago Chinchaycocha (Junin District) stretching south towards the city of Ayacucho.
NOTE: Exposed rocks can rarely be seen anywhere in the country, so use this meta with some caution.
text_zh: 在該國中部附近的海拔較高地區，丘陵和山脈的側面上常見**裸露的岩石露頭**。濃度最高的一些區域靠近欽查科恰湖（胡寧省）向南延伸至阿亞庫喬（Ayacucho）市。
注意：裸露的岩石在該國任何地方都很少見，因此請謹慎使用此元特徵（meta）。

text: Similarly, taller mountains near the middle of the country often feature **rocky and sharp mountain tops**. The main region of these mountains stretches from near the city of Huaraz southward to the city of Cusco; generally away from the coast.
text_zh: 同樣地，該國中部附近較高的山脈通常有**岩石和尖銳的山頂**。這些山脈的主要區域從瓦拉斯（Huaraz）市附近向南延伸至庫斯科（Cusco）市；通常遠離海岸。

text: Areas near the cities of Ica, Arequipa, and Tacna feature** barren and mostly flat desert landscapes** that can resemble areas of [northern Chile](https://goo.gl/maps/LF4MFBiVCeULmxmT7). You can typically see mountains in the distance, primarily while looking to the east.
text_zh: 伊卡（Ica）、阿雷基帕（Arequipa）和塔克納等城市附近的地區具有**荒涼且大多平坦的沙漠地景**，可能類似於[智利北部](https://goo.gl/maps/LF4MFBiVCeULmxmT7)的地區。你通常可以在遠處看到山脈，主要是在向東看的時候。

text: Coastal **agricultural valleys** in the middle and south are commonly sandwiched between **dry mountains with no vegetation**. The general orientation of these valleys are southwest-northeast.
NOTE: Agricultural valleys in the north of Peru can look similar, but often feature more shrubs and trees on the mountains.
text_zh: 中部和南部的沿海**農業山谷**通常夾在**沒有植被的乾旱山脈**之間。這些山谷的整體走向為西南—東北。
注意：祕魯北部的農業山谷看起來可能相似，但山上通常有更多灌木和樹木。

text: The 1N near the Piura and Lambayeque border has a distinct looking landscape. It features a semidesert landscape and has overcast coverage in Generation 3. The new Generation 4 is drier but still looks somewhat similar.
text_zh: 皮烏拉與蘭巴耶克省界附近的 1N 號公路有著獨特的景觀。這裡呈現半沙漠景觀，且在第 3 相機世代中有陰天街景覆蓋。較新的第 4 相機世代比較乾燥，但看起來仍然有些相似。

text: The valley connecting the cities of Jauja and Huancayo features a flat plain with **plentiful trees, agricultural areas, and small villages**. North-south oriented mountains can be seen on both edges of the valley.
text_zh: 連接豪賈和萬卡約兩市的河谷有著**豐富的樹木、農業區和小村莊**的平坦平原。在河谷的兩側邊緣可以看到南北走向的山脈。

text: North of the city of Huancayo lies a shallow lake called Lake Chinchaycocha (also referred to as ‘the middle lake.’). This lake is generally** marshy** and a **range of mountains** can be seen to the** east **of the lake. This lake can look similar to Lake Titicaca, but is generally less densely populated and features fewer trees.
text_zh: 萬卡約市以北有一座名為欽柴科恰湖（Chinchaycocha）的淺水湖（也被稱為「中湖」）。這個湖通常是**沼澤地形**，且在湖的**東側**可以看到**一連串的山脈**。這個湖看起來可能與的的喀喀湖相似，但通常人口較少且樹木較少。

text: Iquitos is a city in **northeast Peru**. It is an isolated city with only **Generation 3** Street View coverage. [Three-wheeled tuk-tuks](https://goo.gl/maps/sF5AYaumuA4RzSnP8), overcast skies, and [rolling Amazonian landscapes](https://goo.gl/maps/f1Jx1vsQcHc44o3w7) are commonly seen in the area. This coverage is isolated from other areas of northern Peru.
text_zh: 伊基托斯是**祕魯東北部**的一座城市。這是一座孤立的城市，只有**第 3 相機世代**的街景覆蓋。該地區常見[三輪嘟嘟車](https://goo.gl/maps/sF5AYaumuA4RzSnP8)、陰天天空以及[起伏的亞馬遜景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/f1Jx1vsQcHc44o3w7)。這種街景覆蓋與祕魯北部的其他地區是隔離的。

text: The southern city of Cusco is recognizable by its prevalence of both [red brick](https://goo.gl/maps/SPo96ELYh9L8WLkX9) and [Spanish colonial style](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzLN3km1TnyiaUk8) buildings. Cusco is surrounded by **mountains on all sides** and features an [**airport in the middle of the city**](https://goo.gl/maps/Dxg9TFTNUNZZCxAVA). Due to its proximity and similar architecture, Cusco superficially resembles the Bolivian city of [La Paz](https://goo.gl/maps/4QxcjEmUPQeAFLjf9).
text_zh: 南部的庫斯科市以盛行[紅磚](https://goo.gl/maps/SPo96ELYh9L8WLkX9)和[西班牙殖民風格](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzLN3km1TnyiaUk8)建築而聞名。庫斯科**四周環山**，且[**市中心有一個機場**](https://goo.gl/maps/Dxg9TFTNUNZZCxAVA)。由於地理位置相近且建築風格相似，庫斯科表面上與玻利維亞城市[拉巴斯](https://goo.gl/maps/4QxcjEmUPQeAFLjf9)十分相似。

text: The forested mountain range in Northern Luzon is characterised by somewhat **dry mountainsides** and an abundance of **pine trees**. You may rarely come across a similar landscape on high-altitude roads in [Mindanao](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dowDy4SWZt1pvxtG9).
text_zh: 呂宋島北部的森林山脈特徵是有些**乾燥的山腰**和大量的**松樹**。你可能很少在[民答那峨](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dowDy4SWZt1pvxtG9)的高海拔道路上遇到類似的景觀。

text: Decorations made of neon-green **Mountain Dew bottles** are commonly found in the north, particularly on northern Luzon.
text_zh: 由螢光綠**山露汽水瓶**製成的裝飾品在北部很常見，特別是在呂宋島北部。

text: The Mayon Volcano is one of the tallest mountains in the Philippines and can be recognised by its almost perfect **smooth cone shape**. Beware that it will very often be covered in [clouds](https://goo.gl/maps/vVLbxF6FtgkXgyRk6).
text_zh: 馬榮火山是菲律賓最高的高山之一，其特徵是幾近完美的**平滑圓錐形**。請注意，它非常常被[雲層](https://goo.gl/maps/vVLbxF6FtgkXgyRk6)覆蓋。

text: Poland is generally a **flat country**, with occasional rolling hills. The country is very green, with a lot of agriculture, and some amount of forest cover.
NOTE: Mountains can be found near the southern border.
text_zh: 波蘭大致上是個**平坦的國家**，偶有起伏的丘陵。這個國家非常綠意盎然，有大量的農業活動，並有一定程度的森林覆蓋。
注意：南部邊境附近可以找到山脈。

text: Even though most of Poland is flat, the southern border area is **very hilly**. Some parts even have mountains.
NOTE: Some other areas in Poland are somewhat hilly, but the south has by far the most amount of significant elevation.
text_zh: 儘管波蘭大部分地區是平原，但南部邊境地區**非常丘陵化**。有些地方甚至有山脈。
NOTE: 波蘭的其他一些地區也有點起伏，但南部的顯著高地絕對是最多的。

text: The **Tatra Mountains** are the highest mountains in Poland. They can be found near Zakopane, on the border with Slovakia.
text_zh: **塔特拉山脈（Tatra Mountains）**是波蘭最高的山脈。它們可以在扎科帕內（Zakopane）附近、靠近斯洛伐克的邊境找到。

text: In the far southwest of the country you can find a flat uncultivated landscape with very limited vegetation, which typically appears quite dry. There are almost no trees nearby, and only very low bushes and grass.
text_zh: 在該國的極西南端，你可以看到一片平坦且未開墾的景觀，植被非常稀少，通常顯得相當乾燥。附近幾乎沒有樹木，只有非常矮小的灌木和草。

text: Most of the **mountainous regions** of Puerto Rico are located in the middle section of the country. Most of the coverage in these areas is limited to divided highways.
text_zh: 波多黎各大部分的**山區**都位於該國的中部。這些區域的大部分街景覆蓋僅限於分隔公路。

text: Qatar's landscape is **predominantly desert**, with **arid**, and **mostly flat** expanses of sand as far as the eye can see. You will often not see a lot of trees or other greenery.
text_zh: 卡達的地景**以沙漠為主**，有著**乾旱**且**幾乎平坦**、一眼望不到盡頭的廣闊沙地。你通常很難看到大量樹木或其他綠色植物。

text: Réunion is a mountainous volcanic island in the Indian Ocean on a similar latitude to Queensland, Australia. Most roads are along the coast, with lush green mountains visible close by. Vegetation consists of [palms](https://goo.gl/maps/NjLXjEScWkmUzNQ17) and [ferns](https://goo.gl/maps/6oLGxZkvfaiTBqZg7), [pine trees](https://goo.gl/maps/J7vpe2wV2kptobfE9) at higher elevation, and [flowering plants](https://goo.gl/maps/zKst3y8NcdYipxtf6) due to the island’s tropical savanna climate.
text_zh: 留尼旺是印度洋上的多火山山岳島嶼，緯度與澳洲昆士蘭相近。大多數道路沿著海岸修建，附近可見蒼翠繁茂的綠色山脈。植被包含[棕櫚樹](https://goo.gl/maps/NjLXjEScWkmUzNQ17)、[蕨類](https://goo.gl/maps/6oLGxZkvfaiTBqZg7)、高海拔處的[松樹](https://goo.gl/maps/J7vpe2wV2kptobfE9)，以及因該島的熱帶莽原氣候而生的[開花植物](https://goo.gl/maps/zKst3y8NcdYipxtf6)。

text: Cilaos is a town inside a **caldera**. It can be recognized by the **wall** of mountains surrounding the town with **overcast** coverage.
text_zh: 奇拉奧斯是**火山破火山口**內的一個城鎮。它的特徵是環繞城鎮、帶有**陰天**覆蓋的群山**牆壁**。

text: Route du Volcan can be recognized by the **Martian** landscape. The only vegetation is scattered shrubs and the soil is a distinct **brown-red** colour. These [white stones](https://goo.gl/maps/UFYFzYRav6h75Fge8) lining the road are also a good clue.
text_zh: 火山公路（Route du Volcan）可以從其**火星**般的景觀認出。唯一的植被是零星的灌木，土壤則是明顯的**紅褐色**。道路兩旁這些[白色石頭](https://goo.gl/maps/UFYFzYRav6h75Fge8)也是很好的線索。

text: The eastern region of Réunion is the least densely populated, evident by the eastern part of the N2, which is a single carriageway passing through [somewhat dense vegetation on both sides](https://goo.gl/maps/1vJBXBfvwwi8YyB37), or a [vast landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/dCWLTzJzexxtujih9) with little to no trees.
text_zh: 留尼旺東部地區人口最稀少，N2 的東部路段即是明證：這是一條單車道公路，穿過[兩側相當茂密的植被](https://goo.gl/maps/1vJBXBfvwwi8YyB37)，或是幾乎沒有樹木的[廣闊景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/dCWLTzJzexxtujih9)。

text: The Romanian landscape ranges from tall forested mountains and hills in the centre to flat or rolling agricultural landscapes in the south, west and east.
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞的地貌從中央高聳的森林山脈與丘陵，到南部、西部和東部的平坦或起伏農業景觀不等。

text: This is an **elevation map** of Romania. The tallest mountains are found in the middle and north of the country, while the south and west are particularly flat.
text_zh: 這是一張羅馬尼亞的**高程地圖**。最高的山脈位於該國中部和北部，而南部和西部則特別平坦。

text: **Completely flat** agricultural landscapes can be found in the south and west.
NOTE: If you can see distant hills or mountains to the north, you are likely in the south, and if you see them to the south or east, you are likely in the west.
text_zh: **完全平坦**的農業景觀可以在南部和西部找到。
注意：如果你能在北方看到遠處的丘陵或山脈，你可能在南部；如果你在南方或東方看到它們，你可能在西部。

text: The 67C is a mountain road with **all** **yellow road lines**.
text_zh: 67C 是一條**全黃色道路標線**的山路。

text: The 7C is recognisable as going through some of the most **dramatic mountains** in Romania. The highest point on the road is right by the border between Sibiu and Argeș.
text_zh: 7C 的識別特徵是穿過羅馬尼亞一些**最壯麗的山脈**。該道路的最高點就在錫比烏和阿爾傑什之間的邊界旁。

text: If you see a **mountainous landscape** in **Generation 2**, you are likely close to Brașov.
text_zh: 如果你在**第二代相機**中看到**山岳景觀**，你可能靠近布拉索夫。

text: **Flat landscapes** in **Generation 2** are mostly found near Bucharest.
text_zh: **第二代相機**中的**平坦景觀**大多在布加勒斯特附近找到。

text: A **boat trekker**, with a green boat, can be found in the far east of the country. It mostly goes through small, overgrown canals in a flat landscape.
NOTE: There is no road coverage in this region.
text_zh: 一艘綠色的**船隻徒步拍攝**可以在該國最東端找到。它主要穿過平坦景觀中長滿雜草的小運河。
注意：此區域沒有道路覆蓋。

text: Sovetskaya Gavan and Vanino in eastern Khabarovsk have winter coverage, somewhat similar to Vorkuta.
NOTE: While Vorkuta and Vanino have similar coverage types, Vorkuta is noticeably flatter, having lower vegetation and a more barren landscape.
text_zh: 哈巴羅夫斯克東部的蘇維埃港和瓦尼諾有冬季街景，與沃爾庫塔有點相似。
注意：雖然沃爾庫塔和瓦尼諾有類似的街景類型，但沃爾庫塔明顯更為平坦，植被較低且地貌更為荒涼。

text: The Khabarovsk-Vanino road has a **mountainous landscape** with very **sunny coverage**. It also drives west with a black car with a blurred, long antenna, which helps to confirm.
text_zh: 哈巴羅夫斯克至瓦尼諾的公路具有**山地景觀**且**陽光普照**。行駛時還會開著配備模糊長天線的黑色車輛，這有助於確認地點。

text: **Sunset coverage**, with the sun very close to the horizon, with an eastern-looking landscape will be the P-297 in Amur Oblast, roughly between the towns of Never and Sivaki.
text_zh: **日落街景**（太陽非常接近地平線）搭配東向景觀，會是阿穆爾州的 P-297 公路，大致介於涅韋爾和西瓦基兩個城鎮之間。

text: Olkhon Island on Lake Baikal has a single road, driving on rolling **sandy hills during sunset**. You can often see Lake Baikal directly with a mountain ridge across the bay.
text_zh: 貝加爾湖的奧利洪島只有一條道路，行駛於**日落時分的連綿沙丘**中。你經常可以直接看到貝加爾湖，海灣對面則有山嶺。

text: Tunkinsky National Park in western Buryatia is a very green **river basin** with tall, **jagged mountains** to the north. In comparison to most of Buryatia, it is much greener.
text_zh: 布里亞特西部的通金斯基國家公園是一個非常綠意盎然的**河谷盆地**，北部有高聳、**鋸齒狀的山脈**。與布里亞特的大多數地方相比，這裡綠得多。

text: The landscape mainly consists of flat or rolling **grasslands**. The coast will be visible more often than not.
text_zh: 地貌主要由平坦或起伏的**草原**組成。通常海岸隨時可見。

text: A slightly **hilly, grass**y landscape with boxy houses spaced apart can be seen on Île-aux-Marins.
text_zh: 在聖保祿島（Île-aux-Marins）上可以看到稍微**起伏、長滿草**的景觀，並有著間距較遠的方正房屋。

text: This rural trekker in the far north can be recognized by the **rolling, grassy** landscape. The trekker can also be seen walking on a wooden path, with trees on either side.
text_zh: 這個位於極北處的鄉村徒步拍攝可以透過**起伏、長滿草**的景觀來辨識。也可以看到徒步拍攝走在木棧道上，兩側都有樹木。

text: The rural trekker on Saint Pierre island has a more **rocky** landscape. The trekker also walks on a path with trees on both sides.
text_zh: 聖皮耶島上的鄉村徒步拍攝具有較多**岩石**的景觀。徒步拍攝也走在兩側有樹木的小徑上。

text: The 739m-tall **Monte Titano** dominates the surrounding landscape and is visible from almost every point in the Republic.
NOTE: Look for the **three towers** to safely identify it.
text_zh: 高達 739 公尺的**蒂塔諾山**主導了周圍的景觀，在共和國的幾乎每個角落都清晰可見。
注意：尋找**三座塔**來確實辨識它。

text: The landscape of San Marino largely consists of smooth **agricultural hills**, with many small winding roads. The vegetation is distinctly **Mediterranean**, and normally appears quite lush.
text_zh: 聖馬利諾的景觀大多由平緩的**農田山丘**組成，有許多小型蜿蜒道路。植被具有明顯的**地中海**特色，通常看起來相當茂盛。

text: A **silver** or **white** truck cab is visible in the Generation 4 coverage. Several variants of each exist, most of which are region or road specific. The most useful and recognizable ones will be shown in the spotlight section. For a complete overview, see [this document](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JdyJNoOkksLAdGnJ_scA17K1pHV3THHERY-Y05B6rKI/edit#gid=0) by Lupus.
In the area around Dakar and Thies you can also find a [black](https://maps.app.goo.gl/M993iFkmA7pFDR2k7) pick up truck.
NOTE: The car may sometimes be fully blurred. Make sure to look at the landscape or other clues in the absence of car meta.
text_zh: 在第 4 代街景中可以看到**銀色**或**白色**的卡車車頭。每種都有幾種不同的變體，大多是地區或道路專屬的。最有用且最具辨識度的將會在重點單元中介紹。若要完整總覽，請參閱 Lupus 製作的[這份文件](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JdyJNoOkksLAdGnJ_scA17K1pHV3THHERY-Y05B6rKI/edit#gid=0)。
在達卡（Dakar）和捷斯（Thies）周遭的區域，你也可以找到一台[黑色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/M993iFkmA7pFDR2k7)皮卡車。
注意：這台車有時候可能會完全模糊。如果在沒有車輛特徵的情況下，務必觀察風景或其他線索。

text: The official and most common language seen in Senegal is French.
NOTE: The other sub-Saharan countries with street view coverage use English (Rwanda being a minor exception to this – however landscape should be sufficient to always tell the difference).
text_zh: 在塞內加爾看到官方且最常見的語言是法文。
注意：其他有街景覆蓋的撒哈拉以南國家使用的是英文（盧安達是個小例外——不過風景通常就足以分辨差異）。

text: The landscape north of The Gambia and for Senegal generally is a **flat, arid, savannah-desert** landscape with sparse trees. The trees themselves will be somewhat short and have leaves that are faded in colour.
text_zh: 甘比亞以北以及整體塞內加爾的景觀是**平坦、乾旱的稀樹草原-沙漠**景觀，樹木稀疏。樹木本身會有點矮小，且葉子顏色較褪色。

text: A **very slightly rolling** landscape consisting of vegetated sand dunes can be seen along the northwestern coast.
text_zh: 西北海岸沿線可以看到由長滿植被的沙丘組成的**微微起伏**景觀。

text: A **dry** landscape with **slight hills** can mostly be seen around Bakel, but also south to Nayé.
text_zh: 巴克爾（Bakel）周遭以及往南到納耶（Nayé）一帶，主要可以看到帶有**輕微丘陵**的**乾燥**景觀。

text: A **greener** landscape with **larger hills** can be seen around Kedougou and Mako.
text_zh: 凱杜古（Kedougou）和馬科（Mako）周遭可以看到帶有**較大丘陵**的**更綠意盎然**的景觀。

text: **Hazy** coverage with a **low sun** through a sometimes agricultural landscape can be seen on the N2 between St. Louis and Richard Toll.
text_zh: 在聖路易與理查托爾之間的 N2 公路上，可以看到帶有**低懸太陽**的**霧霾**覆蓋，穿梭於有時出現的農業景觀中。

text: The N2 between Richard Toll and Matam is a wide road going through a flat desert landscape with very sparse trees. It can be recognized by the **bright blue skies** with **no clouds**. The road itself goes east-west and northeast-southwest.
NOTE: The higher the sun is, the more east you are.
text_zh: 理查托爾和馬塔姆（Matam）之間的 N2 公路是一條寬闊的道路，穿過樹木非常稀疏的平坦沙漠景觀。它的特徵是**晴空萬里**且**沒有雲**。道路本身呈東西走向以及東北-西南走向。
注意：太陽越高，代表你越往東邊。

text: A flat, **slightly marshy** landscape with low vegetation can be seen on a few sections of roads in the Saloum River Delta.
text_zh: 在薩盧姆河三角洲（Saloum River Delta）的幾個道路路段上，可以看到平坦、**微帶沼澤**且植被低矮的景觀。

text: The white road in the Forest of Thies can be recognized by the **dry**,** slightly hilly** landscape with brown vegetation. The road itself is made of bright orange dirt. There is also a noticeably haze in the coverage.
text_zh: 捷斯森林（Forest of Thies）中的白色道路可以透過帶有褐色植被的**乾燥**、**微帶丘陵**景觀來辨認。道路本身是由鮮豔的橘色泥土組成。覆蓋中也有明顯的霧霾。

text: The Slovak landscape varies between very mountainous and completely [flat](https://goo.gl/maps/puNY8G6iPosUHNtMA). Generally speaking, Czechia is hillier, but less mountainous.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的景觀在群山環繞和完全[平坦](https://goo.gl/maps/puNY8G6iPosUHNtMA)之間變化。一般來說，捷克的丘陵較多，但山脈較少。

text: **Grey metal roofs** are very common, particularly in the eastern parts of Slovakia.
NOTE: Apart from the most mountainous areas, it is far less common in Czechia.
text_zh: **灰色金屬屋頂**非常普遍，特別是在斯洛伐克的東部地區。
注意：除了最高山區外，它在捷克的普及程度要低得多。

text: The tallest mountains in Slovakia are found in the **central **and **northern **parts of the country, while the flattest areas are found mainly in the southwest and in the southeast.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克最高山脈位於該國的**中部**和**北部**地區，而最平坦的地區主要位於西南部和東南部。

text: The eastern lowlands can typically be recognized by wide, flat fields, surrounded by hills or mountains in the far distance.
text_zh: 東部低地的特徵通常是寬闊平坦的田野，遠處環繞著丘陵或山脈。

text: Two wide valleys surrounded by tall, often sharp mountains can be found in the northern parts of the country. Due to the directions of the valleys, figuring out the direction to the closest mountain is typically enough to differentiate the two.
NOTE: The light red area has tall, sharp mountains to the northwest, and much lower hills and mountains to the southeast.
text_zh: 該國北部可以找到兩個被高聳且通常尖峭的山脈環繞的寬闊山谷。由於山谷的方向，找出通往最近山脈的方向通常就足以區分這兩者。
注意：淺紅色區域的西北方有高聳、尖峭的山脈，東南方的丘陵和山脈則低矮許多。

text: The Slovenian landscape is generally very **hilly and forested**, with occasional agriculture.
_For exceptions to this, see the region guessing section._
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的地貌通常非常**多山且森林密布**，偶有農田。
_關於此規則的例外，請參見地區猜測章節。_

text: The tallest mountains in the country can be found in the northwestern **alpine** region.
text_zh: 國內最高的高山位於西北部的**阿爾卑斯**地區。

text: **Flat**, or rolling, agricultural fields with **no mountains or tall hills** in view can be seen in the east of the country.
text_zh: 國家的東部可以看到**平坦**或起伏的農田，且視野中**沒有山脈或高山丘**。

text: Near the coast you get a landscape similar to the rest of the Adriatic coast; **white cliffs** with bushy vegetation, vineyards and Mediterranean architecture.
text_zh: 靠近海岸處，你會看到類似亞得里亞海其他地區的景緻；帶有灌木植被、葡萄園和地中海式建築的**白色懸崖**。

text: A **wide valley** going east to west, with mountains to the north and south can be found in the southeast.
text_zh: 東至西走向的**寬闊山谷**，其南北兩側皆有山脈，可以在東南部找到。

text: The northeast of the country can look very dry and somewhat barren, with a lot of orange or red soil. You will often see hills or mountains covered in shrubs.
NOTE: Depending on the season, the coverage can change drastically from [dry](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XsQme5RXp7jB2U1p6) to [very green](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hLARbuFeBKWx6hot7).
text_zh: 該國東北部看起來可能非常乾燥且有些荒涼，帶有大量橙色或紅色土壤。你經常會看到覆蓋著灌木叢的山丘或山脈。
註：根據季節不同，街景覆蓋可能會從[乾燥](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XsQme5RXp7jB2U1p6)急遽轉變為[非常綠意盎然](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hLARbuFeBKWx6hot7)。

text: Unique **rocky**, treeless mountains can be seen in Western Cape, with most of the mountains having tall, steep sides and sharp peaks.
NOTE: Similar mountains can be seen in and around Lesotho.
text_zh: 西開普省可以看到獨特的**岩石**、無樹山脈，大多數山脈都有高而陡峭的側面和尖銳的山峰。
註：賴索托及其周邊地區可以看到類似的山脈。

text: A dry landscape with red soil is typically found in the Northern Cape.
NOTE: This [map](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/c8/Koppen-Geiger_Map_ZAF_present.svg) is a useful guide in guessing based on the climate of South Africa.
text_zh: 帶有紅土的乾燥地貌通常見於北開普省。
註：此[地圖](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/c8/Koppen-Geiger_Map_ZAF_present.svg)是根據南非氣候進行猜測時的實用指南。

text: The landscape near the Mozambique border in the highlighted area is noticeably **flat**, with green subtropical vegetation.
text_zh: 莫三比克邊境附近的景觀在突顯區域內明顯**平坦**，並有綠色的亞熱帶植被。

text: The landscape around Kruger National Park is generally flat, with a **savannah **climate and dry vegetation. You will not see any agriculture and the vegetation is mostly made up of grasses, with small trees dotting the landscape. Red soil can also be seen below the grass.
In addition, this distinctive [directional waystone](https://goo.gl/maps/C4VRQ6v1PyAStJUz7) is commonly found at many junctions.
NOTE: Within the coverage of the park, you will mostly find unpaved gravel roads or small and paved roads without road lines.
text_zh: 克魯格國家公園周邊的景觀通常很平坦，具有**稀樹草原**氣候與乾燥的植被。你看不到任何農業活動，植被主要由草地組成，並散布著小樹。草地下方也能看到紅土。
此外，這個獨特的[方向石碑](https://goo.gl/maps/C4VRQ6v1PyAStJUz7)常見於許多交叉路口。
注意：在公園的街景覆蓋範圍內，你主要會看到未鋪柏油的碎石路，或是沒有道路標線的小型鋪面道路。

text: The section of the **R360 north of Bokspits**, next to the Botswana border, has asphalt with a recognizable reddish tint. The landscape is arid and features dry greyish trees, shrubs and long golden grass. The road runs in a general north to south direction.
NOTE: Asphalt with a reddish tint can be found on other roads and the southern part of the R360. However, the landscape north of Bokspits looks predominantly like this.
text_zh: 位於波斯皮茨以北、鄰近波札那邊境的**R360**路段，其柏油路面帶有明顯的 reddish 泛紅。景觀屬於乾旱型，帶有乾枯的灰綠色樹木、灌木和長長的金色牧草。道路大致呈南北走向。
注意：其他道路以及 R360 的南部路段也可能出現帶有紅調的柏油。然而，波斯皮茨以北的景觀主要就是長這樣。

text: The distinct **Table Mountain**, located west of Cape Town, can be recognized by its prominent three-kilometre plateau. It is flanked by Devil’s Peak, which is more pyramidal.
text_zh: 位於開普敦西側的獨特**桌山**，以其顯眼的三公里高原而聞名。其兩側則是較呈金字塔形的魔鬼峰。

text: Mountains in the Witfontein Nature Reserve, likely **George’s Peak**, will be visible **north** from the city of George.
text_zh: 從喬治市往**北**望去，可以看到維特方恩自然保護區內的山脈，很可能是**喬治峰**。

text: This **wide open valley** with lightly snow capped mountains can be seen on the west side of South Georgia Island.
text_zh: 這個有著微雪覆頂山峰的**寬闊山谷**可以在南喬治亞島的西側看到。

text: The South Korean landscape is predominantly **mountainous**. It is very rare to not see at least some hills or mountains in the distance. Even in the flat areas, you can almost always see elevation on the horizon.
text_zh: 南韓的地形主要是**山地**。在遠處看不到至少一些丘陵或山脈是非常罕見的。即使在平坦地區，你幾乎總能在地平線上看到起伏。

text: Spain has **highly diverse landscapes**, ranging from [lush Atlantic forests](https://goo.gl/maps/U8Vp3k1yGrLdVQANA) to [bone-dry semideserts](https://goo.gl/maps/PwTpyn5Lw6DMApWGA). Elevation is also varied: highland plateaus interspersed with [rolling hills](https://goo.gl/maps/hDzbVSrJbPSPQVnJ7) are common, but you might also encounter jagged mountain ranges and [very flat lowland](https://goo.gl/maps/kgiM3UXvKiQAcToWA) areas.
text_zh: 西班牙擁有**高度多樣化的地貌**，從[綠意盎然的大西洋森林](https://goo.gl/maps/U8Vp3k1yGrLdVQANA)到[極度乾燥的半沙漠](https://goo.gl/maps/PwTpyn5Lw6DMApWGA)應有盡有。海拔高度也變化多端：夾雜著[起伏丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/hDzbVSrJbPSPQVnJ7)的高原很常見，但你也可能會遇到綿延險峻的山脈和[非常平坦的低地](https://goo.gl/maps/kgiM3UXvKiQAcToWA)地區。

text: While there is not one single definitive Spanish landscape, most of the country has a somewhat dry, **Mediterranean** climate, with matching vegetation and agriculture.
text_zh: 雖然西班牙沒有單一最具代表性的地貌，但全國大部分地區都屬於稍微乾燥的**地中海**氣候，並有著相應的植被和農業。

text: Spain is a very **mountainous** country.
The highest mountain ranges are the Pyrenees in the northeast, and the Baetic System (which includes Sierra Nevada) in the southeast.

The Meseta Central is a high altitude, mostly flat area in the centre of the country. It is surrounded by several smaller mountain ranges: the Cantabrian Range in the north, the Iberian System in the east, and Sierra Morena in the south.
Within the Meseta Central there are two more mountain ranges: the Sistema Central (going from the Portuguese border to the northeast of Madrid) and Montes de Toledo.

There are four big river basins in Spain. The Tajo and Guadiana cross Extremadura and go into Portugal, the Guadalquivir covers most of the southwest of Andalusia and the Ebro river basin starts in Navarra and flows into the mediterranean in the south of Catalonia.
text_zh: 西班牙是一個高度**多數山地**的國家。（譯註：此處原文結構稍亂，順譯為：西班牙是一個非常多山的國家。）
最高山脈是位於東北部的庇里尼亞山脈，以及位於東南部的貝蒂斯山系（其中包括內華達山脈）。
梅瑟塔高原（Meseta Central）是國內中部的一片高海拔、大致平坦的地區。它被幾個較小的山脈環繞：北部的坎塔布里亞山脈、東部的伊比利亞山系，以及南部的莫雷納山脈。
在梅瑟塔高原內部還有另外兩座山脈：中央山脈（從葡萄牙邊境延伸至馬德里東北部）以及托雷多山脈。
西班牙有四大河流域。塔霍河和瓜 Guadiana 河穿過埃斯特雷馬杜拉並流入葡萄牙，瓜達基維爾河涵蓋了安達魯西亞西南部的大部分地區，而埃布羅河流域則發源於納瓦拉，並在加泰隆尼亞南部注入地中海。

text: The landscape in the far north is much more **green and lush** than the rest of Spain. The landscape is generally quite hilly. Hedges and green meadows are common. In some places, this region’s landscape bears a vague resemblance to Ireland, France and the UK.
text_zh: 最北部的地貌比西班牙其他地區**翠綠且繁茂得多**。地貌通常相當丘陵起伏。樹籬和綠草如茵的牧場很常見。在某些地方，這個地區的地貌隱約讓人想起愛爾蘭、法國和英國。

text: The **Pyrenees** is a large mountain range on the border between Spain and France. Its mountains are some of the highest in all of Spain. It can be recognized by its light grey rock and abundance of pine trees. Local architecture features many [rock walls](https://goo.gl/maps/F67y544xPUyR5ypo7).

NOTE: Andorra and the French part of the Pyrenees look very similar in terms of landscape and architecture. Also consider that the exclave of [Llívia](/images/spain/spain_pyreneesllivia.png) is part of Spain.
text_zh: **庇里尼亞山脈（Pyrenees）**是位於西班牙和法國邊境的大型山脈。其群山是全西班牙海拔最高的一些山脈。它可透過淺灰色岩石和大量的松樹來辨識。當地建築特色包含許多[石牆](https://goo.gl/maps/F67y544xPUyR5ypo7)。
注意：安道爾和庇里牛斯山的法國部分在景觀和建築上看起來非常相似。同時也要考慮到[利維亞](/images/spain/spain_pyreneesllivia.png)飛地是西班牙的一部分。

text: Thick forests of **tall pines** can be found all throughout the Pyrenees. When encountered in smaller mountains in between grazing fields or agricultural land, it will most likely be in the Basque Country or Navarra.
text_zh: 在整個庇里尼亞山脈都可以找到**高大松樹**所組成的茂密森林。如果在放牧田或農田之間較小的山脈中遇到，那很可能是位於巴斯克自治區或納瓦拉。

text: The centre of Castilla y León features a **mostly flat agricultural landscape**, with only slight changes in elevation. Most of the fields will have cereal crops like wheat and barley, and it is fairly common to find sunflower plantations.
text_zh: 卡斯提亞-雷昂的中部以**大致平坦的農業地貌**為特色，僅有輕微的海拔變化。大部分農田都會種植小麥和大麥等穀物作物，而且找到向日葵種植園也相當普遍。

text: Vineyards can be found in several places in Spain. However, if you see vineyards **in between mountain ranges** to the north and south, you are most likely in La Rioja.
text_zh: 葡萄園可以在西班牙的多個地方找到。然而，如果你看到葡萄園位於南北兩側的**山脈之間**，你最有可能身處拉里奧哈。

text: Starting in Navarra and cutting across the middle of Aragón, there is a strip of semi-desert landscape on both sides of the Ebro river basin. Light sandy soil and **small shrubs** growing on **small hills** are common in this area.
text_zh: 從納瓦拉開始並橫穿亞拉岡中部，在埃布羅河流域兩側有一條半沙漠地貌的帶狀區域。淺色沙質土壤和生長在**小山丘**上的**小灌木**在該地區很常見。

text: Castilla la Mancha can have **completely flat landscapes**, which are not that common in Castilla y León. Half of Spain’s wine is produced in this region, so vineyards are fairly common.
In the western provinces of Ciudad Real and Toledo, it is very common to see olive tree plantations, generally in flatter ground than those found in Andalusia.
text_zh: 卡斯提亞-拉曼查可能擁有**完全平坦的地貌**，這在卡斯提亞-雷昂並不常見。西班牙一半的葡萄酒都是在該地區生產的，因此葡萄園相當普遍。
在雷亞爾城和托雷多的西部省份，看到橄欖樹種植園非常普遍，通常位於比安達魯西亞更平坦的地面上。

text: In the southeast of Spain, especially in Murcia, you can find a rather **arid landscape**, with very sandy soil and **medium sized mountains** surrounding.
Small shrubs and small plantations of fruit trees and olive trees are a common sight around rural roads.
text_zh: 在西班牙東南部，特別是在穆爾西亞，你可以找到相當**乾旱的地貌**，有著非常沙質的土壤，周圍環繞著**中等大小的山脈**。
小灌木以及小型的果樹和橄欖樹種植園是鄉村道路周圍常見的景象。

text: Mountains in this area, especially Murcia and the south of Alicante have a very distinct look.
They are quite **rugged**, usually lacking in vegetation. This region commonly features a **hazy** look, making mountains in the distance look like they are behind a sort of mist.
text_zh: 這一地區的山脈，特別是穆爾西亞和阿利坎特南部，有著非常獨特的外觀。
它們相當**崎嶇**，通常缺乏植被。該地區通常帶有**霧濛濛**的外觀，使得遠處的山脈看起來像是處於某種薄霧後方。

text: The mountain range of Sierra Nevada features **snowy peaks** through the months of November and May. Sierra Nevada is the only mountain range in south Spain with snow during most of the year.
text_zh: 內華達山脈（Sierra Nevada）在 11 月到 5 月期間會出現**積雪山峰**。內華達山脈是西班牙南部唯一一座一年中大部分時間都有積雪的山脈。

text: Towns built **on a mountain face**, consisting entirely of white houses, are very common on the south coast of Spain, around Málaga.
text_zh: 建**在山壁上**、完全由白色的房屋組成的城鎮，在西班牙南部海岸馬拉加一帶非常常見。

text: South of Madrid, olive tree plantations are usually in small or medium sized fields, in mostly flat terrain and commonly accompanied by red soil.
text_zh: 馬德里以南的橄欖樹種植園通常位於中小型田野中，多處於平坦地形，且通常伴隨著紅土。

text: Olive plantations on the east coast are commonly fenced or behind rock walls and you will almost always see mountains in some direction.
text_zh: 東海岸的橄欖種植園通常圍有柵欄或位於石牆後方，而且你幾乎總能在某個方向看到山脈。

text: On the east coast of Spain, you can find many **orange tree plantations**. They are usually in small valleys, and if they are in flat land you can usually see mountains to the west, north or south.
text_zh: 在西班牙東海岸，你可以找到許多**橘子樹種植園**。它們通常位於小山谷中，如果位於平坦土地上，你通常可以看到西側、北側或南側有山脈。

text: In the Guadalquivir river basin you can also find many orange plantations, usually in much more open and flat terrain than those of the east coast.
There are some extensive [plantations](https://goo.gl/maps/6k7YejSEZE3tyhgu9) in the mountains, but coverage is sparse there.
text_zh: 在瓜達基維爾河流域，你也可以找到許多橘子種植園，通常位於比東海岸更開闊、更平坦的地形中。
山區裡有一些廣闊的[種植園](https://goo.gl/maps/6k7YejSEZE3tyhgu9)，但那裡的街景覆蓋稀疏。

text: **Stone pines** ([Pinus pinea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stone_pine)) can be recognized by their fluffy leaves, and compact bulbous crown that is wider than it is tall.
Forests of exclusively stone pines in a flat area are very common around Valladolid and Huelva. It is common to see them in the mountains close to Barcelona in residential areas.
text_zh: **石松** ([Pinus pinea](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stone_pine)) 的特徵是毛茸茸的葉子，以及緊密且呈球根狀的樹冠，其寬度大於高度。
由純粹石松組成的平坦森林在瓦 Valladolid 和烏爾瓦 Huelva 一帶非常普遍。在巴塞隆納附近山區的住宅區也很常見。

text: **Baltic pines** ([Pinus sylvestris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_sylvestris)) are tall and thin, with a dark bark that sheds at the top, revealing the orange-red wood underneath. They usually do not have branches on the bottom half of the trunk, especially when fully grown.
Baltic pines can be found in mainly three mountain ranges: the Pyrinees, Sierra de Guadarrama and the Iberian System.
text_zh: **歐洲赤松** ([Pinus sylvestris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_sylvestris)) 高而細長，樹皮呈深色且在頂部剝落，露出底下的橘紅色木材。它們通常在樹幹的下半部沒有樹枝，尤其是完全長成的時候。
歐洲赤松主要分布在三個山脈：庇里牛斯山、瓜達拉馬山脈和伊比利亞山系。

text: In the rest of Spain you can find the Mediterranean variant of the tree. It still has a grey bark with red tones, and it is usually very fissured.
You can find the tree in most of the mountain ranges in central and southern Spain. Extensive plantations in flat ground can be found North of [Segovia](https://goo.gl/maps/i6S6jEeFsbjheYQe6).
text_zh: 在西班牙的其他地區，你可以找到這種樹的地中海變體。它依然保有帶紅色調的灰色樹皮，且通常有許多裂縫。
你可以在西班牙中部和南部的多數山脈找到這種樹。平坦地面上的廣大人工林則可在[塞哥維亞](https://goo.gl/maps/i6S6jEeFsbjheYQe6)北方找到。

text: There is a large part of north-west Spain where you will find almost exclusively **slate roofs** (recognisable by their almost black colour). This type of roofing can be seen sparingly all the way to the west coast of Galicia, but ends rather abruptly on the east.
Slate roofs can also be found in the [Pyrenees](https://goo.gl/maps/gEG616kL4GBMD2HV8) near Andorra, and in the [mountain ranges](https://goo.gl/maps/WF1eMyRmBBnrFF867) north east of Madrid.
text_zh: 西班牙西北部有很大一部分地區幾乎全都是**石板屋頂**（以幾乎黑色的外觀為特徵）。這類屋頂在通往加利西亞西海岸的沿途稀疏可見，但在東側卻相當突然地結束。
石板屋頂也可以在安道爾附近的[庇里牛斯山](https://goo.gl/maps/gEG616kL4GBMD2HV8)以及馬德里東北方的[山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/WF1eMyRmBBnrFF867)中找到。

text: The small island of Formentera frequently features low **coastal shrubs**. It is common to be able to see the mountains of Ibiza from Formentera’s north coast.
text_zh: 小島福門特拉島經常出現低矮的**海岸灌木**。從福門特拉島的北海岸通常可以看到伊比薩島的山脈。

text: The north-west of Mallorca has a **tall mountain range** that can be seen from many places on the island. It is the only island in the Balearics with mountains this big.
text_zh: 馬約卡島的西北部有一座**高大山脈**，從島上許多地方都能看到。它是巴利阿里群島中唯一擁有這麼巨大山脈的島嶼。

text: The Canaries have **extremely diverse landscapes**, including [steep mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/rfH1kBDye8h9rWaS6), [pine forests](https://goo.gl/maps/Bn6ErCKJ3sfiUaUa8), [volcanic soil](https://goo.gl/maps/6JqQk3AxRiRF3WoDA), and [extreme aridity](https://goo.gl/maps/4fdpWvUUTJYxJMEd7). You can also encounter [more normal landscapes](https://goo.gl/maps/zVYFchUyxrDQ7uyx5) that can look more like mainland Spain.

NOTE: Because of its diversity, it is hard to pin down the average landscape in the Canaries. A more useful strategy is to focus on whether it looks unique and unlike anything that you would find in mainland Europe: if meta matches with Spain, but something is “off” in terms of vibe, consider the Canaries.
text_zh: 加納利群島擁有**極其多樣化的景觀**，包括[陡峭的山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/rfH1kBDye8h9rWaS6)、[松樹林](https://goo.gl/maps/Bn6ErCKJ3sfiUaUa8)、[火山土壤](https://goo.gl/maps/6JqQk3AxRiRF3WoDA)以及[極端的乾旱景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/4fdpWvUUTJYxJMEd7)。你也可以遇到[更正常的景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/zVYFchUyxrDQ7uyx5)，看起來更像西班牙本土。
注意：由於其多樣性，很難確切指出加納利群島的平均景觀。一個更有用的策略是關注它看起來是否獨特，並且不像你在西歐本土會找到的任何東西：如果特徵線索符合西班牙，但在氛圍方面有某種「怪異之處」，請考慮加納利群島。

text: In some parts of the island of **Lanzarote** on the Canary Islands, a very dark, exposed volcanic soil can be seen. In places, this landscape superficially resembles the surface of the moon.
NOTE: The other Canary Islands can sometimes have similar landscapes as well, but it is by far the most common on Lanzarote.
text_zh: 在加納利群島**蘭薩羅特島**的一些地方，可以看到非常黑暗、裸露的火山土壤。在某些地方，這種景觀表面上類似月球表面。
注意：其他加納利群島有時也可能擁有類似的景觀，但在蘭薩羅特島這是絕對最常見的。

text: The island of **Fuerteventura** in the Canary Islands is characterised by a very arid landscape with little to no vegetation. Orange soil is very common, and within the Canary Islands archipelago essentially unique to this island.
text_zh: 加納利群島的**富特文圖拉島**的特徵是極度乾旱的景觀，幾乎沒有植被。橘色土壤非常普遍，在加納利群島群島中基本上是該島特有的。

text: Off the north coast of Lanzarote, you will find the small island of **La Graciosa**. The island’s landscape is completely barren, and the entire coverage features **overcast weather**. There are two towns on the south coast of the island, with white flat-roofed houses like the east Canaries.
text_zh: 在蘭薩羅特島（Lanzarote）北海岸外，你會發現一座名為**拉格拉西奧薩島**的小島。該島的地貌完全荒蕪，且整個街景覆蓋都呈現**陰天**。島的南海岸有兩個城鎮，擁有像東加納利群島那樣的白色平頂房屋。

text: You will find a **mountainous, mediterranean** landscape in Ceuta, featuring a mix of eucalyptus trees and pines.
text_zh: 你在 Ceuta 會找到 **多山的地中海** 景觀，融合了尤加利樹與松樹。

text: The Ebro delta (Deltebre in catalan) features an extremely **flat **landscape, where **rice fields** and **water canals** are very common.
There are significant mountains to the South, West, and North, and some of them can be seen from almost every location in the delta.
text_zh: 埃布羅三角洲（加泰隆尼亞語為 Deltebre）具有極度 **平坦** 的地景，**稻田** 和 **水圳** 非常普遍。
南、西、北部有顯著的山脈，從三角洲的幾乎每個位置都能看到其中一些山脈。

text: All Generation 4 coverage is **low-cam**. This means that the camera on the Google car is intentionally set up lower than in most other countries. This can be recognized in two ways:
- The car blur is significantly bigger. Generally, the bigger car blur is the most consistent way to recognize low-cam.
- Roads look wider and objects around you are seen from a lower angle.
Note that Sri Lanka’s Generation 3 coverage is made with a normal height camera!
NOTE: All coverage in Japan and Switzerland is low-cam. However, landscape should be sufficient to tell these apart from Sri Lanka.
text_zh: 所有第四代街景都是 **低相機視角（low-cam）**。這意味著 Google 車上的相機故意設置得比大多數其他國家還要低。這可以透過兩種方式辨識：
- 車輛模糊範圍明顯更大。通常，較大的車輛模糊是辨識低相機視角最一致的方法。
- 道路看起來更寬，你周圍的物體是以更低的視角被看見。
請注意，斯里蘭卡的第三代街景是用正常高度的相機拍攝的！
注意：日本和瑞士的所有街景都是低相機視角。然而，地景應該足以將它們與斯里蘭卡區分開來。

text: These maps shows the distribution of each of Sri Lanka’s **four main religions**. This can help with region-guessing when you spot a house of worship or other symbol associated with one of the religions.
- Buddhism is found in most of the country but is mostly absent from the north and some parts of the east coast.
- Hinduism is predominantly found in the north and parts of the east, as well as around the town of Nuwara Eliya in the central mountains.
- Islam is strongest on the east coast, but not a majority in any district.
- Christianity is mostly confined to the northwest, and is strongest around the town of Mannar.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這些地圖顯示了斯里蘭卡 **四大主要宗教** 的分布。當你發現寺廟或與其中一種宗教相關的其他符號時，這有助於進行區域猜測。
- 佛教見於該國大部分地區，但在北部和東海岸的部分地區幾乎不存在。
- 印度教主要見於北部和東部部分地區，以及中部山區的努沃勒埃利耶（Nuwara Eliya）城鎮周圍。
- 伊斯蘭教在東海岸最強勢，但在任何地區都不是多數。
- 基督教主要限於西北部，在馬納爾（Mannar）城鎮周圍最強勢。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: This map shows Sri Lanka’s **topography**. Hills and mountains are strongly concentrated in the central-southern part of the country.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這張地圖顯示了斯里蘭卡的 **地形**。丘陵和山脈高度集中在中南部地區。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The southwest of Sri Lanka has a more **wet climate** that is characterised by lush, dense vegetation. Deep green tones dominate the landscape.
text_zh: 斯里蘭卡西南部擁有更 **濕潤的氣候**，其特徵是繁茂、濃密的植被。深綠色調主導了地景。

text: Conversely, the rest of the country has a slightly more **dry climate**. The vegetation is often lower and more open. The landscape usually has a mix of brown and green tones.

Note that the difference is not extreme, as the landscape in Sri Lanka never truly gets downright arid. However, with some practise, you can often learn to tell the difference. Your mileage may also vary depending on the season, local forest cover, or coverage type (Generation 3 often tends to make the landscape look more arid than it really is).
text_zh: 相反地，該國其餘地區擁有稍微更 **乾燥的氣候**。植被通常較低且較為開闊。地景通常融合了棕色和綠色調。
請注意，這種差異並非極端，因為斯里蘭卡的景觀從未真正變得完全乾旱。然而，經過一些練習，你通常可以學會分辨其中的差異。你的體驗也可能因季節、當地森林覆蓋率或街景類型而異（第三代街景通常會讓景觀看起來比實際更乾燥）。

text: **Horton Plains National Park **has a very distinct and bait landscape, consisting of hilly plains covered in long grass. In the distance, you can see forests, but most of the park’s roads meander through a wide open landscape.
text_zh: **霍頓平原國家公園**有著非常獨特且具標誌性的地貌，由長滿長草的丘陵平原組成。在遠處可以看到森林，但公園的大多數道路都蜿蜒穿過寬廣開闊的地貌。

text: The general landscape consists of **barren, treeless** mountains. Trees and greenery are a very rare sight, with the majority of vegetation consisting of moss and grasses. The sky is also often overcast, with a gloomy look to the coverage.
text_zh: 整體景觀由 **荒涼、無樹** 的山脈組成。樹木和綠意非常罕見，大部分的植被由苔蘚和草組成。天空也經常陰沉，街景覆蓋呈現陰暗的外觀。

text: Pyramiden feels more abandoned compared to Longyearbyen. Multi-storey **soviet-style** apartment blocks can be seen, however, with a lack of human-activity. As the name suggests, many [pyramidal](https://goo.gl/maps/BwYf7hXdrqow9e3S6) mountains can be seen in the distance.
text_zh: 與朗伊爾城相比，皮拉米登給人一種更荒涼的感覺。可以看到多層的**蘇聯風格**公寓大樓，但缺乏人類活動的跡象。正如其名，在遠處可以看到許多[金字塔形](https://goo.gl/maps/BwYf7hXdrqow9e3S6)的山脈。

text: This road going south-east of Longyearbyen can be recognized by the barren, treeless **mountains** on both sides of the road, with **lakes** leading up to the mountains. A small black mirror can sometimes be seen on the left.
text_zh: 這條從 Longyearbyen 東南方延伸的道路，其特徵是道路兩側皆為荒涼、無樹的**山脈**，且有**湖泊**一路綿延至山腳下。左側有時可以看到一面小黑鏡。

text: A trekker can be seen holding on to a **red car** heading up a winding road, south of the Svalbard Airport. If the car is not present, this distinct [line of mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/Aub5RxFwVD9QruVz9) to the northeast is a good indicator that you are there.
text_zh: 在斯瓦爾巴機場南方，可以看到一台徒步拍攝相機正抓著一台開往蜿蜒山路的**紅色車**。如果沒有看到車子，東北方這個明顯的[山脈稜線](https://goo.gl/maps/Aub5RxFwVD9QruVz9)會是判斷你身處該處的好指標。

text: Sweden has a varied landscape, with a lot of **boreal forests**, small to medium-sized farmlands and many lakes. The northern and western parts of the country are quite mountainous, with long, narrow lakes and rivers, while the southern and eastern parts are generally flatter.
text_zh: 瑞典的地貌多變，有大量的**北方針葉林**、中小型農田以及許多湖泊。該國北部和西部山巒起伏，有長而狹窄的湖泊與河流，而南部和東部則通常較為平坦。

text: While it is possible to see forested mountains in several regions in the country, mountains with **no trees at the top** can only be found in the northwestern parts of the country.
text_zh: 雖然在該國的多個地區都可以看到有森林的山脈，但**山頂無樹**的山脈僅能在該國的西北部地區找到。

text: In Skåne you will find the **most open agricultural landscape** in Sweden. It is the only region where, rather than a dense forest in the distance, you can get only a few small patches of trees strewn across the fields. On top of that, crops are often [more diverse](https://goo.gl/maps/iSRTHpPv8DEZyymX7) than the [cereal crops](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cereal), which are typical for the rest of Sweden.
text_zh: 在斯科讷（Skåne），你會找到瑞典**最開闊的農業景觀**。這是唯一一個遠處不是茂密森林，而只有幾小片樹木散落田野間的地區。除此之外，農作物通常也比瑞典其他地區典型的[穀物作物](https://goo.gl/maps/iSRTHpPv8DEZyymX7)[更具多樣性](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cereal)。

text: The agricultural landscape of Västergötland and Östergötland is mostly flat, similarly to the landscape around lake Mälaren. The two most consistent differences is that this landscape is **more open** and has lots of **wind turbines**. While you can almost always see a forest in the distance, it will typically be much further away than around Mälaren.
text_zh: 韋斯特吉特蘭（Västergötland）和東吉特蘭（Östergötland）的農業景觀大多很平坦，與梅拉倫湖周邊的景觀類似。兩個最一致的區別是，這裡的景觀**更為開闊**且擁有許多**風力發電機**。雖然你幾乎總能在遠處看到森林，但它通常會比梅拉倫湖周邊的森林還要遠得多。

text: The landscape around the High Coast in Västernorrland can be recognised by the many **forested, rocky mountains** surrounding agricultural valleys. The valleys are rarely straight and the mountains are of varying heights and shapes.
text_zh: 西諾爾蘭省（Västernorrland）高海岸（High Coast）周圍的景觀，可以透過環繞著農業山谷的許多**多林岩山**來辨識。這些山谷很少是筆直的，山峰的高度和形狀也各不相同。

text: Grey **diamond-tiled roofs** are mainly found in Skåne, Blekinge, Öland, and occasionally on Gotland.

NOTE: Gotland and Öland are normally more easily recognised from landscape alone. Houses in western and southern Skåne typically use a lot of stone and bricks, while houses in northeastern Skåne and Blekinge are mostly made of red painted wood.
text_zh: 灰色**菱形磁磚屋頂**主要分佈在斯科讷、布萊金厄、厄蘭島，偶爾也會在哥特蘭島上找到。
注意：哥特蘭島和厄蘭島通常單從景觀就更容易辨認。西斯科讷和南斯科讷的房屋通常使用大量石頭和磚塊，而東北斯科讷和布萊金厄的房屋大多由紅色油漆木材製成。

text: The E10 between Kiruna and the Norwegian border is a major road which can be recognised by the vegetation mainly consisting of **small birches**, occasionally with some [pines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r2w5fSrjknpLRGbg9) strewn in, combined with snow covered mountains, which can typically be seen in the distant west close to Kiruna, and in all directions when you approach the border. A [major lake](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5ufEBehSjqCDNzoB8) can also be seen to the north on the western half of the road.
text_zh: 基律納（Kiruna）與挪威邊境之間的 E10 是一條主要道路，其特徵是植被主要由**小型樺樹**組成，偶爾參雜一些[松樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r2w5fSrjknpLRGbg9)，並結合積雪的山脈；這些山脈通常可以在靠近基律納的遠處西方看到，而在你接近邊境時則四面八方都能看到。在道路的西半部北方，也可以看到一個[大湖泊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5ufEBehSjqCDNzoB8)。

text: The road to Ritsem can generally be recognised by having a large lake following it on the south, combined with having some of the most **dramatic mountains** seen on Street View in the country. The road is small and **without roadlines**, but still fairly well-paved. It is covered both in summer and in [early spring](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JMCi8nGa6w2UnrR89).
text_zh: 通往里特塞姆（Ritsem）的道路通常可以透過其南側伴隨著一個大湖，並結合了街景在國內少數幾個最**壯麗山脈**來識別。這條路很小且**沒有道路標線**，但鋪設得相當好。它涵蓋了夏天和[初春](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JMCi8nGa6w2UnrR89)的街景。

text: Most mountain roads in Sweden have been built below the treeline, resulting in small trees being visible on almost all coverage. The only paved road in Sweden above the treeline, with **no visible trees**, can be found on the border between Jämtland and Västerbotten, near the Norwegian border. The coverage was taken during fall, giving the limited vegetation a yellowish brown colour.
text_zh: 瑞典的大多數山路都是在樹木線下方建造的，導致幾乎所有街景覆蓋中都能看到小樹。瑞典唯一一條位於樹木線上方的鋪面道路、且**沒有可見的樹木**，可以在耶姆特兰（Jämtland）和西博滕（Västerbotten）之間的邊境、靠近挪威邊境處找到。該街景覆蓋拍攝於秋季，使得有限的植被呈現黃褐色。

text: The highest altitude public road in Sweden, which is a dirt road going straight over a **treeless mountain plateau**, was covered in Generation 4 on a cloudy day during summer.
NOTE: The [highest point](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7qKxyKSU7zahSE3b6) on the road features a parking spot and is right on top of the “Falkvålen” label.
text_zh: 瑞典海拔最高的公共道路是一條直接穿過**無樹山地高原**的泥土路，在夏天的陰天以第 4 代相機拍攝街景覆蓋。
注意：道路上的[最高點](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7qKxyKSU7zahSE3b6)有一個停車場，位置就在「Falkvålen」地名標籤的正上方。

text: In Kiruna it is very common to get a glimpse of one of the **two mountains** which have taken shape as a result of the local mine, one to the south and one to the north. On the side of both mountains, different layers in the shape of a staircase may be seen, which is a very strong indication of the town. The mountains may also be spotted from the [E10](https://www.google.se/maps/@67.9367934,20.0607115,3a,15y,144.61h,90.76t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s0P-SurA1W7DqNc1BVjlurw!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D0P-SurA1W7DqNc1BVjlurw%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D245.32181%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192) west of the town.
text_zh: 在基律納，非常常能瞥見因當地礦場而形成的**兩座山脈**之一，一座在南方，一座在北方。在兩座山的側面，可以看到階梯狀的不同地層，這是該城鎮非常強烈的特徵。從城鎮西側的 [E10](https://www.google.se/maps/@67.9367934,20.0607115,3a,15y,144.61h,90.76t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s0P-SurA1W7DqNc1BVjlurw!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D0P-SurA1W7DqNc1BVjlurw%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D245.32181%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192) 也能夠發現這些山脈。

text: In the town of Gällivare you can often see a mountain with a **smooth slope** and a **low tree line **to the southwest. No other town in Sweden has a natural treeless mountain in such close proximity.
text_zh: 在耶利瓦勒（Gällivare）鎮，你經常可以在西南方看到一座擁有**平緩山坡**和**低樹木線**的山。瑞典沒有其他城鎮能在如此近的距離內擁有天然的無樹山脈。

text: If you suspect you are on Gotland, and see small, **dry stony fields** with **small juniper bushes**, you are very likely to be on Fårö. This landscape becomes more extreme near the [north coast](https://goo.gl/maps/r5jtxajoWSd3VZso7) of the island.
text_zh: 如果你懷疑自己身在哥特蘭島（Gotland），並看到小型、**乾燥的石質田地**配上**小型杜松灌木**，你非常有可能身在法勒島（Fårö）。這種景觀在該島的[北海岸](https://goo.gl/maps/r5jtxajoWSd3VZso7)附近會變得更加極端。

text: Road 95 west of Arjeplog can be recognised by the Generation 4 **thawing snow** coverage in a **mountainous landscape**. The amount of snow significantly decreases as you go [further east](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LKbMcdV7kLzYfx7n8).
text_zh: 阿爾耶普卢格（Arjeplog）西側的 95 號公路可以透過**山地景觀**中的 Generation 4 **融雪**街景覆蓋來識別。當你[往東走](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LKbMcdV7kLzYfx7n8)時，雪量會顯著減少。

text: While the southern half of Switzerland is extremely mountainous, with long, thin valleys between the mountains, the northern half mostly consists of large farmlands on either flat ground or rolling hills, typically with forested hills in the distance.
text_zh: 瑞士南部半境極為多山，山與山之間有著狹長的山谷，而北部半境則大多由平地或緩丘的大片農田組成，遠處通常能見到長滿森林的山丘。

text: **Elevation** is an important part of region-guessing Switzerland. The southern half of Switzerland is extremely mountainous, while the northern half mostly has smaller mountains and hills.
text_zh: **海拔高度**是推測瑞士區域的重要依據。瑞士南部半境極為多山，而北部半境則多為較小的山脈和丘陵。

text: A fairly flat landscape with a long chain of medium-sized, forested mountains northwest means you are likely south of the Jura Mountains.
text_zh: 如果地勢相當平坦，且西北方有一長串中等高度、長滿森林的山脈，意味著你很可能位於汝拉山脈以南。

text: **Exposed limestone rocks**, protruding from forested hills, are commonly found in the Jura mountains.
text_zh: **裸露的石灰岩**自森林山丘中突顯出來，這在汝拉山脈一帶很常見。

text: **Rock walls** are mainly found in the Jura mountains, but can also be found in the Alps, particularly in the Italian speaking parts.
text_zh: **石牆**主要分佈於汝拉山脈，但在阿爾卑斯山也能見到，特別是在義大利語區。

text: If the area around your location appears hilly, but not mountainous, and you manage to catch a glimpse of a large lake to the south, with **tall mountains** on the other side, then you are very likely north of Lake Geneva.
text_zh: 如果你所在的位置周圍看似丘陵而非高山，且你瞥見南邊有一座大湖，湖對岸有**高聳的山脈**，那麼你極有可能位於日內瓦湖以北。

text: Seeing a wide lake to the northeast, situated in a landscape with relatively low elevation, means you should be looking at **Lake Constance **(on some Maps labelled as the Bodensee).
NOTE: Due to the low-lying landscape, you will probably be fairly close to the shore if you see the lake.
text_zh: 如果在海拔相對較低的景觀中看到東北方有一座寬闊的湖泊，這意味著你看到的應該是**博登湖**（Lake Constance，在地圖上有時標示為 Bodensee）。
註：由於地勢低窪，如果你看到該湖泊，你可能距離湖岸相當近。

text: The valley of Martigny has the highest density of **fruit plantations** in the country. It can easily be recognized by the many small fruit trees in combination with the wide, flat valley with large mountains on either side.
text_zh: 馬蒂尼山谷擁有全國最高的**果園**密度。透過許多小型果樹結合寬闊平坦的山谷以及兩側的高山，可以輕易辨認出這裡。

text: The central-eastern region that covers two-thirds of Taiwan consists of **forested mountains**.

The central mountain range that runs all the way to the south of the island is made up of tall mountains and rugged valleys. At high elevations, the vegetation can look **less tropical** and feature temperate or even coniferous trees.
text_zh: 佔全島三分之二面積的中東部地區則是**森林覆蓋的山地**。
貫穿至島嶼南端的中央山脈由高山與陡峭溪谷構成。在高海拔地區，植被會顯得**不那麼熱帶**，可見溫帶甚至針葉樹種。

text: The **Hualien-Taitung Valley** is a thin and long valley located on the east coast of the island passing from Hualien City at the north to Taitung City at the south. It is very recognizable as it consists of flat gentle plains surrounded by densely-forested mountains to the east and west.
NOTE: Most of the coverage on the east coast lies within this valley.
There are also other valleys in central Taiwan that can look similar.
text_zh: **花東縱谷**是位於東海岸的狹長谷地，北起花蓮市、南至台東市。特徵非常明顯：平緩的平原地帶，東西兩側被密林覆蓋的山脈夾住。
註：東海岸大部分的街景覆蓋都落在這條縱谷內。
台灣中部也有其他外觀相似的谷地。

text: The **Yilan Plain** is easily identifiable by the mountain ranges that are seen in the north, west, and south. Rice paddies are also extremely common as well as houses built right next to these fields.

NOTE: While the landscape on the surface can look quite similar to the valleys of Hualien and Taitung, unlike those two, you will almost never find mountains to the **east** in the plains of Yilan. Furthermore, the flat plains of Yilan are also generally more open.
text_zh: **蘭陽平原**很好認：北、西、南三面都看得到山脈。稻田極為常見，房舍常常就緊鄰田邊而建。
註：雖然地表景觀與花蓮、台東的縱谷頗為相似，但關鍵差別在於蘭陽平原的**東側**幾乎看不到山。此外宜蘭的平原整體也更為開闊。

text: Miaoli and Hsinchu share a landscape of **low rolling hills** and winding roads as well as sparse farmland with vegetation that can look messy and unkempt.
text_zh: 苗栗與新竹同樣是**低矮起伏丘陵**加蜿蜒道路的地貌，農田分布零散，植被常顯得雜亂未經整理。

text: Similarly, Taichung features these open plains surrounded by **low mountains** that are often in the distance.
text_zh: 台中則多為開闊平原，遠方常有**低矮山丘**環繞。

text: [Areca catechu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Areca_catechu), also known as **areca palms** or betel nut palms, are extensively found in central and southern Taiwan.
Areca palms are most common in the **mountainous** regions of Taiwan, you can still see dense areca palm patches in northern counties but they are few and far between.
text_zh: [檳榔](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Areca_catechu)，也就是**檳榔樹**，在中南部大量分布。
檳榔樹最常出現在台灣的**山區**。北部縣市雖然仍有成片檳榔園，但相當零星少見。
