text: **Tea plantations** are generally seen in mountainous areas all over Taiwan. You can find them commonly in Chiayi, Nantou, Hsinchu, and Miaoli.
text_zh: **茶園**普遍分布於全台山區，嘉義、南投、新竹、苗栗最為常見。

text: These **areca palm plantations** are mostly found in the county of Pingtung.

NOTE: Plantations in Pingtung are mainly found in neat, organised rows like these, in the flat plains. While in most central and southern counties, they will be found in the mountainous areas. Additionally, the counties further north will also rarely have areca palms in the flat plains of the west coast.
text_zh: 這種**檳榔園**主要出現在屏東。
註：屏東的檳榔園多半像這樣整齊排列在平原上；而中南部其他縣市的檳榔園則多位於山區。此外，越往北的縣市，西部平原上幾乎看不到檳榔樹。

text: The islands east of Taitung, Green Island and Orchid Island, are distinct due to the more **tropical** climate, abundance of coconut palms, and lush cliffs. Additionally, it is common to find run-down, **concrete** pavement.

NOTE: While the landscape between Green Island and Orchid Island are quite similar, a good way to distinguish the two is that Green Island frequently uses **yellow outer lines**. Additionally, Green Island is slightly more built-up.
text_zh: 台東東方的綠島與蘭嶼特徵鮮明：氣候更**熱帶**、椰子樹繁多、崖壁植被茂密，另外也常見老舊的**水泥**路面。
註：綠島與蘭嶼的地貌相當接近，但綠島經常使用**黃色邊線**，這是很好的分辨依據；此外綠島的開發程度也略高一些。

text: Lienchiang County, also referred to as the Matsu Islands, is recognizable from the hilly landscape and frequent use of **concrete roads**. The coverage is **overcast** and [this pavement](https://www.google.com/maps/@26.2025968,119.9695409,3a,48.8y,276.8h,91.84t,2.84r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3KR53okaioyHthx43kE3bQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) can also commonly be found.
text_zh: 連江縣（馬祖列島）可由丘陵地形與大量的**水泥路面**辨認。街景多為**陰天**拍攝，[這種路面](https://www.google.com/maps/@26.2025968,119.9695409,3a,48.8y,276.8h,91.84t,2.84r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3KR53okaioyHthx43kE3bQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也很常見。

text: This open landscape with forests of **short trees** surrounding a narrow **grassy road** can be found in Hualien in the flat parts of Guangfu and Fenglin. This area can be distinguished due to it being commonly covered in Generation 2; however, you can find [similar landscapes in Generation 3 and 4](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.6277781,121.4209628,3a,90y,116.32h,95.59t,0.07r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sKO9EMyTVK1jlvcEvATqKog!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 這種開闊地景 —— 狹窄的**雜草路面**兩旁圍繞著**矮樹林** —— 出現在花蓮光復與鳳林一帶的平坦地區。該區多為第二代街景覆蓋，可作為判斷依據；不過[第三代與第四代也找得到類似地景](https://www.google.com/maps/@23.6277781,121.4209628,3a,90y,116.32h,95.59t,0.07r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sKO9EMyTVK1jlvcEvATqKog!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: The Mount Kilimanjaro tripods show a **high altitude landscape**, with [dark grey rock](https://goo.gl/maps/Nmh8gJ1qkczsbrhGA) and in some places [eternal snow](https://goo.gl/maps/DuuFbspLtcPGZmqa6) in the distance. In some panos, you will see mountaineers and [tents](https://goo.gl/maps/SFEq7AFLiejDffT79).
text_zh: 吉力馬札羅山的三腳架拍攝點展現了**高海拔景觀**，遠處有[深灰色岩石](https://goo.gl/maps/Nmh8gJ1qkczsbrhGA)，有些地方甚至有[萬年積雪](https://goo.gl/maps/DuuFbspLtcPGZmqa6)。在某些全景圖中，你會看到登山客和[帳篷](https://goo.gl/maps/SFEq7AFLiejDffT79)。

text: A walking trekker goes through a large part of Gombe National Park. The landscape varies somewhat from place to place.
In the lowland parts, you will see **dense jungle** and usually very little sunlight, leading to dark coverage. Sometimes, you can see **chimpanzees**.
text_zh: 徒步拍攝者走過了貢貝國家公園的大部分地區。當地的景觀隨地點不同而有些許變化。
在低地地區，你會看到**茂密的叢林**，通常陽光很少，導致街景偏暗。有時，你可以看到**黑猩猩**。

text: On top of the hills, the trees make way for a bare **grassland** landscape. Here, you have breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape and Lake Tanganyika.
text_zh: 在山頂上，樹木讓位給光禿禿的**草原**景觀。在這裡，你可以欣賞到周圍景觀和坦干依喀湖的壯麗景色。

text: **Tall mountains** are most often seen in northwestern** **Thailand.
NOTE: Some parts of the southern peninsular part are also mountainous.
text_zh: **高山**最常出現在泰國的**西北部**。
注意：南部半島的一些地區也是多山地形。

text: Low, smooth and forested mountains can be found in the centre-north of the country.
text_zh: 低矮、平緩且有森林覆蓋的山脈可以在該國的中北部找到。

text: Steep mountains with a lot of **exposed rock** are most commonly found in the west and on the peninsula.
text_zh: 擁有大量**裸露岩石**的陡峭山脈最常見於西部和半島地區。

text: The **Phrao District** in Chiang Mai is a fairly flat valley surrounded by mountains in all directions. The valley will commonly grow rice and fruit.
text_zh: 清邁的**帕奧縣**（Phrao District）是一個相當平坦的河谷，四周環山。該河谷通常種植稻米和水果。

text: **Doi Luang Chiang Dao** is the 3rd tallest mountain in Thailand. It along with other distinctly shaped mountains can be seen clearly from the Chiang Dao district of Chiang Mai.
text_zh: **清道หลวง山**（Doi Luang Chiang Dao，譯註：保留泰文或音譯，此處照原文保留 Doi Luang Chiang Dao）是泰國第 3 高的山。它與其他外形獨特的山峰可以從清邁的清道縣清晰地看到。

text: A large and slightly jagged north-south mountain ridge runs through the middle of **Phayao**. It can be seen to the east from afar.
text_zh: 一條巨大且略為鋸齒狀的南北山脊貫穿**帕堯**（Phayao）的中部。從遠處向東望去可以看到它。

text: **Large north-south mountains** can be seen on either side of the Phetchabun valley.
text_zh: 在碧差汶（Phetchabun）河谷的兩側都可以看到**大型南北走向的山脈**。

text: These distinctly shaped mountains can be found in **southwestern Lopburi**.
text_zh: 這些外形獨特的山脈可以在**華富里西南部**找到。

text: The northern half of Saraburi consists of** large, exposed rock mountains** in an east-west orientation.
text_zh: 沙拉武里（Saraburi）的北部由東西走向的**大型裸露岩山**組成。

text: Chaiyaphum features **very long and flat mountain ridges** that can be seen from nearly anywhere in the province.
text_zh: 猜也奔的特色是**非常長且平坦的山脊**，幾乎從該省的任何地方都可以看到。

text: In northern Nakhon Phanom, along the Mekong River, you will sometimes see **jagged limestone karst mountains** to the northeast. These formations stand on the Lao side and are often visible from long distances.
text_zh: 在那空拍儂府（Nakhon Phanom）北部，沿著湄公河，有時會在東北部看到**鋸齒狀的喀斯特石灰岩山脈**。這些地形位於寮國一側，通常從很遠的地方就能看到。

text: Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park in western Prachuap Khiri Khan features large, distinct exposed rock mountain massifs. Notably, the mountains can be seen from the [center of the province](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SNn2WAdVCjAdX8mf9).
text_zh: 巴蜀府西部的拷森羅約國家公園（Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park）擁有大型、獨特的裸露岩石山體。值得注意的是，從[該省中心](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SNn2WAdVCjAdX8mf9)就能看到這些山脈。

text: Khao Sok National Park in northern Phang-nga and western Surat Thani features some of the **tallest and steepest exposed rock mountains** in the south of Thailand. The mountains generally run east-west.
text_zh: 攀牙府（Phang-nga）北部和素叻他尼府（Surat Thani）西部的考索國家公園（Khao Sok National Park）擁有泰國南部一些**最高且最陡峭的裸露岩山**。這些山脈大致呈東西走向。

text: Western Krabi and parts of eastern Phang-nga also feature **large exposed rock mountains** running north-south.
text_zh: 甲米（Krabi）西部和攀牙府東部的一部分也擁有南北走向的**大型裸露岩山**。

text: Tunisia has Mediterranean, dry and semidesert climates.
NOTE: In the second step, you will find more about region specific climate and landscape.
text_zh: 突尼西亞擁有地中海型、乾燥和半沙漠氣候。
註：在第二個步驟中，你會找到更多關於各地區特定氣候與景觀的資訊。

text: The area north of Tunis has a Mediterranean climate with hilly terrain. The region is very agricultural and at the time the coverage was captured, almost all fields laid fallow.
text_zh: 突尼斯以北地區屬地中海型氣候，地形多丘陵。該地區農業興盛，且在拍攝街景覆蓋時，幾乎所有田地都處於休耕狀態。

text: The large middle region between Hammamet and Gabes is very flat, and more arid. Olive tree plantations are common and the more south you go, the drier the landscape becomes.
text_zh: 哈馬馬特和加貝斯之間的大片中部地區非常平坦且更加乾旱。橄欖樹園很常見，而且越往南方走，地景就越乾燥。

text: South of Gabes is where the landscape changes into something more akin to a desert. A lot more rubbish and small white rocks can be found along the roads. Olive tree plantations are still somewhat common. A mountain range far in the distance is often visible to the southwest.
text_zh: 加貝斯以南的地形轉變為更類似沙漠的風貌。道路沿線可以發現更多的垃圾和白色小碎石。橄欖樹園仍然隨處可見。遠方地平線常可見到綿延的山脈。

text: The Turkish landscape ranges from arid in the [southeast](https://goo.gl/maps/LjNc6hYmCyfbay51A) to a Mediterranean landscape in the [southwest](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzXWMtN6TYYx4GG7). In the [north](https://goo.gl/maps/odAj9owBhLGwSmBH7) you will often find a more forested and lush landscape. The most typical landscape is semi-arid, either rolling or flat, with vast agricultural fields, containing very limited vegetation other than crops.
Beware that Turkey is a very naturally diverse country with many landscapes that are not mentioned in this tip.
text_zh: 土耳其的地景從[東南部](https://goo.gl/maps/LjNc6hYmCyfbay51A)的乾燥荒漠跨越到[西南部](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzXWMtN6TYYx4GG7)的地中海風貌。在[北部](https://goo.gl/maps/odAj9owBhLGwSmBH7)，你經常會發現森林密布且草木蔥鬱的地景。最具代表性的地景是半乾燥的起伏地形或平原，擁有廣闊的農田，除了農作物之外幾乎沒有什麼植被。
請注意，土耳其是一個自然多樣性極高的國家，有許多本提示未提及的地景。

text: Lake Van is by far the biggest lake in Turkey and has a semi-arid landscape, being surrounded by dry grassy hills and occasional trees and [agricultural fields](https://goo.gl/maps/LCwckUWMg8zV8yrX7) near the shore.
text_zh: 凡湖是土耳其最大的湖泊，擁有半乾旱景觀，岸邊環繞著乾燥的草地山丘、零星的樹木以及[農田](https://goo.gl/maps/LCwckUWMg8zV8yrX7)。

text: [Mount Ararat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Ararat), labelled as Ağrı Dağı on Google Maps, is a dormant volcano in far eastern Turkey and the **tallest mountain** in the country. It is often seen together with Küçük Ağrı, a smaller volcano to the southeast.
text_zh: [亞拉拉山](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Ararat)在 Google 地圖上標記為 Ağrı Dağı，是土耳其極東部的一座休眠火山，也是該國 **最高山峰**。它經常與東南較小的火山小亞拉拉山一同出現。

text: Road E99 south of Şanlıurfa is a divided highway which can be recognised by the slightly hazy Generation 4 sunrise coverage combined with the flat agricultural landscape and general south-north road angle.
text_zh: 尚勒烏爾法以南的 E99 公路是一條分隔公路，其特徵是帶有微霧的第四代日出街景覆蓋，結合平坦的農業景觀以及大致呈南北走向的道路角度。

text: The National Park is located in the northeastern parts of the country and mostly consists of a large savannah with **mountains** being visible in most directions. The most recognizable mountain range can be seen to the east and is visible in most of the coverage.
text_zh: 該國家公園位於該國東北部，主要由大片稀樹草原組成，多數方向都 **看得到山脈**。最容易辨識的山脈位於東方，在多數街景中都看得到。

text: The southern half of the north road in Kidepo is somewhat **forested**, and as such it may occasionally be hard to see the various mountains.
text_zh: 基代波北部道路的南半部有些許 **森林**，因此偶爾很難看見各個山脈。

text: The northern half of the north road in Kidepo is located in a savannah and can be easily recognised by the **wide mountain** to the north.
text_zh: 基代波北部道路的北半部位於稀樹草原中，透過北部的 **寬闊山脈** 可以輕易辨識。

text: The National Park is located by the northern end of Lake Albert and can commonly be recognized by the low** dirt barriers** along the side of the roads. A savannah can be seen in the western part, while the eastern parts contain many small trees and bushes. Apart from a fairly low and wide mountain range far away to the west, there are no mountains in the vicinity.
text_zh: 該公園位於阿爾伯特湖的北端，通常可以透過道路兩側低矮的 **泥土護欄** 來辨識。西部可以看到稀樹草原，而東部則包含許多小樹和灌木。除了遠處西方一處相當低矮且寬闊的山脈外，附近沒有其他山脈。

text: The park is located west of lake Victoria and has by far the **driest coverage** in the country. The grass is almost always completely dried out, which is normally enough to recognise it. Bushes and trees along the road also typically look very dry. The area is quite hilly, but not mountainous.
text_zh: 該公園位於維多利亞湖以西，擁有該國 **最乾燥的街景覆蓋**。草幾乎總是完全枯死，這通常足以識別它。路旁的灌木和樹木通常也看起來非常乾燥。該地區相當多山丘，但不到群山起伏的程度。

text: This is the **stereotypical rural round** in Ukraine:
- Generally bad road quality.
- A landscape that is usually flat or slightly hilly.
- A line of trees or bushes next to the road, with wide open agricultural fields beyond that.
- A lack of road infrastructure or buildings, until you reach the next urban area.
- Low amount of traffic.
text_zh: 這是烏克蘭**典型的鄉村街景**：
- 通常很差的道路品質。
- 通常平坦或微幅起伏的地形。
- 道路旁有一排樹木或灌木叢，再過去則是開闊的農田。
- 缺乏道路基礎設施或建築物，直到你到達下一個市區。
- 車流量低。

text: The [Carpathian Mountains](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukrainian_Carpathians) is an area in western Ukraine that is significantly **hillier** than the rest of the country, in some places bordering on mountainous. It is also much more forested, with very little agriculture, and a lot of pine trees. The roads going through it tend to be more curvy, rather than the straight highways found in the rest of the country.
text_zh: [喀爾巴阡山脈](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ukrainian_Carpathians)是烏克蘭西部的一個地區，其**地形比該國其他地區起伏得多**，某些地方甚至接鄰山區。這裡的森林也茂密得多，幾乎沒有農業活動，並有大量的松樹。穿過它的道路往往比較彎曲，而不像該國其他地區那樣是筆直的高速公路。

text: Towards the south, the climate becomes **warmer and drier**. The landscape is more arid. Forests are considerably more rare, and make way for shrubs and open fields. The difference is not extreme, but can become noticeable after some practice.
text_zh: 向南走，氣候變得**更暖和、更乾燥**。景觀更加荒涼。森林相當稀少，取而代之的是灌木叢和開闊的田野。這種差異並不極端，但在經過一些練習後會變得明顯。

text: The UAE typically features a flat **desert landscape**.
text_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國通常具有平坦的**沙漠景觀**。

text: **Mountains** are only found in the far east of the country.
text_zh: **山脈**僅分佈在該國的最東部。

text: You can easily recognise the Northern part of the emirate of Ras al Khaimah thanks to the **light-coloured mountains** visible to the east.
text_zh: 你可以透過東側可見的**淺色山脈**，輕鬆認出拉斯海瑪（Ras al Khaimah）大公國的北部。

text: If you see **mountains to the west**, and flatness to the east, you are likely near the Gulf of Oman, in the extreme East of the country.
text_zh: 如果你看到**西側有山脈**，而東側是平地，你可能位於阿曼灣附近，也就是該國的極東端。

text: The Scottish Highlands can be distinguished by the semi-barren, very **mountainous** landscape.
NOTE: A lot of Generation 4 coverage in the Highlands is from (early) spring, meaning that the vegetation often looks brown and yellow.
In addition, some of the most mountainous parts of [Wales](https://goo.gl/maps/DZCbKEo8L9PGxqDG9) and [Northern England](https://goo.gl/maps/RdTAYzq7X8exyYGx7) can look similar.
text_zh: 蘇格蘭高地可以透過半荒蕪、非常**多山**的景觀來辨識。
注意：高地上的許多第 4 代街景覆蓋來自（初）春，這意味著植被通常看起來呈棕色和黃色。
此外，[威爾斯](https://goo.gl/maps/DZCbKEo8L9PGxqDG9)和[英格蘭北部](https://goo.gl/maps/RdTAYzq7X8exyYGx7)的一些多山地區看起來可能也很相似。

text: Death Valley National Park can be easily recognized by the **dry, sandy, treeless mountains** that can be seen from the roads that go through the park. In Generation 3 coverage, the sky can look particularly [dusty](https://goo.gl/maps/aKvwrG5nAMKiyGhv6).
NOTE: Many smaller roads in Death Valley only have Generation 1 coverage.
text_zh: Death Valley National Park 可以透過穿過公園的道路上所看到的**乾燥、沙質、無樹木的山脈**輕易辨識。在第 3 代街景覆蓋中，天空看起來可能會特別[霧濛濛的](https://goo.gl/maps/aKvwrG5nAMKiyGhv6)。
注意：死谷（Death Valley）中的許多小路只有第 1 代街景覆蓋。

text: Along the Canadian border in Montana lies Glacier National Park. It is easily recognizable by its extremely tall and **steep mountain peaks**. Most coverage is also hazy and taken during summer.
NOTE: Other National Parks within the Rocky Mountain range of the US can have a similar appearance, so consider other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 位在蒙大拿州加拿大邊境沿線的是 Glacier National Park。它以極高且**陡峭的山峰**而容易被認出。大多數的街景覆蓋也呈現霧狀，且拍攝於夏季。
注意：美國洛磯山脈內的其它國家公園也可能呈現相似的外觀，因此在盲猜前請綜合考量其他線索。

text: In far Northeastern Wyoming lies Devil’s Tower, which is a **very tall, standalone butte** protruding from the surrounding land. This can sometimes be seen from many miles away because of the lack of nearby mountains.
text_zh: 位於懷俄明州極東北部的 Devil’s Tower，是一座從周圍土地拔地而起的**非常高且獨立的孤峰**。由於附近缺乏山脈，這座孤峰有時從數英里外就能看見。

text: This is the stereotypical Uruguay round. The coverage often, but not always, features **overcast** weather. Most of the landscape consists of open grasslands with gentle hills. Occasionally, you might see separated tree plantations. Roads are generally in worse condition than in neighbouring countries.
text_zh: 這是典型的烏拉圭回合。街景經常（但不總是）帶有**陰天**的天氣。大部分的景觀由帶有平緩丘陵的開闊草原組成。偶爾你會看到分離的樹木人工林。道路狀況通常比鄰國來得差。

text: As mentioned before, most of Uruguay is **slightly hilly**, even though the overall elevation is fairly low. Although it is by no means a mountainous country, roads generally have at least a slight incline.
Take note that this hilliness is usually very subtle: don’t expect immense rolling hills in most of the country.
NOTE: If your location is completely flat, consider that you might be in Argentina instead.
text_zh: 如前所述，烏拉圭大部分地區**稍微起伏有山丘**，儘管整體海拔相當低。雖然它絕對不是一個多山國家，但道路通常至少有輕微的坡度。
請注意，這種起伏通常非常微妙：在該國大部分地區不要期待有巨大的綿延起伏山丘。
注意：如果你的位置完全平坦，請考慮你可能實際上是在阿根廷。

text: The landscape near the town of Minas is recognizable: some of the **tallest hills** in the country, with lots of **exposed rocks**, and often [heavy bushland vegetation](https://goo.gl/maps/1ZNebpfyoL27cq6C9).
The image shown here is a fairly extreme example of this landscape, used for illustration purposes – usually it is more subtle. However, the exposed rock is always a good clue.

NOTE: The landscape in the Quebrada de los Cuervos nature reserve, situated further north, [can look similar](https://goo.gl/maps/eaDMYgJxi43cnmJK9). In addition, there are also very tall hills in the north of the country. However, these look different (see the tip below).
text_zh: 米納斯鎮附近的景觀很好認：擁有國內一些**最高的小山**，帶有許多**裸露的岩石**，且通常有[濃密的灌木叢植被](https://goo.gl/maps/1ZNebpfyoL27cq6C9)。
這裡展示的圖片是這種景觀相當極端的例子，僅供圖解說明之用——通常沒那麼明顯。不過，裸露的岩石始終是一個很好的線索。
注意：位於更北邊的烏鴉峽谷（Quebrada de los Cuervos）自然保護區內的景觀[看起來很相似](https://goo.gl/maps/eaDMYgJxi43cnmJK9)。此外，該國北部也有非常高的小山。然而，這些山看起來不一樣（見下方的提示）。

text: You can also find tall hills in the north of the country. These can be recognized by their noticeably **darker soil**. These hills also typically do not have the exposed rocks that are visible in the Minas hills.
The vegetation tends to be natural, and you will often see **tree plantations**.
This specific landscape tends to be most noticeable very close to the Brazil border, on Route 30 near Tranqueras.
text_zh: 你也可以在該國北部找到高山。這些山可以透過明顯**較黑的土壤**來辨識。這些小山通常也沒有米納斯山那種可見的裸露岩石。
植被傾向於自然生長，你經常會看到**植樹林**。
這種特定的景觀往往在非常靠近巴西邊境的地方最為明顯，也就是特蘭克拉斯（Tranqueras）附近的 30 號公路。

text: This unique Google car is found in the coastal town of **Cabo Polonio**. It can be recognized by the orange strap on the left.

The coverage is an off-road trekker line on the map. The town that it drives through has a unique vibe, consisting of [makeshift-looking shacks](https://goo.gl/maps/kFRyFRU2vKYk4qUc6), scattered around the seaside landscape. In some of the coverage, the car drives [on the beach](https://goo.gl/maps/TcgFWK775WANzTax8).
text_zh: 這個獨特的 Google 車可在海濱小鎮**卡波波洛尼奧**（Cabo Polonio）找到。它可以透過左側的橘色帶子來辨識。
這段街景是地圖上的越野徒步拍攝路線。它穿過的小鎮有著獨特的氛圍，由散落海濱景觀各處的[臨時搭建棚屋](https://goo.gl/maps/kFRyFRU2vKYk4qUc6)組成。在部分街景中，Google 車是開[在沙灘上](https://goo.gl/maps/TcgFWK775WANzTax8)。

text: This unique Google car is found in the **Valle del Lunarejo** natural park, located west of the town of Tranqueras. The car has a white front and a curved black backside with a brown strap.
The coverage is an off-road trekker line on the map. The car drives on a small track through a [grassy landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/uBVaJPJwiV9Ks2UX6).
NOTE: This park only shows up as a point of interest on the map, instead of the usual dark green polygon used for natural parks.
text_zh: 這個獨特的 Google 車可在**盧納雷霍谷**（Valle del Lunarejo）自然公園找到，位於特蘭克拉斯鎮的西側。這台車有著白色的車頭，以及帶有棕色帶子的彎曲黑色車尾。
這段街景是地圖上的越野徒步拍攝路線。Google 車行駛在一條穿過[草地景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/uBVaJPJwiV9Ks2UX6)的小徑上。
注意：這個公園在地圖上僅顯示為一個興趣點，而不是自然公園通常使用的深綠色多邊形。

text: Red and white striped concrete safety barriers are somewhat common on mountain roads.
text_zh: 紅白相間的混凝土安全護欄在山路上相當常見。

text: The **Central Highlands** region tends to have a landscape with a somewhat distinct vibe: often hilly with distant mountains, red soil, and often fairly dry, rolling agricultural fields. Additionally, the vegetation is a bit drier than in the rest of Vietnam (depending on the season).
text_zh: **中央高地**地區的風景往往帶有略微獨特的氛圍：通常是多山丘且遠處有山脈、紅土，而且通常是相當乾燥的緩坡農田。此外，植物比越南其他地區稍微乾燥一些（取決於季節）。

text: The coastal region northeast of Phan Thiết city is noticeably **dry and sandy**, compared to the typical Vietnamese landscape. Some parts of this region are [very rocky](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6tocNAdH2VVzMKpv6) as well.
text_zh: 潘切市東北方的沿海地區與典型的越南地景相比，顯得**乾燥且多沙**。該地區的某些部分也[非常多石](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6tocNAdH2VVzMKpv6)。

text: The Đồng Văn Karst Geopark in northern Hà Giang province, in the extreme northernmost tip of Vietnam, is characterized by a very distinct landscape: **rounded, pointy mountains** with relatively sparse vegetation, exposing the **very dark rocks** underneath.
NOTE: The broader region of northern Vietnam is also characterized by pointy mountains. The Geopark is unique because of the exposed rocks.
text_zh: 位於越南最北端的河江省北部同文岩石高原地質公園，其特徵是非常獨特的景觀：**圓形、尖銳的山峰**且植被相對稀疏，露出了底部的**極深色岩石**。
注意：較廣泛的越南北部地區也以尖山為特點。該地質公園的獨特之處在於外露的岩石。

text: A **single large mountain** in the middle of an otherwise completely flat landscape can be found just northeast of the city of Tây Ninh.
text_zh: 一座**孤立的大山**坐落在完全平坦的景觀正中間，位於西寧市東北方不遠處。

text: Sa Pa is a resort town deep in the northern mountains overflowing with touristy stores and restaurants with excessive signage, and palace-like grand hotels throughout the town. The architecture is a mixture of an [affluent European style](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fbuKyfSwu2fYfuVb9) and a more typical [southeast Asian style](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YuBdCAmfD2rs74it7).
text_zh: 沙壩是深山中的一個度假小鎮，充滿了遊客向的商店和餐廳、帶有過多招牌，以及鎮上各處如宮殿般的大型飯店。其建築融合了[富裕的歐洲風格](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fbuKyfSwu2fYfuVb9)和更典型的[東南亞風格](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YuBdCAmfD2rs74it7)。
